Our analysis identifies the Bayes-optimal reward as a teacher-to-negative log-density ratio and, under explicit assumptions, shows how persistent negatives anchor the discriminator and reduce reward-estimation MSE relative to fresh-negative training. Across two student families, three judges, and four judged-chat benchmarks, persistent-negative adversarial distillation consistently improves performance over current methods at matched discriminator compute. It also yields smoother fresh-policy discriminator trajectories, with fewer below-chance dips. These findings identify the discriminator's negative distribution as an important design axis in black-box on-policy distillation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出持久负样本(Persistent Negatives)对抗蒸馏方法,解决黑盒在线策略蒸馏中判别器负样本分布随策略更新而"移动目标"的问题,通过维护历史prompt-matched教师-学生对比池来稳定判别器奖励学习,同时保持GRPO策略更新的完全on-policy特性。
AI.motivation: 在黑盒在线策略蒸馏(OPD)中,对抗蒸馏方法(如GAD)通过学习判别器对prompt匹配的教师和学生响应进行评分,将其分数作为策略奖励。然而,判别器的负样本仅从当前学生策略采样,每次策略更新后负分布都会改变,导致奖励学习面临"移动目标"问题——某些失败模式可能从最新rollout中消失,但学生仍可能再次产生这些响应。现有方法未充分利用历史对比信息来稳定判别器训练。
AI.method: 提出持久负样本对抗蒸馏(Persistent-Negative Adversarial Distillation):维护一个有界的历史对比池(4096条完整prompt-matched的(x, y_T, y_S)三元组),在每个判别器batch中,用比例ρ=0.5的历史对比替换新鲜对比。负分布变为q_t^ρ = (1-ρ)π_θ_t + ρh_t的混合。GRPO仍然使用从当前学生采样的新鲜响应计算优势函数,保持完全on-policy。理论上证明了Bayes最优Bradley-Terry分数为教师分布与负分布的log密度比(定理4.1),证明了持久负样本对历史损失和判别器曲率的下界(命题1),并在偏差-方差条件下证明持久负样本降低奖励MSE(命题2)。
AI.result: 在两个学生模型家族(Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct)、三个评判模型(Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct、Qwen3.5-27B、Gemma-3-27B-IT)和四个评判对话基准(LMSYS、Dolly、Vicuna/MT-Bench、Self-Instruct)上的实验表明:在匹配判别器计算量条件下,持久负样本方法一致优于仅使用当前负样本的GAD,等集加权增益为+1.0至+2.0个百分点;相对于未蒸馏基线增益为+1.7至+5.3个百分点。在24个学生-评判-数据集组合中全部为正增益。判别器轨迹更平滑,时间标准差从0.087降至0.068,最低准确率从0.414提升至0.461,低于机会水平的次数从6次降至1次。
AI.conclusion: 本文识别出判别器负分布是黑盒对抗蒸馏中的一阶设计选择。持久负样本方法通过利用历史prompt-matched对比稳定判别器奖励学习,同时保持策略更新的on-policy特性,提供了一种有效且理论支撑的方案来缓解移动目标问题。该方法在多模型、多评判、多基准设置下均表现出一致改进,并改善了判别器训练稳定性。

title: Robust to Which Model Change? A Unified Evaluation of Robust Counterfactual Explanations
summary: Robust counterfactual explanations promise recourse that still works after the model behind it changes. Whether they keep that promise depends on what the change is. A small perturbation of the parameters, retraining on new data, and a new architecture are different events, and each existing method is evaluated against the one it was built for. Reported robustness scores, therefore, answer different questions and cannot be compared. We propose a unified cross-family evaluation protocol that holds factual instances and generated counterfactuals fixed while testing every method against the same eight types of model change. The benchmark compares six robust methods and two standard baselines on four tabular datasets. It characterizes every changed classifier through its outputs and reports empirical robustness together with coverage, base validity, and proximity. We find that relative performance and failure modes vary across change families. Bounded parameter perturbations change 0.95\% of test predictions on average, compared with 4.9\% for bootstrap retraining. Methods with guarantees for these perturbations do not necessarily transfer to other changes. RobX transfers most consistently in our experiments, although greater stability can require larger interventions. We argue that robust CFE methods should be evaluated through a common protocol that specifies the model changes, measures their realized behavioral magnitude, and keeps generation performance separate from robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现有鲁棒反事实解释（CFE）方法的评估结果因各自针对不同的模型变更类型而不可比较，提出统一跨家族评估协议，在四个表格数据集、八类模型变更上对比六种鲁棒方法和两种基线，发现方法排名因变更家族而异，针对参数扰动的鲁棒性不能迁移到重训练等场景。
AI.motivation: 鲁棒CFE方法（ROAR、RBR、RobX、BetaRCE、RNCE、APΔS等）各自针对不同类型的模型变更（如参数扰动、分布模糊集、集成重训练等）设计并评估，导致已发表的鲁棒性分数回答不同问题、无法横向比较，限制了对模型变更鲁棒性的真实衡量与实际部署选择。
AI.method: 提出统一跨家族评估协议：固定事实实例和生成的CFE，在4个表格数据集（Breast Cancer、Diabetes、Wine Quality、HELOC）上训练5个MLP基础分类器，对每个基础模型构造8类变更家族（重新初始化、自助重采样、数据删除/新增、标签更新、训练配置变更、架构变更、ℓ∞参数扰动）各25个模型变体（共1000/数据集）；通过预测不一致率和概率MAE刻画变更幅度；独立报告覆盖率、基础有效性、经验鲁棒性、端到端鲁棒性和接近度；分离用于生成/调参的模型与评估用模型。
AI.result: 主要发现：(1) 方法排名随变更家族改变；(2) 鲁棒性证书在其作用域内有效但不迁移——APΔS在有界参数扰动下经验鲁棒性94–100%，但在新初始化下仅11%、架构变更下16%；(3) 不同变更家族改变预测的程度差异显著：自助重采样改变4.92%硬预测，架构4.69%，新初始化4.57%，而参数扰动仅0.95%；(4) RobX在各家族最一致地传递鲁棒性（最低≥99.4%），但需要更大干预；(5) ROAR-LIME和APΔS单独的鲁棒性分数会掩盖生成失败或低基础有效性问题；(6) 鲁棒性以距离增大为代价。
AI.conclusion: 作者主张以统一协议评估鲁棒CFE方法：明确指定的变更模型集合、用输出空间度量（预测不一致率、概率MAE）刻画实际变更幅度、单独报告生成能力指标与鲁棒性，并分离调参模型池与评估模型池；正式证书的结论仅限于其声明的变更类型，实践者应根据部署模型预期承受的更新类型与方法所需的干预代价选择方法。

title: Estimating and Orthogonalizing Unknown Pre-training Gradients for Continual Fine-tuning of Large Language Models
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026. 29 pages, 3 figures. Code: this https URL
summary: Continual fine-tuning is essential for large language models (LLMs) to dynamically adapt to real-world environments, yet it inevitably suffers from catastrophic forgetting, particularly the performance degradation of previous tasks and LLMs' general-purpose knowledge. Although existing methods, such as orthogonal gradient projection, mitigate the forgetting across various fine-tuning tasks, they fundamentally fail to preserve pre-training LLMs' inherent general-purpose knowledge because the original data and gradients of off-the-shelf pre-training LLMs required by these methods are strictly unknown and highly diverse. To bridge this critical gap, we propose EoupCT, a novel framework designed to Estimate and Orthogonalize Unknown Pre-training gradients for Continual LLM fine-Tuning. Specifically, EoupCT estimates pre-training gradients by dynamically generating pseudo data that is most susceptible to forgetting for new tasks through a learnable soft prompt equipped with Gumbel-Softmax relaxation. Furthermore, we formulate a multi-objective optimization problem and introduce a first-order efficient Pareto optimizer that jointly optimizes LLM parameters and the soft prompt, rigorously enforcing orthogonality between new task updates and the estimated pre-training gradients. Extensive experiments across multiple LLMs demonstrate that EoupCT effectively preserves both task-specific proficiency and inherent general-purpose knowledge, successfully mitigating the catastrophic forgetting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EoupCT框架，通过可学习软提示与Gumbel-Softmax松弛估计未知预训练梯度，并结合一阶Pareto优化器在新任务梯度与估计的预训练梯度之间强制正交，有效缓解大语言模型持续微调中的灾难性遗忘问题，在6个LLM上验证了其对任务专精能力与通用知识的双重保护效果。
AI.motivation: 现有正交梯度投影方法（如OLoRA、InfLoRA）仅在已知下游任务梯度间施加正交约束，但无法保护预训练LLM的通用知识，因为预训练数据和梯度对下游用户而言是未知的且高度多样化的，这导致持续微调过程中通用能力的持续退化。
AI.method: 方法包含两大模块：(1) 预训练梯度估计——通过可学习软提示P_t配合Gumbel-Softmax松弛在冻结的预训练LLM上自回归生成可微的伪数据S(P_t)，并以新旧LLM表征的MSE蒸馏损失作为稳定目标；(2) Pareto正交优化——将软提示优化与LLM参数优化构建为多目标问题，通过虚拟步近似（一阶Taylor展开）规避Hessian计算，以四步一阶过程实现：新任务梯度计算→历史零空间投影→与保护梯度冲突时的Pareto投影→联合参数更新。三个关键约束为正交性（任务间、任务与预训练间、预训练间）、脆弱性（生成最易遗忘的伪数据）和可塑性（新任务学习）。
AI.result: 在Qwen3/Llama3/Gemma2三大家族共6个LLM（2B至9B）、SuperNI的15个任务3种顺序及MMLU基准上的实验显示，EoupCT相比OLoRA、CLoRA、LoRAMoE等SOTA方法平均准确率提升3.5%、遗忘率降低3.7%，且计算开销仅为标准LoRA的2.0倍（低于CLoRA的2.6倍和LoRAMoE的3.2倍）；消融实验验证了脆弱性目标、预训练间正交、任务-预训练正交、任务间正交四个约束的必要性；附录提供三个理论定理分别证明Gumbel-Softmax松弛的O(τ)近似误差、Pareto投影的解析最优性以及对抗性局部保护对全局分布的泛化保证。
AI.conclusion: EoupCT首次实现了在无需访问原始预训练数据条件下对预训练梯度的估计与正交化，通过可微伪数据生成与一阶Pareto优化器的协同设计，为持续LLM微调中的灾难性遗忘问题提供了一种兼顾任务专精与通用知识保留的高效解决方案，但仍存在软提示长度限制表征能力和生成过程带来额外计算开销的局限。

title: PORL: Pretrained Offline Reinforcement Learning for the Job Shop Scheduling Problem
comment: This paper has been accepted for presentation at the IEEE 10th International Conference on Computational Systems and Information Technology for Sustainable Solutions (CSITSS 2026)
summary: The Job Shop Scheduling Problem (JSSP) is a fundamental combinatorial optimization problem in industrial optimization. This work introduces Pretrained Offline Reinforcement Learning (PORL), a hybrid approach that combines simulation-based online pretraining with offline fine-tuning on production-specific data. Reinforcement learning through online interaction enables exploration of general scheduling strategies, but typically relies on simulation environments and may suffer from a simulation-to-reality gap. In contrast, offline RL avoids direct interaction with the environment by learning from historical data, but its performance is strongly influenced by dataset quality and coverage. PORL combines the strengths of both paradigms by first learning a general scheduling policy through online interaction and subsequently adapting it offline to a target distribution. A KL-divergence-based policy constraint is introduced to limit deviations from the pretrained policy during fine-tuning. The approach is evaluated on JSSP instances with distribution shift and datasets generated from heuristic, noisy-expert, and random behavioral policies. The results show that PORL consistently achieves lower optimality gaps than standalone offline RL and the considered general scheduling baselines. Furthermore, its advantage over standalone offline RL increases as dataset quality decreases, indicating reduced sensitivity to the quality and coverage of the available offline data. The results suggest that offline adaptation of pretrained policies is a promising approach for industrial scheduling environments where direct online exploration is impractical.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于作业车间调度问题（JSSP）的预训练离线强化学习（PORL）框架。该框架先通过在线仿真训练获得通用调度策略，再使用基于KL散度的策略约束进行离线微调，以适应目标生产分布。实验表明，PORL在分布偏移和低质量数据集下均优于独立离线RL和传统调度基线。
AI.motivation: 在线强化学习依赖仿真环境，存在仿真到现实的差距；离线强化学习虽无需环境交互，但性能受限于数据集质量与覆盖范围。工业调度中在线探索代价高昂且风险大，亟需一种能结合两者优势、减少对离线数据依赖的混合训练方法。
AI.method: 方法包含两阶段：1）在线预训练阶段，使用DQN算法在标准15×15均匀分布JSSP实例上学习通用调度策略；2）离线微调阶段，将预训练Q网络权重迁移至CQL-DQN框架，并通过基于softmax变换的KL散度正则化项约束微调策略不偏离预训练参考策略。总体损失为L_DQN + L_CQL + L_KL，采用学习率和CQL正则化系数的渐进式调整策略以稳定多目标优化。模型采用基于异构图（操作节点与机器节点）的GNN（Graph Isomorphism Network）架构。
AI.result: 在10×15高分布偏移实例上，PORL的最优性差距为11.54%±0.35%，相比独立离线RL（12.48%±0.63%）相对降低7.5%，相比在线PPO基线（16.19%）相对降低28.7%，并优于Flow Due Date/Most Work Remaining启发式规则（13.63%）。在heuristic、noisy-expert和random三种数据集下，PORL均优于离线RL，且优势随数据质量下降而增大：noisy-expert下PORL为13.19% vs 离线RL 16.89%；random下PORL为21.08% vs 离线RL 26.60%。初步消融实验表明移除KL正则化会导致性能退化至25%。
AI.conclusion: PORL通过"先在线预训练、后离线微调"的反向混合范式，有效结合了在线探索的广泛性与离线适应的针对性，显著降低了对数据集质量和覆盖范围的敏感性。该框架在工业调度场景中具有应用前景，尤其是在无法进行在线探索且离线数据质量有限的场景。未来工作将聚焦于更大规模问题、真实生产数据集以及不同分布偏移程度对PORL性能的影响研究。

title: Does Uniform Discrete Diffusion Need Time?
summary: Uniform discrete diffusion models (UDMs) commonly use explicit time conditioning, but we find that it can often be unnecessary in practice. In this paper, we first show that the population-optimal UDM predictor generally depends on time: time controls how much the model should trust the observed context. We then show that this dependence can become negligible in finite-data settings relevant to language. When a corrupted training sequence remains much closer to its original clean sequence than to competing training sequences, the empirical-optimal predictor is nearly insensitive to time over most of the diffusion trajectory, where the guarantee weakens toward the high-noise endpoint. Empirically, trained language UDMs exhibit limited time sensitivity over most of the trajectory, while time-agnostic predictors remain competitive with, and often outperform, time-conditioned models across datasets and training objectives. These results challenge the use of explicit time conditioning in UDMs: although the population optimum depends on time, explicitly conditioning on it may often be unnecessary in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了均匀离散扩散模型(UDM)中对显式时间条件化的必要性。作者证明：虽然在总体最优层面UDM预测器依赖于时间以控制对观测上下文的信任程度，但在有限数据的语言场景中，源序列与竞争序列之间存在较大的汉明分离间隔，导致经验最优预测器在大部分扩散轨迹上对时间几乎不敏感（仅在高噪声端点附近减弱）。实证结果显示时间无关(time-agnostic)模型在多个数据集和训练目标上与时间条件化模型表现相当甚至更优，提示显式时间条件化在多数情况下并非必需。
AI.motivation: 近年来UDM被扩展到大规模语言建模（如DiffusionGemma、Uno），但其是否真正需要显式时间条件化（与MDM形成对比）尚不清楚。明确时间在UDM中的作用，对于简化架构、训练和采样设计具有重要意义。
AI.method: 从三个层面系统分析：(1)在总体层面，刻画最优预测器关于时间依赖性的结构，证明时间仅通过匹配上下文数量M^i的权重来影响预测，并提出Fisher时间敏感度的精确公式；(2)在有限数据层面，推导出匹配计数优势Δ与Fisher敏感度上界的关系，分离间隔越大则时间敏感度越低；(3)在语言数据上实证验证间隔假设，并在Duality和LOO+CE框架下对比time-agnostic/time-variant/hybrid模型的困惑度与生成质量。
AI.result: OWT数据呈现高汉明分离（d(x)中位数为988），且在t≤0.933范围内满足6-可分性，对应oracle Fisher敏感度上界≤10⁻⁵。在LM1B和OWT上，时间无关模型与时间条件化模型困惑度相当（LM1B LOO+CE: 28.93 vs 30.15），hybrid模型（仅在t>0.8使用时间调制）几乎与全时间条件模型一致；生成PPL与样本熵在多种NFE下也接近。
AI.conclusion: 问题不在于"时间是否对UDM重要"，而在于"在哪一时间段重要到需要显式条件化"。在绝大多数扩散轨迹上时间依赖性可忽略，使得time-agnostic UDM成为可行且有竞争力的设计选择，并有望推动更简单的架构、训练和采样方法的发展。

title: The Linear Representation Hypothesis for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: The linear representation hypothesis (LRH) has become a standard lens for measuring and intervening on semantic information through the internal representations of large language models (LLMs). A growing body of work has begun extending this perspective to vision-language-action (VLA) models, but the dynamical nature of embodied interaction introduces an additional challenge. Unlike semantic attributes commonly studied in LLMs, such as gender or language, a physical quantity of interest (QoI) in a VLA evolves jointly with the system dynamics: the representation influences the actions selected by the policy, which alter the physical state and, in turn, the next representation. In this paper, we develop a theoretical, signature-based formulation of the LRH for VLA that unifies representations and policies. On the representation side, we establish the existence of representations from which the future evolution of a QoI under a candidate action trajectory can be recovered via linear probing. On the policy side, we introduce a signature generalized linear model for stochastic action chunks. This structure yields a monotonic change in the expected future QoI along linear paths in natural parameter space, enabling linear steering. We construct an explicit oracle representation in a planar control-affine navigation experiment and verify the predicted linear probing and steering mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文将LLM中的线性表示假设(LRH)扩展到视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型。针对VLA中物理量与系统动力学耦合的挑战，提出基于路径签名(signature)的理论框架，统一表示与策略：在表示端证明存在共享线性表示使传播物理量可通过线性探针恢复；在策略端引入签名广义线性模型，证明沿自然参数空间的线性路径可使期望物理量单调变化，实现线性引导。通过平面导航实验验证理论。
AI.motivation: LLM中LRH已成熟，但VLA中物理量随系统动力学演化（表征影响动作→动作改变状态→状态影响下一表征），传统静态语义量的线性表示理论无法直接迁移，亟需针对这种动态耦合的理论框架。
AI.method: 1. 将VLA建模为控制仿射系统，定义传播物理量QoI ψ(F_u(x))；2. 构造性证明（基于Chen-Fliess展开）：存在共享表示λ和签名因子化测量映射γ_ψ=L_ψ∘S，使得ψ(F_u(x))≈⟨λ(x),γ_ψ(u)⟩（线性探针）；3. 定义签名指数族策略π_λ，赋予统计流形对偶平坦几何；4. 通过反向KL投影到常数QoI超平面，得到线性引导路径λ_α=λ(x)+αλ_ψ(x)，并证明期望QoI关于α单调非减（导数等于方差）；5. 在平面导航oracle实验中数值验证。
AI.result: Chen-Fliess展开在满足解析性、有界控制等条件下局部一致收敛，探针误差可用q_K^N/(1-q_K)界定；线性引导保证J_ψ,x(α)单调非减；在671个候选动作块的oracle实验中，探针精度达3×10⁻¹⁶，引导斜率与策略方差匹配至10⁻¹¹，α∈{0,4,8}时传播p_y从0.000单调增至+0.255。
AI.conclusion: 本文为VLA模型建立了基于路径签名的LRH理论框架，统一了线性探针（表示端）与线性引导（策略端）。该框架将现有VLA的实证探针工作解释为特殊情形，为预训练VLA表示的几何分析提供了理论基础，但实际VLA策略（扩散/流匹配）的兼容性及有限探针误差下的鲁棒性仍需进一步研究。

title: G$^2$PTQ: Improving LLM Post-Training Quantization with Generalized Gradient Compensation
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is a practical approach to reducing the memory and computational footprint of large language models (LLMs) without retraining. GPTQ-based methods have become the de facto standard, yet they suffer from two complementary limitations. Methods with local, layer-wise objectives lack global supervision; while methods with global objectives fix their Hessian estimates at the start and ignore first-order gradients, so their guidance grows stale as quantization proceeds. This paper presents G$^2$PTQ, a unified PTQ framework with Generalized Gradient Compensation that integrates both first- and second-order information under a globally supervised, block-wise optimization objective. By refreshing gradient and Hessian estimates before quantizing each Transformer block, G$^2$PTQ avoids the staleness of prior global methods. Furthermore, to stabilize the exact first-order compensation, we introduce a trust-region scaling mechanism that dynamically bounds the gradient step to prevent exploding weight updates. Finally, we derive efficient implementations for block-wise Hessian approximation and exact gradient compensation. Experimental results on various model families and bit-widths demonstrate that G$^2$PTQ enables better alignment with the full-precision model, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines. Code is available at: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出G²PTQ，一种统一的LLM训练后量化框架，通过广义梯度补偿将一阶和二阶信息整合在全局监督的逐块优化目标下。它在量化每个Transformer块之前刷新梯度和Hessian估计以保持补偿信号的时效性，并通过信赖域缩放机制稳定精确一阶补偿，最终在多种模型家族和位宽上优于现有最优方法。
AI.motivation: 现有GPTQ类PTQ方法存在两类互补缺陷：(1) GPTQ、QuIP等采用逐层MSE目标，缺乏全局监督；(2) OAC、GuidedQuant等采用全局目标（NLL/KL），但Hessian估计在量化开始前一次性计算且固定不变，忽略了权重逐步量化后估计变得陈旧的问题。同时，FOEM虽引入一阶项却依赖仅对逐层MSE精确的Taylor近似，无法应用于块级MSE或KL等更具表达力的目标。两种缺陷在现有方法中从未被同时解决。
AI.method: 方法包含三项核心技术：(1) 逐块优化目标——对每个Transformer块，中间块使用块级MSE、最后一块使用KL散度，并将输出分布与全精度块对齐；(2) 刷新信息机制——量化每个块前对该块单独做一次反向传播，获取新鲜的梯度和Hessian估计，避免估计陈旧；(3) 信赖域缩放机制——通过动态缩放因子β将一阶更新步限制在二阶近似的最优不超α倍的预算内，防止精确一阶梯度补偿引发权重更新爆炸。此外推导了基于Fisher信息矩阵的块级Hessian近似、精确一阶梯度的递归高效实现（复杂度O(max{d_col³, d_row·d_col²})，匹配原GPTQ）及lazy-batch更新策略，并使用Triton内核融合与分布式量化扩展至大规模MoE。
AI.result: 在15个模型（0.6B–125B，含13个密集模型和2个MoE）上、2/3/4位权重量化及4位权值-激活量化下全面评估。W2A16设置下，G²PTQ*平均KL散度从GPTAQ的1.83降至0.90，QA准确率提升6.45%；LLaMA3-70B 4位权值-激活量化下QA准确率较GPTAQ提升4.56%；125B Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 4位量化下QA准确率仅下降0.33%，推理基准上几乎无损。消融研究证实块级对齐、刷新信息、精确梯度和KL对齐均有正向贡献，去掉信任域会导致模型崩溃（QA准确率从39.83%降至28.97%）。8B模型量化仅需2.24小时和12.54GB单卡显存。
AI.conclusion: G²PTQ通过统一的块级优化目标同时整合一阶和二阶梯度补偿，刷新策略确保补偿信号时效，信赖域机制保证数值稳定。其高效实现使大规模LLM量化实用可行，在多个模型家族和位宽上均达到当前最优的全精度对齐效果。

title: DynBranch: Speculative Subgraph Reuse for Dynamic Agentic LLM Serving
summary: Agentic LLM workflows decide their execution paths at runtime. Downstream computation may be predictable, or may have run before, yet it cannot begin until the model or the user resolves the branch. We call this serialization the branch-resolution barrier. Caching alone does not hide it: the key that identifies a reusable result is not known until then. In this paper, we propose DynBranch, which makes an unresolved branch addressable before it resolves. Its stable coordinate lets candidate subgraphs run during resolution and completed subgraph results be reused across later requests. A two-level controller admits this work when its expected benefit exceeds the load price. DynBranch sits at the model-API boundary and requires no changes to agent harnesses or model execution engines. Across four agentic workloads with Qwen3-32B on 4x H200 GPUs, DynBranch reduces mean latency by up to 32% over each workload's strongest prior system and by 46-66% against a no-reuse floor, while preserving workflow results. The benefit persists across backbone families and on a commodity Qwen3-8B/RTX 4090 deployment.

AI.tldr: DynBranch提出了一种面向动态Agentic LLM工作流的推测性子图复用系统，通过在分支解析前的"分支-解析屏障"期间利用稳定坐标启动候选子图的预执行，并结合基于负载定价的双层准入控制器，实现跨请求的子图复用与早期填充，从而显著降低延迟。
AI.motivation: Agentic LLM工作流在运行时动态决定执行路径，下游计算必须串行等待模型或用户做出分支决策（即"分支-解析屏障"）。研究表明45-57%的端到端延迟属于解析屏障后的串行时间，现有缓存机制因键在解析前未知而无法隐藏该延迟，且推测执行的结果仅限当前请求使用，跨请求复用困难。
AI.method: DynBranch在模型API边界处运行，无需修改agent框架或推理引擎。核心机制包括：(1) C1 共享子图复用——以子图指纹与渲染输入哈希作为复用名称，结合反向索引追踪外部读取的依赖新鲜度；(2) C2 早期填充——利用分支坐标（决策点在模板中的稳定标识）在解析前启动候选子图执行，结果作为不可见"影子"存储，需匹配且新鲜的标准需求授权后方可提升；(3) C3 负载定价准入——两级控制器（Action 0分支级UCB门控预测开销，Action 1填充级效用阈值权衡预期收益与对标准请求的延迟代价），使用因果负载包络ρ̄_H跟踪当前decode与KV占用。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-32B/4×H200配置下，DynBranch在四种agentic工作负载（Routing、ReAct、Sub-Agent、HCI）上较各自最强基线系统平均延迟降低最高达32%，较无复用基线降低46-66%；纯早期填充（C1关闭）在模型驱动路径上降低8.5-34.4%，在HCI用户等待路径上降低46.6-47.7%。在Qwen3-8B/RTX4090消费级部署上同样保持6.9-37.6%的改进。任务准确性与无复用基线一致，工作流结果无损。
AI.conclusion: DynBranch通过将未解析分支视为可寻址的服务状态，在分支解析屏障期间实现跨请求的子图复用与早期填充，结合负载定价的双层准入控制，在不修改agent框架或推理引擎的前提下显著降低动态agentic LLM工作流的延迟。其契约仅要求命名决策点与可幂等执行的安全阶段，适用于形状在运行时确定的工作流，且负载定价使其在空闲到饱和负载下均能保持有效性。

title: Bayesian Optimization with Fisher Information Geometry: Gradient Bounds and Trust-Region Methods
summary: We study Bayesian optimization (BO) through the lens of information geometry. Pulling back the Fisher information metric through the surrogate posterior map yields a local sensitivity tensor on the input space, which leads to an upper bound on the gradient of reparameterizable acquisition functions. This view explains vanishing-gradient behavior in high-dimensional BO and provides a common interpretation of heuristics such as RAASP and dimension-scaled lengthscales. Building on this analysis, we propose FITR, a trust-region-based BO method that replaces lengthscale-based scaling by local pullback-Fisher weights. FITR is not restricted to GP kernels with explicit lengthscales. On GP benchmarks with an SE kernel, experiments show competitive performance using FITR. The proposed method also easily generalizes to non-isotropic surrogates, although the gains are more task-dependent in that setting.

AI.tldr: 本文从信息几何视角研究贝叶斯优化（BO），通过将Fisher信息度量沿代理后验映射拉回输入空间，推导出采集函数梯度的因子化上界，并据此解释了高维BO中梯度消失现象及RAASP、维度缩放长度尺度等启发式方法的共同机制。基于此分析，提出FITR方法，用局部拉回Fisher权重替代TuRBO中基于长度尺度的信任区域形状构造，可推广至非各向同性代理。
AI.motivation: 高维贝叶斯优化（HDBO）中，采集函数（AF）优化常因维度升高而出现梯度消失问题，导致内层优化失效。已有解决方案包括维度缩放的长度尺度先验、RAASP初始化和信任区域方法，但这些启发式方法之间缺乏统一的理论解释。本文旨在从信息几何的角度提供一个统一的分析框架，揭示代理模型在输入空间上诱导的局部几何与采集函数梯度行为的内在联系。
AI.method: 方法包括三个核心部分：(1) 将代理模型视为从输入空间到预测分布统计流形的平滑映射，通过Fisher-Rao度量的拉回构造拉回Fisher张量g_t(x)；(2) 通过链式法则与Cauchy-Schwarz不等式，推导出采集函数梯度范数的上界‖∇_x α‖² ≤ C_α(θ)·tr(g_t(x))，将AF梯度分解为采集侧敏感度C_α和拉回张量迹tr(g_t)的乘积；(3) 基于此理论提出FITR方法，用对角正则化拉回Fisher权重重塑TuRBO的信任区域，使其适用于任意可微概率代理，包括非显式长度尺度核（如IBNN核）。
AI.result: 在GP+SE核的九个标准HDBO基准测试上，FITR-REI在多个问题上优于TuRBO-REI，在其余问题上与DSP、BOUNCE等强基线保持竞争力。对角近似版本的FITR优于完整张量版本（FullFITR）。在IBNN核（非各向同性代理）上的迁移性实验表明FITR可推广到非长度尺度核，但增益更具任务依赖性。论文严格证明了在p≠1/2的长度尺度缩放下，tr(g_t)会指数或多项式衰减，从而解释了HDBO中AF梯度消失现象。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了BO的信息几何视角，将AF梯度范数因子化为采集侧敏感度与代理诱导几何（拉回Fisher张量迹）的乘积。这一分解统一解释了高维BO中维度缩放长度尺度（λ=Θ(√D_x)是唯一避免trace崩溃的临界缩放）和RAASP局部初始化的有效性。基于此提出的FITR方法是一种不依赖显式长度尺度的信任区域方法，在SE核基准上表现良好，并可推广到非各向同性代理。未来工作包括完整旋转Fisher区域的边界处理以及非长度尺度核的更深入理论分析。

title: From Shortcut Learning to Discrete Neural Insertion Sort
summary: Neural algorithmic reasoning aims to train neural networks to follow known algorithms and generalize beyond the input sizes seen during training. However, correct final outputs and intermediate supervision do not necessarily show that a model follows the intended execution. We study this problem using insertion sort. Our analysis of the CLRS30 baseline NAR shows that the hint objective is weakly optimized and that hint accuracy remains low. Moreover, many intermediate representations can already be decoded into sorted sequences before the reference insertion-sort execution terminates, suggesting that the model learns a shortcut to the final output. Motivated by these findings, we introduce Discrete Neural Insertion Sort. Our model represents the sequence as a chain, separates scalar exchanges from control-state transitions, and projects node representations back to discrete states after every processor step. When trained only on sequences of length 16, the model achieves $100\%$ sorted-sequence accuracy on sequences of length 64 and 128. However, an ablation shows that discretization and graph structure alone are insufficient: without additional supervision of the global inner-loop state, the model fails even at the training length. Our results show that discrete execution can support strong length generalization, while also highlighting the problem-specific inductive bias required to learn a faithful algorithmic execution.

AI.tldr: 本文研究神经算法推理(NAR)中的"捷径学习"问题，以插入排序为研究场景。作者诊断了CLRS30基线模型，发现其hint目标优化不足且中间表示过早解码为排序结果（即"rush-to-output"行为），表明模型并未忠实执行参考算法。为此提出Discrete Neural Insertion Sort：使用链式图结构，分离标量交换与离散控制状态转换，并在每步将节点表示投影回离散状态。该模型仅在长度16的序列上训练，在长度64和128的序列上达到100%排序准确率。消融实验表明，离散化和图结构本身不够，还需要对全局内层循环状态（虚拟节点）进行额外监督。
AI.motivation: 神经算法推理旨在训练神经网络执行已知算法并泛化到训练分布之外。然而，正确的最终输出和中间监督并不能保证模型忠实遵循参考算法的执行轨迹。对于排序任务，不同的排序算法产生相同的最终结果，模型可能学习到支持最终预测的"捷径"而非忠实执行参考轨迹。本文以插入排序为受控场景，研究如何通过架构约束和监督信号使模型学习忠实且可解释的算法执行。
AI.method: 1. 诊断分析：对CLRS30基线在插入排序任务上分离记录输出损失与hint损失，并在中间步骤将最终输出解码器应用于节点嵌入，检测"早期解"。2. Discrete Neural Insertion Sort：(a) 将序列表示为双向链式图，每步仅允许相邻位置间的标量移动；(b) 每个节点携带标量值和4位离散状态(i, j, next_j, k, j∧k, nothing)，通过查表获得嵌入；(c) 边表示包含两个节点状态嵌入和显式的标量比较结果位；(d) 标量更新通过学习的"take"门控控制标量在邻居间的传递，实现局部交换；(e) 每步消息传递后将连续嵌入通过4个线性层投影回离散状态，形成离散瓶颈；(f) 引入虚拟节点vG对全局内层循环状态建模，通过边注意力机制聚合有向边信息，辅助离散状态转换；(g) 多重监督：离散状态BCEloss、标量MSE损失、虚拟节点辅助损失（预测内循环是否终止）。
AI.result: 1. CLRS30基线诊断：hint损失几乎不变，hint精度在长度16的轨迹上始终较低；64个序列中有13个在步骤3时已可解码为排序结果，32个在步骤4时已排序，而参考插入排序最早在步骤14才完成，呈现明显的"rush-to-output"捷径行为。2. 主模型：在长度16训练后，自回归评估在长度16/64/128的序列上均达到100%的状态准确率、标量准确率和排序准确率。3. 消融实验：去除虚拟节点监督后，即使在训练长度16上也完全失败（0%），表明离散化和图结构本身不足以保证学习正确的转移规则。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示了NAR中正确的最终输出并不能证明忠实的算法执行这一关键问题。提出的离散神经执行器通过分离标量与控制状态、引入离散瓶颈实现了对插入排序的完美长度泛化。然而，结果依赖于较强的归纳偏置和算法特定的监督（尤其是虚拟节点的全局信号监督）。这表明在NAR中，仅提供必要信息不够充分，训练目标还需主动引导模型以预期方式使用这些信息。这是可解释性与算法特定知识之间的权衡，未来需探索弱监督或自动发现所需离散状态与全局信号的方法。

title: Teacher-Anchored Selection of Post-Training Quantized Models under Domain Shift
summary: Compressing a trained model yields a family of deployment candidates, and under domain shift the most compressed one need not be the one to deploy. We study selection over such a family, with candidates and teacher fixed and target labels absent or scarce. Two findings organize the label-free case. Minimum teacher distortion behaves almost as a constant rule, selecting the same eight-bit, per-channel, unclipped configuration in every run, which does not minimize empirical target cross-entropy. Established estimators divide sharply: in the overconfident-collapse regime of the CNN families, confidence-based estimators order the family close to backwards, and the diagnostics that identify it need the labels the setting denies, while output-distribution estimators match the teacher-relative anchor and on one architecture beat it. Distortion is nonetheless stable, so a supervised term can move selection away from it. Combining the two, we give exact quadratic identities for a canonical quadratic analogue of the family. We also show that under symmetric corruption the label-dependent part of a criterion linear in the label indicator is multiplied by one common factor whenever its coefficient sums are candidate-invariant, a class holding teacher contrasts and accuracy but not cross-entropy. These characterize the score's components without bounding selection regret. Across one hundred and thirty-four candidate families, one per independently trained convolutional or Vision Transformer teacher, anchoring reduces mean regret at the smallest label budget in every setting, an advantage that fades beyond twenty-five labels.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在领域偏移下，从共享同一教师网络的训练后量化候选模型族中选择最佳部署模型的問題，并提出锚定选择（Anchored Selection）方法，将无标签的教师KL失真与少量有标签的监督项结合，通过交叉验证权重进行选择。
AI.motivation: 模型压缩（尤其是训练后量化）产生多个部署候选模型；在领域偏移下，最压缩的模型未必是最佳部署选择。当目标标签缺失或稀缺时，如何从共享同一教师的候选族中选择最优模型是一个独立于候选构建的关键挑战。
AI.method: 提出锚定选择框架 S(g) = D(g) + α·Φ_S(g)，其中 D(g) 为候选与教师的平均KL失真（无标签锚），Φ_S(g) 为有标签样本上的监督项（CE-combo使用交叉熵，Alignment使用方向性统计量）。权重α通过交叉验证在标签样本内选择。另证明了两个理论结果：1）二次恒等式刻画分数各分量关系；2）在对称标签噪声下，标签指示器线性准则的标签依赖部分按单一共同因子衰减。实验覆盖134个独立训练的教师（CNN与ViT），在DomainNet和CIFAR-20上进行领域偏移评估。
AI.result: 无标签场景下：教师失真几乎退化为常数选择（所有134个族均选择相同的8-bit逐通道配置），且该选择并非总能最小化目标交叉熵；基于置信度的估计器在过度自信坍缩模式下严重失败（平均遗憾高达15），而输出分布估计器在MobileNetV2上优于锚定。锚定方法在最小标签预算（10个标签）下在所有四个设置中均降低平均遗憾；标签稀缺时方向性项贡献显著（尤其在ResNet50上）。腐蚀标签场景下：锚定在20个预算-腐蚀率组合的每一个上都优于直接验证。衰减恒等式在经验上得到验证（最大绝对偏差0.016）。
AI.conclusion: 锚定选择是将教师失真的稳定性与少量标签的监督信号有效结合的实用方法，在标签极稀缺（≤25个）和标签被腐蚀时优势最明显；但当标签充足且可靠时优势消失。方法论最小化建议：在标签少时锚定，标签多但不可靠时考虑有界准确度准则。

title: SPADE: Escaping the Popularity-Similarity Frontier to Measure Serendipitous Recommendations
summary: Recommender systems engineer serendipity to foster active exploration and break predictable consumption cycles. The problem with existing offline beyond-accuracy metrics is that they often either isolate historical similarity or global popularity. We aim to design an evaluation metric that examines similarity, popularity, and actual user relevance. To achieve this, we introduce SPADE (Serendipitous Pareto Distance Evaluation). SPADE maps all items into a two-dimensional space to directly calculate a user-specific Pareto frontier of maximally popular and historically similar items. The final serendipity score is then computed by averaging the minimum Euclidean distance from this boundary strictly for the correctly recommended test-set items. Evaluating SPADE across five datasets and five baseline algorithms confirms its effectiveness; our results show that the metric successfully prevents algorithms from exploiting beyond-accuracy measures with irrelevant or non-personalized recommendations, reliably isolating serendipitous discoveries.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为 SPADE（Serendipitous Pareto Distance Evaluation）的离线评估指标，用于在推荐系统中量化"意外发现（serendipity）"。该指标通过将所有物品映射到由"全局流行度"和"用户历史相似度"构成的二维空间中，构建用户专属的Pareto前沿（Pareto frontier），并以正确推荐物品（测试集中的物品）到该前沿的最小欧氏距离（Euclidean distance）作为意外性分数，从而同时考察相似性、流行度与用户实际相关性，避免被无关或非个性化推荐所利用。
AI.motivation: 现有的超越准确率（beyond-accuracy）的离线评估指标通常只孤立地考察一个维度——要么是用户历史相似性，要么是全局流行度。这导致这些指标容易被"利用"：例如向用户推荐全球热门但其尚未接触的项目会被误判为意外发现，或推荐与历史高度相似但全球罕见的项目也会得到高分。因此需要一种能够同时考察相似性、流行度与用户实际相关性的统一指标来可靠地量化 serendipity。
AI.method: SPADE 包含以下核心步骤：(1) 以归一化的物品交互频率（n_i / max n_k）作为流行度（x 轴）；(2) 以带经验贝叶斯平滑（empirical Bayes smoothing, α=1）的正点互信息 PPMI（Positive PMI）之和作为用户历史相似度（y 轴）；(3) 对相似度进行 Min-Max 归一化到 [0,1]；(4) 为每个用户构建 Pareto 前沿 P_U（即不存在另一物品同时在两维度上严格占优的集合）；(5) 计算正确推荐物品（测试集中的物品）到 Pareto 前沿的最小欧氏距离作为 SPADE 分数，并在用户与算法层面取平均。选择 PPMI 是因为其与流行度呈负相关，可保证两维度构成真正的权衡，从而形成宽阔可辨的 Pareto 曲线。
AI.result: 在五个数据集（CiteULike、MIND、MovieLens-1M、MovieLens-20M、Netflix）与五个基线算法（EASE、SLIM、ItemKNN、Popularity、Random）上的实验表明：(1) Random 算法虽在 Primitivity、Co-Occurrence、Novelty 等传统指标上得到高分甚至无穷大，但因几乎无准确推荐项，SPADE 分数极低（≈0.003），证明 SPADE 不会奖励无关推荐；(2) Popularity 等非个性化基线在 SPADE 上也持续最低；(3) 个性化算法（EASE、SLIM、ItemKNN）在保持 NDCG 准确率的同时获得最高的 SPADE 分数（如 CiteULike 上 EASE 达 0.406），并通过两位 MovieLens 用户的案例研究（Retroactive、The Way of the Gun）验证了 SPADE 可识别远离用户偏好聚类的真正意外项。
AI.conclusion: SPADE 提供了一个鲁棒、可复现的离线评估框架，通过将 serendipity 严格锚定在测试集相关性上，同时惩罚高度相似或高度流行的推荐。它使研究者能够可靠地区分真正的意外发现与仅利用孤立超越准确率指标的"伪发现"，并以 Pareto 距离为统一量化基础，弥补了现有 beyond-accuracy 指标各自只能考察单一维度的缺陷。代码已开源以保证可复现性。

title: Improving Visual Sensitivity of LLMs on Multimodal Machine Translation with Metric-based Loss Weighting
summary: Multimodal Machine Translation aims to incorporate additional signal from non-textual modalities to improve translations by resolving ambiguities. While models, through multimodal fusion, are able to accept images related to the source text, they can ignore this information. Therefore, increasing their visual sensitivity remains an active research area. In this work, we introduce a training method, Metric-based Loss Weighting, that improves visual grounding of translations by increasing the loss function for tokens that benefit from the accompanying image. We identify these tokens using the Point-wise Cross-mutual Information (PCXMI) metric, which compares the model's output probabilities with and without visual context. We introduce a Congruency-based PCXMI metric and experimentally show that both metrics working in combination yield the best results. We evaluate our method by fine-tuning three pretrained Multimodal Large Language Models on the task of Image-guided Machine Translation for three language directions. Metric-based Loss Weighting outperforms other tested methods on the CoMMuTE contrastive dataset, improving accuracy by up to more than 7 percentage points compared to standard fine-tuning, while maintaining strong general translation performance.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多模态机器翻译（Multimodal Machine Translation, MMT）中多模态大语言模型（MLLM）视觉敏感度不足的问题，提出了一种基于指标驱动的损失加权（Metric-based Loss Weighting）训练策略。该方法通过 Point-wise Cross-Mutual Information（PCXMI）及作者新提出的 Congruency-based PCXMI（CPCXMI）指标识别目标序列中依赖图像消歧的 token，并在训练时对这些 token 增大损失权重。在 Multi30k 训练集上微调 Qwen3-VL 4B/8B 和 IDEFICS 9B 等模型，测试覆盖英→德、英→法、英→捷三个方向，并使用 BLEU/COMET 与 CoMMuTE 对比集评估。结果显示该方法在 9 个实验设置中有 6 项取得 CoMMuTE 准确率最佳，其余 3 项为次优，且通用翻译性能（BLEU/COMET）保持稳定，最高相对标准微调提升超过 7 个百分点。本文还分析了 PCXMI/CPCXMI 的分布特性、定性比较了 Fine-tuning 与 Weighted 模型的 BLEU 差异来源，并将所提方法与 Word Dropout 组合，验证了二者协同进一步提升视觉敏感性。
AI.motivation: 多模态机器翻译中模型往往忽略视觉模态，导致视觉依赖性差；现有数据集（如 Multi30k）中真正需要图像消歧的样本稀少，使得训练信号稀疏，模型未能充分学习使用视觉上下文。传统机器翻译指标（BLEU、COMET）无法有效衡量视觉敏感度，需要新的针对性评估与训练方法。
AI.method: 1. 指标设计：采用 PCXMI 衡量有图 vs 无图条件下输出概率的对数比，提出 CPCXMI 使用正确图 vs 不一致（随机采样的不一致）图比较；每 token 取两者最大值作为最终图像依赖度 a。2. 损失加权：在标准 NLL 损失的基础上，对 a 超阈值 τ 的 token 应用 1+α 的权重（α=8）。3. 实现细节：基于多模态大语言模型（Qwen3-VL 4B/8B、IDEFICS 9B），在 Multi30k 训练集上使用 LoRA 进行指令微调，并配合 VMLM、Word Dropout、Source Degradation、Metric Fine-tuning 等基线对比。
AI.result: 在三个模型与三个语言方向上，Metric-based Loss Weighting 在 6/9 场景下取得 CoMMuTE 准确率最高，最高提升超过 7 个百分点（相对标准微调），BLEU/COMET 几乎不退化。CoMMuTE 准确率与 BLEU/COMET 并非强相关，证实通用指标无法反映视觉敏感度。分布分析显示 PCXMI/CPCXMI 在训练集中大多接近零（图像消歧需求稀疏），而在 CoMMuTE 中较高值密度更大。与 Word Dropout 结合后，在英→德与英→捷进一步提升视觉敏感性，但伴随 BLEU 下降。
AI.conclusion: Metric-based Loss Weighting 通过识别并加权图像依赖型 token 显著增强了 MLLM 在多模态机器翻译中的视觉依赖性，同时保持了通用的翻译质量，是解决视觉信号稀疏与视觉敏感度不足的有效手段。该方法独立于源端增强（如 Word Dropout），并可与之协同进一步提升视觉倾向。但当前受限于同属印欧语系拉丁字母的语言、模型规模<10B、运行次数较少（统计显著性不足）等局限。未来工作可探索在训练过程中动态更新图像依赖指标、扩大模型规模、引入更多指标和跨语系验证。

title: Rethinking Data Quality for AI-Driven Systems: Evidence from Practitioner Interviews
comment: This is a preprint version and the final version will appear in the proceedings of PROFES 2026
summary: Data quality research has usually treated data as an input that is stored, processed, and validated. In AI-driven software-intensive systems, data also shapes model behavior, evaluation, and lawful use. Empirical evidence remains limited on how practitioners define, assess, and manage quality under these conditions. We interviewed 16 practitioners from nine organizations and analyzed the transcripts using reflexive thematic analysis and developed six themes from participants' accounts. In AI systems, traceability shifted from modular debugging to attributing model behavior, while using models as quality assessors introduced circularity. Agent context and memory became data objects, and synthetic and pseudo-labeled data made authenticity a quality concern. In foundation-model development, lawfulness became a gate for training data, while representativeness was judged through coverage of situations in which the system must behave safely. Prior ML research examines many of these problems separately. Our study provides a practitioner-grounded account of how they are encountered together as an engineering and organizational concern. We also interpret five recurring conditions as helping explain how the themes relate to reduced trust in data and AI outcomes. We synthesize these findings through lifecycle assurance: a conceptual framing focused on producing evidence that data can support a specific AI claim when its influence may be embedded in model behavior, model-based judgments, or agent actions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对9家组织16位从业者的半结构化访谈，采用反思性主题分析，揭示了AI驱动系统中数据质量的六个新主题，并提炼出五个基础解释机制，最终提出"生命周期保证"(lifecycle assurance)概念框架，强调数据质量应围绕AI声明产生并维护证据链。
AI.motivation: 传统数据质量研究将数据视为存储、处理和验证的输入，但AI驱动系统中数据同时塑造模型行为、评估结果与合规使用，已有研究多孤立地考察来源、合成数据、文档或治理问题，缺乏从业者如何将这些问题作为整体工程与组织挑战来应对的实证证据。
AI.method: 对9家组织16位从业者进行半结构化访谈（45-60分钟），覆盖汽车、电信、数据标注、工业自动化、基础模型开发等领域；采用Braun和Clarke六阶段反思性主题分析(RTA)进行归纳编码，从45条引文提取中构建六个主题，并进行二阶解释产生五个基础机制(F1-F5)；使用链式证据链(quote→code→theme→mechanism)保持经验材料与解释的可追溯性。
AI.result: 提炼出六个主题：行为级可追溯性(T1)、模型作为数据质量评判者(T2)、智能体上下文与记忆作为新数据对象(T3)、生成数据的真实性(T4)、合规治理与数据权利作为训练数据门槛(T5)、代表性作为行为覆盖(T6)。提炼出五个跨主题基础机制：数据被超越原始目的复用(F1)、AI规模超出人工检查能力(F2)、模型将数据吸收进行为(F3)、AI系统产生新数据制品(F4)、组织数据质量所有权碎片化(F5)。提出"生命周期保证"概念框架，将数据质量从通用维度转向针对特定AI声明的证据基础设施。
AI.conclusion: AI驱动系统中的数据质量应被理解为生命周期保证：为每个数据制品提供与其所支撑的AI声明相匹配的证据，涵盖真实性、出处、合规性、可追溯性和行为适配性。问责应贯穿"数据-模型-决策"链，组织需拥有端到端的证据链而非仅拥有单个数据集。该框架使不确定性显式化、可审查化和可问责化，需要在工业案例研究中进一步验证。

title: MoSAR: Mixture of Semantic Attention Regimes for Learning Adaptive and Approximable Attention Geometries
summary: The quadratic complexity of dense self-attention remains a central bottleneck for long-context language modeling. Many efficient alternatives address this cost by deciding in advance where attention should be sparse or local. We argue that attention approximation should instead be approached as a geometric problem, with the relevant interaction geometry learned from data: natural-language dependencies are input-dependent and difficult to prescribe in advance, so the model should learn where positional relevance can decay and where broader interactions must be preserved. We introduce Mixture of Semantic Attention Regimes (MoSAR), which learns such an adaptive, controlled-decay geometry over query--key interactions. Input-conditioned query and key routers, applied after positional encoding, select mixtures over short, medium, and global regimes, inducing a continuous distance-dependent attention field rather than a fixed sparsity pattern. This geometry is learned during training and can subsequently be discretized through top-1 routing. In controlled pre-training experiments with matched 500M-parameter models, MoSAR learns a substantially lower-reach attention geometry without degrading language-modeling quality, improving perplexity over dense RoPE at the training context length. Under length extrapolation, MoSAR achieves the best perplexity among all evaluated variants, including strong baselines such as ALiBi. Moreover, the learned geometry remains stable under deterministic top-1 discretization, suggesting that it is not only adaptive, but also amenable to low-cost approximation at inference time.

AI.tldr: MoSAR 提出了一种将注意力近似问题重新建模为几何学习问题的方法，通过双线性路由在查询和键上分别学习短、中、全局三种"语义注意力机制"(regime)，以可学习的方式选择距离相关的衰减几何，避免硬掩码和预先固定的稀疏模式。在500M参数从零预训练实验中，MoSAR在不牺牲语言建模质量的同时学习到更低覆盖范围的注意力几何，并在长度外推上优于RoPE和ALiBi等基线，其软几何可通过确定性top-1路由安全离散化以降低推理成本。
AI.motivation: 密集自注意力的二次复杂度是长上下文建模的主要瓶颈。现有效率替代方案通常预先规定稀疏模式（如滑动窗口），假设所有token、层和上下文都适用相同的局部性概念。然而自然语言依赖是上下文相关的，难以预先规定。作者主张注意力近似应被视为几何问题，让模型学习一个可控的距离依赖衰减几何，并按需自适应地分配注意力预算。
AI.method: MoSAR在RoPE之后插入轻量级双线性路由器(Q和K各一个小型MLP)，输出短(S，reach=128)、中(M，reach=512)、全局(G，reach=2048)三种regime的softmax分布。对于任意查询-键对(i,j)，两个边际regime通过算术平均组合形成两两regime几何 g_mn(d)，具有局部保留平台(T)、平滑过渡区(L)和有限下限(e^{-B})。worth field 定义为 W_θ(i,j)=π_Q^T G(d=i-j) π_K，然后取对数作为加性注意力偏置。训练使用语言建模损失(soft routing)；MoSAR-Cost变体额外添加了期望归一化覆盖范围的辅助成本损失。还可通过top-1离散化获得近似的稀疏推理域 Ω_θ。默认参数：R=3，B=6，p=2。
AI.result: 在匹配的500M参数Gemma2风格解码器模型(18层、1024隐藏维度、8头)上，使用Wikipedia语料库训练约10B token。结果显示：(1) 在训练上下文长度2048下，MoSAR达到PPL 12.269，与最优的Fixed-M基线(12.267)基本相当，但优于密集RoPE(12.517)和ALiBi(12.411)；(2) 在长度外推到4k和8k时，MoSAR分别取得11.753和12.208的最佳PPL，超过所有评估基线，包括ALiBi(11.873/12.232)和RoPE(12.373/15.176)；(3) 硬top-1路由在2k/4k/8k下仅带来3.5%-5.4%的PPL退化，同时将覆盖范围从0.219降至0.169，软成本从0.221降至大约0.169；(4) 支持密度 ρ_Ω 从2048时的0.154下降到8192时的0.104，表明有效注意力成本随上下文长度呈次二次增长；(5) MoSAR-Cost实现最低学习成本(0.0897)但有轻微PPL惩罚。
AI.conclusion: MoSAR的核心论点是：(1) 可控衰减比突然的局部掩码是更强的归纳偏置；(2) 自适应regime选择在长上下文中优于固定局部性；(3) 学习到的软几何是可近似的——硬路由可在保留竞争性PPL的同时降低注意力域。该方法将注意力近似从固定稀疏模式问题提升为可学习、适应性、自洽几何问题，为后续稀疏注意力内核设计提供了理论支撑。局限性包括规模受限(500M/10B token)、单一语料、缺乏下游任务评估。

title: Softmax Reparameterization for Output-Head Quantization
summary: Large vocabularies make output heads a substantial inference cost in small language models. We propose softmax reparameterization, a post-training method that selects a functionally equivalent output head before quantization. The method subtracts a scalar multiple of the vocabulary-row mean from every output row and selects the coefficient by validation KL separately for RTN, activation-weighted MSE, and full-Hessian GPTQ. This one-dimensional search includes the original head and fixed mean-centering, preserves the full-precision softmax distribution, and leaves the trained decoder unchanged; a rank-one correction handles nonlinear logit paths such as soft-capping. Across seven heads, W4 gains concentrate where baseline quantization substantially distorts predictions: on Phi-4-mini, AW-MSE KL falls from 0.936 to 0.256. The gains survive stronger GPTQ calibration and remain complementary to exact per-channel scaling and affine quantization. Across four heads and three W4 quantizers, frozen WikiText-selected coefficients also transfer to C4 and OpenWebMath, outperforming mean-centering in all 18 comparisons where the frozen coefficient differs from $1$ and matching it in the remaining six. At W2, used as a compression stress test, benefits broaden across nearly the full model--quantizer matrix. Matched residual analysis shows that improved fidelity can accompany greater logit reconstruction error while reducing the residual's Fisher-weighted cost. For shift-compatible heads, reparameterization adds no inference operation and preserves packed W4 execution: with the decoder held in BF16, quantizing the Phi output head reduces batch-one generation latency by 10.8% relative to the BF16-head baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出 Softmax Reparameterization：在保持全精度 softmax 分布不变的前提下，沿词汇行均值方向搜索标量偏移 t，为每种基量化器选择最优等价输出头表示，从而显著降低输出头量化后的 KL 失真，并保持 Marlin INT4 打包推理的 10.8% 延迟优势。
AI.motivation: 大词汇表使输出头成为 SLM 推理瓶颈，但现有后训练量化方法对其处理不足；softmax 的相对不变性提供了加法等价类自由度，可被搜索利用以降低量化残差。
AI.method: 沿词汇行均值方向做一维标量搜索 t，按验证集 KL 选最优；对非线性 logit 路径用秩一修正恢复共享分量；用 Fisher 矩阵的二次型作为机制诊断。
AI.result: W4 下 Phi/BLOOM/XGLM AW-MSE KL 降幅 73–93%；W2 下几乎所有模型-量化器组合均改善；冻结系数跨域迁移 18/18 优于均值中心；Phi 打包推理延迟降低 10.8%；Fisher 加权误差降幅显著大于普通 logit 误差。
AI.conclusion: 输出头的精度需求部分取决于其参数化形式；softmax 重参数化作为零推理成本的前处理，是输出头量化流水线的高效补充，且与现有量化器、缩放方法、仿射量化以及打包内核完全兼容。

title: Beyond Approved Actions: Runtime Validation of Persistent Outcomes in Agent Workflows
comment: 22 pages including 7 pages of supplementary material. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering
summary: Large language model agents increasingly act on software systems, no longer merely generating text but also changing databases and online services. However, an approved database update may succeed yet leave an unapproved notification because execution can produce persistent effects beyond the requested change. Current safeguards can approve an action or record its aftermath, but without checking the persistent result before continuation, an unapproved outcome can be accepted as success and propagated to later steps. We present EffectMatch, a runtime that collects persistent changes within a controlled execution boundary and compares them with what the application approved for the current state and execution. The comparison governs commit and dependent execution. In comparative evaluation on 206 public business tasks, EffectMatch preserved all clean executions and prevented all tested incorrect commits. Six 20-run ablations exposed the failure caused by each removed mechanism, while 80 task-topology cases preserved truthful handoffs and blocked invalid continuation. Together, these results show that EffectMatch blocks the silent acceptance and downstream propagation of persistent outcomes inconsistent with application approval.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出EffectMatch运行时系统，通过将应用层审批与实际持久化执行结果进行验证，解决了LLM智能体工作流中已批准操作仍可能产生未经授权的副作用这一安全漏洞。其核心是"效果提交契约"（Effect Commit Contract），将审批、结果比较和后续执行决策绑定到同一执行实例。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM智能体已从文本生成扩展到直接修改数据库和调用在线服务。已有安全机制（授权检查、事务处理、状态审计）能验证操作是否被批准、执行是否成功，但无法确保执行留下的持久化结果与审批一致——例如一个被批准的数据库更新可能因触发器额外插入了未经授权的通知，导致不一致的副作用被静默接受并传播到后续步骤。
AI.method:
1. 形式化定义：定义"批准结果A"（应用预先批准的持久化变更）和"执行结果E"（实际产生的变更），引入完备性（Complete）和结果分类（EXACT/DIVERGED/INDETERMINATE）的形式化语义。
2. Effect Commit Contract协议：包含三个核心机制——(a) 将审批绑定到当前状态和单次执行发生权（绑定BA与一次性许可BG）；(b) 在受控执行边界内通过执行边界认证（边界证书）、变更收集与比较来验证实际效果；(c) 通过持久化终端日志（T）将决策传递给后续进程。
3. 三种后端能力分级：PROMOTABLE（可暂存检查后再提交，如数据库事务）、MEDIATED（通过排他网关控制请求并事后回读）、OPAQUE（仅事后分类，无回滚能力）。
4. 信任基础：审批方、运行时决策核心和注册观察接口分别承担不同职责，避免智能体自证。
AI.result: 在206个公开商业任务上：EffectMatch保留了所有618次干净执行，拒绝了所有472次错误提交（遗漏354次、重复138次）。12个独立审批任务中拒绝了全部117次不匹配执行。6次20运行的消融实验分别暴露了各机制被移除后的失效（每项均产生20/20错误结果）。80个任务拓扑案例正确保留真实交接、阻止无效延续。三种智能体配置（DeepSeek API、DeepSeek+DSH、Codex）在108个实时执行回合中均正确集成。跨进程恢复测试在540次执行和1080个消费者进程读取中均正确治理延续。PostgreSQL边界认证中位数开销29.13ms（2.19×），STATE任务中位数开销1.08ms。
AI.conclusion: 通过将持久化结果验证置于受控执行边界内，并将执行决策持久化为后续工作的治理依据，EffectMatch能够阻断与审批不一致或未解析的执行以成功形式传播。该协议在多种后端（PostgreSQL、MySQL、ToolSandbox、GitHub）和智能体配置下均可集成，验证了以结果为中心的执行级安全保障在大语言模型智能体工作流中的可行性和必要性。

title: A Safety-Bounded SDC-to-MCP Gateway for Medical AI Agents
comment: 18 pages. Code: this https URL . Software and evaluation artifacts: this https URL
summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) provides a common interface through which AI applications discover and use external resources and tools. It allows language-model agents to ground their reasoning in current system state and interact with heterogeneous services. In medical environments, however, exposing device state and action affordances requires deterministic constraints on possible effects. We present an IEEE 11073 Service-Oriented Device Connectivity (SDC)-to-MCP gateway that exposes metrics, alarms, context references, and semantic metadata as read-only resources, while representing selected action affordances as policy-validated dry-run tools. The term safety-bounded denotes a narrow no-execution property: agent-facing requests dispatch no SDC device operation. A Python prototype supports simulated fault and lifecycle experiments, a software-reference protocol path spanning independent Java and Python implementations, deterministic baselines, representation ablations, and multi-model agent evaluation. The results show semantically explicit resource exposure, visible rejection of invalid or outdated state, and preservation of the no-execution boundary across resource, proposal, and authorization paths. Explicit semantic metadata improved conformity to required metric identifiers in structured alarm outputs relative to a generic representation, while retained structured-output failures reveal a distinction between plausible narrative answers and task-compliant machine-readable results.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种安全受限的IEEE 11073 SDC到MCP网关，将医疗设备状态以只读资源和策略验证的dry-run工具形式暴露给LLM智能体，确保智能体不会触发任何实际的设备操作。
AI.motivation: 在医疗环境中，LLM智能体可通过MCP协议与外部工具交互，但将物理医疗设备直接暴露给具有非确定性的语言模型存在安全风险。需要一种方法使设备状态对智能体可读，同时限制其执行设备操作的权限。
AI.method: 1. 设计SDC到MCP的确定性投影Φ(S)=(R, T_dry)，将BICEPS/MDIB中的描述符、指标、告警、上下文和操作结构映射为只读资源和dry-run工具；2. 提出SDC特定的元数据互操作交换（SDC-MIE），明确暴露代码、句柄、单位、告警引用和策略元数据；3. 通过Python原型集成sdc11073消费者和Java SDCri参考实现，覆盖TLS、SOAP、XML解析全协议路径；4. 通过边界测试、表示消融、多模型智能体评估验证不变性。
AI.result: 实验表明：(1) 语义显式的资源暴露有效，提高了结构化告警输出中所需指标标识符的符合性；(2) 无效或过时状态被显式拒绝；(3) 在资源、提案和授权路径上均保持了无执行边界；(4) 存在"看似合理的叙述性回答"与"任务合规的机器可读结果"之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: 该安全受限网关成功在SDC设备状态与MCP智能体接口之间建立了确定性约束边界，但保留了结构化输出失败的风险，揭示了自然语言流畅性与机器可读任务合规性之间的本质差异。部署到真实临床环境仍需独立的完整安全论证。

title: Highlight-Then-Summarize: Learning to Compress Evidence for Long-Context Understanding
comment: 23 pages, 13 figures. Zhaoyuan Xia and Qinghongbing Xie contributed equally. Corresponding authors: Dai Dai, Tong Mo, and Long Zeng. Code and data are available at this https URL
summary: Long-context understanding requires large language models (LLMs) to reason over lengthy documents, conversations, and code, yet task-relevant evidence is often sparse and scattered amid substantial irrelevant and redundant content. We propose Highlight-Then-Summarize (H2S), a compress-then-reason paradigm that first identifies source-grounded, question-relevant evidence and then integrates it into a compact, question-conditioned summary before producing the final answer. To train this behavior, we construct H2S-Dataset, comprising 6,647 examples from 11 benchmark families with an average context length of 43.9K tokens, and introduce H2S-RL, which provides process-level rewards for evidence selection and summary construction in addition to final-answer correctness. We evaluate on H2S-Bench, a seven-task long-context suite. Under a shared 128K input and 4K output budget, H2S-14B achieves an average score of 32.60, outperforming Qwen3.8-27B by 10.17 points and obtaining the strongest overall result among the evaluated open-source models. H2S-14B also achieves the highest Evidence-Summary Quality score and retains 97.1% of its 16K-budget performance with only a 4K output budget. These results show that explicitly selecting and integrating evidence improves long-context reasoning while enabling more compact generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Highlight-Then-Summarize (H2S) 范式，将长上下文推理分解为"高亮证据→生成摘要→得出答案"三阶段，通过外部化证据定位与整合过程提升推理效率。配套构建含6,647例的H2S-Dataset和带过程级奖励的H2S-RL训练方法，在H2S-Bench七项任务上H2S-14B以平均32.60分取得开源模型最佳，且仅用4K输出预算即可保留16K预算97.1%的性能。
AI.motivation: 长上下文场景中任务相关证据稀疏分散，现有方法虽强化证据检索但对多片段证据的整合仍隐式纠缠于最终答案生成中，导致证据难以一致利用且推理链条过长。本文受Kintsch文本理解理论启发，研究紧凑的、问题条件化的中间表征能否提升长文档推理效果。
AI.method: 1) H2S范式：将分块文档D和问题q的联合推理分解为 Highlight→Evidence Eq →Summarize→Summary Sq →Reason→Answer 的单轨迹自回归生成，因式分解为 p(E|D,q)·p(S|D,q,E)·p(a|D,q,E,S)，原文全程可访问而非剪枝。2) H2S-Dataset：基于11个基准族构建6,647例Evidence-Summary-Answer结构化样本（4,228 SFT + 2,419 RL），经分块、混合检索、子问题分解、原子事实抽取、问题条件摘要、三重质量校验（忠实性/覆盖/可答性）迭代构建，平均上下文43.9K tokens。3) H2S-RL：GRPO框架下设计确定性轨迹级奖励 R = R_structure·[λR_answer + (1-λ)·2·R_evidence·R_summary/(R_evidence+R_summary)]，对答案、证据定位与覆盖、摘要、结构四方面联合监督。
AI.result: 在128K输入+4K输出预算下：H2S-14B在七任务H2S-Bench平均32.60，比QwenLong-L1-32B高5.01、比Qwen3.8-27B高10.17，为开源最优；H2S-7B平均28.56，参数不到QwenLong-L1-32B的四分之一仍略胜。H2S-RL相对SFT在7B/14B上分别再提升4.88/3.44分。ESQ评估H2S-14B以31.02居首。消融显示移除证据平均降4分，移除摘要平均降9分，移除两者降幅最大。输出预算分析：H2S-14B从4K扩到16K仅增0.96分，保留97.1%性能，对输出长度极不敏感。注意力可视化显示H2S对16个证据块的注意力份额翻倍以上。失败案例分析揭示块级溯源不能保证声明忠实性。
AI.conclusion: H2S通过显式外部化证据定位与问题条件摘要，有效提升长上下文推理并大幅压缩生成长度，验证了"结构化中间表征优于冗长思维链"的设计理念。当前局限在于对广泛分布型任务适应性欠佳，且过程级评估依赖构造期参考。未来将探索自适应压缩目标与更强过程监督。

title: ActKV: Efficient LLM Agents through Action-Guided KV Cache Management
summary: Agentic LLM inference accumulates long KV caches across iterative observation-reasoning-action loops, imposing substantial memory overhead and limiting serving throughput. Existing compression methods emphasize overall output quality, overlooking the asymmetric importance of actions in driving task progress. Our key idea is to establish a compression criterion that values KV entries by their contribution to action generation and prioritizes action quality. However, iterative execution, dynamic memory demands, and scattered action-critical entries pose challenges to eviction policies, budget allocation, and paged memory integration. To this end, we propose ActKV, the first KV cache compression framework tailored for agentic LLM inference. (i) Action-oriented KV cache eviction exploits stable action access patterns to retain entries critical to future actions, supporting reliable task progress under compression. (ii) Confidence-driven adaptive budget allocation uses LLM's intrinsic confidence to adapt the budget to evolving action-critical memory demands. (iii) Page-aware compression management standardizes compression into three primitives with customized kernels, realizing practical throughput gains. On long-trace tasks, ActKV retains an average of 98.53% of FullKV's accuracy with only 25.98% of its peak KV cache memory. It also achieves 3.97 times and 3.58 times FullKV's token and task throughput, delivering state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: ActKV 是首个面向智能体（Agentic）LLM 推理场景的 KV Cache 压缩框架。其核心思想是：与传统文本生成不同，Agent 推理中只有动作（action）令牌真正影响环境和任务进度，因此压缩策略应以"动作质量"而非"整体输出质量"为目标。ActKV 通过三个组件——动作导向的 KV 淘汰（基于注意力感知的 LRFU 策略）、基于模型置信度的自适应预算分配（利用 token 分布置信度反映预算充足性）、以及面向分页内存的压缩管理（基于 LSE 恢复的注意力计算内核 + 原地压缩内核），在长轨迹任务上仅用 FullKV 25.98% 的峰值内存即可保留 98.53% 的准确率，端到端 token/task 吞吐提升 3.97×/3.58×。
AI.motivation: Agentic LLM 推理中，观测-推理-动作（ORA）的迭代循环导致 KV cache 不断累积（例如 Qwen3-30B 跑 WebShop 任务约 35K tokens、3.20 GB KV cache），严重限制并发与吞吐。现有压缩方法（StreamingLLM、SnapKV、H2O、R-KV 等）面向通用文本生成，假设各 token 重要性均匀，使用近未来注意力贪心淘汰。但在 Agent 场景下，token 重要性高度不对称：观察和推理 token 多为内部状态，对用户无直接价值；只有动作 token 驱动环境与任务进度。直接套用通用压缩策略会损害后续动作的生成质量。同时，迭代执行带来的动态内存需求、动作关键条目分散于多个分页内存块中，进一步挑战了淘汰策略、预算分配和分页内存集成。
AI.method: ActKV 由三大模块协同：(i) 动作导向的 KV cache 淘汰——在每次 ORA 回合结束后，识别动作生成区间并提取该区域的注意力分数，定义动作访问向量 AAV，根据 top-p（90%）判定条目是否对动作重要；为应对间歇式高贡献条目被误删的问题，采用注意力感知的 LRFU（最近最久未用）策略，保持分数 KS_t(i) = λ·KS_{t-1}(i) + AttnScore_t(i)·hit，通过衰减因子 λ=0.5 兼顾频率与时效性。(ii) 置信度驱动的自适应预算分配——构建三层置信度监测器：token 级（top-k 概率的负平均对数似然）、trace 级（滑动窗口最小池化 + 底部 b% 选择，对局部置信度塌陷敏感）、趋势检测（线性拟合斜率 α<0 时扩展预算）。初始预算 512，按 scale_up=1.75 阶梯扩容，上限 30K。(iii) 面向分页内存的压缩管理——将压缩流程抽象为三个原语（注意力计算、条目淘汰、缓存压缩），并定制两个内核：基于 LSE 恢复的注意力计算内核（从分页 attention 已有的 softmax log-sum-exp 恢复每个 KV 条目的注意力分数，避免 gather 操作）；无冲突原地压缩内核（将保留条目规划到尾部 X 个逻辑块，无冲突 slot 对齐后一次完成就地复制，无需额外 buffer）。基于 Triton 实现，集成到 Transformers v5.3.0 与 vLLM v0.19.0。
AI.result: 在 4 个 LLM（Qwen3-30B-A3B、Qwen3-235B-A22B、GPT-OSS-20B、GPT-OSS-120B）与 3 个 Agent 基准（ALFWorld、WebShop、HotpotQA-Web，各 1500 任务）上的实验表明：(1) 准确率——ActKV 在长轨迹任务上以仅 25.98% 的 FullKV 峰值内存保留平均 98.53% 的准确率，相对 R-KV、SnapKV、StreamingLLM 分别提升 27-32%、27-31%、54-71%；在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上甚至以 10% 和 25% 预算实现 81.34% 和 101.41% 的 FullKV 准确率；在某些设置下比 FullKV 高 1.40-3.13%（剔除噪声 token 后注意力更聚焦）。(2) 自适应预算——在三个数据集上分别以 26.38%/35.08%/25.58% 峰值内存达到 98.04%/96.81%/99.02% 的 FullKV 准确率，trace 长度仅比 FullKV 长 9.67-13.97%。(3) 内核效率——相对 paged R-KV，ActKV 在 1K–6K KV 压缩规模、1–64 并发下平均 10.41× 单次压缩加速，且无额外 KV 存储。(4) 端到端吞吐——相对 FullKV，token 吞吐提升 3.80×–4.14×，task 吞吐提升 3.32×–3.80×。总体达到 SOTA。
AI.conclusion: ActKV 将 Agent 场景下的 KV cache 管理从"保留整体输出质量"重构为"以动作质量为压缩准则"，通过动作导向淘汰 + 置信度驱动自适应预算 + 分页感知内核，实现了在显著压缩比下仍保持近 FullKV 准确率，并大幅提升服务吞吐。该工作表明，面向 Agent 的高效服务应将内存管理与任务结果对齐，而非单纯追求 token 级保真度，为内存高效 Agent 系统奠定了原则性基础。

title: Sorry Robot, Happy Human: Vision-Language Models Read Only One of Two Legible Typographic Layers
comment: Accepted to the First Workshop on Document Intelligence and Understanding (DocInsights 2026), co-located with the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs), despite their success in optical character recognition (OCR) tasks, are vulnerable to typographic attacks and have a fragile structure for images with multiple text layers. In this study, the DecoyBench dataset was created using the Decoy Font method. The dataset consists of 300 images, each containing text with sharp contour lines superimposed on another text with soft shading. Six recent closed-source models from three different model families were evaluated using this dataset under two different prompting conditions (naive and guided) and at two different resolutions ($512\times512$ and $64\times64$). A validation study showed that human participants could read both text layers with high accuracy. In contrast, the models, with most variants and both prompting methods, read the contour text with near-human accuracy at high resolution, but almost never fully extracted the shading text. At low resolution, the contour text could not be read by either the models or humans, while the shading text could be extracted with high accuracy. The findings indicate that the evaluated VLMs exhibit a consistent behavioral limitation when processing typographic structures containing multiple spatial frequency layers.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了DecoyBench数据集（300张图像），每张图像包含两层叠加文本：高空间频率的清晰轮廓文本与低空间频率的柔和阴影文本。研究评估了六个闭源VLM在两种提示策略和两种分辨率下的表现，发现模型能像人类一样在高分辨率下读取轮廓层，却几乎无法识别阴影层；而在低分辨率下，模型与人类都无法读轮廓层，反而能高准确率地识别阴影层，表明VLM在处理多空间频率叠加文本时存在一致的行为局限。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）虽然擅长OCR任务，但对排版攻击（typographic attack）脆弱，并且在处理含多层文本的图像时表现脆弱。与以往研究关注添加文本对模型的干扰不同，本研究考察当人类能够同时分辨两层叠加文本时，VLM是否同样具备分离多层文本结构的能力，以揭示模型与人类在视觉层分离机制上的差异。
AI.method: 使用Decoy Font方法生成DecoyBench数据集：300对在词数与字符长度上严格匹配的文本对，每对生成一张同时叠加"锐利轮廓文本"与"柔和阴影文本"的图像，统一调整为512×512与64×64两种分辨率。邀请10位人类参与者进行可读性验证。评估来自GPT、Gemini、Claude三个家族的六个闭源VLM，在naive提示与guided提示两种条件下进行OCR，分别以精确匹配率（EM）与归一化Levenshtein相似度（LS）评估轮廓层与阴影层的转录准确率。
AI.result: 人类在高分辨率下可读99.7%轮廓文本与96.3%阴影文本，低分辨率下轮廓文本完全不可读、阴影文本仍可读98.7%。在高分辨率下，VLM轮廓层EM普遍达94%以上（接近人类水平），但阴影层EM几乎全部为0%，即使在guided提示下也极少超过1%；在低分辨率下，所有模型的轮廓层EM降为0%，而阴影层EM达93.7%-100%，与人类表现一致。guided提示虽提高模型生成多文本的倾向，但并不带来真正的阴影层识别能力。结论表明VLM在处理多频空间叠加文本时表现出跨模型家族一致的系统性局限，倾向于优先处理高频轮廓信息而忽略低频阴影信息。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明VLM在处理同一视觉空间中叠加的两层可读文本时，表现出跨模型家族一致的行为局限：在高分辨率下几乎完全无法识别低频阴影文本，仅识别高频轮廓文本；而在低分辨率下则反向。该局限性不是单一模型缺陷，而是VLM体系结构的普遍特征，对含水印、印章、档案文档等多层文本真实文档的自动处理具有重要影响。局限包括仅300张单一样式图像、仅英文、未单独测试单层、人类验证样本仅10人。未来工作可拓展至不同字体、对比度、阴影密度及其他语言与文档类型。

title: Towards Mitigating Fabricated Consensus: The Active Provenance Gate for Multi-Agent Debate Synthesis
comment: Accepted for publication at the 38th IEEE International Conference on Tools with Artificial Intelligence (ICTAI 2026)
summary: Large language model-based multi-agent debate (MAD) systems are being increasingly used as complex decision pipelines in distributed processes. However, their final synthesis phase still remains inadequately controlled. Even with detailed debate logs, summarizing models are prone to fabricating smoothly written debate consensus that is not grounded in the debate's history. To address this safety gap, this paper presents empirical research and studies if the introduction of active post-debate verification can mitigate the production of such factually unsupported summaries, while still providing valuable information. Furthermore, it is examined whether explicitly signalling divergence is preferable in the absence of a reliable compromise. The Active Provenance Gate (APG) is introduced as a post-debate verification layer that treats the source as a hard constraint, analysing the debate logs, auditing each claim, and applying self-correction. In crisis simulations, the self-healing mechanism more than doubles the average data Provenance Fidelity in difficult condition scenarios, before the strict gate blocks unsupported claims and generates divergence reports. In the human study, a vast majority of the users (over 75%) preferred a report explicitly stating failure in critical scenarios, despite most of them perceiving fabricated consensus from the baseline system as more fluent. Our main contribution is the transition of data origin tracing from passive logging to active conditional blocking before publication.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"主动溯源门"(Active Provenance Gate, APG),一种在多智能体辩论(MAD)系统综合阶段后插入的主动验证层,通过NLI审计和受控自愈机制,强制综合报告的每一条声明都必须有辩论日志的证据支撑,无法达到溯源保真度(PF≥0.95)阈值时输出分歧报告而非勉强合成共识,以缓解LLM多智能体系统中流畅但无根据的"虚构共识"问题。
AI.motivation: 在基于LLM的多智能体辩论系统中,最终的综合阶段(synthesis phase)存在结构性盲点:即便保留了完整的辩论日志,以流畅性为优化目标的综合模型仍可能将不可调和的分歧抽象化、软化为虚假的共识——特别是在密集知识源(KG/RAG)输入下,模型更倾向于在部分兼容的片段间进行插值性幻觉。这种"虚构共识"在危机决策等高风险场景下会通过自动化偏差误导操作者信任,而现有的溯源追踪方法(如PROV、PROV-AGENT)仅将日志视为被动诊断产物,缺乏实时控制机制。
AI.method: 采用"研究即构建"(research-by-construction)方法,构建一个固定预算的危机管理委员会对抗性辩论测试床(含90条知识标注轨迹kg_cfr_full)。APG作为辩论与发布之间的确定性状态机(LangGraph实现),包含四个功能组件:(1)证据语料库组装,将公共转录、去重的KG/RAG公理、私有追踪合并为封闭证据世界;(2)异构Proposer-Validator配对,低成本LLM(Gemini 3 Flash)作为执行生成器,高推理模型(Gemini 3.1 Pro)作为全局审计器进行逐句NLI蕴含检查;(3)受控自愈循环(MAX_SYNTHESIS_ITER=3),利用未支撑句子提示生成器修正;(4)显式失败信号,无法达标时输出JSON分歧报告。通过Provenance Fidelity(PF)=支撑句数/总句数衡量接地性,以PF≥0.95为硬性发布门槛。同时进行33人盲法A/B用户研究和30轮验证器架构消融实验。
AI.result: 在90次对抗性运行中,基线系统在高低冲突场景下初始溯源保真度分别仅为0.288和0.183;APG的自愈机制将终末PF分别提升至0.617和0.586,翻倍以上。在零和僵局高冲突条件下,系统触发75.0%的分歧报告率,低冲突条件下为60.0%。消融实验揭示对称部署(Proposer与Validator使用同款轻量模型)的脆弱性:错误验证率达85.6%;切换到非对称配置(Gemini 3.1 Pro仅作审计器)后,相同文本PF降至0.300,63.3%的不可调和输出被拒绝。用户研究(N=33)显示,虽然66.7%认为基线更"流畅",但在S_026零和场景下75.8%认为APG更忠实于证据,配对t检验显示APG的显式失败报告获得显著更高的校准信任(M=3.27 vs 2.45, t(32)=3.12, p=0.0039)。自愈循环实现97.3%的文本长度保留率。
AI.conclusion: 本文核心贡献是将数据溯源从事后被动日志记录转变为发布前的主动条件拦截——APG将辩论追踪视为封闭证据世界,在综合边界强制执行严格的证据保真度门槛,迫使有限修复,并在可达成的接地协议不可得时提供结构化分歧机制。结论指出,流畅性优化的综合模型会系统性地利用发布边界的薄弱治理,将不可调和的接地立场转化为虚构共识;主动溯源强制将这种被动诊断转化为运行时发布约束。未来工作包括将溯源强制扩展到实时辩论循环内部、动态校准的声明级并行法官,以及面向操作者仲裁的交互式分歧报告。

title: ViSTA: A Simple Bridge Extends Visual Alignment to Clinical Time-Series Understanding in Multimodal LLMs
summary: Clinical prediction models estimate risk from patient measurements, while large language models support medical text understanding and question answering. Yet their language capabilities do not ensure accurate prediction from structured, high-dimensional clinical time series. Improving this ability would connect risk estimation with flexible questions about a patient's evolving condition. We introduce ViSTA, a compact adapter that incorporates irregular numerical measurements into a pretrained vision-language model's chart representations. It learns corrections to visual tokens while leaving all pretrained parameters unchanged. On MIMIC-IV, ViSTA has the highest mean scores among the compared adaptations on all four metrics for acute kidney injury and mortality prediction across models with 2-9 billion parameters. With 0.516 million trainable parameters, the 2-billion-parameter model reaches an area under the ROC curve of 0.7376 for acute kidney injury, compared with GPT-5.6 Sol's 0.7380 with text input and high reasoning effort. Training for temporal question answering yields 69.27% accuracy at 4 billion parameters with over 90% fewer trainable parameters than low-rank adaptation using charts or numerical text, at a 2.82-4.88 percentage-point accuracy gap. ViSTA extends pretrained language models to numerical prediction and temporal questions.

AI.tldr: ViSTA是一个紧凑适配器，将不规则临床数值测量融入预训练视觉语言模型的图表表示中，通过学习对视觉token的残差修正，在保持预训练参数完全冻结的前提下，以不到100万的可训练参数显著提升了临床预测和时间问答任务的性能。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型在临床文本理解方面表现出色，但在处理高维、不规则采样的临床时序数据进行数值预测时能力不足；同时现有的时序-语言对接方法（文本序列化、数值编码器、图表路径）各有局限，需要一种能直接访问精确数值同时保留视觉-语言对齐优势的紧凑适配方案。
AI.method: ViSTA由不规则序列编码器和残差桥接器组成：编码器通过MLP和变量嵌入对每个事件（值、时间、间隔、首次观测标志）编码，再用变量索引的可学习查询通过交叉注意力池化为固定大小的记忆；桥接器以视觉网格位置和变量身份为条件查询读取记忆，生成与视觉token同形状的残差，并以RMS缩放叠加到原始视觉token上，输出投影以零初始化（保证初始行为等价于原生图表模型）；预训练的视觉编码器、投影器、语言解码器和输出头全部冻结，仅通过答案token交叉熵训练适配器参数；提供Joint（跨变量联合池化）和Separate（变量内独立池化）两种编码设计。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-IV上，ViSTA-Joint在2B/4B/9B三个Qwen3.5规模的所有四项预测指标（AKI和死亡率的AUROC、AP）上均取得最高均值；2B模型以0.516M可训练参数达到AKI AUROC 0.7376，逼近GPT-5.6 Sol文本输入的0.7380；4B模型监督QA准确率69.27%，比LoRA基线少90%以上可训练参数，差距仅2.82-4.88个百分点；预测概率校准（Brier分数、ECE）也全面改善；预测增益随骨干模型规模从2B扩展至9B持续提升。
AI.conclusion: ViSTA以不到100万参数在完全冻结预训练视觉-语言模型的前提下，实现了临床数值预测和时间问答的显著改进，2B模型可逼近GPT-5.6 Sol的预测水平，且增益随骨干规模扩大而持续；这表明在固定预训练组件中通过紧凑数值接口注入精确测量证据是一条有效路径，未来应将其应用于更强的预训练骨干并在外部队列上验证。

title: Different Corruptions, Different Signals: Uncertainty and Loss in Federated Data Quality
comment: Accepted at IEEE The 4th International Conference on Federated Learning Technologies and Applications (FLTA26)
summary: Federated learning (FL) data corruption can affect either inputs or labels, but it remains unclear whether input-conditional uncertainty and prediction-label loss expose these corruption modes equally. This paper compares two corruption-detection signals in FL: input-conditional uncertainty and prediction-label loss. The uncertainty signal is characterised using a learned aleatoric variance estimate together with Monte Carlo (MC) dropout variance and entropy measures, while the loss is computed against the supplied label. We test these signals against additive image noise and persistent random label flips. On ResNet-20 with CIFAR-10 and SVHN under Dirichlet partitions with data that are not independent and identically distributed (non-IID), the two corruption types behave differently. For persistent random label flips, the within-client per-sample area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) is 0.85 on CIFAR-10 and 0.95 on SVHN for prediction-label loss, while every uncertainty estimator stays at chance (0.49--0.50). This pattern is consistent with the model remaining confident in the underlying image despite the supplied label being wrong. For image noise, expected-entropy uncertainty rises above chance (0.67 on CIFAR-10 and 0.66 on SVHN), while loss responds comparably (0.64 on both). Each signal is therefore the stronger detector for a different corruption: the prediction-label loss for persistent label flips, and expected-entropy uncertainty for image noise, with its advantage becoming apparent as federation-wide corruption prevalence increases. Robust FL data-quality assessment should match the signal to the corruption rather than rely on uncertainty alone across corruption types.

AI.tldr: 本文针对联邦学习中的数据质量问题，比较了两种腐败检测信号——输入条件不确定性（aleatoric/epistemic 方差与熵）和预测-标签损失——在面对不同类型数据腐败（持久随机标签翻转 vs. 加性图像噪声）时的检测能力。研究发现：对于标签翻转，所有不确定性信号在样本级别均处于随机水平（AUC ≈ 0.49–0.50），而预测-标签损失表现强劲（AUC 0.85–0.95）；对于图像噪声，期望熵不确定性优于损失（AUC 0.66–0.67 vs. 0.64）。结论是：稳健的 FL 数据质量评估应使信号与腐败类型相匹配，而不是依赖单一不确定性信号。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习中数据腐败可能影响输入（图像噪声）或标签（标签翻转），但目前尚不清楚输入条件不确定性和预测-标签损失这两种信号是否能同等程度地揭示这些不同的腐败模式。许多现有方法（如 FedNed、FedDPSO）默认使用不确定性来检测噪声客户端，但这种做法可能对特定类型的腐败无效。因此需要明确：在 FL 中，不确定性和损失能否检测不同形式的数据腐败？
AI.method: 方法包括：(1) 信号定义——四种输入条件不确定性信号（AV 学习型偶然方差、EV MC dropout 概率方差、AE 期望熵、EE 互信息熵，均不读取标签）和一种预测-标签损失 ℓ = −log p̄_y(x)；(2) 基于 UDF-GMA 的损失衰减机制，结合 aleatoric 估计与 MC dropout 方差；(3) 在 10 客户端 FedAvg 联邦设置下，使用 ResNet-20 在 CIFAR-10 和 SVHN 上进行实验，采用 Dirichlet 非 IID 分区 (α ∈ {0.1, 0.3, 1.0})；(4) 腐败掩码——每个 corrupt client 以 rate q (∈{0.2,0.4,0.6}) 进行持久随机标签翻转或加性高斯图像噪声（SD=0.3），作为独立条件；(5) 在两个粒度上评估检测性能：客户端级 AUC（受客户端异质性混杂）和客户端内样本级 AUC（控制混杂）。总共 450 次运行（2 数据集 × 25 条件 × 3 α × 3 种子）。
AI.result: 核心结果如下：(1) 持久随机标签翻转——所有输入条件不确定性信号在客户端内样本级别均处于随机水平（AV/AE/EV/EE AUC = 0.49–0.50），而预测-标签损失强劲（CIFAR-10 AUC = 0.85，SVHN AUC = 0.95）；(2) 加性图像噪声——期望熵（AE）优于损失（AE AUC = 0.67/0.66 vs. Loss AUC = 0.64/0.64 on CIFAR-10/SVHN），且当 M ≥ 4 时 AE 在所有噪声单元均占优；(3) 危害不对称——标签翻转使准确率下降多达 39 个百分点（CIFAR-10），而图像噪声仅使准确率变化 +0.2 到 +1.4 个百分点（类似数据增强）；(4) 损失随腐败流行率增加而削弱（标签翻转损失 AUC 从 0.93/0.98 降至 0.70/0.86）。结论是：每种信号对不同腐败模式具有不同的信息价值。
AI.conclusion: 本文得出结论：在联邦学习中，不同类型的数据腐败会留下不同的特征信号。持久随机标签翻转（危害最大）能被预测-标签损失检测，却无法被输入条件不确定性检测；图像噪声（危害较小）则能被期望熵不确定性更好地检测。因此，稳健的 FL 数据质量评估不应单一依赖不确定性信号，而应将信号与腐败类型匹配——同时监控基于熵的不确定性和预测-标签损失。本研究为诊断性的信号比较，未将信号用于客户端选择或聚合。未来工作包括：将这些信号嵌入完整的防御流程、构建联邦腐败检测器、以及测试类一致翻转等更复杂腐败模式下的信号行为。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Federated Learning for Infant Movement Analysis
comment: Accepted at IEEE The 4th International Conference on Federated Learning Technologies and Applications (FLTA26)
summary: Infant movement analysis provides valuable biomarkers for the early identification of neurodevelopmental disorders. Recent advances in deep learning have enabled automated analysis of infant movements from video-derived skeletal representations, achieving performance comparable to expert assessment for tasks such as General Movement Assessment (GMA). However, most existing approaches rely on centralized training, requiring data from multiple institutions to be collected and stored at a single site. Such assumptions are often impractical in clinical settings due to privacy, governance, and data-sharing constraints. To address these challenges, we present, to the best of our knowledge, the first federated learning framework for automated infant movement analysis and General Movement Assessment using skeletal motion data. As a clinically relevant use case, the proposed framework is evaluated on fidgety movement classification. To quantify model confidence, Monte Carlo (MC) Dropout is employed to estimate predictive uncertainty during inference. Building upon this, we propose an Uncertainty-Aware Federated Averaging (UA-FedAvg) strategy that incorporates predictive entropy derived from MC-Dropout into the federated aggregation process, enabling client contributions to be adjusted according to their predictive uncertainty. Experiments were conducted using a cross-subject evaluation protocol under a three-client federated learning setting. Results demonstrate that federated learning substantially improves classification performance compared with independently trained local models while achieving performance approaching that of centralized training. Furthermore, UA-FedAvg and its variant incorporating validation loss generally outperform conventional FedAvg across the evaluated data-split configurations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个面向婴儿运动分析（具体为一般运动评估GMA中的fidgety movement分类）的联邦学习框架，并通过将MC-Dropout估计的预测熵融入聚合过程，提出了Uncertainty-Aware FedAvg (UA-FedAvg) 及其结合验证损失的变体。三客户端实验表明，联邦学习显著优于独立本地训练，且接近集中训练性能；UA-FedAvg在多数数据划分下优于标准FedAvg。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化GMA研究多依赖集中式训练，但临床场景中婴儿运动数据因隐私、伦理和治理约束难以跨机构共享，限制了多机构协作建模的可行性。此外，不同机构间的数据分布异质性可能导致客户端模型置信度差异，而传统FedAvg仅依据样本量加权，忽略了模型可靠性信息。
AI.method: 1) 基于Flower构建三客户端联邦学习框架，每个客户端使用Kulvicius等人提出的CNN对2D骨架运动序列（250帧×60维）进行fidgety movement二分类；2) 采用MC-Dropout在推理时进行多次随机前向传播，估计预测均值、方差和预测熵；3) 提出UA-FedAvg聚合策略，以w_i ∝ n_i/(H_i+ε)为客户端加权；4) 提出UA-FedAvg w/ vLoss变体，将验证损失L_i与预测熵H_i结合（权重因子α=0.25）；5) 采用9折跨被试交叉验证，三种数据划分（111-211、211-211、211-112），3个随机种子取平均。
AI.result: 在聚合评估中：集中式基线准确率0.8685；无联邦（No Federation）仅0.77–0.79；FedAvg提升至0.853–0.857；UA-FedAvg为0.850–0.860；UA-FedAvg w/ vLoss在111-211和211-211划分下取得最佳准确率（0.8638、0.8626），UA-FedAvg在211-112划分下四项指标均最优。联邦模型与集中训练差距<1%。客户端层面，UA-FedAvg w/ vLoss对训练数据比例较低的客户端（如111-211的Client#1、211-112的Client#3）提升更明显。预测不确定性方面，UA-FedAvg多数情况下中位预测不确定性最低。
AI.conclusion: 实验证明：(1) 联邦学习可使分布式婴儿运动分析接近集中式训练性能；(2) 预测熵作为置信度代理可在多数数据划分下指导联邦聚合，UA-FedAvg及其变体总体优于标准FedAvg；(3) UA-FedAvg策略模型无关，可推广至其他可估计预测不确定性的联邦学习应用。局限在于数据集仅含典型发育婴儿，结果未必适用于CP等高风险临床人群。未来工作包括：在多机构多样化队列上验证、引入校准指标（ECE、BALD）与样本级噪声/标签翻转检测、与FedProx/SCAFFOLD/FedAdam/FedYogi等方法对比。

title: Evaluating Cultural Awareness of LLMs for Haitian Creole
summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit substantial performance disparities between high- and low-resource languages. Beyond lower task performance, they often fail to capture the cultural norms and values of underrepresented communities. In this work, we present the first systematic evaluation of cultural awareness in LLMs for Haitian Creole, a language spoken by millions but severely underrepresented in digital resources. We assess cultural awareness along four complementary dimensions---specificity, bias, diversity, and variation---using a benchmark of culturally salient prompts curated by native speakers in a text infilling setting. Our results reveal a clear gap between cultural awareness in Haitian Creole and higher-resource French, with Haitian performance being more uneven across domains and more affected by French linguistic interference. Story generation further reveals recurring portrayals of Haitian characters through hardship and resilience, showing that even positive characterizations can encode stereotypical narratives. Our code, benchmark, and evaluation framework are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次系统评估了大语言模型（LLMs）在海地克里奥尔语（Haitian Creole）中的文化意识，针对一个在数字资源中严重欠缺的低资源语言，提出了由母语者策划的文化相关提示（prompt）基准，并沿四个维度（specificity、bias、diversity、variation）评估了Mistral模型的文化实体填充能力及故事生成中的刻板印象表征。
AI.motivation: 多语言LLMs在高资源与低资源语言之间存在显著性能差距，且即便能生成语法正确的文本，也常常无法准确捕捉特定语言社区的文化规范和价值观。海地克里奥尔语虽使用者超过1300万，但在NLP资源中严重不足，且先前研究多聚焦标准任务（如机器翻译、阅读理解），缺乏对其文化表征能力的系统评估。因此，作者旨在回答：多语言LLMs在用海地克里奥尔语生成文本时，能在多大程度上理解和表征海地文化？
AI.method:
1. 基于CAMeL框架设计文化实体填充任务（cultural entity infilling）和故事生成任务。
2. 构建首个文化显著性基准：七类文化实体（Food、Music Groups、Music Type、Festivals、Political Figures/ Heroes、Authors、Locations），由四位母语者策划并标注，含文化和上下文无关（agnostic）两类提示。
3. 评估指标涵盖四个维度：specificity（文化对齐比例）、bias（非目标文化比例）、diversity（目标文化实体覆盖广度）、variation（重复生成的多样性）。
4. 主实验采用Mistral Medium模型（中大型），并将其与French语境对比，以分离语言资源不足与文化表征问题。
5. 故事生成任务中，使用z-score方法提取与海地/法国角色最相关的形容词，分析刻板印象表征。
AI.result:
1. 海地克里奥尔语的文化意识明显低于法语，跨领域表现不均衡：Music Groups和Authors较强，Festivals和Locations较弱。
2. Locations类常出现法语命名对海地克里奥尔语的"语言干扰"，降低specificity并抬高bias。
3. 中等规模Mistral模型在specificity和bias上整体优于大规模模型，但大规模模型diversity更高，表明diversity与specificity互补。
4. 故事生成揭示：海地角色反复被框定为"坚韧面对逆境"的刻板形象（如贫穷、简朴、努力、慷慨），即使描述为正面属性，也限制了叙事模板；法国角色则呈现更广泛的个体身份（独立、内省、冒险、日常经验）。
5. 刻板印象在仅以食物或音乐团体为条件时仍持续存在，表明文化刻板印象超越显性国籍线索，且即使是积极属性（如resilient、courageous）也可能反映定型化表征。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了首个用于评估海地文化意识的多语言LLMs基准，包括母语者策划的文化显著性提示和实体清单，并提出结合specificity、diversity、bias、variation的评估框架。结果揭示了海地克里奥尔语与高资源法语之间的清晰文化意识差距、跨文化领域的显著差异，以及对海地角色反复通过"艰辛与韧性"进行的叙事表征。研究强调，在低资源语言场景中评估LLMs时，不仅要关注语言支持度，还需关注其表征该文化的忠实性与包容性；同时，积极属性不应被直接视为无偏见的证据，需结合具体叙事语境进行评估。

title: Compact Documentation for Coding Agents: A Benchmark, an Optimizer, and Why It Does Not Transfer
comment: 13 pages. Code and data: this https URL
summary: We investigate whether natural-language documentation helps coding agents resolve software issues, and we build the tools to construct and evaluate it. We introduce a roundtrip benchmark that scores code descriptions by whether code regenerated from them passes the original tests, and show that completeness, not length, drives a description's fidelity. Using the benchmark as an optimization signal, we discover a description-writing prompt that reaches full fidelity and generalizes to unseen files. We then test the hypothesis that motivated the work: that better documentation helps an agent resolve real repository issues. Across two model families and ten repositories, and against a positive control confirming that our evaluation can detect a genuine improvement, we find that it does not. When the source is present, neither static compact documentation nor retrieved context beats the issue alone. We report this negative result together with the benchmark and the optimizer, and we characterize the boundary at which documentation helps.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自然语言文档是否能帮助编码代理解决软件问题。研究者构建了一个往返基准（roundtrip benchmark）来评估代码描述的保真度，并通过该基准优化出了一个能生成高保真描述的提示词。然而，在跨两个模型家族和十个仓库的大规模实验中，他们发现：当源代码已存在于上下文中时，无论是紧凑文档还是检索上下文，都无法比仅提供问题描述带来更多收益——核心动机假设失败。这是一个诚实的负面结果报告。
AI.motivation: 大型代码库无法全部加载到代理上下文中时，编码代理必须依赖高层文档来推断代码的意图和契约。由此自然产生一个假设：高质量的自然语言文档应能帮助代理解决实际问题。研究者试图构建足够好的文档并验证这一假设。
AI.method: 1. 边界实验：使用人工构造的代码库和控制任务，确立"文档仅在携带源码未暴露的意图或契约时才有用"，并分离出完整性与紧凑性两个属性。2. 往返基准：从 SWE-bench Verified 筛选出 11 个 fixture（单文件修改、有命名 oracle 测试、自包含），通过 describe→regenerate→evaluate 三阶段流程，以原始测试套件为等价性预言机来评分描述的保真度，并定义密度（描述 token 数 / 代码 token 数）衡量紧凑性。3. 提示词优化：以基准分数为目标，将描述提示词视作 harness 进行自动搜索优化，使用 3 个训练 fixture 和 2 个保留 fixture 验证泛化性。4. 下游迁移测试：在源代码存在和源代码缺失两种条件下，跨两个模型家族、五个设置和十个仓库（含 SWE-ContextBench 外部基准），使用配对符号检验和 McNemar 检验评估文档对问题解决率的影响。
AI.result: 1. 完整性（而非长度）是描述价值的决定因素：完整描述无论长短，对弱模型增益相同；遗漏事实的冗长描述同样失败。2. 往返基准上，Flash 模型在 11 个 fixture 上平均保真度 0.32±0.35，密度与保真度的 Pearson 相关性为 0.88；外部工具 OpenWiki 因遗漏内部细节而保真度更低。3. 优化循环在训练集上达到保真度 1.0，在保留集上将保真度从 0.5 提升到 1.0，且独立重新发现了研究者手工归纳的失败模式修复方案。4. 源代码缺失时，优化描述将平均测试通过率从 0.08 提升到 0.71。5. 源代码存在时（核心场景），跨 5 个设置、2 个模型家族、3 种文档类型的实验一致显示文档不优于仅提供问题：Gemini-2.5-Pro 在 django 上紧凑描述 16 vs 问题单独 15；Flash 在 SWE-ContextBench Lite 全部任务上问题单独 33 vs 紧凑 29 vs 检索 30（McNemar p=0.22/0.25，不显著），且完整长度描述是最差条件。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心结论是一条边界而非一种方法：自然语言文档在源代码无法装入上下文时是有效的压缩替代形式，但在源代码已存在时则冗余甚至有害（因为完整描述会诱导代理重写而非打补丁）。完整性而非长度决定描述的价值；往返基准可以驱动描述生成器的自动优化。然而，在编码代理通常工作的"源代码在场"场景下，额外的文档并不能改善问题解决率——核心动机假设被证伪。这是一个有正面对照验证（确认评测工具能检测真实改进）支撑的稳健负面结果。研究者明确报告了该负面发现并指出了下一步方向：在仓库规模上验证同样的现象。

title: Proceedings 19th Interaction and Concurrency Experience
summary: This volume contains the proceedings of ICE'26, the 19th Interaction and Concurrency Experience, which was held in Urbino, Italy, as a satellite event of DisCoTec'26. The ICE workshop series features a distinguishing review and selection procedure: PC members are encouraged to interact, anonymously, with authors. The 2026 edition of ICE received 8 submissions, each reviewed by three PC members, and about 60 comments were exchanged during the review process, witnessing very lively discussions. Five papers were accepted for publication plus two oral communications, which were accepted for presentation at the workshop. We were proud to host one invited talk, by Emilio Tuosto. The abstract of his talk is included in this volume, together with the final versions of the research papers, which take into account the discussion at the workshop and during the review process.

AI.tldr: This is the proceedings volume of ICE'26 (the 19th Interaction and Concurrency Experience workshop), held in Urbino, Italy, as a satellite event of DisCoTec'26. It contains a preface, one invited talk abstract, and five accepted research papers covering topics such as safe composition of communicating finite-state machines, asynchrony and reversibility in CCS, session type state spaces, shared-space coordination modelling, and structural invariants in Colored Petri Nets.
AI.motivation: ICE is a well-established workshop series focused on interaction and concurrency experience. The motivation is to provide a forum with a distinctive interactive review process (double-anonymous, with PC members encouraged to interact with authors via HotCRP) that improves feedback quality and paper quality. This proceedings documents the 2026 edition's contributions to the theoretical foundations of concurrent and distributed systems.
AI.method: The workshop employs a double-anonymous review process on the HotCRP platform, with three PC members reviewing each submission and approximately 60 comments exchanged overall. The 2026 edition received 8 submissions, of which 5 papers were accepted for publication and 2 were accepted as oral communications (not included in the proceedings). Discussions continued during and after the workshop, with authors incorporating feedback into final versions.
AI.result: The proceedings includes: (1) an invited talk abstract by Emilio Tuosto titled "What do you mean A -> B: m?" reviewing 30 years of behavioural specifications for distributed communicating systems; (2) "Safe Composition of CFSM Systems via Partial Gateways" by Franco Barbanera; (3) "On Asynchrony and Reversibility in CCS" by Hernán Melgratti, Claudio Antares Mezzina, and G. Michele Pinna; (4) "Session Type State Spaces Form Lattices" by Alexandre Zua Caldeira; (5) "Modelling Shared-Space Coordination in mCRL2: a Bach-to-mCRL2 Translation Framework" by Corentin Reuther and Jean-Marie Jacquet; and (6) "A Practical Approach To Verifying Structural Invariants In Colored Petri Nets" by Lorenzo Capra. Christopher Esterhuyse received the ICE 2026 Outstanding PC Member Award.
AI.conclusion: The volume documents a successful 19th edition of ICE, showcasing active research in concurrency theory, formal methods for distributed systems, session types, process algebras (CCS), Petri nets, and coordination languages. The interactive review process continues to be a distinguishing feature of the workshop, with the lively discussions contributing to improved paper quality. The invited talk highlights open problems in behavioural specifications of distributed communicating systems, suggesting directions for future research in the community.

title: Communication-Aware Model Distributed Inference via Latent Representation Compression
comment: This is an extended version of the work published at MobiHoc 2026
summary: We study optimization of distributed model inference over resource-constrained edge resources. We propose a framework that optimizes the trade-off between model accuracy and communication costs by controlling latent representation compression to meet strict Quality of Service (QoS) throughput targets. For settings with known channel state information (CSI), we derive a closed-form optimal solution for single tasks and reduce the multi-task problem to a convex optimization program characterized by a per-link water-filling strategy. We extend these to handle unpredictable environments via a stochastic dual descent algorithm that relies only on causal channel estimates. We provide Lyapunov-based proofs demonstrating that our approach strictly satisfies long-term delay constraints while achieving a bounded optimality gap. Our results offer a robust, scalable blueprint for maximizing the performance of pipelined AI tasks in dynamic, resource-constrained distributed systems. We verify the effectiveness of our proposed framework through simulations and experiments with real edge devices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向资源受限边缘设备的分布式模型推理框架，通过动态调整中间激活的压缩率，在满足严格QoS吞吐量约束的同时最大化推理精度。在已知CSI条件下推导出单任务闭式最优解及多任务凸优化（逐链路注水）策略；在未知CSI条件下提出基于随机对偶下降的在线算法，并利用Lyapunov方法证明其满足长期时延约束且具有有界最优性间隙。通过在Raspberry Pi、Jetson Orin Nano及PRESCIENT三个真实边缘测试床以及多种视觉/语言任务上的大量实验验证了算法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 边缘设备部署大规模ML模型面临通信开销瓶颈：传输未压缩的中间激活在高动态信道下成为吞吐量瓶颈。已有模型压缩与分布式推理工作大多假设静态网络或单任务环境，无法联合处理动态信道、多任务共享资源以及准确率-通信开销的实时权衡。
AI.method: 1) 建立系统模型：多个ML推理任务被流水线并行分区到边缘节点图上，节点间传输中间激活时可进行压缩，引入压缩率η和精度-压缩函数A(η)。2) CSI已知情形：单任务给出闭式最优解η*=min{1, c/(Ra)}；多任务化为凸优化，等价于逐链路注水策略。3) CSI未知情形：提出随机对偶下降算法（单任务Alg.1，多任务Alg.2用块坐标下降），采用90%下置信界（LCB）作为因果信道估计。4) 精度-压缩函数估计：使用多项式/MLP等拟合方法以及基于Stein引理的高斯核平滑零阶梯度估计，并通过Monte Carlo Jensen不等式统计验证A(η)在信息域内的凹性。5) 基于Lyapunov漂移分析证明长期时延约束严格满足且最优性间隙有界（O(μ)与O(1/μ)权衡）。
AI.result: 离线实验：OURS-CSI在所有CSI已知场景取得最高可行精度；OURS-NOCSI在多数No-CSI场景下满足时延约束且精度接近CSI已知最优，明显优于MYO、MA等失败基线和过度悲观的CONS。真实测试床（PRESCIENT、Jetson、Raspberry Pi）：在P-L1-G、P-VV-G、J-LV-M等高难度场景中，OURS-NOCSI是唯一同时可行且高精度的No-CSI方法，I8压缩下P-VL-E精度达0.844。μ-扫描实验验证了理论O(μ)与O(1/μ)权衡。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的通信感知框架为动态、资源受限的分布式边缘推理提供了鲁棒、可扩展的蓝图：通过动态调节中间激活压缩率，能够严格满足QoS吞吐量约束同时最大化聚合精度。未来的工作方向包括应对链路中断的提前退出策略，以及处理自回归工作负载中prefill与decode阶段不同计算和激活负载的问题。

title: Unifying In-Memory Data Analytics through Sparse Compilation
summary: As modern data analytics workloads become increasingly heterogeneous and hardware-intensive, achieving efficient multi-core performance across diverse applications remains an open challenge. We present Reffine, a compiler-based in-memory analytics engine that delivers high performance across a broad range of data analytics workloads.
