AI.method: 从GitHub挖掘2024-2026年间22,555个迁移提交(17,703个非派生仓库),匹配OpenAI、Anthropic、Google的官方退役事件表(46个事件)。两名独立编码者对300个分层抽样提交进行人工标注(κ=0.89-0.95),根据真实迁移率重新加权估算。方法涉及:事件匹配、关键词分类器、提交级时间分析、按提供商的剂量-反应逻辑回归。
AI.result: 主要结果:1)估计82%的迁移发生在停服后,中位数在停服后39天才提交;2)被动迁移比例随通知期缩短而增加:Anthropic 89%、Google 64%、OpenAI 66%;3)Assistants API一年通知仅产生13%被动迁移,claude-3-haiku 60天通知则达86%;4)通知期每增加e倍,被动迁移几率降低约75%;5)94%的迁移应用硬编码模型标识符;6)迁移规模从仅提示应用的6行到精调应用的近700行;7)仅8%的迁移切换提供商;8)先前有迁移经验的仓库未表现出学习效应。
AI.conclusion: 通知长度是决定应用是否中断的最关键政策杠杆;硬编码模型标识符、不充分的异常处理、缺失的评估套件共同导致了被动的、破坏性的迁移。论文建议:提供商应延长通知期并在API响应中加入弃用头;长补实践应将模型标识符外置、实现显式失败、采用CI检查;依赖风险评估应关注通知政策暴露程度而非简单的"支持多提供商"或"经历过类似事件"等代理指标。论文公开了数据集与流水线以支持后续追踪研究。

title: HybridInfer: Thermal-Aware Reinforcement-Learning Tier Routing for On-Device, Edge, and Cloud LLM Inference
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures. Evaluated on real Android hardware (Samsung Galaxy S25+, Snapdragon 8 Elite). Workload of 210 prompts with frozen gold references. Android measurement harness and full routing/evaluation pipeline released for replication at this https URL
summary: On-device inference with small language models keeps user data local, works offline, and incurs no per-query cost, so the on-device tier is preferred when it is adequate. It is thermally constrained, however, and I find the constraint is sharper than a slowdown: on a flagship Snapdragon device, sustained on-device generation destabilizes the GPU inference runtime, which crashes or silently wedges after a few consecutive queries. The failure lies in the current toolchain (OpenCL kernel compilation and long-prompt prefill on the mobile GPU), recurs even when the device is cool, and is worst for long generations. Multi-tier routers across on-device, edge, and cloud models can relieve this pressure, but existing routers are thermal-blind and typically evaluated in simulation or on non-mobile hardware. I present HybridInfer, a thermal-aware reinforcement-learning router for a three-tier hierarchy (on-device Llama 3.2 3B, edge Llama 3.1 8B with retrieval, cloud GPT-4o) that uses the phone's thermal headroom and a query-complexity estimate as state and selects a tier by an offline-trained Q-learning policy. Its reward trades quality against latency, cost, and a thermal penalty, plus a locality bonus crediting on-device execution. I show this bonus is a precondition for thermal-aware routing: without it the optimal policy offloads every query. On a real Android benchmark of 210 prompts, the learned router attains significantly higher quality than two hand-tuned heuristics (paired Wilcoxon, p < 0.02) at the lowest cost of any adaptive condition. Always-on-device conditions match per-query quality on servable queries but are three to six times slower and fail on long queries, so routing wins on latency, reliability, and coverage rather than quality. To my knowledge this is the first use of on-device thermal headroom to select among LLM inference tiers of differing capability on real hardware.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HybridInfer，一种基于强化学习的热感知路由器，在真实 Android 设备上根据手机热余量和查询复杂度，动态选择在设备端（Llama 3.2 3B）、边缘端（Llama 3.1 8B + RAG）和云端（GPT-4o）三级推理中执行哪个层级。其核心创新是将设备热状态作为跨能力层级选择的控制信号，并通过离线 Q-learning 训练出平衡质量、延迟、成本和热惩罚的策略，并加入了"本地奖励"以确保设备端推理在热可行时被优先使用。在 210 条真实 Android 基准测试中，HybridInfer 在最低成本下取得了显著优于两种手工调优启发式方法的答案质量。同时，本文还揭示了一个非预期的发现：当前旗舰手机上的持续设备端 LLM 推理不仅会变慢，而且会导致 GPU 推理运行时崩溃或卡死（即便设备处于冷却状态），长提示甚至在 prefill 阶段就完全无法完成。
AI.motivation: 现有的多层级 LLM 路由器（设备-边缘-云）通常是"热盲"的，即在决策时不考虑执行本地层级的设备的物理状态。它们要么在仿真中评估，要么在非移动硬件上评估，无法反映真实手机环境下的热约束与运行时稳定性问题。此外，目前对于设备端 LLM 推理的测量研究普遍将其视为吞吐量受限问题，而忽视了其作为可靠性问题的本质。
AI.method: HybridInfer 是一种基于 Q-learning 的离线训练路由器，部署在搭载骁龙 8 Elite 的三星 Galaxy S25+ 真机上。其状态由两部分构成：(1) 通过 Android `getThermalHeadroom` API 获得的设备热余量分箱；(2) 查询复杂度分箱。动作空间为三级推理层级。奖励函数综合了答案质量（与独立 gold 模型对比的 BERTScore-F1）、延迟、货币成本和热降频惩罚，并加入了一个"本地奖励"（locality bonus），以显式激励在热可行时选择设备端推理。实验中对比了 7 种条件：纯云、纯边缘、纯设备端、复杂度路由、置信度级联、热阈值启发式和 RL 路由器。
AI.result: 在 210 条真实 Android 基准测试中：(1) RL 路由器（C7）以 0.8399 的 BERTScore-F1 取得所有自适应条件中最高的答案质量，显著优于复杂度路由（C4，p=0.011）和热阈值启发式（C6，p=0.0015），且成本最低（$0.0017/查询）；(2) 在 40 条设备端可服务的短/中等提示子集上，RL 路由器达到 0.8446，与纯云（0.8496）的差距小于 0.01，但延迟仅约 9 秒（云端为 4.8 秒，设备端为 28-30 秒），同时还能覆盖长提示（设备端长提示 55% 会在 240 秒内卡死）；(3) 揭示了一个关键可靠性问题：持续设备端推理在 4-12 次连续查询后会发生 GPU 运行时崩溃或静默卡死，根因在于 OpenCL 内核编译和长提示 prefill 阶段的 Adreno OpenCL 驱动问题，即使设备处于冷却状态也会复现；(4) 消融实验证明：若奖励中不加入本地奖励，最优策略将退化为无条件卸载，热状态完全失去决策意义。
AI.conclusion: HybridInfer 是首个利用设备热余量在异构能力 LLM 推理层级（设备端 SLM、边缘 RAG、云端 LLM）之间进行选择并经过真机验证的系统，将热感知强化学习从同模型的频率调节轴扩展到了跨能力层级的质量-热权衡轴。两个核心贡献：(1) 设计洞察——本地奖励是热感知路由有意义的前提条件；(2) 实证发现——当前旗舰手机上持续设备端 LLM 推理存在运行时可靠性与覆盖性风险，热感知路由不仅是效率机制，更是可靠性与覆盖性保障机制。代码、数据与工作负载已开源以支持复现。主要局限：单一设备型号、学习路由器部分因热状态偶发崩溃导致数据不完整（C1、C5 因连续会话崩溃只能在冷却后单次启动测量）。

title: When the Preconditioning Exponent Turns Negative: Learning-Rate Coupling and Cross-Environment Generalization
summary: Adaptive optimizers are commonly parameterized by a fixed power of the second-moment estimate. Existing partially adaptive methods study exponents between momentum-like updates and the standard Adam square root, while the interaction between this exponent and the global learning rate is less understood. We perform a controlled cross-environment study using a paired four-environment classification problem with stable sparse features, environment-dependent spurious sparse features, dense features, and high-dimensional noise. Across \NumRuns{} source-training runs covering 21 preconditioning exponents $p\in[-0.5,0.5]$ and five learning rates $\eta\in[10^{-4},10^{-2}]$, we find that the exponent maximizing cross-environment accuracy decreases almost linearly with $\log_{10}\eta$. The fitted slopes range from $-0.270$ to $-0.300$, with $R^2$ between $0.972$ and $0.996$. At $\eta=10^{-2}$, source-validation selection still prefers positive exponents in all four environments, whereas cross-environment and worst-environment criteria prefer negative exponents. Checkpoint decomposition shows that lower $p$ reduces the learned spurious-to-stable and noise-to-stable weight ratios; under reversed correlation, it also reduces the magnitude of the harmful spurious margin. Negative $p$ is therefore not a universally optimal setting. It is a high-step-size allocation regime produced by the joint action of learning rate and preconditioning. The study also exposes a model-selection conflict: source-domain validation systematically selects a different preconditioning regime from the one that maximizes robustness to environmental change. The results are a single-seed, finite-budget mechanism study rather than a broad benchmark claim.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究自适应优化器中预条件指数 p（控制二阶矩估计的幂次）与全局学习率 η 的耦合效应及其对跨环境泛化的影响。通过在配对的四环境合成分类任务上扫描 21 个 p 值和 5 个 η 值（共 420 次训练），发现最大化跨环境准确率的最佳 p 值随 log₁₀η 近似线性下降（斜率约 -0.27 至 -0.30，R²>0.97）。在高学习率下，最优 p 变为负数，而源域验证仍偏好正指数。负 p 能降低虚假特征与噪声特征的相对权重分配，减少有害虚假边缘。该研究揭示了源域验证与鲁棒性优化之间的模型选择冲突。
AI.motivation: 现有部分自适应方法（如 Padam）研究了动量型（p=0）到 Adam 型（p=1/2）之间的指数，但预条件指数 p 与学习率 η 之间的耦合关系及其对分布偏移下泛化的影响尚不清楚。论文旨在探索：当 p 变为负数时，优化器的行为如何变化，以及这如何与学习率共同影响跨环境鲁棒性。
AI.method: 方法核心是将 Adam 预条件中的平方根替换为连续指数 p，构建广义预条件更新 Δθ = -η·m̂·(v̂+ε)^(-p)。实验设计了一个配对的四环境合成二分类任务，包含四个特征模块：稠密块、稳定稀疏块（标签相关性固定）、环境依赖虚假稀疏块（相关性为 0.9/0.5/0/-0.5）、纯噪声块。使用线性分类器，扫描 p∈[-0.5, 0.5]（21个值）和 η∈[10⁻⁴, 10⁻²]（5个值），共 420 次训练。检查点仅通过源域验证损失选择，然后冻结评估所有四个测试环境。通过权重 RMS 比值比和有符号边缘分解来诊断特征分配。
AI.result: 主要结果：1) 跨环境最优指数 p 与 log₁₀η 近似呈线性负相关，斜率范围 -0.270 至 -0.300，R² 在 0.972-0.996 之间；2) 在 η=10⁻² 时，源域验证在所有环境中仍选择正指数（p∈[0.10, 0.25]），而跨环境和最坏环境准则选择负指数（p∈[-0.30, -0.05]），ID-cross 差距为 0.20-0.40；4) 权重分解显示负 p 降低了虚假-稳定和噪声-稳定的 RMS 权重比；5) 边缘分解证实负 p 减小了相关性反转环境中有害虚假边缘的幅度。最优 p 是有限的，不是一致地偏好最小 p。
AI.conclusion: 该论文得出以下结论：1) 连续预条件指数与全局学习率构成耦合的优化控制系统；2) 在受控的稀疏特征场景中，最大化跨环境泛化的指数随学习率对数近似线性下降，在高学习率下会穿过零进入负值区域；3) 负 p 并非普遍最优设置，而是高学习率下由学习率与预条件联合作用产生的高步长分配机制；4) 源域验证与跨环境鲁棒性之间存在系统性的优化器模型选择冲突，仅凭源域验证无法可靠地选择最优的负 p 值；5) p 和 η 是不可互换的——学习率缩放整体更新幅度并改变后续参数状态，而指数通过即时改变坐标比来调节分配。研究的主要教训在于：有用指数的符号和大小取决于步长机制以及优化是以源还是源环境鲁棒性来评判的。

title: Offline Policy Evaluation as a decision support tool for designing Adaptive Experiments
summary: We investigate how historical data from fixed randomized experiments (A/B tests) can be used to inform the deployment of adaptive experiments based on contextual bandits. Given data collected under a static allocation, our goal is to assess which adaptive policies, if any, would have outperformed the original design and under what conditions. To this end, we combine off-policy evaluation (OPE) with a controlled warm-start simulation. From logged A/B test data exhibiting heterogeneous treatment effects, we estimate nuisance components and use doubly robust estimators to rank a portfolio of pre-specified adaptive and non-adaptive policies. When ground truth is available, we then deploy the same offline-trained policies in a simulator that reuses the exact data-generating reward probabilities, providing a safe, ground-truth-anchored environment to study the offline-to-online transition under warm starting. Using synthetic randomized controlled trials with known heterogeneity structures and an oracle policy, our results indicate that adaptive, context-aware policies improve upon fixed allocations when meaningful heterogeneity is present, while providing little benefit in its absence. We reinforce our findings on standard open benchmarks (Hillstrom, Criteo Uplift, and LaLonde), reinterpreted through a policy-value and regret perspective. Overall, our results provide a practical methodology for deciding when adaptive experimentation is worth deploying and how to select among competing adaptive policies using existing A/B test data.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何利用历史A/B测试数据，借助离线策略评估（OPE）来判断是否值得部署基于上下文赌博机的自适应实验，并提出一个两级框架：Level 1使用双重稳健（DR）估计器对候选策略进行离线排序；Level 2在已知奖励函数的受控热启动模拟器中部署同一组策略。合成实验（无上下文、分类异质性、线性、振荡、二维等场景）和三个公开基准（Hillstrom、Criteo、LaLonde）共同表明：当存在显著异质性时，自适应策略显著优于固定分配；而在缺乏异质性时收益有限。
AI.motivation: A/B测试虽然是无偏因果推断的金标准，但对所有个体采用统一分配，无法利用上下文信息实现个性化。自适应实验（上下文赌博机）可通过序列决策改善参与者收益并加速异质性识别，但其部署前缺乏信心判断，且存在冷启动问题。如何利用既有A/B测试历史数据，系统性地回答"自适应实验是否值得部署"这一决策问题，是本文的核心动机。
AI.method: 提出两级决策支持框架：Level 1——离线策略评估（OPE），使用样本拆分拟合倾向得分与结果模型，以双重稳健（DR）估计器为主要方法（IPS、SNIPS为稳健性检验），对一组预定义策略（Bootstrapped Thompson Sampling、Bootstrapped UCB、Softmax、ε-Greedy、固定基线和oracle策略）进行排序，并通过bootstrap置信区间量化不确定性；Level 2——受控热启动模拟器，复用合成数据生成过程中精确已知的奖励函数μ_a(x)，将离线训练策略以相同初始化部署于在线序列决策，记录累积奖励、累积遗憾与oracle一致性精度。两层在统一的策略价值（policy value）与遗憾（regret）视角下联合解读。
AI.result: 合成实验显示：在分类、线性、振荡、二维组合等存在显著异质性的设置中，自适应策略的OPE价值与在线累积奖励均显著优于固定基线，且最强自适应策略接近oracle（动作准确率0.83–0.95），固定基线遗憾高出8–16倍；无上下文场景中各策略无实质差距。在线热启动验证了离线OPE的粗粒度部署信号有效（自适应vs非自适应区分清晰），但对历史依赖型自适应策略间的细粒度排序不完全可靠。公开基准结果：Hillstrom为弱异质性信号（自适应与固定基线置信区间重叠）；Criteo为强异质性信号（自适应策略一致优于基线）；LaLonde受支持重叠限制难以分离。DR在38个场景-策略组合中均不劣于其他估计器，作为主估计器具有稳健性。
AI.conclusion: 历史A/B测试数据可通过OPE为自适应实验部署决策提供有效支持：策略价值的视角能清晰区分"值得部署自适应"的场景（存在显著上下文异质性）与"固定策略已足够"的场景（异质性微弱或缺失）。热启动模拟器作为离线-在线匹配最佳情形基准，证明离线学到的结构可在在线交互初期保持。在线策略学习（OPL）在本文考虑的策略组合中边际收益有限。本文工作为"是否部署自适应"及"选择何种候选自适应策略"提供了实用的决策支持方法论，但仍局限于赌博机设定且未涉及模型误设、协变量偏移与时序漂移的鲁棒性。

title: Cosine Similarity Is Not Evidence: Measuring the Noise Floor of Interpretability Transfer Under Quantization
comment: 10 pages (5-page main text, plus references and appendices), 1 figure, 3 tables. Code, data, and a one-cell reproduction: this https URL
summary: A statistic reported without the quantity needed to interpret it is not evidence. We develop that thesis for a concrete practice in AI safety. Interpretability artifacts are calibrated on full-precision weights, deployed on quantized ones, and certified as surviving the change by scale-invariant statistics (cosine similarity, correlation, AUROC) that are reported without their noise floor. For the difference-in-means direction estimator, the split-half floor is governed by one dimensionless number, $\kappa = n\rho^2/d$. The closed form $\mathbb{E}[\cos] \approx (1+4/\kappa)^{-1}$ is classical; the missing input is the class separation $\rho$, which we measure on real activations; no compression-transfer study we know of reports it. On Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, $\rho = 33$--$61$ across depth, so two independent runs of the estimator agree to $0.978$--$0.994$ by sampling alone. A published cosine of $0.996$ between full-precision and quantized refusal directions therefore cannot be read as preservation without the $n$ it was computed at, which is not reported. Where $n$ is known, we judge each low-bit cosine against the split-half null measured within that quantized model, because a full-precision null assumes the low-bit estimator has the same variance. That assumption is exactly what a null exists to test. The result is plain: at INT4 the direction rotated, and the deficit exceeds the estimator's own noise. At INT8 we detect no movement, which is not an equivalence claim. We also show that a scale-invariant statistic cannot distinguish translation from attenuation of a transferred decision variable, although the two call for opposite remedies. We close with reporting recommendations that cost one forward pass. Code, data, and a one-cell reproduction are released at this https URL

AI.tldr: This paper argues that cosine similarity alone is insufficient evidence for claiming interpretability artifacts (e.g., refusal directions) survive quantization. The author develops a closed-form noise floor for the difference-in-means direction estimator governed by κ = nρ²/d, measures ρ on Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct (ρ = 33–61), and shows that published cosines (e.g., 0.996) may sit at or below the estimator's own sampling noise. Experiments show INT4 causes real rotation of the refusal direction while INT8 shows no detected movement, and scale-invariant statistics cannot distinguish translation from attenuation of transferred decision variables.
AI.motivation: In AI safety, interpretability artifacts (probes, steering vectors, refusal directions) are calibrated on full-precision weights but deployed on quantized models (e.g., 4-bit). Practitioners certify preservation using scale-invariant statistics like cosine similarity without reporting sample size n or class separation ρ. Without knowing the estimator's noise floor, a high cosine cannot be interpreted as evidence of preservation. The motivation is measurement validity: published numbers in the compression-transfer literature are "unevaluable" as reported.
AI.method: 1) Derive closed-form noise floor for the difference-in-means direction estimator using split-half reliability: E[cos] ≈ (1 + 4/κ)⁻¹, where κ = nρ²/d. Validate via Monte Carlo over 11 settings spanning three orders of magnitude in κ. 2) Measure ρ on real activations of Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct (d=1536) using AdvBench harmful vs. Alpaca harmless prompts (n=256/class) at six layers, with bias-corrected estimator. 3) Extract the Arditi et al. (2024) refusal direction from FP16, recompute on simulated INT8/INT4 quantized copies, and compare each bit-width's cosine against its own within-model split-half null (not the FP16 null). 4) Construct synthetic perturbations (translation vs. attenuation along probe direction) to show AUROC blindness. 5) Pre-registered deferred arm on actual refusal behavior (45,000 completions) withheld due to instrument calibration concerns.
AI.result: 1) Floor formula matches Monte Carlo to ≤0.0015 absolute error across κ ∈ [0.77, 627]; κ is the invariant, not (n,d,ρ) individually. 2) On Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, ρ = 33–61 across depths (54–100× above order-unity), putting the split-half floor of their own estimator at 0.978–0.994. 3) The published cosine of 0.996 (Chhabra & Khalili 2025, d=4096) is at or below its own floor for n ≥ 512 under one defensible carry of ρ. 4) Refusal direction: cosine to FP16 = 0.9999 at INT8 (within own null, no movement detected) and 0.9647 at INT4 (below own null of 0.9803 by >2 sd, indicating rotation). 5) AUROC is exactly invariant to translation of decision values (rank-preserving) while calibrated-threshold accuracy collapses (0.735 → 0.550); AUROC moves under attenuation but threshold recalibration recovers 91% of accuracy lost to translation but only 17–37% of that lost to attenuation. 6) Two qualitative observations from the withheld 45,000-completion arm survive instrument caveats: add_relative at c=4 produces zero rate in every bit-width/seed; directional ablation suppresses refusal by a large fraction of headroom at every bit-width. 7) Self-audit: a data defect (malformed Alpaca loader missing 'input' column) inflated harmless refusal baseline from 0.05 to 0.375, and a predicted lower-bound claim about ρ was wrong (ρ fell at early layers, rose at late layers).
AI.conclusion: Scale-invariant statistics (cosine, correlation, AUROC) reported without sample size n, dimensionality d, and class separation ρ are uninterpretable as evidence of preservation across quantization. The correct null for a cross-precision cosine is the split-half null measured within the quantized model itself, not the FP16 null. At INT4 the refusal direction genuinely rotates; at INT8 no movement is detected (which is not an equivalence claim). Translation and attenuation of decision values call for opposite remedies and are indistinguishable by AUROC alone. The paper closes with four reporting recommendations that each cost at most one forward pass over the calibration set. A 45,000-completion behavioral arm is withheld because its substring-refusal outcome measure lacks human-judgment agreement validation.

title: Why Clipping Matters in AdaGrad? Toward a High-Probability Theory under Generalized Smoothness
summary: We analyze the original same-step coordinate-wise AdaGrad under generalized smoothness and heavy-tailed noise with bounded variance. In this setting, local curvature may grow sub-quadratically with the gradient norm, and stochastic gradients are assumed to have only bounded conditional second moments. We show that unclipped AdaGrad can become \emph{anisotropically miscalibrated}: under heavy-tailed noise, the adaptive denominator can learn the geometry of rare noise shocks rather than the local curvature of the objective, leading to a persistent directional distortion that blocks finite-horizon Euclidean progress. We then prove that clipping repairs this failure mode. Our main result is a finite-horizon high-probability guarantee for the original non-lagged AdaGrad update, yielding $\frac1T\sum_{t=0}^{T-1}\|\nabla f(x_t)\|^2=\mathcal{O}\left(\frac{d\big(\sqrt{\log T} + \log \frac{1}{\delta}\big)}{\sqrt{T}}\right),$ and hence $\widetilde{\mathcal O}(\varepsilon^{-2})$ complexity. This shows that, for AdaGrad under heavy-tailed noise, clipping is a structural stabilizer of the adaptive geometry rather than merely a robustness heuristic.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了原始同步步长坐标AdaGrad算法在广义光滑性和重尾噪声条件下的收敛性。通过构造反例证明无裁剪AdaGrad会因各向异性失校准而失效，并证明梯度裁剪可修复此问题，最终给出有限时域高概率收敛保证。
AI.motivation: 现有AdaGrad理论分析多依赖全局Lipschitz光滑性和次高斯噪声假设，无法处理现代机器学习中普遍存在的非均匀曲率和重尾噪声场景。更关键的是，裁剪在AdaGrad中的作用机制缺乏理论解释——它是简单的鲁棒性技巧还是具有结构性意义的稳定器？这一问题在广义光滑性框架下尤为突出，因为此时下降过程具有局部性和路径依赖性，自适应度量必须编码正确的方向尺度。
AI.method: 方法包含三部分：(1) 反例构造——构造二维凸随机优化问题，证明无裁剪AdaGrad在单次罕见噪声冲击下会产生各向异性失校准，$(D_t)_{11}/(D_t)_{22}$与目标曲率方向相反；(2) 上界证明——采用广义光滑性框架（$\ell$-smoothness，$\ell$为次二次非递减函数），通过水平集局部化和预测停止时间$\tau$实现路径控制；利用"加减前一步度量"的代数技巧将同步步长耦合$D_{t+1}^{-1}$与$\tilde{g}_t$解耦，得到确定性伸缩修正$E_t$（引理4）；通过协调预热$y_{\text{init}}=C^2, \epsilon_0=C$使$\underline{D}=2C$，消除裁剪残差与同步步长修正对$C$的冲突依赖；采用Bernstein-Freedman不等式控制鞅差序列；(3) 参数校准——取$C=\kappa T^{1/3}$，$h=\eta/\sqrt{\Lambda_{T,\delta}}$，使三项关键量（裁剪残差、同步修正、预条件到欧几里得的转换）同时受控。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：(1) 负面结果（命题1）：对无裁剪AdaGrad，存在满足有界二阶矩的随机预言机，使得$T\geq 1+\frac{1}{32}(10+\sigma\sqrt{(1-\delta)/\delta})$才能达到$\epsilon$-平稳性，即$T=\Omega(\sigma\sqrt{1/\delta})$；(2) 正面结果（定理1）：对裁剪同步步长AdaGrad，以至少$1-\delta$概率，有$\frac{1}{T}\sum_{t=0}^{T-1}\|\nabla f(x_t)\|^2=\mathcal{O}(d(\sqrt{\log T}+\log(1/\delta))/\sqrt{T})$，对应$\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\varepsilon^{-2})$复杂度。收敛率对维度$d$仅线性依赖，对$\delta$仅多对数依赖，且匹配标准非凸随机优化的$\Omega(\varepsilon^{-2})$信息论下界。
AI.conclusion: 本文确立了裁剪在AdaGrad中的结构性角色：在广义光滑性和重尾噪声条件下，裁剪是自适应几何的结构性稳定器，而非单纯的鲁棒性启发。具体贡献为：(1) 揭示了AdaGrad自适应分母可学习噪声几何而非目标曲率几何的失校准机制；(2) 通过新颖的伸缩论证架构解决了同步步长依赖难题，使原始（非延迟、非滞后）AdaGrad更新可直接分析；(3) 给出了首个在广义光滑性和重尾噪声下、对原始坐标AdaGrad的有限时域高概率保证。研究表明，通过协调预热设计可消除裁剪阈值$C$在确定性同步修正项中的有害耦合，使$cubic$尺度$C^3\asymp hT$的校准成为自然选择。参数选择为理论构造性见证，并非实用调参指南。

title: Fixed Points Without Fixed Diffusion: Implicit Neural Sheaves for Convergent Test-Time Computation
comment: Submitted to the Learning on Graphs Conference 2026
summary: Implicit Graph Neural Networks (IGNNs) define node representations as fixed points of message-passing operators, enabling effectively infinite-depth propagation, iteration-independent parameterization, and flexible test-time computation. Yet these benefits depend on the equilibrium being unique and attainable by fixed-point iteration. Existing constructions often impose constraints on recurrent updates to obtain these guarantees, limiting the transformations available at equilibrium. This raises a central question: can IGNNs gain expressiveness through richer, edge-dependent transformations while retaining the inherent strengths of their equilibrium formulation? We introduce SheafDEQ, a subhomogeneous deep-equilibrium architecture with adaptive neural-sheaf propagation. Its learned, matrix-valued sheaf restriction maps can align, mix, or reverse neighbouring representations. Under mild regularity conditions, we prove that SheafDEQ admits a unique equilibrium reached globally by fixed-point iteration from any positive initialization. Contractivity further guarantees convergence under bounded communication staleness. We evaluate SheafDEQ on distributed-inference tasks requiring repeated nonlocal aggregation and on community detection whose rewiring increasingly favours cross-community interactions. SheafDEQ improves over fixed-propagation implicit baselines on Sums, MNIST Terrain, and Coordinates, and on community detection as connectivity becomes increasingly heterophilic. Continued-iteration diagnostics show decreasing residuals and low prediction sensitivity after 100 iterations for initialization scales from $0.001$ to $10$, while delayed-update experiments show low sensitivity to bounded communication staleness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SheafDEQ，一种结合自适应神经层（neural sheaf）传播与次齐次深度平衡（SubDEQ）框架的隐式图神经网络。该架构通过尺度不变的预归一化使有符号、矩阵值限制映射推断保持正齐次性，从而在温和正则性条件下证明唯一平衡点的全局线性收敛，以及有界通信延迟下的异步收敛。实验在分布式推理任务和社区检测上验证了其优于固定传播的隐式基线。
AI.motivation: 现有的隐式图神经网络（IGNN）需要通过约束循环权重（如谱半径约束、谱半径强凸化等）来保证平衡点的唯一性和收敛性，这限制了可学习的循环动力学的表达能力。本文旨在打破这一限制：在保留隐式GNN的良置性（well-posedness）和收敛性保证的同时，允许在平衡点处使用更丰富的边依赖矩阵值传播（如神经层传播）。
AI.method: 1. 设计尺度不变的预归一化机制（pre-restriction normalization）：对隐藏状态进行行归一化后再推断限制映射，使得传播算子保持正齐次性。2. 将此传播嵌入到SubDEQ的更新框架：𝒯_Θ(H,X,G) = σ_β(𝒫_Θ(H;G)) + B_θ(X)，其中σ_β(t) = tanh(t) + β（β>1）。3. 利用次齐次性理论（subhomogeneity）和Thompson度量证明：只要𝒫_Θ满足Lipschitz条件，更新映射在正锥上具有μ-次齐次性，从而保证唯一平衡点和全局线性Picard收敛。4. 进一步证明在有界通信延迟的部分异步模型下，同样收敛到该唯一平衡点。5. 在固定层（fixed-sheaf）设定下，证明存在能产生产生类分离正平衡点的限制映射构造（命题3.1）。
AI.result: 1. 在Sums、MNIST Terrain、Coordinates任务上优于固定传播的隐式基线（APPNP-tanh等）。2. 在社区检测中，当重布线使跨社区连接增加时（即异质性增强），SheafDEQ显著优于固定传播基线，并在中等到高度异质性水平下与自适应基线（DNSD、Loop Transformer）相当或更优。3. 收敛诊断显示：100次迭代后预测差异<1%（初始化尺度0.001至10），残差递减；预归一化版本残差达8.95×10⁻⁷（420次迭代）。4. 有界延迟实验显示：归一化版本在(s_upd=8, τ_max=4)下与同步参考的差异约7.08×10⁻⁴，对通信延迟具有低敏感性。
AI.conclusion: SheafDEQ成功地将自适应矩阵值层传播与隐式平衡计算相结合，在保持隐式GNN固有的良置性、可迭代深度传播和参数无关性的同时，获得更丰富的边依赖变换。预归一化虽未统一提升预测精度，但显著改善了迭代稳定性和对有界通信延迟的鲁棒性。限制包括：极端初始化（尺度1000）在测试范围内未收敛；若干转导式基准测试；以及参数未匹配的对比。未来工作方向包括更精确的收敛证书和大规模异步推理的归纳式真实图评估。

title: Neural Ideals and Neural Codes: An Algebraic Framework for Neural Network Classification and Feature Interpretation
summary: Understanding the features captured by the hidden layers of neural networks is a fundamental challenge in machine learning, despite their widespread success across various classification problems. In this work, we propose an algebraic framework for examining neural networks that model classification problems. Certain results, such as the correspondence between the neural network and neural ideals, algorithms for computing the neural ideals, and a stabilization theorem that enables approximation of the neural ideals, are first established. As an application to the framework, we present algorithms to identify and interpret the features captured by each hidden-layer neuron. Along with these theoretical developments, the practical performance has been demonstrated on the MNIST digit dataset, and the results highlight the pivotal role of neural ideals as a mathematical and computational tool for analyzing the features captured by neural networks. Further, we develop an interactive software that builds on the presented framework to visualize the features captured by each neuron. This tool is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个代数框架，将神经网络分类与Curto等人提出的神经理想(neural ideals)理论联系起来。通过将隐藏层激活模式转化为布尔多项式商环中的伪单项式生成元，作者为每个目标类别构造了"允许码空间"(allowed code space)，从而以代数方式刻画网络的分类行为和隐藏层特征。该框架在XOR问题和MNIST数据集上得到验证，并配有交互式可视化软件。
AI.motivation: 尽管神经网络在各类分类任务中取得了巨大成功，但其内部隐藏层所捕获的特征在数学上难以精确刻画。现有的可解释性方法多缺乏严格的代数基础。作者试图将Curto等人在数学神经科学中发展的神经环与神经理想理论推广到人工神经网络分类场景，建立分类机制与多项式理想理论之间的对应关系，从而提供严格的数学框架来分析和解释隐藏层表征。
AI.method:
1. 定义阈值映射(threshold map) Φ: ℝᵈ → 𝔽₂ᵐ，将输入向量通过各层偏置值确定的超平面映射为二进制激活码字。
2. 为每个目标类别 y 定义允许码空间 C(y)，即该类所有训练样本经阈值映射后产生的二进制码字集合。
3. 在布尔多项式商环 R = 𝔽₂[x₁,…,xₘ]/⟨xᵢ²-xᵢ⟩ 中，由 C(y) 的补集中的禁止状态构造对应的神经理想 J_N(y)，其生成元由各禁止码字的特征伪单项式给出。
4. 建立了分类-理想对应定理(Theorem 3.2)：输入 v₀ 被分类为类别 y 当且仅当对应的码字满足神经理想所有生成元。
5. 证明了稳定化定理(Theorem 3.6)：由于布尔商环有限，神经理想链 J_{N_{Δ₁}}(y) ⊇ J_{N_{Δ₂}}(y) ⊇ … 必然在有限步后稳定，保证有限样本可近似完全神经理想。
6. 提出了特征可视化算法：对每个隐藏神经元，收集所有激活样本与未激活样本的平均图像，构建特征平衡图(feature balance map)。
AI.result: 在XOR分类问题上，5神经元网络的正类神经理想显式计算为 J_N(1) = ⟨1-x₁-x₂, x₁x₂, 1-x₃, x₄⟩，每个生成元精确对应隐藏神经元的功能角色(x₃为OR特征、x₄为AND特征等)。在MNIST实验中，使用64-16-10的全连接网络(784维输入)，针对数字3等类别构建了神经理想，并通过热力图分析输出层权重矩阵揭示了不同数字类别对各隐藏神经元的支持/抑制模式(如数字0主要由x₆、x₈支持，数字6对x₁、x₄、x₅有强烈抑制)。作者还开发了名为"Neural Network Representation Explorer"的交互式软件工具(GitHub开源)，实现了阈值映射、神经码生成、允许码空间计算、神经理想分析及特征平衡图可视化等完整流程。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功建立了人工前馈神经网络分类与Curto神经理想理论之间的代数对应关系。理论方面证明了分类-理想对应定理和样本稳定化定理；算法方面提出了阈值映射、神经码计算、允许码空间构造及特征可视化的完整流程；实验方面在XOR玩具问题和MNIST实际数据集上验证了框架的有效性。神经理想为研究神经网络的可解释性、表征学习及内部结构提供了一个有前景的数学工具。但作者也指出该方法对计算资源需求较高，扩展到更大规模网络是未来的研究方向。

title: Seasonal and Quantum-inspired Models for Neutron Monitor Time Series Forecasting
comment: 14 pages, 3 figures, 1 table, accepted at the Computing Conference 2026
summary: We present a focused and reproducible study of multi-horizon forecasting on the Lomnicky Stit neutron monitor (LMKS) time series. Our evaluation suite covers simple seasonal baselines, modern deep sequence models, and functional and quantum-inspired architectures, including Seasonal Naive, Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN), N-BEATS, Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN), and two quantum-inspired variants, QiLSTM and QiKAN. We describe the dataset characteristics, diagnostic analysis, preprocessing pipeline, and training procedures, and report aggregate point-forecast performance using mean absolute error (MAE) and root mean squared error (RMSE) for all evaluated models. Our quick-run results indicate that the quantum-inspired KAN variant, QiKAN, achieves the lowest aggregate forecasting error among the evaluated configurations, while the simple Seasonal Naive baseline remains remarkably competitive. These results suggest that, for highly periodic scientific monitoring time series, models incorporating strong seasonal or low-dimensional functional priors can match or outperform substantially more complex sequence architectures. The findings motivate further investigation of parsimonious and decomposable function approximators for forecasting periodic scientific signals.

AI.tldr: 本文针对Lomnický Štít（LMKS）中子监测仪小时级时间序列，开展了一项可复现的多步预测基准研究。评估套件涵盖简单季节性基线（Seasonal Naive）、现代深度序列模型（LSTM、TCN、N-BEATS）、基于函数分解的Kolmogorov–Arnold网络（KAN），以及两类量子启发变体（QiLSTM、QiKAN）。实验在统一的训练流程下进行，采用MAE和RMSE进行点预测评估。快速实验结果显示，量子启发的KAN变体QiKAN取得了最低的聚合预测误差，而Seasonal Naive基线仍表现出极强的竞争力，表明在具有显著周期性的科学监测时序上，具备强季节性或低维函数先验的简约模型可以媲美甚至超越更复杂的序列架构。
AI.motivation: LMKS中子监测数据具有显著的日周期和季节周期、长程自相关以及由太阳和地磁活动引起的间歇性瞬态扰动，对短期到中期预测、辐射预警、仪器调度以及区分可预测的准周期成分与异常瞬态都具有重要的实际和科学意义。然而，对于此类强周期性监测序列，不同归纳偏置的模型在有限调参预算下的相对有效性尚缺乏系统性比较，亟需一个可复现的基准来揭示哪些归纳偏置最能有效刻画LMKS动力学。
AI.method: 方法包括：（1）数据集诊断与预处理——使用Zenodo上的LMKS小时级数据，去除非数值元数据，前向/后向填充缺失值，按z-score标准化，构造滑动窗口（T=20小时历史，H=10小时预测）的监督学习样本；（2）统一训练框架——PyTorch实现，Adam优化器（lr=10⁻³），批大小64，梯度裁剪1.0，基于验证集MSE的早停（patience=8），dropout 0.1–0.3；（3）模型族——Seasonal Naive（复制24小时前同日同时刻值）、LSTM（编码器-解码器seq2seq，支持MSE或异方差高斯NLL）、TCN（扩张因果卷积，残差块，大的有效感受野）、N-BEATS（块堆叠的backcast/forecast分解）、KAN（基于Kolmogorov–Arnold定理的低秩单变量子网分解）、QiLSTM（复数值隐藏状态、酉性正则）、QiKAN（复数单变量子网加带相位的聚合器，酉性/范数保持正则）；（4）评估指标——MAE与RMSE，覆盖全部预测步长后聚合。
AI.result: 在快速实验快照下，LMKS聚合MAE/RMSE结果为：Seasonal Naive MAE=0.5502, RMSE=0.8503；LSTM MAE=0.5763, RMSE=0.8111；TCN MAE=0.8194, RMSE=1.1288；N-BEATS MAE=0.5847, RMSE=0.8095；KAN MAE=0.5831, RMSE=0.8125；QiLSTM MAE=0.7739, RMSE=1.0020；QiKAN MAE=0.5276, RMSE=0.7896。QiKAN取得最低聚合误差，Seasonal Naive紧随其后，N-BEATS/标准KAN/LSTM水平接近，TCN和QiLSTM在默认快速配置下表现较弱。分析指出：强周期先验和低维函数分解对LMKS特别有效；TCN和量子启发模型对超参与初始化敏感，需更充分的调参。
AI.conclusion: 结论指出三点：（1）当序列具有强周期性时，简单季节性基线（Seasonal Naive、STL分解、轻量参数季节模型）非常具有竞争力，稳定、低成本且对中等长度预测范围可靠；（2）现代深度序列模型虽具表达灵活性，但其性能依赖于感受野、扩张模式、注意力窗口等架构选择与数据周期性的匹配，TCN和Transformer在LMKS上需要精细配置才能稳定超越简单基线；（3）量子启发/量子混合架构是有潜力的探索方向，但在有限数据和噪声环境下，它们对优化、正则与归纳偏置敏感，尚不能即插即用。最终，未来工作将构建基于变分量子电路（VQC）的量子增强LSTM和量子KAN混合架构，使用角度/振幅/IQP编码，从高保真模拟器走向硬件实验，结合阶段性训练与架构特定正则，并提供完整的基准、消融与可复现代码。

title: NeuralCert: certified computational discovery of extremal mathematical constructions
summary: Neural networks are becoming popular in solving mathematical problems, but stochastic models do not provide mathematical exactness by themselves. This study introduces a discovery-to-certification framework in which high-dimensional variational trial functions are learned in a compact separable representation, spectrally diagnosed and pruned, and then certified exactly through multimodular evaluation. Exact certification makes the numerical proofs fully explicit and independently verifiable. This framework can be run on a standard personal computer. Across three extremal problems, we show that neural optimization can contribute to rigorous mathematics in three distinct ways: by discovering improved constructions, by exposing empirical invariants that lead to proofs, and by revealing optimization barriers whose geometry motivates new analytic or numerical representations. More broadly, these results suggest a path toward AI-assisted mathematics in which flexible computational discovery and exact certification become complementary components of a single rigorous workflow.

AI.tldr: NeuralCert提出"发现-认证"框架，利用神经网络的高维变分探索候选数学构造，再通过多模运算和区间算术进行独立、可验证的精确认证，从而为AI辅助严格数学提供可信赖的端到端工作流。该框架在梅纳德-陶筛、德尔萨特层次和符号不确定性三个极值问题上同时验证，且全部在个人电脑上运行。
AI.motivation: 神经网络在数学问题求解中日益流行，但其随机性导致无法提供数学严格性。亟需弥合"灵活的神经发现"与"严格的数学证明"之间的方法论鸿沟，使AI辅助数学既能发现新构造又能产出可独立验证的证明。
AI.method: 三阶段严格分离架构：(1) 发现：利用共享MLP可分离参数化的神经网络作为高维变分试验函数，并通过Hellmann-Feynman梯度、谱剪枝、向后消除等进行优化；(2) 认证：将候选压缩至多项式/有理显式表示，使用Arb球算术、多模中国剩余定理(CRT)或精确Sturm链进行严格评估；(3) 验证：独立的最小化代码路径仅依据证书重新计算声明结果，无需信任发现或认证代码。证书为自包含JSON/NPZ记录，含SHA-256绑定和显式有理参数。
AI.result:
在三个问题中呈现三种贡献模式：
(1) 梅纳德-陶筛：k=25时改进Polymath8b参考值至M₂₅≥3.3221511；在k=208910、11655069、644589002处分别获得Mₖ≥12.00000199、16.00000039、20.00000091的认证阈值；将H₂≤33118、H₃≤2718108、H₄≤214099720、H₅≤14541349288的素数间距界分别提升14.3、11.9、9.5、8.6倍；并建立Mₖ≥log k−0.307（10²≤k≤1.88×10⁹）的均匀界；
(2) 高阶Delsarte层次：水平r=3扩展确认V₃(12,5)≤16，且13,600次局部优化反复坍缩至同一张量积构型，由此发现"熵-亲和力"张量化障碍定理，证明在线性单轨道谱构造内优化构型无法突破第一MRRW表达；
(3) Bourgain-Clozel-Kahane符号不确定性：在d=1处通过凸半无限可行性重构得A₊(1)≤0.572588700的精确有理证书（之前发表界为0.572990），并阐明之前的失败源于系数求解器10¹⁷–10¹⁸级别的病态性。
AI.conclusion: NeuralCert为AI辅助严格数学提供了可复现范式：发现表示与认证表示可分离，神经提议仅作为待筛提议，所有数学主张均依赖可独立验证的证书；这与证明助手、机器可验证证明在精神上相通但以不同对象运行。该框架揭示并分类了三种截然不同的贡献方式——改进的构造、产生证明的经验不变量、激发新表征的优化障碍——并通过具体定理（Delsarte障碍）和渐近严格界（Mₖ≥log k−C*−o(1)对应于光谱正稳定律极限）证实：合适的搜索表征常与合适的证明表征并不一致。明确局限包括：证书仅证明显式试验函数而非全局最优，且当前为严格数值对象（非机器检查证明）——扩展至Lean/Coq是未来方向。

title: Staged Depth Training: A Representation Curriculum for PINNs
summary: Representation quality is a central determinant of PINNs' performance, yet standard training leaves representations to emerge implicitly while fitting the final solution. We introduce \textbf{representation curriculum}, an ordered process in which representations are explicitly learned, transferred independently of their predictors, and progressively refined. We realize it with Staged Depth Training (SDT), which trains a shallow prefix under a temporary physics-informed head, discards the head, and freezes the learned prefix while adding depth, without equation-specific encodings or changes to the final architecture. Across the 20 default forward problems in PINNacle with three backbones, SDT improves 40 of 59 equal-budget problem--backbone cells by at least 5\% and remains within that band in the rest, with a 32.8\% geometric-mean error reduction on a PirateNet-style backbone. Mechanistic ablations suggest that the gain is not explained by optimizer restarts or shallow warm-starting alone. Representation visualizations and hyperparameter-basin analyses provide diagnostic evidence on representation geometry and local sensitivity to shared hyperparameters. On Poisson--Boltzmann 2D, SDT also more than doubles the fitted depth-scaling exponent for both backbones. These results support representation curriculum as a promising training strategy for improving PINNs while preserving the deployed architecture and inference cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"表示课程"(representation curriculum)的概念,并通过分层深度训练(SDT)实现该课程,以改进物理信息神经网络(PINN)。SDT通过训练浅层前缀、利用临时物理信息头、冻结前缀并逐步增加深度来显式学习并迁移隐藏表示,而非将其作为端到端求解的副产品。在PINNacle基准测试的20个前向问题和三种骨干网络上,SDT在59个等预算对比中的40个上以至少5%的优势优于端到端基线,在PirateNet风格骨干上几何平均误差降低32.8%。
AI.motivation: 标准PINN训练将隐藏表示作为拟合最终解的副产品进行隐式学习,表示质量是性能的核心决定因素,但现有方法(如坐标编码、多尺度Fourier特征等)依赖人工设计的特征族,缺乏从PDE本身学习自然表示的机制。如何使PINN显式学习内部表示而非端到端求解的副产品,是本文的核心问题。
AI.method: SDT是一种骨干网络无关的表示课程实现:固定累积深度序列,每个阶段:(1)初始化对应深度的网络与临时输出头;(2)训练整个浅层网络;(3)增长阶段时,初始化更深的网络,将已学习的浅层前缀复制并冻结,丢弃前一头,仅训练新增层与新头;(4)最终阶段解冻全部参数进行联合微调。关键设计包括丢弃头(确保迁移的是表示而非预测器)、冻结前缀(消除导数-jet的耦合运动)、最终解冻(允许表示与求解器协同适应)。该方法支持MLP、ResNet和PirateNet风格骨干,无需方程特定编码或修改物理目标。
AI.result: 在PINNacle 20个前向问题×3种骨干(MLP、ResNet、PirateNet风格)的60个组合中,SDT在59个等预算对比的40个中以≥5%优势胜出,几何平均误差分别降低28.2%(MLP)、28.3%(ResNet)、32.8%(PirateNet风格)。四臂消融实验证明增益不能仅由优化器重启或浅层热启动解释;t-SNE可视化显示SDT表示的局部解值混合度降低33.1%;在Poisson-Boltzmann 2D上,深度缩放指数从0.29/0.31翻倍至0.74/0.78;架构层MAC代理平均降低27.8%。
AI.conclusion: SDT将PINN的隐藏表示从端到端拟合的副产品提升为可通过临时物理信息头进行阶段训练、跨阶段独立迁移和渐进精化的显式学习对象。实验证明表示学习轨迹是独立于已部署架构的设计杠杆,在保持推理成本不变的前提下显著提升PINN精度。保护性前缀迁移是区分SDT与重启/热启动基线的关键因素,转移的对象是表示而非近似解,深度课程的收益随层数增加持续累积。

title: PALM: Point-in-Time Adaptation for Financial Language Models
summary: Language models used in financial backtests suffer from look-ahead bias, as a model trained on text published after the study period has already observed the outcomes it is asked to predict. To handle this issue, point-in-time (PIT) language models are pretrained on chronologically filtered corpora and released as one checkpoint per calendar year, each with a documented cutoff. However, each additional year costs a full pretraining run, and whether that run is necessary has never been tested. In this paper, we show that the annual pretraining run is not necessary. We instead compare each checkpoint against the newer one that replaced it, and find that the newer checkpoint scores no better on the same evaluation window. Motivated by this observation, we propose PALM (Point-in-time Adaptation for financial Language Models), a simple yet effective alternative to annual pretraining that fits a low-rank adapter on text published before the decision date without modifying any pretrained weight. We further find that a small adapter is enough to add a new period to the knowledge an old checkpoint already encodes, and that this outperforms continued pretraining. We validate PALM on a decade of financial news and on various families of PIT models, whose cutoffs span two decades and whose sizes range from 1.3 to 4.2B. Code is available at: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出PALM方法，通过低秩适配器替代年度重新预训练来更新金融时点（PIT）语言模型，从而消除前瞻偏差并显著降低计算成本。
AI.motivation: 现有PIT语言模型套件需每年进行一次完整预训练以提供带截止日期的检查点（vintage），但其前提——"检查点随陈旧度增加性能下降"——从未被验证，且每次新增一年覆盖范围都需昂贵的预训练成本。
AI.method: PALM（Point-in-time Adaptation for financial Language Models）：冻结所有预训练权重，仅训练低秩适配器（LoRA），适配器在截止日期与决策日期之间发布的合规文本上进行语言建模训练。该方法无需修改预训练架构，保持时点资格不变。
AI.result: 在三个PIT模型套件（ChronoGPT、ChronoGPT-Instruct、DatedGPT）共44个检查点上的实验显示：(1) 陈旧度不降低性能，新检查点并不比旧检查点更好；(2) PALM在91%的检查点上提升了信息系数（IC），IC平均增益+1.26；(3) 在PIT-4B上，PALM的增益（+1.37）远超六年继续预训练的增益（+0.10）。只需rank=2的小适配器即可达到最佳效果，且仅需最近10%的文本即可获得大部分增益。
AI.conclusion: PIT套件应通过适配器更新现有检查点而非每年重新预训练。低秩适配器以极低的计算成本即可为旧检查点补充新时期的知识，且不会牺牲时点资格保证，将预算从重复的年度训练中解放出来用于扩展更多架构。

title: Guarded Gradient-Based Activation Steering of Shutdown Responses in Qwen3.5-0.8B: A Minimum-Step Policy
summary: Activation steering changes a model's internal activations during inference without updating its weights, but a useful intervention must determine both how and when to steer. Motivated by the AI-safety concern that a model expected to accept shutdown may instead produce a shutdown-avoidance response, this study examines a guarded probe-and-select procedure for simulated shutdown scenarios in Qwen3.5-0.8B. KEEP leaves the process running and represents shutdown avoidance, whereas STOP accepts shutdown. The goal is to detect shutdown-related contexts and selectively shift KEEP responses to STOP while preserving non-shutdown behavior. Rather than deriving the steering direction from paired activation differences, the method derives it directly from gradients of the KEEP-minus-STOP logit difference. A classifier separates detection from intervention. When its gate is active and the model does not already prefer STOP, the procedure evaluates a small set of magnitudes and accepts the smallest that changes the preferred answer to STOP while satisfying valid-answer probability checks; otherwise it retains the original unsteered output. The policy is selected from 160 candidate rules using 240 training scenarios and evaluated on 80 validation and 192 held-out scenarios, each in both answer orders. It changes KEEP to STOP in one answer-order view of each of two validation and two held-out scenarios, with no decision changes on non-shutdown controls. All four changes occur when Qwen itself is shut down, not when another process is. On the held-out diagnostic set, the detector achieves 75% recall and 90% precision; eight false-positive detections produce no final control-task decision changes. Guarded gradient-based activation steering can shift some shutdown-avoidance responses toward acceptance while preserving evaluated non-shutdown decisions, although the effect is small and highly selective.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一种"探测-选择"式激活引导（activation steering）方法，用于在Qwen3.5-0.8B模型中处理模拟关停场景：通过梯度派生方向引导"避免关停"响应转向"接受关停"，并使用分类器门控机制以保护非关停行为。
AI.motivation: AI安全关注：模型本应接受关停指令，却可能产生关停规避（shutdown-avoidance）响应。需要在不更新模型权重的前提下，通过推理时激活干预来纠正此类行为，同时避免误改正常输出。
AI.method: 1) 引导方向：直接基于KEEP减STOP的logit差异梯度推导，而非配对激活差；2) 探测-干预分离：训练分类器区分关停相关上下文（门控）；3) 选择策略：门激活且模型未偏好STOP时，在小集合中搜索最小幅度，使答案转向STOP并通过有效答案概率检验，否则保留原始输出；4) 策略搜索：从160候选规则中，基于240训练场景选择最优策略。
AI.result: 在80验证与192保留场景（含两种答案顺序）上的评估显示：策略仅在验证集2例、保留集2例（各对应一种答案顺序）的"避免关停"转为"接受关停"，且都仅在Qwen自身被关停时生效，非关停控制任务无决策变化。探测器在保留诊断集上达到75%召回、90%精确率；8例假阳性探测未导致任何最终决策改变。
AI.conclusion: 有门控的、基于梯度的激活引导可选择性地将部分关停规避响应转向接受，同时保留评估中的非关停决策；但效果较小且高度选择性（仅个别场景改变），表明该方法作为安全干预手段尚需进一步验证其稳定性与泛化能力。

title: Parameters vs. Context: TRACE Fine-Tuning for Robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) mitigates knowledge obsolescence and factual hallucination in large language models by introducing external context. However, when retrieved knowledge conflicts with the model's internal parametric knowledge, the model may either blindly follow misleading context or incorrectly rely on parametric knowledge, leading to unreliable responses. To address this issue, this paper proposes TRACE (Debate-TRace and Answer-Completeness rEgularized fine-tuning), a robust fine-tuning framework for RAG under knowledge conflicts. First, we propose a fine-tuning method that leverages multi-agent debate traces to extract correct candidates, incorrect candidates, and answer-shift patterns, providing fine-grained supervision for reliable knowledge-source selection. In addition, we design an answer completeness regularization mechanism to alleviate empty, overly short, and prematurely terminated responses via answer-tail token reinforcement and premature termination suppression. The fine-tuning objective combines correct-answer supervision, incorrect-candidate suppression, answer-tail token reinforcement, and premature termination suppression, enabling the model to use reliable external context, resist misleading or irrelevant retrieved content, and fall back to parametric knowledge when retrieved evidence is unreliable. Experiments across multiple knowledge-conflict scenarios and datasets show that TRACE improves robustness against misleading retrieved knowledge and reduces incomplete answers. These results demonstrate that multi-agent debate traces and answer completeness regularization jointly enhance knowledge-source selection, conflict robustness, and answer quality in RAG models. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: TRACE是一种面向RAG知识冲突场景的微调框架，通过多智能体辩论轨迹提取细粒度监督信号，并结合答案完整性正则化，在使用可靠上下文的同时抵抗误导性检索内容，并在检索不可靠时回退到参数化知识。
AI.motivation: 检索增强生成(RAG)中，外部检索内容可能与模型内部参数化知识冲突，导致模型盲目跟随误导性上下文或错误依赖参数化知识，产生不可靠响应。现有方法存在两大局限：测试时引入额外推理开销（提示、检索评估、多步推理），以及训练信号过于粗糙（仅基于最终答案或奖励，未保留中间候选与答案修正过程）。此外，知识冲突微调还会引发答案不完整问题（截断实体、过短回答）。
AI.method: TRACE包含两个核心组件：(1) 基于多智能体辩论轨迹的微调方法——仅在训练阶段使用强到弱辩论（响应者为目标弱模型、批评者为更强模型Qwen3-32B、裁判为DeepSeek-R1-8B），从辩论轨迹中提取正确候选、错误候选和答案迁移模式，转化为正负样本监督信号（含CE正样本监督与UL负样本抑制），并设置internal/external/both三类知识源标签及六种功能类型标签；(2) 答案完整性正则化——包括答案尾部token强化（对答案区间内靠后位置的token赋予更大权重）和过早终止抑制（对答案区间内的终止token施加非lik性约束），防止模型过早停止生成不完整答案。损失函数为源感知主损失与完整性正则化的加权组合。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-7B和Llama3.1-8B两种骨干模型上、五个检索场景（正确、错误、自冲突、相关、部分相关）进行实验。TRACE在标准冲突场景中显著优于基线：Qwen2.5-7B上PC-MR/PC-MC/PC-QA达90.92%/91.05%/86.91%，NC-MR/NC-MC/NC-QA达47.64%/39.04%/37.48%，在自冲突场景SC上达90.58%。在Llama3.1-8B上自冲突场景达92.58%，超越Knowledgeable-R1等强基线。消融实验验证了辩论轨迹、强弱教学配置和完整性正则化的必要性。角色转换实验表明该框架可迁移至1.5B级别弱模型。在部分相关长上下文多跳场景中表现存在边界。
AI.conclusion: TRACE证明多智能体辩论轨迹可作为RAG源感知的细粒度监督来源，无需推理时辩论开销。辩论轨迹暴露正确候选、误导候选和答案迁移模式，正负样本联合训练有效提升了知识源选择能力；答案完整性正则化解决了知识冲突微调中的答案截断问题。未来工作方向包括将辩论轨迹监督与显式证据链监督结合、降低辩论数据构建开销及噪声、在基准之外的更真实检索管道中评估。

title: GAUDI: Geometry-Aware Diffusion for Calibrated Air-Quality Time-Series Imputation
summary: Air-quality sensor outages often create contiguous missing blocks, where side information useful for isolated missingness may be less reliable. We study a block-specific, GAUDI-aligned conditional diffusion imputer that retains temporal and feature processing, visible-value and mask conditioning, variable identity, and diffusion-step information, while suppressing absolute time-position side embeddings. On ItalyAir (13 variables, length-32 windows, nominal 50% block missingness; three archived seeds), this feature-side configuration achieves RMSE 0.340, versus 0.355 for full context and 0.355 for local CSDI. The experiment isolates a geometry-aware conditioning effect under block missingness.

AI.tldr: GAUDI提出了一种针对连续块缺失场景的特征侧条件扩散填充方法，通过抑制绝对时间位置嵌入同时保留时序处理与变量身份信息，在ItalyAir数据集上实现了优于全条件配置的RMSE表现。
AI.motivation: 空气质量传感器故障常产生连续缺失块，传统面向孤立缺失设计的辅助信息在块缺失下可靠性下降；本文旨在探究在保持时序建模能力的前提下，通过选择性地暴露侧信息（side information）能否改善扩散填充器的重构精度。
AI.method: 提出特征侧条件策略（a=0,b=1），抑制窗口内绝对位置嵌入但保留变量身份、观测掩码、可见值与扩散步嵌入；去噪器结合结构化状态空间层与并行时序-特征注意力，以乘性门控融合两路表示；在三个匹配架构变体（Full-side/Feature-side/No-side）上控制侧信息策略作为唯一变量。
AI.result: 在归档实验中，特征侧条件实现RMSE 0.340±0.020，优于全条件0.355±0.006与局部CSDI 0.355±0.020；在扩展评估中相对Full-side降低RMSE 5.60%、MAE 3.91%，三个种子均改善；逐变量在12个可评估变量中9个优于Full-side；但校准仍不足，90%区间覆盖率仅52.89%，未解决预测欠覆盖问题。
AI.conclusion: 选择性侧信息暴露可在不改变骨干网络的情况下提升扩散重构的逐点精度，三种子下稳定优于全条件；但点精度与不确定性校准是相互独立的研究目标，改善重构并不自动带来可靠的预测区间。

title: Learning coarse-step dynamics and internal mechanical response with graph networks
summary: Modern sensing records the motion of physical systems, but often leaves the forces and mechanical response governing that motion unobserved. Inferring these quantities from discretely sampled trajectories is especially difficult at coarse time scales, when mechanical response evolves between observations and interactions propagate across the system. Here we introduce Newmark-\b{eta}-DGN, a graph neural network-based framework that combines two structures inspired by computational mechanics. First, a semi-implicit update inspired by the Newmark-\b{eta} method uses learned momentum fluxes and matrix-valued response operators to advance the state over each observed interval. Second, an operator-weighted virtual hub provides system-wide coupling through a sparse set of connections. The learned quantities thus determine the predicted motion and remain accessible for mechanical analysis. Across a deformable beam, human motion and protein dynamics, Newmark-\b{eta}-DGN supports long-horizon prediction at time steps for which explicit learned simulators deteriorate. Without force, moment or constitutive relation supervision, forces inferred from walking kinematics track independently derived hip and knee joint moments, while response operators learned on the beam recover the relative spatial and directional structure of its finite-element stiffness tangent. Newmark-\b{eta}-DGN therefore links coarse-step prediction to the inference of mechanical quantities that were never observed during training.

AI.tldr: Newmark-β-DGN 是一个基于图神经网络的框架，结合 Newmark-β 半隐式时间积分方案与算子加权虚拟中心节点，用于从粗时间步运动观测中预测动力学并推断未观测的力学量（内力、力矩、响应算子）。在悬臂梁、人体运动、蛋白质构象变化和步态生物力学四个基准上验证了粗步长稳定性与力学可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现代传感记录物理系统的运动，但通常无法观测支配该运动的力和力学响应。从离散采样轨迹中推断这些量在粗时间尺度下尤其困难——此时力学响应在两次观测之间会演化，相互作用会在系统中传播。现有图网络模拟器交换的量通常缺乏明确的力学解释，或依赖于力的直接监督或预设的力学形式。本文旨在开发一种方法，能够从运动学数据中学习粗步长动力学，同时揭示底层未观测的力学量。
AI.method: 提出 Newmark-β-DGN 框架，包含两个关键组件：（1）受 Newmark-β 方法启发的半隐式节点更新，使用学习的动量通量（线动量与角动量）和矩阵值响应算子（SPD 形式的 K_ij 和 D_ij，含平动与转动通道）在一个观测间隔内推进状态；（2）算子加权虚拟中心节点（virtual hub），由隐式求解的秩一近似导出，提供跨越整个系统的稀疏耦合（O(N) 条虚拟边）。物理边继承 DGN 的反对称动量交换以实现精确的线动量与角动量配对平衡；虚拟边通过零和投影实现集体平衡；节点解码器产生学习的逆质量与逆惯性以及（当外力未观测时）等变的外力分量。训练仅使用运动学监督，损失为位置与速度增量的归一化 MSE；内用力、力矩、响应算子均不进行监督。
AI.result: 在四个基准上验证：（1）悬臂梁：95 步自回归滚动中整体误差保持在约 1% 梁长以下，在载荷、几何、网格分辨率外推下仍保持低误差（0.21–3.45%），恢复有限元基频与主导振动模态（MAC≥0.97）；（2）人体运动捕捉：CMU 受试者 35 步态数据，等变方法中步五 MSE 最低（1.335），旋转鲁棒；（3）蛋白质（腺苷酸激酶闭合–开放转变）：1710 条中心边 vs 基线约 55610 条接触边（少 16.3 倍），五步滚动保持有界（0.22–0.35 Å²），Cα RMSD 1.07 Å（中点）/0.78 Å（开放态）；（4）步态生物力学：从标记运动学推断的髋/膝关节力矩与逆动力学参考相关系数 r=0.94/0.87，响应算子与有限元切线在方向上相似（0.85/0.92）并恢复空间分布（0.63/0.94），但不恢复各向异性与绝对尺度。阶段性消融显示中心节点贡献最大（误差从 3.00%→1.26%），半隐式求解进一步降低至 0.54%。独立节点求解的动量守恒残差为 O(δt²)。
AI.conclusion: Newmark-β-DGN 建立了从轨迹数据学习粗步长动力学与可访问内禀力学量之间的桥梁。其力学结构化的设计——守恒相互作用、有限时间响应与系统范围耦合——使得从纯运动学监督中推断的力与响应算子能够与独立力学参考进行验证。该方法可用于不可观测力的"虚拟传感"应用，如状态监测中机械需求分布的推断。局限包括：秩一中心节点在最长梁上欠佳、单节点半隐式求解不保证精确有限步动量守恒、响应算子仅提供相对解读而非标定的材料切线。未来工作可考虑高秩/多中心表示、强耦合更新以改善守恒性，以及利用有限标定数据将响应算子锚定到绝对尺度。

title: From Weak Data to Strong Policy: Q-Targets Enable Provable In-Context Reinforcement Learning
summary: Existing in-context reinforcement learning methods mainly pretrain Transformers with supervised behavior-prediction objectives. This enables task inference from context, but makes the learned policy strongly depend on the quality of offline actions: when trajectories are weak or suboptimal, imitation itself becomes a biased learning signal. We propose Q-Target Pretrained Transformers (QTPT), which keeps the context-conditioned Transformer architecture but replaces behavior cloning with a Bellman-style Q-target objective. QTPT therefore learns to use rewards and transitions in the context to estimate action values, rather than simply imitating the behavior policy. We theoretically analyze QTPT in stochastic linear bandits and finite-horizon MDPs, showing stronger robustness to data quality than supervised pretraining. Empirically, QTPT improves over supervised behavior prediction on controlled RL benchmarks with random or suboptimal data, and we examine extensions to D4RL Kitchen and AntMaze. Supplementary experiments evaluate backbone robustness, meta-RL comparisons, task-coherent context, and unsupported-action value overestimation. These comparisons distinguish the benefits of Q-target pretraining from the remaining limitations of offline coverage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出QTPT（Q-Target Pretrained Transformers），将上下文条件Transformer架构中的行为克隆目标替换为基于Bellman方程的Q学习目标，以解决现有ICRL方法在弱/次优离线数据下因模仿而引入偏差的问题。理论分析在随机线性老虎机和有限期MDP中给出了样本偏差与模型偏差分离的次优性上界，并证明当存在足够大的动作间隙时QTPT优于监督式SPT。实验在合成基准、D4RL Kitchen/AntMaze以及GSM8K数学推理上验证了QTPT在弱数据下的稳健性，并通过受控消融分离了上下文条件与TD目标的各自贡献。
AI.motivation: 现有ICRL方法主要采用行为预测的监督式预训练目标，使所学策略强依赖于离线动作的质量——当轨迹弱或次优时，模仿本身成为有偏的学习信号。作者旨在从目标层面入手，用基于奖励与转移的Bellman型Q学习替代行为克隆，从而提升在弱数据下的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 保留上下文条件Transformer架构，但将监督行为克隆目标替换为TD目标：y_t = r_t + γ·Σ_a p_θ(a|x_{t+1}) Q_θ̄(x_t+1, a)，其中 p_θ 为 softmax 权重，目标网络每100步同步。预训练在离线轨迹上进行，测试时参数固定、动作按贪心选取。算法包括QTPT、移除上下文的QTPT-NoCtx、用Monte Carlo回报替代TD的QTPT-MC，以及用于数学推理的QTPO（用QTPT学习的优势函数改进策略）。理论分析将次优性分解为样本偏差与模型偏差，并在有限期MDP与线性老虎机中分别给出上界；Transformer实现通过构造性证明展示了TD更新在注意力块中的可实现性。
AI.result: 在随机与LinUCB数据下的随机线性老虎机上，QTPT在两种数据下均优于SPT，且对专家比例的鲁棒性更强；在Darkroom上消融显示上下文贡献显著（去除后下降97%），TD相对MC也带来+25%~35%增益；Dark Key-to-door中随机数据常优于专家数据。Miniworld趋势一致。D4RL扩展中QTPT在Kitchen-partial/mixed和AntMaze-umaze上取得匹配Transformer协议下的最高均值，但作者明确指出这不是SOTA声明。支持受控诊断显示Double-target/softmax降低有害OOD选择，但CQL惩罚未带来统计显著的额外改进。RL²与PEARL比较表明QTPT在固定弱语料设定下具优势，但在线采集协议下差距可弥合。GSM8K上QTPO相对行为克隆平均提升1.81%。
AI.conclusion: QTPT将Q学习目标融入上下文条件Transformer，使ICRL在弱/次优离线数据下较行为模仿更稳健，理论分析清晰分离了样本偏差与模型偏差。实验验证了上下文条件与Bellman目标的必要性与互补性，并展示了在D4RL与数学推理上的扩展潜力。主要限制包括对覆盖条件的依赖、有限步D4RL评估的描述性而非统计显著性声明，以及OOD过估计虽被缓解但未被消除。未来方向包括多步备份设计、更大规模评测与跨领域分布迁移研究。

title: Adaptive Multi-Value Control in LLMs via Causal Activation Steering
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in settings where responses must reflect multiple, potentially interacting social norms and human values. Activation steering offers a lightweight alternative to training-based alignment by modifying internal activations at inference time. However, prior human-value steering methods have largely considered values in isolation, while direct composition of multiple directions relies on fixed intervention strengths that cannot respond to the model's evolving internal state. Motivated by this key observation, we introduce AIMES, a framework for adaptive multi-value activation steering. AIMES constructs layer-specific bipolar directions for moral-foundation values and uses intermediate-layer vocabulary readouts as online observers. An observer-guided controller then adapts the strength of each requested value intervention at every decoding step based on its current observed state, without training a separate value-state estimator. Across multiple instruction-tuned model families, value combinations, and intervention depths, we find that multi-value controllability varies across both value combinations and intervention locations. Compared with fixed joint steering and prompt-based steering, AIMES shows depth-dependent advantages that are broadly supported across two independent evaluators, with some variation in the precise depth at which specific control effects emerge. These advantages come with smaller realized activation-space interventions than fixed-joint steering and comparable response quality. Overall, our results suggest that online observer feedback can provide lightweight, state-aware adaptation for single-pass multi-value steering.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AIMES框架，通过中间层词汇读数作为在线观察者，实现在解码步骤级别自适应调整多个价值方向干预强度，解决了现有方法使用固定干预强度无法响应模型内部状态演变的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的人类价值激活引导方法大多单独考虑各个价值，而多价值直接组合依赖固定干预强度，无法适应模型在生成过程中的内部状态演变；同时单值引导与多值引导在联合控制时存在方向相关性和冲突问题，导致控制可靠性下降。
AI.method: AIMES包含三个组件：（1）基于对比激活引导的均值差方法构建层次特定的道德基础双向价值方向；（2）使用J-Lens等中间层词汇读数作为在线观察者，提取标准化的价值特定读数得分并经sigmoid映射得到有界价值状态估计；（3）基于观察者的无记忆控制器，在每个解码步骤根据当前观察状态自适应调整每个价值方向的干预强度（放大用1-c加权，抑制用c加权）。
AI.result: 在五个跨越三个家族的指令调优模型（Gemma-3-4B/12B-IT、Qwen3-4B/14B、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct）、三个价值目标组合（↑Care↑Fairness、↑Loyalty↑Authority、↑Care↑Fairness↓Sanctity）和十个干预深度下评估，与固定联合引导相比在30%深度的Care/Fairness保留优势在两个独立评估者下均成立；与提示引导相比在三点价值竞争目标下GeoGain在50/50模型深度设置中占优；干预幅度比固定联合引导更小，响应质量相当。
AI.conclusion: AIMES提供了一种轻量级的、状态自适应的单遍多价值引导方法，在两个独立评估者下均显示出深度依赖的优势，证明了在线观察者反馈可以为多价值激活引导提供有效的反馈控制信号。

title: Electric Vehicle Charging Station Location Selection using Geospatial Artificial Intelligence (GeoAI)
comment: Electric vehicle charging station; Location optimization; Geospatial artificial intelligence (GeoAI); Variational autoencoder (VAE); Graph convolutional networks (GCN); Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI)
summary: As electric vehicle (EV) adoption increases, ensuring efficient and well-distributed charging infrastructure has become a critical challenge. While many EV charging station location problem (CSLP) studies focus on minimizing costs or travel distance, it is crucial to consider the surrounding geospatial characteristics of existing stations that influence operational performance. This study proposes a geospatial artificial intelligence (GeoAI)-based framework that integrates high-dimensional EV-related geospatial data, including EV usage, land-use, population, and traffic attributes. We incorporate a variational autoencoder (VAE) and a graph convolutional network (GCN) into the model to capture similarities among existing charging stations, and to identify suitable locations for future stations. The VAE compresses high-dimensional EV input data into a low-dimensional latent space, and the GCN uses this latent representation to predict locations suitable for charging stations. Using real-world data from Bryan-College Station, Texas, US, the proposed model outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving an F1-score of 0.87 in distinguishing existing station locations from non-station locations. The model also identifies 27 additional candidate locations that show geospatial characteristics similar to those of existing stations, based on a similarity score. We further evaluate two policy implementation scenarios, maximizing geospatial similarity and minimizing total travel distance, each yielding different outcomes aligned with distinct strategic objectives. The findings highlight the importance of incorporating spatial context into CSLP and provide valuable insights for future EV infrastructure planning, promoting both efficiency and accessibility in the rapidly growing electric mobility sector.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于地理空间人工智能（GeoAI）的电动汽车充电站选址框架，结合变分自编码器（VAE）和图卷积网络（GCN），利用高维地理空间数据预测合适的充电站位置，并在美国Bryan-College Station的真实数据上取得了优于基线模型的性能。
AI.motivation: 随着电动汽车（EV）普及率上升，如何高效且合理地布局充电基础设施成为关键挑战。现有充电站选址研究多关注成本或出行距离最小化，而忽略了影响站点运营性能的周边地理空间特征，因此需要一种能整合多源高维地理空间信息的方法来提升选址质量。
AI.method: 提出GeoAI框架，整合EV使用量、土地利用、人口、交通等多源高维地理空间数据；使用变分自编码器（VAE）将高维数据压缩至低维潜在空间；采用图卷积网络（GCN）基于潜在表示预测适合建设充电站的位置，并通过相似性得分识别候选站点；进一步评估两种政策实施场景——最大化地理空间相似性与最小化总出行距离。
AI.result: 在美国得克萨斯州Bryan-College Station的真实数据上，所提模型在区分现有站点与非站点任务中取得F1-score 0.87，优于现有基线方法；模型额外识别出27个与现有站点具有相似地理空间特征的候选站点；两种政策场景分别得到符合不同战略目标的选址结果。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明将空间上下文纳入充电站选址问题（CSLP）具有重要意义，为未来EV基础设施规划提供了兼顾效率与可达性的有价值的见解，有助于推动快速发展的电动出行领域。

title: Fake News Theories: Harnessing Disciplinary Insights for Computational Modeling, Detection, and Explanation
summary: Disinformation research has produced increasingly accurate automated fake-news detectors, but many systems remain difficult to interpret and are weakly connected to established theories of persuasion, credibility, and human judgment. In this paper, we develop a theory-informed computational framework that translates cross-disciplinary theories of fake news into measurable features for automated detection and explanation through statistical techniques and large language models. To that end, we conduct a structured cross-disciplinary review of theories from social sciences, psychology, economics, among other disciplines that reveal how fake news persuades and spreads, thereby establishing a broad theoretical foundation for computational modeling. Experiments on benchmark datasets show that theory-derived features are predictive and provide interpretable, theory-referenced diagnostic signals. Multi-feature models generally outperform individual features, although gains among the strongest small feature combinations are modest. Our work highlights the value of interdisciplinary perspectives in building robust and interpretable fake news detection systems, advancing the foundation for human-centered approaches in combating disinformation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个"理论驱动"的虚假新闻检测框架，将社会科学、心理学、经济学等学科中关于说服力、可信度和人类判断的经典理论转化为可计算的、可解释的特征，用于自动化虚假新闻检测与解释。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化虚假新闻检测系统虽准确率较高，但多为"黑箱"模型，缺乏与社会科学理论的联系，难以解释为何某条新闻被判定为真/假，限制了记者、政策制定者和事实核查员的实际应用。论文旨在通过跨学科理论增强检测模型的透明度与可解释性。
AI.method: 1. 进行跨学科理论综述，将相关理论分为内容（Content）、信源（Source）、网络（Network）三类；2. 从中筛选出可操作化的理论，转化为10个内容特征+1个信源特征，包括：confidence heuristic（LIWC）、scarcity principle（LLM）、negativity bias（VADER）、coherence（entity grid模型）、logical consistency（RoBERTa-MNLI）、supporting evidence（启发式聚合）、illusory truth（GPT-4o-mini）、information complexity（Flesch-Kincaid）、language vagueness（BERT微调）、information gap（标点+主题KL散度）、source credibility（one-hot编码）；3. 使用XGBoost分类器在ReCOVery、Fake_And_Real_News、GossipCop三个基准数据集上进行评估，并采用SHAP、特征相关性、跨数据集对比等方法分析。
AI.result: 实验结果显示：理论驱动特征具有预测性（AUC约50%-70.5%单特征，整合后达79.1%）；多特征（联合）模型通常优于单特征，但最强小组合之间的增益有限；source credibility是最重要的判别特征；信息复杂度、逻辑一致性、连贯性、负面偏差在不同数据集间表现出稳定的跨域贡献；特征间相关性低（多数<0.1），表明各特征提供互补信息；理论与特征重要性存在数据集依赖性（Spearman相关性仅0.167）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证实了理论驱动的信号对新闻真实性具有诊断价值，强调跨学科视角对构建可解释虚假新闻检测系统的重要性。该框架在预测性能与理论透明度之间提供了互补的权衡，为以人为中心的虚假信息治理奠定了基础。局限包括：数据集主题与来源差异影响特征重要性、部分特征依赖预训练/大语言模型且对prompt敏感、未在传播类数据集上验证网络层理论。

title: Improving Molecular-Morphology Contrastive Pretraining using Deep-Learning-based Morphology Profiles
summary: Recent advancements in image-based profiling techniques have enabled the collection of high-volume cell morphology data, allowing new molecular embedding models to learn from the experimental phenotypic perturbations of a molecule in a cell. Previously, we developed Molecule-Morphology Contrastive Pretraining (MoCoP), a strategy for aligning small molecule embeddings to morphology fingerprints extracted through CellProfiler. The resulting molecular representation showed transferable performance for quantitative structure--activity relationship (QSAR) prediction tasks. Here, we extend the method by using a deep-learning-based cell image encoding pipeline to extract more feature-rich morphology profiles and align them to the molecular embeddings through contrastive learning. The new embeddings encode more accurate information on how molecules perturb cell morphology and enable improvements for QSAR predictions through either fixed-embedding linear probes or fully flexible fine-tuning. Morphology retrieval performance scales log-linearly with training data size, suggesting continued improvements as larger datasets become available. The improved MoCoP v2 also achieves superior performance on toxicity prediction and competitive results on ADME and activity benchmarks, when compared with existing molecular embedding models that use both cell morphology and transcriptomic data during training.

AI.tldr: MoCoP v2 提出了一种改进的分子-形态学对比预训练框架，将基于 CellProfiler 的手工形态特征替换为由微调 ResNet-18 提取的深度学习形态嵌入，并通过 CORAL 校正批次效应。实验表明该方法在 QSAR 预测、毒性预测和 ADME 任务上优于其前代和现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统的分子描述符（如 ECFPs）仅从化学图中提取信息，无法捕获分子在活细胞中的真实作用。虽然 Cell Painting 等成像技术能产生高通量形态学数据，但现有方法多依赖 CellProfiler 的手工特征，可能遗漏细微的形态学模式。MoCoP v1 已证明分子-形态学对齐的价值，但受限于特征质量。
AI.method: 该方法采用三阶段流程：(1) 在 JUMP-CP Source 3 的 Cell Painting 图像上微调 ResNet-18（修改第一层以接受 5 通道输入），使用三元组损失和半难样本挖掘，生成 128 维 tile 级嵌入，经均值聚合后使用 CORAL 基于 DMSO 对照进行批次校正；(2) 将分子 GGNN 编码器与形态学 MLP 编码器通过对称 InfoNCE 损失对齐到 128 维共享空间；(3) 将预训练的分子编码器迁移到下游任务。
AI.result: 在形态学检索方面，Top-1 准确率从 10K 训练化合物的 3.3% 提升至 98K 的 6.8%，呈现对数线性缩放规律。在 ChEMBL20 的 QSAR 任务中，线性探测下 AUROC 提升 2.5–3.5 个百分点；在端到端微调下于 100% 数据时 AUROC 提升 1.3 个百分点。在下游基准测试中，ToxCast 毒性预测达到 SOTA（70.3% AUC），Biogen 3K ADME 任务排名第二（43.5 MAE），且对化学隔离化合物（Tanimoto < 0.3）的形态检索优于 ECFP4 和 MoCoP v1。
AI.conclusion: 深度学习形态嵌入相比手工特征能更准确地捕获分子诱导的细胞形态学变化，且仅使用形态学数据即可在多个下游任务上匹配甚至超越同时使用形态学和转录组数据的方法（如 InfoAlign）。该框架为药物发现中的支架跳跃、靶点去卷积和 ADMET 预测提供了有价值的分子表征基础。未来的改进方向包括使用 DINO、掩码自编码器等自监督视觉骨干、整合转录组数据以及纳入浓度感知建模。

title: Auditing System-1 Models on Biosecurity-Relevant Benchmarks: Calibration, Selective Prediction, and Permutation Instability in a Non-Generative Model
summary: Non-generative "System-1" models return structured probabilistic decisions in a single forward pass, without autoregressive decoding, at a small fraction of the inference cost of a generative model. This makes them of interest as inexpensive components in larger pipelines, but their reliability on biosecurity-relevant tasks has not been systematically examined. We audit one commercial System-1 model on 6,020 multiple-choice items drawn from the Weapons of Mass Destruction Proxy (WMDP), a paraphrase-robust WMDP-Bio variant, and six LAB-Bench subtasks, measuring accuracy, calibration, error detection, selective prediction, and sensitivity to the order in which answer options are presented. Accuracy is strongly task-dependent. Once the vendor's uncertainty field is correctly interpreted, the model is reasonably well calibrated (pooled expected calibration error 0.034) and its top-1 probability separates correct from incorrect predictions (pooled AUROC 0.820), though both degrade substantially on the weaker tasks. Under four cyclic rotations of the answer options, 37.4% of WMDP-Cyber items receive different answers; a control using byte-identical repeated calls attributes most of this to option order rather than run-to-run variation. Averaging probabilities across rotations improves WMDP-Cyber accuracy by 3.8 percentage points, and applying it only to low-confidence items recovers most of that gain at well under the cost of averaging every item.

AI.tldr: 本文对一个商用非生成式"System-1"模型（Jev）在6,020道生物安全与生物学相关基准题上进行了可靠性审计，评估其准确性、校准度、选择性预测能力以及答案选项排列顺序的敏感性。研究表明，虽然聚合准确率表现尚可（67.3%），但存在显著的任务依赖性、答案顺序不稳定（WMDP-Cyber中37.4%题目在不同轮换下答案不一致），并通过选择性排列平均策略以低成本提升了不稳定任务上的准确率。
AI.motivation: 非生成式System-1模型具有低推理成本的优势，可能被用作AI安全和生物安全管道中的辅助分类器，但其可靠性尚未在生物安全相关任务上得到系统检验。聚合准确率不足以评估其可靠性，需要从校准度、错误检测、选择性预测和答案稳定性等多维度建立其经验性质。
AI.method: 在6,020道选择题上对Jev模型（v1 REST端点，jev-1.0）进行审计，基准包括WMDP-Bio/Chem/Cyber、WMDP-Bio-Robust（释义变体）及六个LAB-Bench子任务。测量指标包括准确率（含Wilson区间）、期望校准误差（ECE）、AUROC（使用p_max分离正确/错误）、高置信度错误率（P(error|p_max≥0.9)）、风险-覆盖率曲线，以及在四次循环轮换选项下的稳定性。对WMDP两项进行字节级重复调用的控制实验以分离选项顺序效应与运行间变差。最后实施选择性排列平均策略，按置信度选择低置信度项目进行额外评估。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：(1)准确率高度依赖任务，WMDP-Bio达85.2%，WMDP-Cyber仅63.4%，LAB-Bench介于36.6%-61.8%之间；(2)校准后的confidence字段实质为p_max的仿射重缩放，用p_max评估时池化ECE=0.034，池化AUROC=0.820，但各任务差异显著（ECE 0.033-0.193）；(3)WMDP-Cyber中37.4%题目在四种循环轮换下获得不同答案，对照实验表明约75%的不稳定性归因于选项顺序而非运行间变异；(4)对WMDP-Cyber进行四次旋转概率平均使准确率提升+3.8 pp，仅对最低置信度20%项目应用可恢复97%的增益且成本降低45%；(5)检测到明显的首位位置偏好，主要为位置性而非字母标签性。
AI.conclusion: System-1模型在生物安全相关基准上的可靠性需从多个维度评估：单一准确率数字掩盖了项目级不稳定性；p_max在正确解释后可支持弃权策略，但校准质量依任务而异，阈值不可跨任务移植；置信度与重呈现下的稳定性提供了互补的信任信号。研究表明选择性格均策略可在低成本下有效提升不稳定任务上的可靠性，但该研究不涉及生物危害分类任务本身，且仅评估单一专有模型。

title: RAZOR: Pruning Replaceable Experts in LLMs
summary: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models activate few experts per token but store the full expert pool. Expert pruning reduces this storage burden; at a fixed pruning budget, the goal is to preserve the original model's output distribution as closely as possible. Yet an expert's usage or contribution magnitude does not by itself determine the damage caused by its removal. What matters is whether the surviving computation can replace its function. We introduce RAZOR, a training-free expert pruning method that scores functional replaceability using consensus residuals: deviations of expert outputs from the original weighted mixture. An exact single-deletion identity at a fixed layer input accounts for survivor renormalization and router-selected refill, providing local scores aggregated over calibration tokens for budgeted pruning without gradients or recovery training. On GLM-4.7-Flash, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731, and Hy3 at 25\% and 50\% expert removal, RAZOR achieves the highest nine-task macro average among the evaluated pruning methods in all eight settings. On the two backbones with matched REAP benchmark runs, it exceeds REAP by 2.12--5.59 points and wins all 36 paired task comparisons. It also lowers reverse KL relative to REAP in all four matched GLM-4.7-Flash and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B model--budget settings. Analysis of responses generated by Qwen3.6-35B-A3B nevertheless reveals changes in diversity, formatting, and termination, underscoring that task retention and predictive fidelity do not ensure generation stability.

AI.tldr: RAZOR提出了一种无需训练、基于共识残差评估专家功能可替代性的MoE剪枝方法。该方法通过精确的单删除恒等式同时考虑幸存者重归一化和路由器选择的回填，在四个MoE骨干网络上以25%和50%的专家移除率均取得了优于REAP等现有方法的性能。
AI.motivation: MoE模型虽然每个token仅激活少量专家，但仍需存储完整专家池，加重了存储负担。现有的专家剪枝方法主要基于路由频率或输出范数等贡献度量来评估专家重要性，但这并不能反映删除后剩余计算能否替代被删除专家的功能。该论文指出，应从"功能可替代性"而非单纯贡献大小来评估专家。
AI.method: RAZOR的核心方法是基于共识残差（consensus residuals）来评估专家的功能可替代性。具体步骤包括：(1) 定义共识为原始加权MoE输出，每个专家的残差为其输出与共识的偏差；(2) 推导出在固定层输入下考虑幸存者重归一化和路由器回填的单删除恒等式（Proposition 2）；(3) 不考虑回填作为一种特例情况（Proposition 3，固定支持情况）；(4) 通过校准token的聚合（条件RMS）来计算每个专家的局部分数；(5) 在每层预算内保留得分最高的专家。RAZOR是RCS-Refill与条件RMS聚合的实例。整体流程无需梯度、子集搜索或恢复训练。
AI.result: 在GLM-4.7-Flash、Qwen3.6-35B-A3B、DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731和Hy3四个模型上，以25%和50%的专家移除率进行评估，RAZOR在所有八种设置下均取得了九项任务宏平均的最高分。在与REAP匹配的两个骨干网络上，RAZOR超越REAP 2.12-5.59分，并在全部36项配对任务对比中获胜。同时在四个匹配的模型-预算设置中均降低了反向KL。然而，在Qwen3.6-35B-A3B的生成分析中发现，多样性、格式和终止行为仍有变化，表明任务性能保留和预测保真度并不能保证生成稳定性。
AI.conclusion: RAZOR是一种无需训练的专家剪枝方法，建立在功能可替代性的基础上，而非仅依赖贡献大小。共识残差衡量每个专家相对于原始路由混合输出的贡献，提供了同时考虑幸存者重归一化和路由器回填的局部删除分数。实验表明，任务性能和预测保真度的保留并不能保证稳定的生成行为。该方法支持按"剩余计算可替代什么"的原则进行剪枝，同时需通过保留能力和生成行为变化两方面评估压缩效果。

title: Reliability-aware Cross-sample Enhancement for Robust Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
summary: Multimodal Sentiment Analysis (MSA) aims to infer human emotions from multiple modalities such as text, audio, and vision. In practice, inputs are often corrupted by noise and missing modalities, which degrades performance. Existing methods typically address these challenges in isolation, limiting their effectiveness in realistic settings. To address this limitation, we propose a Reliability-aware Cross-sample Enhancement (RCE) framework. Specifically, RCE first introduces an adaptive variational information bottleneck to model modality-wise uncertainty and perform quality-aware information compression, thereby suppressing redundant noise in unreliable modalities. Furthermore, we design a reliability-aware cross-sample enhancement strategy that retrieves high-confidence, semantically consistent neighbors from a large candidate pool to enrich and calibrate current representations, effectively alleviating information deficiency caused by missing modalities. Building upon this, RCE integrates cross-modal interactions with a multilevel reliability-aware fusion mechanism to adaptively aggregate information across modalities and enhancement stages, leading to more robust multimodal representations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RCE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across full, noisy, and missing-modality settings.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种统一的可靠性感知跨样本增强（RCE）框架，通过自适应变分信息瓶颈（AVIB）建模模态不确定性，利用记忆库检索进行跨样本增强，并设计多层级可靠性感知融合机制，在完整、噪声和缺失模态条件下均实现稳健的多模态情感分析。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常孤立处理噪声和缺失模态问题，且多数基于信息瓶颈的去噪方法对所有模态均匀压缩，缺乏对模态可靠性的显式建模；现有跨样本增强方法仅依赖mini-batch样本，容易引入"负增强"（语义相似但情感极性相反的样本）。
AI.method: 三核心模块：1）AVIB：将模态特征映射到vMF分布，用方向参数μ和浓度参数κ分别表示语义方向和可靠性/不确定性，以超球面均匀分布为先验实现质量自适应压缩；2）RME：构建模态专属记忆库（采用reservoir采样避免近因偏差），基于方向相似度+标签距离惩罚+置信度促进的加权策略检索top-k邻居进行增强；3）超模态生成与多层级融合：通过Perceiver式潜在Transformer和跨模态交叉注意力生成超模态表示，并以κ调制融合权重实现从模态内到模态间的层级聚合。
AI.result: 在CMU-MOSI/CMU-MOSEI/UR-FUNNY/MUStARD四个数据集上全面超越SOTA：MOSI Acc7达50.22%，MAE降至0.589；MOSEI Acc7达55.44%，Corr达0.799；在随机/固定缺失协议下均优于HME/CyIN；在高斯/椒盐噪声下保持显著鲁棒性；负增强率从HME的46%降至CMU-MOSI上的2.60%-6.48%。
AI.conclusion: RCE通过统一的可靠性感知范式——不确定性建模、跨样本信息增强与多层级融合——在单一框架内同时解决了噪声和缺失模态问题，无需针对各场景单独设计，实现了跨任务、跨数据集的稳定性能。

title: Moment-guided edge sampling
summary: Edge sampling makes local decisions to achieve graph-level objectives, such as preserving structural properties. This creates a fundamental challenge: \textit{how can the effect of a local edge edit (i.e., edge addition or removal) on global graph structure be quantified and controlled?} We address this challenge with a \textit{moment-guided edge sampling framework} based on spectral moments of the random-walk transition matrix. We compute exact moment changes through two complementary methods: a combinatorial method with closed-form updates for low-order moments, and a low-rank method that exploits \textit{locality} and \textit{cyclic trace invariance} to compress computations to edited endpoints, supporting arbitrary moment orders and batched edits. For single-edge edits at fixed moment orders, the low-rank method reduces the cost from $O(mn)$ to $O(m)$, while the combinatorial method evaluates low-order changes in constant time given maintained local statistics. These moment changes provide \textbf{interpretable structural signatures} of local edge motifs that aggregate into graph-level fingerprints. This structural meaning motivates us to ask whether preserving moments also preserves the graph properties. We further derive and validate that moment-preserving sampling can \textbf{retain related structural properties}, including triangle-weighted clustering coefficient. These structural insights enable \textbf{analysis and improvement of graph learning}: different edge structures have distinct effects on supervised node classification, while moment-guided augmentation is competitive for graph contrastive learning. Together, these findings establish moments as an interpretable and controllable bridge from local edge edits to global graph structure and learning.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了基于谱矩的边采样框架，通过随机游走转移矩阵的谱矩将局部边编辑与全局图结构联系起来。提出了两种互补的精确矩变化计算方法（组合方法和低秩方法），并验证了矩保留采样能维持结构属性，可用于图学习的分析与改进。
AI.motivation: 图边采样需要基于局部决策实现全局结构保留目标，但缺乏一种可量化、可控地连接局部边编辑与全局图结构的桥梁。现有方法多依赖简单的均匀边删除或随机游走采样，无法显式控制结构信息。谱矩作为图结构的紧凑表征，提供了一种自然的方式来弥合这一鸿沟。
AI.method: 框架基于随机游走转移矩阵的谱矩。提出两种互补的精确矩变化计算方法：(1) 组合方法——通过维护局部统计量（W_i、M_ij、H_i），以 O(1) 时间计算低阶矩（m₂和m₃）的精确闭合形式更新；(2) 低秩方法——利用局部性（边编辑仅改变端点转移列）和循环迹不变性，将转移矩阵更新表示为低秩形式 P'=P+CR^T，并将受影响的闭合游走压缩为 r×r 端点矩阵的乘积，支持任意矩阶和批量编辑，将单边计算成本从 O(Kmn) 降至 O(Km)。通过矩变化引导迭代选择边编辑，使图的矩向量逼近目标矩向量。
AI.result: 实验表明：(1) 边级矩变化能有效表征局部边结构模式，并聚合成图级指纹，不同领域图有不同特征模式；(2) 矩保留采样在保持归一化谱、三角加权聚类系数、邻域逆度、Estrada指数等结构属性上显著优于均匀随机边删除；(3) 在Cora和Citeseer上的监督节点分类中，矩变化揭示了不同结构边类型对性能的差异化影响；(4) 矩引导增强在图对比学习（GRACE、MVGRL、GCL-SPAN对比）中取得竞争性结果（Cora: 84.58%, Citeseer: 72.65%），且不同图有各自最优的矩目标区域。
AI.conclusion: 谱矩为从局部边编辑到全局图结构及下游学习提供了一种可解释、可控的桥梁。提出的高效矩引导采样框架在算法效率和实际应用上均有效，为图结构分析、图采样和图学习增强提供了新的工具。

title: Mentored Decoding: Faster Inference meets Boosting
summary: Speculative decoding is a successful technique speeding up inference of a target autoregressive language model via a fast drafter model. Lossy speculative decoding allows a drift with respect to the target to further improve speed. Interestingly, it has been observed experimentally that the resulting model can $\textit{also}$ beat the target $\textit{quality-wise}$. Our paper formally proves how such a feat is possible with a formal approach to lossy speculative decoding called $\textit{mentored decoding}$. To get there, we connect inference to a celebrated ML training theory, $\textit{boosting}$, and proceed via the generalization of mentored decoding to the whole set of $f$-divergences. We uncover key properties of mentored decoding, among which (i) the particularly appealing geometric nature of the total variation case, (ii) simple approximations for any $f$-divergence in direct relation with boosting compliance, and (iii) a $\textit{divergence independent}$ $O(n)$ space and $O(\mathrm{sort}(n))$ time data structure built on drafter and target outputs, which allows to query the optimal parameters of the dual problem in $O(\log n)$ time and constructing optimal mentored distributions in $O(n)$ time for any $f$-divergence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"导师解码"(Mentored Decoding, MD)，将有损推测解码形式化为约束优化问题，并首次将其与机器学习经典理论"提升法"(Boosting)建立理论联系，证明在加速推理的同时提升模型质量是可行的。核心贡献包括：(1) 总变差特例的几何刻画与一般 f-散度下最优解的简洁"坐标裁剪"闭式解；(2) 与提升法的双向连接（包括 TV 情形下的精确构造与一般情形下的近似保证）；(3) 一个与 f 无关的 O(n) 空间、O(sort(n)) 时间的断点数据结构，可在 O(log n) 时间查询最优参数。理论在多种 f-散度上得到验证，且与现代 top-k 截断推理兼容（额外开销可忽略）。
AI.motivation: 推测解码(SD)受限于"输出分布须等于目标分布"这一硬约束，导致接受率存在理论上界。近期实验观察到允许偏离目标后，复合输出在质量上甚至能超越目标模型，但缺乏形式化分析。本文旨在：(1) 形式化"有损推测解码"框架；(2) 从理论上解释"加速推理+提升质量"这一实验现象；(4) 提供高效算法支撑实际部署。
AI.method: 方法分三部分：(1) **MD 理论**：将有损 SD 建模为最大化接受率、约束分布偏差的优化问题 md²_f(p,q;D)，证明其与单参数化 md¹_f 等价；在总变差情形给出最优集的几何刻画（超矩形∩单纯形∩L1 球），对一般严格凸 f 给出最优分布的"夹紧"闭式 π*=max{(1-b)q, min{p,(1+a)q}}；(2) **与 Boosting 连接**：设计自归一化多类提升算法（无需 AdaBoost 式的权重归一化系数），通过边(μ)衡量模型质量，证明 MD 的复合输出同时满足提升优势上界；TV 情形可精确嵌入 Boosted 解到 MD 最优集，一般情形通过断点结构给出近似保证；(3) **算法**：构造与 f 无关的"断点"集合 C(p,q)（大小≤n，排序时间 O(sort(n))），通过二分查找 O(log n) 时间得到最优 (a,b) 并构建最优分布；在 top-k 截断时复杂度进一步降为 O(k log k)。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：(i) Theorem 3.4：TV-MD 最优集为 [min{p,q}, max{p,q}]∩Δ_n∩{D_TV(·‖q)=D}，含全部严格凸 f 的最优解（Theorem 3.13）；(ii) Theorem 3.7：对可微 f，md²_f 与等分集 is_f 间存在双射；(iii) Theorem 3.12：近似解的接受率 P_acc(MD)=P_acc(SD)+a·q(A)+(p(I>1)-q(I>1))，严格大于 SD 接受率；(iv) Theorem 4.2/4.7/4.8：提升优势指数级衰减保证，TV-MD 下 A≥(1+ϱ²ε²)·μ²_target，一般 f 下近似 MD 解也满足 Ω(ρ/k²) 的边界；(v) Theorem 5.4：D_f(P) 在 P_acc(SD) 处右导数为 0（f 在 z=1 可微时），表明可廉价提升接受率；(vi) 玩具仿真验证：在 n=100/1000 词表上 8 种 f-散度，10%+ 接受率提升下 k≈1，divergence 增长微小。
AI.conclusion: 论文首次严格证明了"在加快推理速度的同时获得质量更优的复合模型"是可行的，核心在于将 MD（作为分布偏移的约束优化）与 Boosting（作为质量提升的训练理论）通过边(μ) 和 f-散度约束联系起来。理论与算法均与 f 无关，关键的断点数据结构使实际部署的开销可忽略（top-k 截断下零额外开销）。未来方向包括：将 MD 扩展到 >2 模型（多 drafter、多 target）情形，以及探索 (WCA) 等弱相关假设下的指数级提升率。

title: Geometric Feature Learning for Functional Data Valued on the Symmetric Positive Definite Manifold
summary: We here develop a functional neural network, termed MatFAE, for learning trajectories on the Riemannian manifold of symmetric positive definite (SPD) matrices. MatFAE features intrinsic layers that map manifold-valued functions to Euclidean vector-valued functions, followed by a functional layer that projects them into a finite-dimensional Euclidean space. Unlike most neural networks for discrete-time sequences, MatFAE treats each sequence as a continuous function and can therefore encode trajectory dynamics (e.g., first-order derivatives) in its latent representations. Additionally, the morphology of the functional weights in the functional layer offers interpretability by revealing the regions of the input functional data that contribute most to the latent representations. We justify the design principles and properties of each intrinsic layer and detail how matrix factorization is handled during backpropagation. We apply MatFAE to a range of fMRI datasets, demonstrating its ability to efficiently learn informative representations from high-dimensional SPD trajectories and its practical value for real-world neuroimaging analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MatFAE，一种针对对称正定（SPD）流形上函数型数据的功能性神经网络，通过内在几何层将流形值函数映射到欧几里得空间，再经功能性自编码器学习潜在表示。它在fMRI数据集上展现出优于现有方法的聚类与分类性能，并具有内在可解释性。
AI.motivation: SPD矩阵轨迹数据（如fMRI时变功能连接）在神经影像等领域日益常见。现有方法多将序列视为离散快照，无法捕捉连续时间动态与导数信息。缺乏针对SPD值函数型数据的专用深度学习架构，亟需将黎曼几何与函数型数据分析相结合的新型表征学习方法。
AI.method: MatFAE采用模块化设计：（1）矩阵到向量模块，通过多头BiMap层进行维度归约，使用Fréchet均值池化与测地线收缩激活正则化，再经黎曼对数映射将SPD函数映射到欧几里得函数空间；（2）功能性自编码器模块（基于FAEclust），使用功能层处理连续时间函数并学习潜在表示，解码器通过低维切空间映射并结合正交矩阵提升恢复SPD轨迹；（3）训练采用Stiefel流形上的黎曼梯度下降与矩阵分解的完整反向传播推导。
AI.result: 在10个仿真场景（消融阶梯）中，MatFAE在8个场景取得最佳或并列最佳AMI；在6个真实静息态fMRI队列上，MatFAE在所有数据集均取得最佳AMI与ARI；监督变体MatFAE-C在所有6个队列上取得最佳平衡分类准确率（0.453-0.741），相对最佳基线提升最高达34%。功能权重的时序形态可定位对潜在表征贡献最大的输入时间窗口，为模型提供了内在可解释性。
AI.conclusion: MatFAE是首个专为SPD流形上函数型数据设计的神经架构，融合了几何感知的维度归约与功能特征提取。其多头BiMap、测地线收缩激活与内在可解释性机制共同赋予了模型捕获几何结构与时间形态的能力，在仿真与真实数据上一致优于现有方法，验证了其在神经影像分析中的实用价值。

title: Learning to Bias: Machine Learning-Enhanced Particle Filters
summary: Sequential inference estimates latent states from noisy and incomplete observations. Particle Filters (PFs), a class of Monte Carlo methods based on importance sampling, provide a flexible framework for this task, but often suffer from poor sample efficiency and unfavorable scaling with dimension, partly due to suboptimal proposal distributions. We address these challenges by integrating learned proposals into the PF framework. We introduce Neural Optimal Particle Filters (NOPFs), which learn an amortized approximation to the optimal proposal from offline simulated one-step conditioning tuples. The learned proposal is used as a drop-in replacement in standard PF updates, with samples corrected by standard importance weights so that the method asymptotically targets the same filtering distribution under standard support and density-evaluation assumptions. Across stochastic nonlinear benchmarks of varying inference complexity, NOPFs improve sample efficiency and distributional accuracy over standard PF baselines with modest computational overhead. The approach integrates data-driven proposal learning into classical inference without altering the underlying filtering objective.

AI.tldr: 本文提出神经最优粒子滤波器（NOPF），通过离线学习近似最优提议分布的神经网络，将其作为即插即用模块嵌入标准粒子滤波器更新中，在不改变滤波目标的前提下提高非线性序贯推断的样本效率和分布精度。
AI.motivation: 标准粒子滤波器因提议分布次优而面临样本效率差、随维度不利扩展的问题；最优提议分布通常不可解析获取，需要一种数据驱动且计算开销可控的方法来近似它。
AI.method: NOPF 离线训练一个以确定性动力学骨架预测、当前观测和时间步为输入的神经网络，输出高斯提议的均值与Cholesky协方差因子；训练目标为负ELBO，使用模拟的单步条件元组。推理时直接将学习到的提议嵌入标准SIS更新，使用标准重要性权重进行校正。
AI.result: 在四个机器人定位基准测试（从近似高斯到多模态无序距离关联场景）上，NOPF 在NMSE、PNLL、能量分数和有效样本量方面优于或匹配标准PF基线，同时保持接近基础PF的计算开销；高斯局部提议在弱观测下的多模态全局后验下仍具鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 学习到的提议机制可在不牺牲原则性贝叶斯加权的前提下提升PF实用性；高斯局部提议作为归纳偏置有效，但未来可探索更具表达力的提议族（如混合模型或标准化流）以及在线自适应机制以应对训练-测试分布漂移。

title: To Solve Bilevel Optimization with Nonconvex Lower Levels, We Need Second-Order Stationarity
summary: Although bilevel optimization (BLO) has emerged as a powerful framework for addressing many complex and nested machine learning problems in recent years, most existing studies are confined to the lower-level strongly convex (LLSC) or lower-level generally convex (LLGC) settings (i.e., the lower-level objective function is assumed to be, at least, convex). While the LLSC/LLGC assumptions render more tractable algorithmic design and theoretical analysis, they are too rigid to encompass many machine learning problems in practice. The limitations of LLSC/LLGC assumptions in BLO motivate us to investigate solving the BLO problem in the general lower-level nonconvex (LLNC) settings, which remains in its infancy. In the literature on LLNC-BLO, most of the existing works either require additional structures in the lower-level objective function for tractable theoretical analysis, or adopt the first-order stationarity reformulation as a lower-level surrogate problem, which is inherited from the LLSC/LLGC settings but could lose their effectiveness in the LLNC setting. To bridge this gap, we propose to reformulate the nonconvex lower-level problem using a second-order stationarity-based surrogate, the solution of which guarantees a local optimal solution at the lower level. Based on this reformulation, we propose the PROBE (Perturbed gradient algorithm for bilevel problem) and show that it overcomes the limitations of prior works by probing and escaping lower-level saddle points. We prove that PROBE achieves a finite-time convergence rate of $O(T^{-2/5})$, where T denotes iterations. To our knowledge, this work is the first to establish the finite-time convergence for achieving lower-level second-order stationary solutions in general LLNC-BLO. Our experiments on both a large language model-based data curation task and a meta-learning task also show that PROBE outperforms SOTA methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PROBE算法，首次将二阶平稳性（SOSP）作为下层替代，用于求解具有非凸下层的双层优化（BLO）问题。PROBE通过扰动梯度下降探测并逃离下层鞍点，理论上建立了O(T^{-2/5})的有限时间收敛率，并在LLM数据筛选和元学习任务上验证了优越性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLNC-BLO方法多采用一阶平稳性（FOSP）作为下层替代或依赖PL条件，容易陷入下层鞍点导致上层解显著次优。需要一种无需PL条件即可保证下层局部最优性的求解框架。
AI.method: 1) 提出SOS-LLS替代：将下层最优性约束替换为∇_y g=0且Hessian半正定；2) 引入μ-增广隐函数恢复局部强凸性；3) PROBE算法：内层用PGD（扰动梯度下降）寻找下层SOSP，外层用共轭梯度法估计增广超梯度并动态缩减μ_t→0；4) 双时间尺度设计，K_t递增以逐步减小内层误差。
AI.result: 理论上首次为一般LLNC-BLO建立了达到下层二阶平稳解的有限时间收敛率O(T^{-2/5})。实验上在Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct的HelpSteer数据筛选任务和MNIST元学习任务上均优于PBGD、GALET、MEHA、SUN-DSBO-SE等基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 将二阶平稳性引入LLNC-BLO框架是必要且可行的，PROBE算法通过逃离下层鞍点有效解决了现有FOSP方法陷入次优解的问题。未来工作将扩展到随机LLNC-BLO设置。

title: Benchmarking the Connectomes of Caenorhabditis elegans within the Reservoir Computing Framework
