AI.conclusion: 基于交叉注意力的自适应策略能够使离线训练的S2TT模型在实时流式场景中有效平衡翻译质量与延迟，无需额外训练或复杂决策模块。RFAP适用于中低延迟场景，DCAP适用于超低延迟场景，二者互补地为同步翻译提供了轻量级解决方案。

title: Aligning One-Step Generative Models with Reward-Weighted Transport Distillation
summary: One-step generators enable high-quality visual generation with a single network evaluation, but their post-training is difficult: general implicit generators provide neither tractable likelihoods nor denoising trajectories, and many rewards are non-differentiable. We introduce Reward-Weighted Transport Distillation (RWTD), a post-training method that requires only generated samples and scalar reward evaluations. Rather than aligning solely to the conventional reward-tilted reference distribution, RWTD constructs an adaptive target that mixes separately tilted current and reference distributions. The current component incorporates improvements discovered during training, while the reference component anchors the target to the pretrained generator. RWTD realizes this target through feature-space optimal transport and fixed-point regression. Theoretical analysis shows that the fixed-point distributions of RWTD interpolate between off-policy reward tilting of the reference and on-policy tilting of the current model, providing a principled approach to balancing reward adaptation with retention of prior knowledge. Empirically, RWTD substantially improves the GenEval score of the one-step SANA Sprint 1.6B backbone from 0.73 to 0.80, while separate preference alignment experiments demonstrate strong cross-reward generalization that yields balanced improvements and preservation of compositional capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对一步式(one-step)生成模型的后训练方法RWTD(Reward-Weighted Transport Distillation),仅需生成样本和标量奖励即可实现高质量对齐,在无需似然和去噪轨迹的情况下提升生成质量与奖励一致性。
AI.motivation: 一步式生成器虽然推理高效,但后训练困难,因为其隐式生成器既无可处理的似然也无去噪轨迹,使得多数奖励信号无法直接反向传播;现有基于奖励倾斜参考分布的对齐方法难以在保留先验能力与获得高奖励之间取得平衡。
AI.method: RWTD构建一个自适应目标分布,该分布对当前模型分布与参考分布分别进行奖励倾斜后进行混合;通过特征空间最优传输与不动点回归(fixed-point regression)实现该目标;理论分析表明其不动点分布插值于参考分布的离策略奖励倾斜与当前模型的在线策略倾斜之间。
AI.result: 在SANA Sprint 1.6B一步式骨干上,将GenEval评分从0.73提升至0.80;在独立偏好对齐实验中,展现出跨奖励的强泛化能力,可实现各项能力的均衡提升并保持组合生成能力。
AI.conclusion: RWTD为一步式生成模型提供了一种原理清晰的后训练方案,通过混合当前与参考的奖励倾斜目标实现奖励适配与先验保留之间的平衡,并具备良好的跨奖励泛化性能。

title: Learning Chance-Constrained MDPs with Bellman Distributional Certificates
summary: Safe reinforcement learning (RL) commonly enforces expected-cost constraints, but such expectation safety may fail to control the probability of rare high-cost trajectories. Chance-constrained MDPs (CCMDPs) impose a stronger probability-level requirement, but are widely viewed as harder because the chance constraint is nonconvex and depends on the full trajectory rather than a Bellman-linear expectation. In this paper, we reveal that this computational difficulty does not necessarily imply a higher statistical price. For tabular discounted CCMDPs with fixed bounded successor support and access to a certified planning oracle, we establish a model-based upper bound, with a matching lower bound up to logarithmic terms. Technically, our key idea is the \emph{Bellman distributional certificate}, which constructs a Bellman recursion for constraint violation probabilities before policy selection. The certificate can be reused across candidate policies; combined with shared row-wise reverse-KL confidence sets, it gives a policy-uniform trajectory-KL transfer without a union bound over policies or time--budget Bellman tables. For stochastic policies, we give a model-free variance-reduced policy-gradient algorithm with a finite-sample expected KKT-residual guarantee and independent validation of every accepted policy. Numerical experiments on synthetic CCMDPs and an IEEE 14-bus energy storage control benchmark illustrate the safety and mechanism behavior of the proposed algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文针对机会约束马尔可夫决策过程（CCMDP）的安全强化学习问题，提出"Bellman分布证书"方法，将轨迹级违反概率的Bellman递推前置到策略选择之前，从而实现可复用的安全认证。研究在固定有界后继支撑和认证规划oracle条件下，给出与下界匹配（至对数因子）的样本复杂度上界，同时开发了基于轨迹采样的无模型方差缩减策略梯度算法。
AI.motivation: 传统安全RL（CMDP）仅约束期望累积成本，无法控制罕见高成本轨迹的发生概率；机会约束虽更符合安全关键应用需求，但因非凸且依赖完整轨迹分布，被普遍认为统计代价更高。本文挑战这一直觉，证明计算困难不一定意味着更高的统计代价。
AI.method: 核心方法：(1) 对折扣安全预算进行截断和离散化，构建"违反概率Bellman表"，通过共享的行级反向KL置信集进行悲观Bellman递推，得到可跨策略复用的Bellman分布证书；(2) 模型化算法在经验Bellman表上求解收紧的确定性优化问题；(3) 无模型算法采用方差缩减策略梯度（SARAH/STORM递归）直接优化有限违反概率目标，辅以独立验证批次进行安全认证。关键统计技术：共享行级KL置信集 + 轨迹级KL迁移，无需对策略或时间-Bellman表取并集界。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) 确定性策略上界：样本复杂度 Õ(|S||A|d₀[(1-γ)⁻³ε⁻² + (1-γ)⁻¹ρ⁻²])，改进了已有确定性CCMDP学习结果 Õ(|S|²|A|(1-γ)⁻⁴(ε⁻²+ρ⁻²))；(2) 匹配下界：相同主要参数依赖，证明两项均不可避免；(3) 无模型算法：优化阶段 Õ(ε_kkt⁻³) 期望KKT残差保证，验证阶段 Õ(ρ⁻²) 独立认证；(4) IEEE 14节点储能控制基准实验显示Bellman选择器收敛至机会约束最优解，而Markov-CMDP期望成本代理因结构性保守性存在持续性能差距。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明CCMDP的统计学习代价与MDP/松弛可行性CMDP本质相同，挑战了"机会约束更难的统计"的普遍观点。Bellman分布证书将分布级安全检查转化为局部Bellman更新，实现策略间样本高效复用。未来方向包括扩展模型化分析到更广泛策略类与转移结构，以及获得全局无模型保证。局限性：模型化结果限于确定性策略且依赖认证规划oracle；无模型结果仅提供近似KKT保证且可能返回unresolved。

title: CacheReforge: Bounded Recovery for Stale KV Caches under Evolving Adapters
comment: 13 pages, 5 figures. Artifact: this https URL
summary: Large language models rely on KV caching to reduce repeated prefill computation in long context and interactive applications. As lightweight adapters evolve, cached states reflect earlier versions, so stale reuse distorts current model outputs, while complete affected suffix recomputation restores fidelity at substantial cost. We seek minimal recomputation that recovers current adapter behavior. Existing systems track token, context, or stable adapter identity, but neither represent caches from earlier adapter versions nor distinguish update propagation from the recomputation required for behavioral recovery. To address these gaps, we introduce CacheReforge, which represents stale KV caches as layerwise mixed-version objects. It combines per-layer adapter anchors, calibrated sensitivity, accumulated drift, and executable restart boundaries to select direct reuse, bounded recomputation, or complete affected-suffix recovery. We distinguish dependency depth from the functional recomputation horizon and use cumulative tail influence to characterize when bounded recovery preserves current-model behavior. We evaluate CacheReforge on Qwen2.5-1.5B and Qwen2.5-7B with continual LoRA updates, including 16K HotpotQA and 2WikiMQA workloads. CacheReforge reduces mean KL divergence by 92.4% relative to stale reuse, while recomputing only 5.44% of layers and reducing cache-maintenance time by 93.2% relative to fresh full prefill. These results show that version-aware recovery preserves model fidelity and most KV caching gains.

AI.tldr: CacheReforge提出了一种面向演化LoRA适配器下过期KV缓存的版本感知有界恢复框架，通过逐层混合版本表示、校准敏感度与累积漂移，在直接复用、有界重计算与完整受影响后缀重计算三种策略间自适应选择，仅重算5.44%层即可将KL散度降低92.4%。
AI.motivation: 持续适配（adapter evolution）会使此前缓存的KV状态与当前模型不一致：直接复用会丢失适配收益，而完整重算又代价过高。需要以最小重计算恢复当前适配器行为。
AI.method: 将陈旧KV缓存建模为逐层混合版本对象；定义尾影响力（tail influence）Tb，区分依赖深度与功能性重计算范围；离线校准逐层敏感度sℓ，结合运行时适配器位移dℓ(t)形成风险代理qℓ(t)=sℓ·dℓ(t)，据此选择直接复用、有界重计算或完整后缀恢复。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B上的HotpotQA与2WikiMQA长上下文任务上：相比陈旧复用KL降低92.4%，top-1从84.47%升至94.04%，仅重算5.44%层；相比完整重算缓存维护时间降低93.2%，单请求总时间从4.16s降至2.30s（-44.7%）。
AI.conclusion: 版本感知的陈旧KV恢复是必要的系统问题；累积尾部影响力比单一边界测量更能预测恢复边界；层敏感度与自适应范围选择共同带来显著的保真度-效率提升。

title: EPOC: Endpoint-Preserving Online Correction With Compressed Residual State for Multi-Horizon Time Series Forecasting
summary: Completed multi-horizon forecasts provide residual feedback for a fixed forecaster, but retaining full residual blocks increases auxiliary state. We propose Endpoint-Preserving Online Correction (EPOC) with a compressed residual state. It stores low-order discrete cosine transform (DCT) coefficients and the final value of the preceding residual block. Within each channel, the endpoint is shared across component-wise online ridge regressions that also use current-forecast coefficients. The fitted DCT correction is blended with the base forecast. We evaluate eight multivariate series with DLinear and PatchTST, three seeds, and two training variants, yielding 96 matched fixed-base conditions at a 24-step horizon. EPOC achieves mean condition-wise reductions in mean squared error (MSE) and mean absolute error (MAE) of 15.40% and 9.35% from the uncorrected base, respectively, with a median of 6,352 B in retained auxiliary arrays. It has lower paired MSE than the $\delta$-Adapter, COSA, FAC, and OMPB in a majority of conditions and uses less state than each. Full ELF achieves the largest mean MSE reduction, 19.29%, but its median retained state is 474,048 B ($\times$75 relative to EPOC). Equal-size summary controls favor the endpoint by 1.65--2.20% in paired MSE; a coefficient-reconstructed endpoint yields similar accuracy to the observed endpoint, highlighting its role as a shared input. Increasing the retained DCT component count from 4 to 8 adds 1.00 percentage point of MSE reduction for 5,728 B. On jointly trained bases, EPOC lowers MSE by 16.69--20.15% relative to globally blended TEFL-style adapters applied to the same base. The code and numerical records are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: EPOC是一种用于多步时间序列预测的在线残差校正方法，通过保留压缩的DCT系数和残差块的最终值（端点），结合通道内分量级的在线岭回归，以极小的辅助存储（仅6,352字节）实现对固定基预测器的显著误差降低。在96个匹配条件下，相比未校正基线平均MSE降低15.40%、MAE降低9.35%，且在多数条件下优于δ-Adapter、COSA、FAC和OMPB等竞品。
AI.motivation: 固定基预测器在多步预测完成后会产生残差反馈信息，但完整保留残差块会占用大量辅助存储状态。该研究旨在探索压缩残差表示与在线校正之间的准确性与存储权衡，研究压缩方法针对残差块的最终值（端点）能否在压缩DCT系数之外提供额外的校正价值。
AI.method: EPOC方法保留前一个残差块的低阶DCT系数（K=4）以及其未压缩的最终值（端点）。在每个通道内，端点作为共享特征输入到K个分量级在线岭回归中，每个回归还接收当前预测的对应DCT系数。拟合的修正通过由已完成块导出的混合权重与基预测融合。回归使用指数加权岭回归（λ=1，半衰期128块），更新仅在完整目标块到达后进行。
AI.result: 在8个多变量序列、两种基架构（DLinear和PatchTST）、3个种子和2种训练变体产生的96个匹配条件下，EPOC实现平均MSE降低15.40%、MAE降低9.35%，中位保留字节仅6,352 B。在多数条件下，EPOC的配对MSE低于δ-Adapter（84/96）、COSA（77/96）、FAC（58/96）和OMPB（91/96）。完整ELF达到最高平均MSE降低19.29%，但中位保留状态为474,048 B（EPOC的约75倍）。端点比等大小的首部、中间值和均值残差摘要带来1.65–2.20%的配对MSE降低。从DCT系数重建的端点与观测端点准确率接近（14.98% vs 15.40%），表明端点作为共享输入起关键作用。在联合训练基上，EPOC比TEFL风格适配器降低MSE 16.69–20.15%。K从4增加到8仅额外带来1.00个百分点的MSE降低，但增加5,728 B存储。
AI.conclusion: EPOC为固定多步预测器的在线校正提供了一个紧凑的准确性-存储操作点。核心贡献在于：（1）定义了结合截断残差DCT系数和未压缩端点的紧凑保留状态；（2）通过等大小摘要控制和输入消融验证了保留信息的选择；（3）在96个条件下展示了优异的准确性与存储平衡。端点作为跨分量回归的共享输入特征是提升性能的关键因素。K=4是参考设置而非最优设置，准确性-存储权衡可根据可用存储进行调节。

title: Low-Bit Recurrent States in Hybrid Language Models
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to ICASSP 2027
summary: Hybrid language models maintain fixed-size recurrent states, but existing quantizers typically use eight bits or more. Quantization errors persist according to channel decay rates. We derive distortion weights from the observability Gramian and combine them with normalized state ranges for mixed-precision bit allocation, without calibration data, rotation, or training. We also quantize decay rates logarithmically. With per-token state quantization, a four-bit mean payload reduces excess negative log-likelihood by factors of 3.3--27.9 relative to the best of seven baselines across three hybrid models; metadata costs vary. At six bits, negative log-likelihood differs from the FP32-state baseline by less than 0.005 nats. Ablations separate gains from variable bit widths, decay weighting, and range normalization. With less frequent write-backs, gains diminish and depend on the model and budget.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对混合语言模型（Hybrid LMs）循环状态的低比特量化方法。通过基于可观测性格拉姆矩阵（observability Gramian）推导失真权重，并结合归一化状态范围进行混合精度比特分配，无需校准数据、旋转或训练即可实现。该方法在三种混合模型上以4比特平均有效载荷将额外负对数似然（NLL）较最优基线降低3.3–27.9倍。
AI.motivation: 混合语言模型（线性注意力、Delta规则、状态空间模型）通常使用固定大小的循环状态存储历史信息，但现有量化方案需8比特以上才能保持精度，且未考虑通道衰减速率差异对误差传播的影响——缓慢衰减的通道会累积误差，快速衰减的则会消散误差，因此需要一种无需校准或训练的感知衰减的低比特量化方法。
AI.method: 1. **理论框架**：建立线性噪声模型，定义稳态读出失真为 Σ‖i Γ_i σ_i²，其中 Γ_i 是可观测格拉姆矩阵的对角元，由衰减率决定（公式 Γ_i = ρ_i/(C·expm1(2s_i))）。2. **衰减门量化**：对衰减率 s_i 取对数均匀量化级别。3. **状态比特分配**：最小化代理失真 Σ c_i·2^{-2b_i}，其中 c_i = Γ̂_i·R̃_i²（Γ̂ 为基于 EMA 估计的衰减项，R̃ 为组内归一化范围），通过经典高率比特分配公式 b_i = b̄ + ½ log₂(c_i/GM(c)) 求解。4. **存储与电平**：使用对称电平 {-n,…,n}Δ，Δ = fR/n，f 在 16 个值中按平方误差拟合，FP16 标量存储。
AI.result: 1. 在 Kimi-Linear、Qwen3.6-35B-A3B、Qwen3.8-27B 上，4 比特平均有效载荷下额外 NLL 较最优基线降低 3.3–27.9 倍（所有 8 个评估窗口均胜出，无调整符号检验 p=0.004）。2. 在 6 比特时，与 FP32 状态基线的 NLL 差异小于 0.005 nats。3. 消融实验分离了可变比特宽度（贡献 +0.167→+0.022 NLL 改进）、衰减加权（C=16 时 +0.024）和范围归一化（消除头间范围与衰减的相关性，中位 Spearman 相关系数 -0.65）三者的贡献。4. 在 RULER 长上下文检索（16K）多值查询任务中，恢复率 0.90 vs FP32 的 1.00，优于 INT 行量化（0.80）和 TurboQuant（0.80）。5. 局限：在 C=64、3 比特时，Qwen3.8 上某些量化器（含块量化器、Nemotron 上的 TurboQuant）优于本文方法；存在相关舍入误差导致的模型高估（模拟显示增益被高估 1.7–2.6 倍）。
AI.conclusion: 基于衰减加权结合归一化范围的混合精度分配方法显著改善了低比特循环状态量化，尤其在频繁写回场景下效果最佳。该方法无需校准数据、旋转或训练，具有部署友好性。然而，相关舍入误差（确定性舍入在 1 比特/3–5 比特下可达 0.23 的滞后一阶相关）和写回频率降低时的性能衰减仍需进一步研究。

title: Towards Understanding Momentum Acceleration in River-Valley Loss Landscape
summary: The empirical success of pretraining large language models has inspired a deeper investigation into the underlying loss landscapes and the optimization dynamics. Recent empirical and theoretical study suggest that the training loss landscape often exhibits a "river-valley" structure, which features a low-loss manifold (river) flanked by sharp orthogonal directions with higher loss (mountains). In the long term, the optimization progress is determined primarily by the progress along the river. Within such a landscape, gradient descent with large learning rates can move faster along the river despite high apparent loss due to vertical oscillations, while a subsequent sharp decay in the learning rate suppresses these oscillations, revealing genuine optimization progress. This explains the recent success of warmup-stable-decay (WSD) learning rate scheduler which, unlike cosine scheduling, keeps stable high learning rate and decays before producing intermediate checkpoints. Building on this foundation, in this work we take a step further and study the role of momentum within such a loss landscape. We establish theoretical analysis that characterizes how momentum accelerates optimization by stabilizing large learning rates that can not be tolerated by vanilla GD without deviating significantly from the river. The enabled large learning rate in-turn gives greater speed along the river and makes faster essential progress in the long run. Another intriguing observation from theory is that for a river-valley landscape with very flat and slow-spinning river, the momentum itself does not contribute directly to acceleration in terms of the speed of tracking the river, while the main acceleration comes from the admissible larger learning rate.

AI.tldr: 该论文在"河流-山谷"损失景观下，重球动量可将最大可容忍学习率提升约(1+β)/(1-β)倍，从而通过稳定大学习率来加速沿低损河流流形的优化，但动量本身在平坦慢旋河流中几乎不直接改变河流方向的速度。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型预训练中的损失曲面常呈"河流-山谷"结构（低损流形"河流"+陡峭正交方向"山谷"），但动量在非凸复杂景观中加速优化的理论依据不足；本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.method: 在河流-山谷损失景观的精确假设下，对带重球动量的梯度下降（GD-M）进行非凸分析：通过四组端点归纳条件（尖锐方向稳定、平坦方向梯度持续、平坦方向动量逼近滑动平均、平坦方向主导）追踪梯度与动量在平坦/尖锐方向上的分量，利用Lyapunov方程与矩阵稳定性分析推导出最大可容忍学习率的新阈值 η_max^GD-M ≈ (1+β)/(1-β)·η_max^GD，并证明迭代能紧跟参考流形且时间指标几乎与学习率成正比。
AI.result: 理论与合成实验吻合：动量按(1+β)/(1-β)放大最大学习率；GD-M（β=0.9）在η=0.4下能稳定沿河流推进而GD持续振荡；在GPT-Neo/TinyStories预训练中，SGD-M与Adam的最大可容忍学习率均随β（或β₁）单调增大（与理论趋势一致），大学习率配合动量取得更低训练与验证损失。
AI.conclusion: 在河流-山谷景观中，重球动量的主要作用是稳定一个本质上更大的学习率，从而加快沿河流的长期推进；在平坦慢旋的河流下，动量本身并不显著改变河流方向速度，收益主要来自被容许的更大学习率；该框架可拓展至Adam、Muon等含动量的自适应优化器。

title: Gradient Surgery for Physics-Informed Neural Networks
summary: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) are trained by optimising a composite objective that combines data fitting with physics-based constraints, typically resulting in a highly imbalanced multi-task optimisation problem. Under these conditions, existing optimisation strategies are affected by conflicting task gradients, leading to slow convergence and unstable training, particularly for stiff and high-frequency partial differential equations. We analyse gradient conflicts throughout training of PINNs with standard optimiser and investigate Multi-Task Deep Learning (MTDL) optimisation methods. In our analysis across four benchmark problems we observed that PINN optimisation exhibits three distinct phases in which angle- and magnitude-based gradient conflicts alternate, with only one present at a time. Building on these observations, we propose PAM-GS, a physics-aware gradient surgery method that adaptively mitigates task interference during training according to the observed conflict types. Experiments on four representative PDE benchmarks demonstrate that PAM-GS combines competitive solution accuracy with consistently strong task-balanced performance, outperforming existing methods on most problems.

AI.tldr: 本文针对物理信息神经网络(PINNs)训练中由多任务目标(数据拟合与物理约束)引起的梯度冲突问题,系统分析了基于角度和基于幅度的两类梯度冲突在训练中的动态演化规律,并提出了一种新的物理感知动量梯度手术方法 PAM-GS。
AI.motivation: PINN 将 PDE 求解转化为复合损失的多任务优化问题,其中 PDE 残差、边界条件和初始条件梯度之间存在严重的方向与幅值冲突,导致收敛慢、不稳定,尤其在刚性和高频 PDE 上表现差。现有梯度手术方法多忽略冲突类型的时序差异,因此需要一种能感知训练阶段并自适应处理不同冲突类型的优化器。
AI.method: 1) 在四个经典 PDE 基准(1D Burgers、1D Schrödinger、2D Kovasznay、3D Beltrami)上用 Adam 训练 PINN,逐层度量任务梯度间的余弦相似度(角度冲突)和幅度相似度 ψ(幅度冲突)。2) 发现训练呈现三阶段交替结构:拟合阶段(角度冲突低)、扩散阶段(角度冲突升高、幅度相似度上升)、完全扩散阶段(角度冲突下降但幅度失衡加剧)。3) 提出 PAM-GS:在每层检测冲突类型——若 ψ<γ 则进行任务梯度幅度均衡化;若 cos(Φ)<0 则基于动量的 Adam 风格加权重缩放;否则直接聚合。超参 β₁=0.9, β₂=0.99, γ 按问题设置。4) 与 PCGrad、GradDrop、CAGrad、IMTL、Aligned-MTL、Nash-MTL、SAM-GS、CONFIG 等多种损失平衡和梯度手术方法对比,采用 MSE、平均排名 MR 和相对改进 ΔM%。
AI.result: PAM-GS 在 2D Kovasznay 和 3D Beltrami 流动上均取得最佳整体 MSE 与 MR≈1;在 1D Burgers 与 1D Schrödinger 上整体 MSE 与 CAGrad 相当但任务均衡性更优(Kovasznay ΔM%=-94.83%, Beltrami ΔM%=-46.13%, Schrödinger ΔM%=-77.01%)。损失地形可视化显示 PAM-GS 收敛轨迹最短。计算/内存开销与 SAM-GS 等方法相当。
AI.conclusion: PINN 训练中角度与幅度梯度冲突呈交替出现的三阶段动态,PAM-GS 通过显式检测冲突类型并采用相应的梯度均衡化或动量重缩放策略,实现了更稳定、任务更均衡的优化,在四个基准中大多数情况下优于现有方法,验证了区分冲突类型而非将其作为静态现象处理的重要性。

title: LipSSM: Structurally Lipschitz-Bounded Cascaded State-Space Model via Metric Transfer between Consecutive SSM Layers
summary: Lipschitz continuity is a fundamental principle in the design of certifiably robust deep neural networks (DNNs), wherein adjusting the Lipschitz constant, which quantifies network robustness, is of central theoretical importance. A standard approach to enforcing Lipschitz continuity requires each layer of a DNN to be Lipschitz continuous, thereby guaranteeing overall Lipschitz continuity. However, this layer-wise approach typically imposes overly conservative restrictions by producing a loose estimate of the overall Lipschitz constant, which limits the expressive capacity of the DNN and degrades empirical performance at a prescribed level of robustness. To overcome this loose estimation, the recently proposed LipKernel transfers information across layers to yield a much tighter overall Lipschitz bound than conventional layer-wise construction. In this paper, we extend this concept to cascaded state-space models (SSMs) to construct Lipschitz-continuous DNNs capable of modeling longer-term dependencies. The proposed architecture, named LipSSM, is theoretically justified and empirically evaluated.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LipSSM，一种基于广义 Cayley 变换的结构性 Lipschitz 有界级联状态空间模型（SSM），通过层间度量传递实现紧致的网络级 Lipschitz 界，保证在保持可认证鲁棒性的同时建模长期依赖。
AI.motivation: 传统逐层 Lipschitz 约束通过各层 Lipschitz 常数之积估计整体上界，虽然实现简单但估计过于保守，限制了 DNN 的表达能力并降低给定鲁棒性水平下的经验性能。尤其对于具备长期依赖建模能力的 SSM，如何在不牺牲表达力的前提下获得紧致且可认证的 Lipschitz 界仍是开放问题。
AI.method: 将 LipKernel 的"层间度量传递"思想推广到一般（非有限时间）级联 SSM 中。借助增量耗散性理论，推导将线性矩阵不等式条件转化为谱范数约束 ‖M‖₂≤1 及 2V−Q⪰0 的等价条件，并使用广义 Cayley 变换（涉及反对称矩阵 K 与半正定矩阵 Y）以无约束参数化方式结构性保证这些条件成立，从而得到系统矩阵 A、B、C、D 的构造流程。
AI.result: 在 100 次随机初始化实验中，不同网络深度 L∈{1,2,4,8} 与状态维度 n∈{4,8,16,32} 配置下，LipSSM 的最大雅可比谱范数始终低于 1（接近 1），验证了理论 Lipschitz 上界。在非线性 IIR 系统辨识任务中，LipSSM（2 层、状态维度 2）在三种记忆参数 α∈{0.1,0.5,0.9} 下均大幅优于 LipKernel（NMSE 最低至 0.0005 vs. 0.13+），且实际 Lipschitz 常数随 α 增大而增大（最高约 6.0），反映其利用递归动力学的优势。代价是训练时间约为 LipKernel 的 10 倍。
AI.conclusion: LipSSM 通过结构性参数化在构造层面保证 Lipschitz 连续性，既避免逐层约束的过度保守问题，又能建模长时依赖，为认证鲁棒的深度学习在序列建模中的实用化提供了可行路径。未来工作将扩展到更大规模序列建模任务以及更具表达力的 SSM 变体。

title: Learning Hierarchical Causal Representations of the Effects of Forcings on Temperature in Climate Models
summary: Machine learning (ML) emulators provide a fast and cost-effective method to simulate climate change scenarios after being trained on Earth System Models projections. However, the black-box nature of those data-driven approaches limit the usability and trustworthiness of their outputs and in particular their use as causal attribution tools. Here, we develop a hierarchical causal representation learning framework applied to sea surface temperature fields from a state-of-the-art global climate model. As a key advance over previous work, our framework explicitly models both atmospheric dynamical interactions arising from internal climate variability and forced responses due to changes in atmospheric greenhouse gas and aerosol concentrations. When trained on future climate change scenarios, our method accurately predicts the long-term global mean and regional temperature evolution and shows physically realistic responses to perturbations in greenhouse gas and aerosol concentrations when evaluated on unseen scenarios. Our results underline the potential of causal representation learning frameworks for advancing climate model emulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种层次化因果表示学习框架，用于建模气候系统中外部强迫（如温室气体和气溶胶）对海表温度的影响，同时显式分离内部气候变率与外强迫响应。
AI.motivation: 传统的机器学习气候模拟器虽然推理速度快，但其黑盒特性限制了输出的可解释性和因果归因能力；而现有的因果表示学习方法（如PICABU）仅在无外强迫的工业化前控制场景下建模内部变率，无法处理气候预测中由温室气体和气溶胶引起的强迫响应，因此需要一种能够同时建模内部动力学和外部强迫效应的可解释框架。
AI.method: 在PICABU的基础上引入层次化潜变量结构：全局潜变量 z_g 捕捉全球温度对CO₂和CH₄等温室气体的响应，K=48个局部潜变量 z 捕捉区域动力学并受黑碳(BC)和SO₂等空间局域化气溶胶强迫影响；通过单父映射保持可识别性，训练目标结合层次化ELBO、稀疏因果图约束和全球平均地表温度(GMST)对齐损失；采用贝叶斯粒子滤波的自回归滚动进行长期气候预测。
AI.result: 在NorESM2-LM气候模型数据上训练（使用历史时期、SSP1-2.6和SSP2-4.5场景），在未见过的SSP3-7.0 OOD场景上，模型准确预测了85年的GMST和Niño3.4演化（GMST均值1.41 vs 真值1.24），并重现了2.5–5年的ENSO周期特征；反事实实验表明固定CO₂和CH₄可抑制长期增温，增加东亚BC引起局部增温、增加SO₂引起局部降温，符合物理预期。
AI.conclusion: 该框架首次将因果表示学习扩展到包含外部强迫的气候建模，能够区分全球和区域强迫的不同因果路径，为气候模拟中的统计归因研究迈出了第一步；但仍存在同一层次内强迫（如CO₂与CH₄）难以分离等局限，未来工作将引入因果模块并扩展到更多气候变量和模型。

title: Robust Successor Features
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, to be published in EWRL 2026
summary: Generalization in Reinforcement Learning (RL) refers to the ability to execute close-to-optimal policies in unseen tasks after the agent has been trained on a different set of tasks. Building on the seminal work of the successor representation and further adaptations with function approximation, Transfer in RL has traditionally focused on generalizing to tasks that only differ in the reward function. A decade after the introduction of the successor representation, Robust RL emerged simultaneously from several articles in the field of operations research. In Robust RL, the transition kernel is unknown, and the goal is to maximize the expected reward under this uncertainty. Our work unifies these two paradigms through robust successor features, which generalize across both the reward function and the transition kernel, under the assumption that tasks are linear Markov Decision Processes. We derive a bound on Generalized Policy Improvement (GPI) that explicitly quantifies how performance degrades with the mismatch between transition kernels, recovering existing successor-feature guarantees when dynamics are shared. Finally, the generalization capabilities of robust successor features are validated on several grid-based benchmarks and compared to previous alternatives that focus solely on either the reward or the transition kernel.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"鲁棒后继特征"（Robust Successor Features, RSF），统一了迁移强化学习（跨奖励函数泛化）和鲁棒强化学习（跨转移核泛化）两个范式，在线性MDP假设下实现对奖励函数和转移核的同时零样本泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有的后继特征方法仅假设任务共享相同的转移核，因此只能泛化到奖励函数变化的场景；而鲁棒强化学习方法则专注于转移核变化但奖励固定。两种方法长期处于割裂状态，缺乏一个能够同时处理奖励和动力学变化的统一框架，且在SF&GPI框架下没有相关的次优性保证。
AI.method: 提出鲁棒后继特征（RSF），在线性MDP假设下使用独立的特征空间分别表示奖励函数（φ, w）和转移核（φ, p）。将Q值分解为 Q = p^T τ(s,a,z,q) w，其中 τ 是鲁棒后继特征，z 和 q 分别编码策略和参考动力学。推导出广义策略改进（GPI）的理论下界，引入动态失配项 κ_pq = min(2, L_φ‖p-q‖)，当 q→p 时该项趋于零，退化为仅奖励泛化的情形。算法上提出基于DDQN的ϵ-贪心Q学习方法（Algorithm 1）。
AI.result: 在3×4随机Gridworld环境中（包含不同的转移概率p和步奖励r），RSF在零样本策略准确率上达到93.6%，优于USFA基线（86.7%）、仅奖励泛化消融（86.8%）和仅动力学泛化消融（91.3%）。在Q值MAE指标上，RSF（0.063）同样优于其他对比方法。在少样本适应场景中，RSF能够通过少量交互快速估计新任务的w和p，优于USFA和鲁棒RL方法。
AI.conclusion: RSF成功地将迁移RL和鲁棒RL统一到一个框架中，在保持后继特征高效TD学习优势的同时，实现了对奖励函数和转移核的联合零样本泛化。理论保证扩展了Barreto等人(2017)的GPI界，明确量化了动力学失配对性能的影响。未来工作方向包括：联合学习特征映射φ和φ、集成隐藏参数MDP框架以处理连续状态/动作空间、以及采用熵正则化等方法改善探索。

title: Metacognitive Selective Ensemble for Mobile Systems
summary: Deep ensembles improve robustness in mobile sensing, but repeatedly executing many models over continuous sensor streams is costly. Selecting only a few members reduces this cost, yet adaptive selection often requires additional model execution to obtain reliable evidence about inactive candidates. We present MetaSE, an active ensemble framework that exploits short-term persistence in per-model reliability. MetaSE maintains a small active set across windows, uses post-execution evidence to reject unreliable members, and invokes lightweight routing only when replacement is needed. This stateful design accesses the diversity of a larger pool without repeated full-pool evaluation. Across four HAR datasets and four model architectures, MetaSE consistently improves over a fixed three-model ensemble and achieves accuracy comparable to substantially more expensive adaptive and full-ensemble inference. On a Raspberry Pi 4B, MetaSE is 2.7x faster and uses 69% less memory than full ten-model inference.

AI.tldr: MetaSE是一个面向移动感知系统的主动集成框架，通过维护小型活跃模型集并利用感知可靠性的短期持续性，在仅执行3个模型的情况下实现接近完整10模型集成的精度。
AI.motivation: 深度集成在移动传感中提高鲁棒性，但在连续传感器流上重复执行多个模型成本高昂。现有自适应选择方法需要额外执行候选模型来获取证据，进一步增加了开销。需要一种能在保持低推理成本的同时利用更大模型池多样性的方法。
AI.method: 1. 利用传感器流中短期可靠性持续性（连续窗口内模型可靠性局部相关）；2. 维护小型活跃集K=3跨越连续窗口，默认保留当前成员；3. 执行后拒绝机制：为每个模型配备轻量级rejecter，结合预测边际、马氏距离比、同伴一致性和短时flick信号；4. 前向免替换路由：使用预计算的类条件路由表τ_{k,c,j}=Pr(f_j(x)=y|f_k(x)=c)选择替换，无需执行候选模型；5. 拒绝-然后-路由策略：仅在需要替换时才触发路由计算。
AI.result: 在4个HAR数据集（HHAR、UCIHAR、WISDM、MOTIONSENSE）和4种模型架构（Transformer、CNN、GRU、MLP）上，MetaSE在14/16的配置中优于固定三模型集成，在11/16配置中优于完整10模型软投票；在Raspberry Pi 4B上比完整10模型推理快2.7倍，内存减少69%；在15/16配置中优于KNORA-U（同样3模型预算）；在所有4个数据集上优于Ens-CLRF和FilterAct。拒绝分析显示错过拒绝贡献了2.84百分点的误差，而错误拒绝仅0.10点。
AI.conclusion: MetaSE通过非对称地使用运行时信息（执行后证据用于活跃成员拒绝，预计算路由表用于替换选择），能够在仅执行K≪N个模型的情况下访问更大模型池的多样性，在嵌入式设备上同时实现高准确性和高效率，为连续移动感知中的自适应集成提供了实用解决方案。

title: Robust Graph Clustering Network for Multiple Missing Data
summary: Clustering on graphs where both node attributes and structural links are partially missing remains a challenging task. Existing methods typically rely on imputation-then-clustering on single-view missingness incomplete graphs, which are vulnerable to cross-view error propagation and cluster-boundary blurring under simultaneous attribute and structure missingness. To address these limitations, we propose a Robust Graph Clustering Network for Multiple Missing Data (RGCN), which is designed to handle simultaneous node attribute and graph structure incompleteness. RGCN introduces three key innovations: First, we design a view-decoupled dual-branch imputation to mitigate interference and enable mutual enhancement in recovering missing data. Second, we employ a multi-hyperspherical mixture prior to enhance intra-cluster compactness and inter-cluster separability on a directional latent manifold. Third, a boundary-aware contrastive enhancement objective mitigates the blurring of clusters caused by imputation bias. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that RGCN consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines under various missing patterns.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于多视图缺失数据的鲁棒图聚类网络(RGCN)，首次同时处理节点属性和图结构的同时缺失，通过解耦双分支填充、多超球面混合先验和边界感知对比增强三个核心创新，在多个基准数据集上优于现有最优方法。
AI.motivation: 现有图聚类方法通常先填充再聚类，在单一视图缺失场景下有效，但当节点属性和图结构同时缺失时面临跨视图错误传播和聚类边界模糊的挑战，难以同时处理双重缺失。
AI.method: RGCN框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 视图解耦的双分支填充——通过动态特征亲和空间下的扩散填充节点属性，并通过属性无关的低秩结构重参数化恢复缺失链接；(2) 多超球面混合先验——将节点表示投影到单位超球面上，利用von Mises-Fisher分布驱动聚类分配，增强簇内紧凑性和簇间分离性；(3) 边界感知对比增强——基于后验熵识别边界模糊节点，扩宽其与竞争原型之间的角度边缘。通过交替优化避免不稳定的联合更新。
AI.result: 在ACM、REUT、HHAR、DBLP、Co.CS和Arxiv六个真实数据集上的实验表明，RGCN在50%属性和结构同时缺失率下，ACC、NMI、ARI和F1指标均优于11种现有最优基线方法；在50%-80%缺失率范围内保持稳定性能，消融实验验证了三个组件的必要性。
AI.conclusion: RGCN首次解决了图聚类中节点属性和图结构同时缺失的难题，解耦双分支填充有效减少了跨视图干扰，多超球面先验与边界增强协同保持了清晰的聚类结构；未来将扩展到动态图、异构图和联邦场景以提升可扩展性和适应性。

title: Aurora-X: Built for Extreme Time Series Forecasting
summary: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) enable cross-domain forecasting, but their development as general-purpose forecasters remains constrained by underexplored training potential and limited architectural versatility. To address these challenges, we introduce Aurora-X, a billion-scale TSFM with a progressive curriculum and a unified architecture. We first use channel-independent pretraining to learn temporal patterns, then introduce cross-variable dependencies, varied context and horizon lengths, and future covariates if available during midtraining. Variable-resolution post-training further enables an adjustable temporal span per token at inference. With fixed model weights, this supports longer histories under a fixed token budget or fewer tokens for the same history, enabling test-time scaling. With a versatile architecture, Aurora-X supports cross-variable modeling, covariate conditioning, and parallel decoding of future patches for probabilistic forecasting. These are supported by a novel pattern-guided mixture-of-experts that expands model capacity through sparse activation and uses shallow patch similarities to constrain deep-layer routing, guiding expert specialization across heterogeneous time series. Furthermore, we propose an implicit quantile network head that predicts arbitrary quantiles to characterize predictive distributions, enhancing probabilistic forecasting flexibility. Comprehensive experiments on GIFT-Eval, TIME, FEV-Bench, TFB, and DAG-Bench demonstrate state-of-the-art forecasting performance against pretrained TSFMs and task-specific supervised models.

AI.tldr: Aurora-X是一个十亿参数级的时间序列基础模型,通过渐进式课程训练(预训练→三阶段中训练→后训练)和统一架构,支持跨变量建模、协变量条件化、可变分辨率推理和任意分位数预测,在五个基准测试上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列基础模型面临两大挑战:(1)训练潜力未充分挖掘,特别是中训练和后训练阶段的能力扩展未被系统化;(2)架构多功能性受限,缺乏同时支持跨变量建模、协变量条件化、概率预测和测试时缩放的统一架构。
AI.method: 提出三阶段能力导向课程:(1)预训练使用通道独立策略学习时间模式;(2)中训练分三阶段(M1引入跨变量依赖,M2适应变化上下文/预测长度,M3引入未来协变量);(3)后训练通过多尺度重采样实现可变分辨率推理。架构包括:Time-Group MoE块(时间注意力+分组注意力+稀疏专家);模式引导的混合专家(基于浅层patch相似性约束深层路由的原型路由器);隐式分位数网络(IQN)头(基于余弦嵌入的连续分位数条件化,通过掩码分位数损失训练)。
AI.result: 在GIFT-Eval、TIME、FEV-Bench三个综合预测基准上,Aurora-X实现了最低的相对MASE:在GIFT-Eval上比Falcon-2.0降低1.1%,在TIME上比Toto-2.0(2.5B)降低0.3%,在FEV-Bench上比TimesFM-2.5和Chronos-2分别降低4.2%和4.4%。在TFB上MSE平均降低9.0%、MAE降低3.6%(相较DUET);在DAG-Bench上MSE降低11.5%、MAE降低7.7%(相较DAG)。概率预测在FEV-Bench上达到最佳相对SQL。在TFB的五个特性数据集上,不同专家显示出场景特定的路由偏好,而其他MoE变体在深层失去区分。课程分析显示从预训练到后训练相对MASE逐步降低13.1%-20.4%。推理效率方面,Aurora-X(48 token)在L=960、H=96设置下比Toto-2.0-1B节省76.5%的MACs,实现2.35倍加速。
AI.conclusion: Aurora-X通过模式引导MoE路由、隐式分位数头和能力导向课程的组合,作为一款开箱即用的决策智能工具,在五个预测基准测试中展现出强大的性能、有利的计算成本和推理延迟。其渐进式课程有效将基础时间序列建模发展为全面的预测能力,包括跨变量依赖、协变量条件化和可变分辨率推理。

title: SAGE: A sampling-aware global evaluation benchmark for species distribution modeling
comment: Under review. Project page: this https URL
summary: Knowing where species occur is fundamental for biodiversity research and conservation. Species distribution models (SDMs) link species observations to environmental conditions to estimate their spatial distribution. However, accuracy varies with the underlying data and models, making it essential to know for which species models can be trusted. Deep-learning-based SDMs ("DeepSDMs") now jointly model thousands of species, drawing on hundreds of millions of community-science records. At this scale, averaging performance hides substantial species-level variability, particularly for rare species, often of greatest conservation concern. Records are also strongly biased, making occurrence counts misleading. Accounting for these factors is essential for a reliable and informative evaluation of multi-species SDMs. Here, we introduce a Sampling-Aware Global Evaluation (SAGE) benchmark, combining GBIF records for training with sPlotOpen vegetation plots for presence-absence evaluation across 5771 plant species. We propose an evaluation framework that groups species based on two properties, sampling effort and relative prevalence, which describe how densely a species' range is sampled and how frequently the species is recorded. Evaluating single-species SDMs and multi-species DeepSDMs, we find that Random Forests and DeepSDMs perform best overall, but neither dominates: DeepSDMs outperform single-species SDMs for infrequently recorded species while offering no consistent advantage for well-sampled ones. Crucially, this advantage emerges only when established bias-correction practices, such as spatial thinning and reweighting, are carried over to the deep-learning setting. SAGE helps identify the species and data conditions for which a given approach is beneficial, thereby supporting the development of more transparent and ecologically credible SDMs. Data and code: this https URL

AI.tldr: SAGE是一个采样感知的大规模物种分布模型（SDM）评估基准，结合GBIF存在-only训练数据与sPlotOpen存在-缺失评估数据，涵盖5771个植物物种，并提出基于"采样努力"和"相对流行率"的物种分组评估框架，揭示不同模型在不同数据条件下的性能差异。
AI.motivation: 现有的SDM基准无法同时满足全球覆盖、大规模非匿名物种以及可靠的plot-based存在-缺失评估，且缺乏系统性地按数据偏差对物种进行分组评估的方法。社区科学数据存在严重的采样偏差，简单的平均性能指标掩盖了模型在数据匮乏物种上的真实表现。
AI.method: 构建SAGE基准数据集：GBIF的89,768,872条存在-only训练记录与sPlotOpen的53,336个专家策划的植被样方配对，覆盖5771个非匿名植物物种及52个环境预测变量。提出两个物种级属性——采样努力（SE）和相对流行率（RP）——将物种划分为四象限。评估GLM、GAM、MaxEnt、BRT、Random Forest等单物种SDM，以及通过四个设计选择（数据聚合、子采样、架构、损失函数）增量优化的多物种DeepSDM。
AI.result: Random Forest和优化的DeepSDM整体性能最佳且接近，但两者各有优势：DeepSDM在低相对流行率物种上表现更好，Random Forest在稀疏采样区域更强。DeepSDM的优势仅在采用空间稀疏化和重加权等偏差校正实践后才显现。损失函数和数据聚合是贡献最大的设计选择，模型架构影响最小。性能差异在地理上呈现明显梯度，主要由采样努力而非相对流行率驱动。
AI.conclusion: SAGE基准通过揭示平均性能指标掩盖的物种级性能差异，证明了不存在普遍优越的建模方法——模型选择应取决于物种的数据条件和保护优先级。研究强调了为多物种SDM量身定制数据准备和偏差校正策略的重要性，为开发更透明、更具生态可信度的物种分布模型奠定了基础。

title: Block Sparse Attention with Log-Linear Complexity
summary: Scaling language models to long contexts is limited by the quadratic cost of self-attention. Block sparse attention offers an efficient alternative, but selecting the retained blocks remains a bottleneck. Conventional block selection requires scoring all query-block pairs and therefore remains quadratic in sequence length. To address this issue, we propose PISA, a block-sparse attention mechanism that employs a pyramid Top-$K$ selection strategy. The main idea is to gradually narrow down the candidates across different levels, making it more efficient to find the most relevant keys. Specifically, we construct a coarse-to-fine hierarchy of keys and perform selection from the coarsest level. At each level, LogSumExp scoring is applied to a bounded candidate set to select candidates for the next finer level, continuing until the finest level is reached. Through pooling, we construct $O(\log N)$ levels of keys, yielding an overall complexity of $O(N\log N)$, where $N$ denotes the sequence length. We develop hardware-aware Triton kernels for both training and inference, fusing hierarchical routing and LogSumExp scoring without materializing the query-key score matrix. We further evaluate our method on language modeling tasks. Compared with the baseline, our method achieves comparable performance on benchmarks such as commonsense reasoning while delivering better results on retrieval tasks.

AI.tldr: PISA提出了一种基于金字塔式Top-K选择的块稀疏注意力机制，通过构建O(log N)层粗到细的key层级结构，将注意力计算复杂度从O(N²)降至O(N log N)，有效解决长上下文场景下块选择的效率瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 标准自注意力机制在长序列上具有二次方复杂度，成为大语言模型扩展上下文窗口的核心瓶颈。块稀疏注意力虽能提升效率，但传统的块选择仍需对所有query-block对进行打分，本质上仍是二次方复杂度，难以真正实现高效的长上下文建模。
AI.method: 1. **金字塔层级构建**：通过对key进行池化操作，构建O(log N)层由粗到细的key层级结构；2. **逐层Top-K选择**：在每层使用LogSumExp打分对候选集合进行筛选，将候选范围逐层缩小，直至最细粒度的key层；3. **硬件感知实现**：开发Triton内核，将层级路由与LogSumExp打分操作融合，无需显式构造query-key打分矩阵；4. **复杂度降低**：整体计算复杂度为O(N log N)，同时支持训练与推理。
AI.result: 在语言建模任务上的实验表明：1. 在常识推理等基准测试上，性能与基线方法相当；2. 在检索类任务上表现优于基线方法；3. 通过Triton内核优化实现了高效的训练和推理，验证了方法在长序列场景下的实用性与可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: PISA通过金字塔式Top-K选择策略，成功将块稀疏注意力的复杂度降至O(N log N)，在保持模型性能的同时显著提升了长上下文处理的效率。该方法为高效的长序列语言建模提供了一个实用且可落地的解决方案。

title: The Residual Stream's Effective Depth
comment: Accepted at the 17th Asian Conference on Machine Learning (ACML 2026)
summary: We introduce \emph{effective depth} ($\Deff$), a scalar diagnostic that treats the layer-wise residual stream of a transformer as a discrete-time process, measures how representation similarity decays with layer distance, and aggregates that profile into one number. Across sixteen decoder-only language models, $\Deff$ separates a structural consequence of residual accumulation from an empirical one: even maximally diverse orthogonal updates have the closed-form reference $F_L = 2L/(L+1)<2$, yet fifteen of sixteen default measurements lie below $F_L$ (Qwen3.5: 32--44\%, OLMo-2: 40--41\%, Pythia: 23--28\%). Matched references show that the gap is not caused by the persistent initial state or update-size imbalance, but is largely a calibrated signature of correlated residual updates rather than evidence that depth is unused. Symmetric position-0, token-normalisation, and top-PC controls show the regime is not reducible to BOS or top-PC artefacts: the lone above-reference default outlier joins the same regime, and all sixteen models are sub-reference after token-normalisation or top-1-PC removal. Intermediate checkpoints show that the regime is established early in OLMo-2 and stable through 5T tokens, while Pythia-1.4B follows a distinct decreasing trajectory. A controlled residual-carry intervention supports the mechanism, and $\Deff$ is best read as a \emph{global} accumulated-state diagnostic, not as a capability score or pruning method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"有效深度"（D_eff）这一标量诊断指标，将Transformer的逐层残差流视为离散时间过程，测量表征相似度随层距离的衰减并将其聚合成单一数值。通过在16个仅解码器语言模型上的实验，发现存在一个校准的低于参考值的运行域，该域主要由残差更新的相关性表征，而非简单的层深度未充分利用。
AI.motivation: Transformer名义深度L通常是研究者关心的架构参数，但大量研究表明大量层可以被剪枝而性能损失很小，这引发了一个核心问题：给定L层的Transformer，其残差流实际上穿越了多少个统计上可区分的状态？需要一个统一、架构无关的诊断指标来量化这一现象。
AI.method: 定义层相似度自相关函数ϱ̂(k)为不同层间CKA相似度的均值，然后采用Bartlett加权聚合得到D_eff = L / [1 + 2Σ(1-k/L)ϱ̂(k)]。在正交更新假设下，理论参考值F_L = 2L/(L+1)。在16个仅解码器LM（Pythia、OLMo-2、Qwen3.5、Llama-3.1、Mistral、Gemma-3）上提取10000条FineWeb-Edu样本的隐状态，计算D_eff及其与F_L的差距，并通过位置0控制、token归一化、top-PC投影控制进行鲁棒性检验，使用nanoGPT上的γ扫描进行因果干预实验。
AI.result: 16个模型中15个的默认测量值低于F_L参考值（Qwen3.5低32-44%，OLMo-2低40-41%，Pythia低23-28%）。匹配参考分析表明该差距不能由初始状态h_0或更新规模不平衡解释，而是与残差更新相关性相关。经token归一化或top-1-PC去除后全部16个模型均低于参考。OLMo-2的训练动态显示40-41%的差距在第一个检查点就已建立并稳定持续5T tokens。12层nanoGPT上的γ干预实验表明，适度减小残差载流不改变D_eff，而能显著提高D_eff的减幅会破坏优化。
AI.conclusion: D_eff应被理解为全局累积状态的诊断工具，而非能力评分或剪枝方法。残差累积本身就会产生低D_eff/L比值的结构性现象，实测差距反映的是相关更新的校准信号而非深度未利用的证据。该指标为比较不同模型族、检查点和架构变体提供了校准参考地图。

title: Frame the adversary: a structure-aware attack methodology
summary: Frequency-based adversarial attacks have recently grown popular by exploiting spectral sensitivities shared across neural architectures. Unlike spatial perturbations, frequency-based attacks expose deeper vulnerabilities, making them especially valuable for robust evaluation of safety-critical and security-sensitive applications. Yet, existing approaches are typically not derived as solutions to an optimization problem that explicitly captures transform-domain structure. In this paper, we propose a methodology for crafting principled frequency-based adversarial attacks, via a dedicated optimization framework. A cornerstone of our method hinges on the introduction of a perturbation constraint set, tied to highly structured non-orthogonal transforms, well-known for their flexible, non-predefined frequency handling. We prove that the attacks emerge as weighted $\ell_2$-projections onto this set, yielding a general and controlled attack generation mechanism. By this, we provide a clear geometric attack characterization, ensuring alignment between the optimization objective and the perturbation constraint. We assess our framework on standardized datasets, for pretrained and adversarially robust models. Results highlight that our attacks, being solutions to an optimization problem, over a structured perturbation set, are highly effective, even across different, unseen architectures. Our methodology could serve as a theoretical baseline for designing and analyzing transformed-based attacks, targeting fundamental model vulnerabilities, instead of mere architecture-specific artifacts typically studied in the robustness literature.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于离散Gabor框架（DGF）的原理性频域对抗攻击方法。通过引入与变换域几何结构对齐的扰动约束集，将攻击构建为加权ℓ₂投影问题，从而在保持视觉质量的同时显著提升跨模型迁移性。
AI.motivation: 现有频域对抗攻击（如基于Fourier、DCT或小波变换的PGD攻击）虽实证有效，但缺乏理论依据：它们并非作为显式优化问题的解而导出，且扰动约束集（标准ℓₚ球）与变换域结构不匹配，无法解释攻击成功与迁移性的内在机理。
AI.method: 核心方法包含三个组成部分：(1) 采用过完备（非正交）的离散Gabor框架作为分析算子Ψ，利用其空频局部化与方向选择性灵活捕获图像模式；(2) 构造新的扰动约束集𝒞_{M_D} = {δ : δᵀM_D δ ≤ ε²}，其中M_D = Ψ* DΨ由平均相干性加权的对角矩阵D生成，从而将攻击能量沿结构化空频方向分布；(3) 证明PGD在该集合上的投影具有闭式解Π_{𝒞_{M_D}}(δ) = (I + 2λℜ(M_D))⁻¹δ（Proposition 6），其中λ通过二分法确定，由此保证攻击是加权ℓ₂投影问题的严格解。
AI.result: 在ImageNet与CIFAR100上的实验表明：相比AutoAttack（空间域）与F-PGD（频域）基线，所提攻击在预训练模型与RobustBench鲁棒模型上均取得更高的攻击成功率（ASR）与跨模型迁移性，同时保持更优的SSIM视觉质量。例如在ImageNet跨模型平均ASR上预训练/RobustBench分别达74.5%/63.4%，显著优于F-PGD的32.8%/32.1%与AutoAttack的33.6%/30.9%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一个原理性框架来解释频域攻击的成功机制：扰动集的几何结构（而非单纯的高低频选择）是关键。Gabor框架的过完备性与空频局部化使其能捕捉跨架构共享的谱敏感性。该框架可作为基于变换域结构的鲁棒性评估与防御设计的理论基线，未来工作包括耦合对抗训练、扩展至其他结构化变换族（如可学习自适应变换）。

title: CRNDiff: Count-Native Diffusion Framework via Chemical Reaction Networks
comment: 28 pages, 9 figures, 10 tables. Under review as a conference paper at ICLR 2027
summary: Scientific measurements such as single-cell RNA (scRNA) sequencing often take the form of nonnegative integer counts, whereas continuous-state diffusion models approximate this discrete structure using continuous coordinates. Building on stochastic chemical reaction networks (CRNs), a class of count-native Markov jump processes, we introduce CRNDiff, a structured framework that combines count-space diffusion with inference-time conditioning on rare subpopulations. An independent birth--death instantiation yields a closed-form transition kernel for forward noising. This kernel enables reverse sampling via forward-filtering backward-sampling (FFBS) and supports data-driven selection of the terminal noising time, eliminating the need for a validation sweep. This tractability also lets us introduce tilted Feynman--Kac (FK) steering, a method for sampling target subpopulations from a frozen generator without retraining. By tilting posterior marginals before FK particle correction, steering mitigates importance-weight concentration when the target population is rare. Using scRNA-seq data from the human heart cell atlas, we test the ability of CRNDiff to generate cell-type-specific distributions. Across the three evaluated target populations, CRNDiff achieves the highest conditional fidelity among the evaluated generative models, with larger mean purity margins for rarer target populations. Generated cells preserve marker-level differential-expression structure. Replacing real training cells for the target classes with generated cells yields downstream classification performance approaching that of the real-data reference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CRNDiff，一个基于化学反应网络（CRN）的计数原生扩散框架，用于在非负整数格上生成单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）计数数据。其核心贡献包括：(1) 采用独立生灭过程实例化扩散模型，获得闭式转移核；(2) 基于过度协方差衰减的数据驱动终端时间选择准则；(3) 提出"倾斜Feynman-Kac引导"（tilted FK steering）方法，通过边际倾斜后再做FK粒子校正，缓解稀有目标亚群的重要性权重集中问题，无需重训生成器。
AI.motivation: 现有连续状态扩散模型将离散计数数据近似为连续坐标，破坏了非负整数格的自然结构。已有的计数原生扩散模型（Blackout Diffusion、CountsDiff、Count Bridges、Count-FM）各自基于特定转换机制，缺乏统一的结构化框架来参数化各种可容许的状态转换及其状态依赖速率。此外，针对稀有细胞亚群的推理时条件生成存在重要性权重集中和谱系退化问题。需要一个既能保持计数空间结构，又能有效处理稀有目标条件生成的统一框架。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) **CRN扩散框架**：以独立生灭反应网络作为前向加噪过程，利用概率生成函数（PGF）求解得到Binomial*Pois-sson闭式转移核，平稳分布为乘积泊松分布；(2) **终端时间选择准则**：通过过度协方差矩阵的广义特征值分解，当最强正二阶信号衰减至有限样本泊松噪声底线（Marchenko-Pastur边缘）时确定T_O；(3) **倾斜FK引导**：先用边缘密度比对后验做边缘倾斜（因子τ控制强度），再用基于判别器的FK粒子权重和重采样修正剩余联合失配。两个阶段均不改变生成器参数。
AI.result: 在二维合成计数混合实验中，倾斜FK引导将FK引导的能量距离从0.255降至0.036，谱系多样性从0.116提升至0.875。在人类心脏scRNA-seq数据上，对内皮（80,463细胞，丰富）、髓系（18,422）和神经元（3,168，稀有）三个目标群体，CRNDiff在纯度、W₁、MMD²、PCC四个条件保真度指标上均优于scVI、scANVI、CFGen和MDLM；纯度优势随训练丰度降低而扩大（神经元纯度0.971 vs MDLM 0.784）。生成的细胞保留了标记基因差异表达结构，在替换真实训练细胞后下游11类分类器的macro F₁达0.915（真实参考0.960）。在稀有神经元目标上，倾斜FK引导以更高纯度和更低W₁优于所有测试的best-of-N和value-guided方法，且无需重训。
AI.conclusion: CRNDiff通过CRN将计数空间扩散参数化：生灭实例提供了闭式核、马尔可夫桥和阶乘累积量动力学，支持精确反向采样、终端时间选择和推理时条件生成。心脏图谱结果表明，将生成器学习与采样器级条件分离对稀有目标群体具有重要价值。边界条件：终端加噪仅使用二阶过度协方差（高阶依赖可能需要额外诊断），有限粒子数、密度比或判别器误差会影响稀有目标的纯度-保真度权衡。未来工作应测试耦合反应和结构化状态扩展，同时保持核、桥和采样器的可处理性。

title: Bayesian Tensor Autoencoder with Physics-informed Predictive Prior for Multi-dimensional Time Series Anomaly Detection
summary: Multi-dimensional time series, inherently tensorial, are common in practice. Despite great progress in time series anomaly detection, most existing methods are confined to uni-/multi-variate time series. When handling multi-dimensional time series using these methods, reshaping operations are required, which inevitably break the intrinsic correlations and thus lead to performance degradation. In uni-/multi-variate time series anomaly detection, AutoEncoders (AEs) are widely adopted and generally categorized into reconstruction-based and prediction-based AEs. The reconstruction-based AE utilizes the current observation for reconstruction, while the prediction-based AE utilizes the historical information to predict the current observation. Thus, the two AEs utilize different information. To bridge the gap between reconstruction-based and prediction-based AEs, so as to fully leverage the available information and thus further enhance performance, we propose a predictive prior and incorporate it into the reconstruction-based AE. It may not be very difficult to conceive this idea, but designing the predictive prior so that it can work for tensor anomaly detection is non-trivial. Specifically, to avoid breaking the intrinsic correlations within the multi-dimensional time series, we use the tensor AE as the backbone. To incorporate the predictive prior into the reconstruction-based AE, we propose a Bayesian fusion approach and our analysis reveals that this approach can enhance the modeling capability of the model for normal data. To mitigate the over-generalization problem of AE, we incorporate physical laws, i.e. tensor low-rank decomposition rules, into the neural networks in the predictive prior, leading to the Physics-informed Predictive Prior Tensor AE (PPPTAE) framework. Experimental results on real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PPPTAE（Physics-informed Predictive Prior Tensor AutoEncoder），一种用于多维时间序列异常检测的贝叶斯张量自编码器框架，通过将预测先验以贝叶斯融合方式融入重构型张量自编码器，并结合物理启发的张量低秩分解约束，有效缓解自编码器的过度泛化问题。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列异常检测方法主要针对单变量/多变量时间序列，在处理多维时间序列时需要进行reshape操作，会破坏数据内在相关性导致性能下降；同时，重构型自编码器与预测型自编码器利用的信息不同（前者用当前观测，后者用历史信息），现有方法未能有效融合二者。此外，自编码器存在过度泛化问题，即异常样本也可能被很好重构。
AI.method: 方法包含三大核心模块：(1) 预测先验：基于历史M个时间步的特征预测当前特征的高斯分布均值与方差；(2) 贝叶斯融合：通过贝叶斯定理将重构分布p(F_t|X_t)与预测先验分布p(F_t|F_{t-M:t-1})融合，得到p(F_t|X_t, F_{t-M:t-1})，其中分母p(F_t)起到重加权作用，使特征均匀分布；(3) 物理启发的贝叶斯张量分解模块：将特征分解为低秩张量轮(TW)分量、稀疏分量与噪声分量，并采用变分推断进行近似后验估计，对正常特征施加低秩约束以缓解过度泛化问题。训练采用窗口随机采样策略，测试采用时延模块避免冷启动。
AI.result: 在三个真实多维时间序列数据集（Freeway、HR-Extreme、Milan）上，PPPTAE的AUC指标全面优于15种SOTA方法：在Freeway上达到95.39%，在HR-Extreme四个子集上分别为98.82%、92.21%、95.28%、94.65%，在Milan上达到98.90%，均显著超越TimesNet、PatchTST、Crossformer等最优基线。消融实验验证了贝叶斯低秩模块与预测先验的各自贡献。
AI.conclusion: PPPTAE通过贝叶斯融合有效桥接了重构型与预测型自编码器，物理启发的张量低秩约束有效缓解了过度泛化问题，在多维时间序列异常检测中取得了显著性能提升，验证了张量结构保持、预测-重构融合以及物理信息正则化的重要性。

title: I Act Therefore I Am: When Is JEPA's Action-Conditioning Enough to Learn Causal Mechanisms?
summary: Recent empirical and theoretical advances suggest that joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) may learn meaningful representations for action-conditioned prediction of future outcomes, thus becoming one of the foundational structures for world models. However, accurate prediction does not, in general, necessarily imply recovery of underlying causal states that give rise to the observed dynamics. This work investigates when and how JEPAs can recover the underlying causal states from observations. We first introduce a latent variable model, in which high-dimensional observations are generated from latent causal states whose dynamics are governed by action-conditioned transition mechanisms. Based on this formulation, we develop a general information-theoretic objective that combines conditional likelihood maximization for learning transition dynamics with entropy maximization for preserving latent state information. We then establish identifiability conditions under which representations learned by this general objective recover the underlying latent causal states up to component-wise invertible transformations and permutation. One key condition for such identifiability is sufficient action-induced variation in the transition mechanisms. Guided by this finding, we instantiate the general objective with an action-modulated Gaussian additive-noise model, yielding action-modulated JEPA (A-JEPA). Experiments on synthetic environments verify the theoretical findings under the identifiability conditions and robustness to moderate violations, while visual benchmarks demonstrate improved state recovery and transfer to unseen transition mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文研究联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）在何种条件下能够从高维观测中恢复潜在的因果状态，而非仅实现准确的预测。作者提出了一个潜在变量模型和一种信息论目标函数，结合条件似然最大化与熵最大化，并建立了成分级可辨识性理论，得出关键条件是动作引起转移机制的充分变化。基于此提出了动作调制 JEPA（A-JEPA），通过合成与视觉实验验证了理论。
AI.motivation: 准确的未来预测并不必然意味着恢复生成观测的潜在因果状态；现有 JEPA 理论仅保证正交变换级别的可辨识性，无法区分个体因果变量。这限制了世界模型在分布外场景中的泛化与迁移能力。
AI.method: （1）构建一个潜在因果生成模型，其中高维观测由通过时序结构因果模型（SCM）演化的潜在因果状态生成；（2）提出通用信息论目标函数 ℒ_λ = −E[log p_φ(z_t|z_{t−1},a_{t−1})] − λH(z_t)，结合转移可预测性与信息保持；（3）在观测映射光滑可逆（假设3.1）与动作引起转移机制充分变化（假设3.2）下证明成分级可辨识性（定理3.3）；（4）通过动作调制高斯加性噪声模型实例化，提出 A-JEPA，用高斯 NLL 实现转移可预测性，用对比负样本项近似熵正则化。
AI.result: （1）理论证明：满足假设 3.1 和 3.2 时，学到的表示可恢复潜在因果状态（至逐分量可逆变换与置换）；（2）合成实验 MCC 峰值约 0.948（α≈0.51），动作设置从 5 增到 50 时 MCC 由 0.857 提升至 0.959，维度从 d=5 扩展到 d=10 时 MCC 保持在 0.90–0.96；（3）四种视觉控制环境（TwoRoom、OGB、Reacher、PushT）上成分级 MCC 一致优于 LeWM/PLDM 基线；（4）RoboNet 跨机器人迁移中，A-JEPA 在未见过的 Franka 和 Sawyer 上 h=20 时 rollout R² 仍 >0.90，远优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 当动作引起潜在转移机制的充分变化时，JEPA 可实现潜在因果状态的成分级恢复，而非仅限于正交变换级别。A-JEPA 通过动作依赖的条件均值与方差同时调制实现这一可辨识性，并在视觉控制与跨机器人迁移中展示了更好的状态恢复与迁移能力。这区分了表示学习中的两类失败：信息丢失坍缩与信息保持的表示混合。

title: WorldTS: World Modeling for Multimodal Covariate-aware Time Series Forecasting
summary: Time series forecasting is typically framed as learning a direct mapping from historical to future observations in the observation space. However, sequences of observations generally provide only a partial view of the dynamics of the underlying system, with future observations being shaped by latent dynamics. Recent latent-space forecasting methods thus achieve improved performance by predicting future observations from latent-space representations of historical observations rather than directly forecasting future observations in the observation space. Next, while future observations are also shaped by external factors, how to incorporate external, often multimodal, information into forecasting, so that it can shape latent-state formation and evolution directly, remains underexplored. We propose WorldTS, a world-modeling based forecasting framework that integrates multimodal covariates directly into the forecasting to further improve forecasting performance. Specifically, WorldTS employs a two-stage training strategy. First, it learns forecasting-relevant latent state dynamics conditioned on multimodal covariates, yielding encoded future states. Next, the learned state dynamics are frozen, and an observation decoder is trained to map the predicted future states back to future observations. Extensive experiments on 21 real-world datasets offer insight into WorldTS and its effectiveness.

AI.tldr: WorldTS提出了一种基于世界建模的多模态协变量感知时间序列预测框架，通过两阶段训练在潜空间中预测未来状态，并将多模态协变量（数值、文本、图像）整合到状态预测中。
AI.motivation: 现有协变量感知预测方法主要在观测空间利用外部信息，且观测仅是底层系统状态的外在表现，难以充分建模系统动态；如何将多模态协变量融入潜在状态演化以提升预测性能尚未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 两阶段框架。Stage 1：共享TS编码器将历史观测和真实未来观测映射到同一潜空间，多模态协变量通过专用编码器编码，预测器基于历史状态与协变量表示预测未来状态，并直接以编码后的真实未来状态进行监督（采用L1损失、余弦相似度损失和VICReg防坍缩正则化）。Stage 2：冻结编码器与预测器，仅训练解码器将预测的未来状态解码回观测空间。预测器包含协变量条件状态预测模块，通过CFA低秩瓶颈融合文本/图像协变量，未来协变量可用时进一步精炼预测状态。
AI.result: 在21个真实数据集（12个数值协变量、8个文本协变量Time-MMD、1个图像协变量MMSP）上的实验表明，WorldTS在三种设置下均优于现有基线：数值协变量设置在12个数据集上MSE/MAE均最低，文本协变量设置在14/16项对比中排名第一，图像协变量设置MSE和MAE均最佳。消融实验验证了三项损失互补、重叠因果补丁有效、潜空间监督优于单阶段观测空间训练以及协变量的贡献。
AI.conclusion: WorldTS是首个将多模态协变量融入未来状态预测的世界建模时间序列预测框架，通过潜空间直接监督与两阶段解耦训练，有效建模系统动态并整合异构外部信息，在多种协变量类型下均取得最优性能。未来可探索协变量条件预测状态学习的理论分析、时序结构定制化正则化、与预训练时间序列基础模型结合以及不规则采样场景。

title: Audio emotion recognition for atypical hearing
summary: My doctoral work aims to explore Audio Emotion Recognition (AER) in the context of atypical listening. This research focuses on auditory hypersensitivity in people with autism, a phenomenon that is often difficult to evaluate and unique to each individual. Our core idea is to leverage our understanding of affect from acoustic traits, relying on the possibility of generalizing affective responses from a small amount of annotated data. As a first step, we fine-tune a large foundation model, Contrastive Language-Audio Pretraining (CLAP) using low-rank adaptation (LoRA), trained on a valence and arousal dataset of neurotypical listeners.

AI.tldr: 本文为博士工作介绍，提出通过微调CLAP基础模型（使用LoRA）来识别音频情感，旨在将该方法应用于自闭症人群的听觉过敏评估，利用从少量标注数据中泛化情感反应的能力。
AI.motivation: 自闭症患者的听觉过敏现象难以评估且因人而异，需要一种能够从声学特征推断情感状态的方法，以辅助评估这些非典型听觉体验。
AI.method: 在neurotypical听者的valence和arousal数据集上，使用低秩适应（LoRA）技术对大规模音频-语言预训练基础模型CLAP进行微调。
AI.result: 该工作处于研究初期阶段，文中未报告具体实验结果。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种基于CLAP+LoRA的音频情感识别思路，计划将其进一步应用于自闭症患者的听觉过敏评估，探索从少量标注数据泛化情感反应的可行性。

title: ALF: An Active Learning Framework for Scientific Discovery
summary: Machine learning for scientific discovery is almost systematically data bound. Producing relevant high quality data, under budget constraints, is amongst the most promising ways to advance the field. Active learning (AL) offers promise wherever labelling requires expensive experiment, measurement, or simulation. Most existing tools cover only part of the data acquisition loop, and typically focus on either offline benchmarking or online deployment, but not both. We present ALF, a modular AL Framework that runs the full data acquisition loop via five modular components. One clear API for both settings: offline, against an existing dataset for controlled and reproducible experimentation; and online, against an oracle for acquiring new candidates in real-world deployments. ALF is open-source and available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: ALF是一个开源的、模块化的主动学习框架，通过统一的API同时支持离线基准测试和在线真实部署，覆盖蛋白质序列、小分子和材料等多种科学领域的数据采集全流程。
AI.motivation: 科学发现中数据获取成本高昂（湿实验、MD模拟等），且组合搜索空间巨大，现有AL工具往往仅覆盖数据采集循环的一部分，且离线与在线设置使用不兼容的工具，阻碍了方法从基准验证到实际部署的转化。
AI.method: 采用ask/tell框架，由五个可互换模块组成：数据集（Dataset）、代理模型（Surrogate）、搜索函数（Search Function）、采集函数（Acquisition Function）、Oracle。同一API支持离线（数据集查找）和在线（生成新候选+模型评分）模式；支持多种采集策略（Greedy、UCB、EI、Thompson Sampling、CoreSet等）；通过alf-core和alf-tools双包设计实现轻量级接口与具体实现的分离。
AI.result: 在蛋白质（HIS7_YEAST）、小分子（osimertinib_mpo）和材料（matbench_mp_e_form）三个模态上验证了框架能力，离线和在线实验均成功运行；AL目标下信息型策略表现接近，BO目标下效用型策略持续优于随机基线；已被用于MLIP主动学习（神经切线核信号优于基线）和蛋白质序列设计（排序损失优于MSE）等前沿研究。
AI.conclusion: ALF填补了科学发现中离线基准与在线部署之间的工具鸿沟，其模块化和数据模态无关的设计降低了工程门槛；局限性包括：实验为框架演示而非策略对比、Oracle为计算替代品而非真实实验、搜索受限于单步编辑；未来需支持更大规模GP推理、生成式搜索以及异步/含噪Oracle场景。

title: Self-Supervised Representation Learning: From Spectral Foundation Models to Auroral Emission Spectra
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027
summary: Auroral spectrographs such as the Auroral Spectrograph In Skibotn (ASIS) record hundreds of thousands of emission spectra, but only a few hundred can be labelled by an expert. To exploit the rest, we pretrain a 1D Vision Transformer with a masked autoencoder on 223,000 unlabelled spectra. Without labels, its representation recovers the emission-line intensity ratios that physicists use to diagnose the precipitating particles (R^2 0.91 vs. 0.77 for an untrained control) and, under one linear probe, classifies as well as 13 features designed by experts. Fine-tuned, the model outperforms the previous supervised auroral classifier on its own benchmark (macro-AP 88.5 vs. 77.8), reaches 0.870 mAP, and exceeds the same architecture trained from scratch by +0.159 with 10% of the labels; attribution shows that it uses both N2+ bands. Could an existing pretrained model replace it? Two astronomical spectral foundation models and a time-series model transfer according to their spectral window: SpectraFM, trained in the infrared, falls below the untrained control, whereas SpecFormer, trained in the optical, approaches in-domain pretraining without reaching it.

AI.tldr: 本文针对极光光谱标注稀缺问题，提出基于掩码自编码器的1D Vision Transformer自监督预训练方法，在23.3万条无标注极光光谱上预训练，所得表征在线性探测下即可恢复物理学家使用的发射线强度比（R²=0.91），并与13种专家手工特征分类性能相当；微调后在五类基准上达到macro-AP 88.5（超越此前监督模型77.8），在七类任务中以10%标签量获得+0.159的提升，并通过Integrated Gradients证明模型使用了完整的N₂⁺发射系统。
AI.motivation: 极光光谱仪（如ASIS）已记录数十万条发射光谱，但专家仅能标注数百条，监督学习方法受限于标注数据规模与细粒度分词导致的过拟合。需要探索自监督学习能否利用无标注语料，并判断现有天文/时序基础模型能否迁移到大气发射光谱这一全新领域。
AI.method: 1. 数据：329,704条ASIS光谱（405–687 nm，1024点），按观测夜划分，223,065条用于预训练，811条专家标注（7类多标签）。2. 输入双通道：发射线通道（去基线、asinh压缩）与连续谱通道（基线本身）。3. 1D ViT编码器：16点卷积分词→64个token（每token约4.4 nm）、8层Transformer、宽256、6.3 M参数。4. MAE预训练：35%随机掩码，轻解码器重建（150轮）。5. 评估协议：5×3分层多标签交叉验证，线性探测（每类一个logistic回归），与13个专家手工特征及未训练对照比较。6. 微调：类加权BCE + 高斯噪声 + AdamW（15或100轮）。7. 与SpectraFM、SpecFormer、Mantis等外部预训练模型同协议对比。
AI.result: 1. 冻结表征线性探测macro mAP=0.863（±0.013），与13个专家特征（0.861）持平（p=0.76），显著高于未训练对照0.816（p<0.001）。2. 微调后五类benchmark macro-AP=88.5，超越此前监督ViT-1D的77.8和MLP的81.1；最难molecular类从51.6提升至82.5。3. 七类任务中，预训练模型比同架构从零训练高+0.030（全部标签）至+0.159（10%标签）。4. 外部模型迁移取决于光谱窗口重叠：SpecFormer（360–980 nm，含本研究范围）mAP=0.844；Mantis（通用时序）0.824；SpectraFM（红外1515–1694 nm，无重叠）0.789，低于未训练对照。5. 掩码消融：均匀或知情掩码在0.35–0.75范围内性能差异≤0.008，但知情先验使训练时间减少23%。6. 物理可解释性：R²=0.91恢复五条发射线强度比；Integrated Gradients显示elow类56%归因于红氧双线，n2_471类同时使用427.8与470.9 nm两条N₂⁺第一负带。
AI.conclusion: 在极光光谱领域，自监督预训练的ViT-1D编码器所获表征可有效恢复物理诊断量，在少标签场景下增益最显著；微调后全面超越此前监督方法与同架构从零训练基线。现有天文/时序基础模型均无法替代领域内预训练，其迁移能力主要由预训练与目标的光谱窗口重叠程度决定，而非物理源类别相似性。模型已学会利用完整的N₂⁺发射系统而非人工检查的单条谱线，提示可发现专家未显式使用的物理特征。该结论关于"光谱窗口决定迁移性"为可检验预测，留待跨仪器研究验证。

title: Budgeted Quotient-Residual Guidance for Frozen Pocket-Conditioned Molecular Diffusion
comment: 21 pages, 5 figures. Includes theoretical proofs and supplementary experimental results
summary: Pocket-conditioned molecular diffusion updates ambient atom coordinates, but many lead-optimization objectives are expressed on quotient features such as distances, contacts, and anchored substructures. We introduce budgeted quotient-residual guidance (QRG), an inference-time correction that makes these quotient objectives active without retraining the molecular generator. QRG lifts quotient covectors to metric-horizontal ambient directions and delivers them through a trust budget set by the frozen sampler's own step norm: quotient geometry chooses the direction, while sampler motion bounds the scale. We derive the horizontal lift, closed-form sampler-budget update, KL/kinetic interpretation around a frozen reverse step, equivariance conditions, and a product-budget split for budget-capped section and residual controls. Controlled quotient tasks confirm that sampler-relative delivery activates signals that raw local quotient gradients leave dormant. On frozen TargetDiff backbones, official seed-0 CBGBench ligand-generation/editing sweeps show practical quality-runtime gains: Local-QRG improves validity from 0.815 to 0.864 on fragment growing, 0.664 to 0.707 on scaffold hopping, and 0.681 to 0.712 on linker design, while PredNext-QRG improves fragment/scaffold and remains near-neutral on linker. Novelty remains 1.000 and diversity is preserved in the matched multi-seed molecular slice, giving task-dependent improvements without sampler retraining or backbone modification. Overall, QRG provides a lightweight route to quotient-aware inference for frozen molecular samplers with explicit runtime accounting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为QRG（Budgeted Quotient-Residual Guidance）的推理时校正方法，用于冻结的口袋条件分子扩散模型。该方法通过将商空间（quotient space）中的目标（如距离、接触、固定子结构）提升为度量水平（metric-horizontal）的环境方向，并以冻结采样器自身的步长范数作为信任预算（trust budget），实现在不重新训练分子生成器的前提下激活商目标信号。核心思想是"商几何选择方向，采样器运动约束尺度"。
AI.motivation: 口袋条件分子扩散在环境原子坐标空间中演化，但许多先导优化目标（如片段几何、支架保留、连接子闭合、袋内接触）仅在商特征（距离、锚点、子结构特征）上有定义。直接使用不变能量的局部梯度往往方向正确但数值上处于"休眠"状态——其尺度由商特征映射决定，而非由采样器运动决定。现有的推理时引导方法或需要昂贵的多步前瞻（rollout），或未能有效激活这些休眠信号。本文旨在解决"如何在冻结采样器自身的步长尺度下传递商方向"这一核心问题。
AI.method: QRG的核心是商微分到度量水平环境方向的提升（horizontal lift）以及采样器相对信任域（trust-region）传递机制。具体而言：(1) 利用商映射的雅可比矩阵J和采样器度量M，将商余向量c提升为h = M⁻¹Jᵀc，该方向在度量上正交于核空间ker(J)；(2) 信任半径设为Bₜ = ρₜ‖vₜ‖_M，即冻结采样器自身步长范数的固定比例；(3) 求解min⟨cₜ, Jₜu⟩ s.t. ‖u‖_M ≤ Bₜ，得到闭环形式的活跃预算更新uₜ^quo = -Bₜhₜ/‖hₜ‖_M；(4) 证明对高斯反向核，该更新等价于KL预算约束下的最优解，对确定性采样器等价于动能信任域规则；(5) 提出产品预算分裂（section-residual product budget），分别对代表性保持方向和商残差方向进行独立预算封顶；(6) 给出等变性条件证明。部署的变体包括：PredNext-QRG（复用采样器的下一步预测，每两步施加一次修正）和Local-QRG（使用局部半径商代理而非全密度对项）。
AI.result: 在冻结的TargetDiff骨干网络和CBGBench风格的先导优化协议下进行评估。控制性商任务（2D高斯、轨道点匹配、玩具分子）验证了预算残差传递机制能够激活休眠的局部商梯度信号。主要分子生成结果（官方seed-0）：片段生长任务有效性从0.815提升至0.864（Local-QRG）；支架跳跃从0.664提升至0.707（Local-QRG）；连接子设计从0.681提升至0.712（Local-QRG）。PredNext-QRG在片段和支架任务上有提升，在连接子任务上接近中性。新颖性保持在1.000，多样性得以保留。控制/基础比率维持在0.19-0.27的预算区间内，运行时间开销适中（约为基础的1.1-1.2倍）。配对目标级分析揭示了目标异质性，bootstrap区间反映了不确定性。侧链装饰任务作为预算迁移压力测试，暴露了默认配体生成预算在该任务上的不匹配。滚动前瞻教师（Rollout-QRG Teacher）作为诊断上界点报告，但非部署方法。AutoDock Vina对接分数仅作为支持性诊断，呈现混合信号。
AI.conclusion: QRG为冻结分子扩散采样器提供了一种轻量级的商感知推理路径，具有明确的运行时核算。其核心贡献在于将商残差方向转化为以采样器尺度为界的推理时修正，而非训练时生成器或无界外部优化器。结论是任务依赖的质量-运行时权衡：片段生长和支架跳跃获得明确的有效性提升，连接子设计获得Local-QRG的适度提升，而侧链装饰揭示了预算迁移的失败模式。配对目标级统计揭示了异质性，对接诊断呈混合信号，说明该方法是有范围（scoped）的实用改进，而非普适单调提升规则。方法明确划定了能力边界：不替代训练时生成器、不重新训练骨干网络、不需要昂贵的多步前瞻，同时通过形式化理论（水平提升、KL/动能预算解释、等变性证明、产品预算分裂）支撑了实现选择。

title: Benchmarking Attention for Tabular Foundation Models
summary: Tabular in-context learners such as TabPFN, Mitra, or ConTextTab rely on alternating row and column attention over 2D sequences of latent embeddings. These attention patterns differ markedly from the one-dimensional case in language models: row attention involves longer sequences while column attention operates on much shorter ones, and the strided memory layout of tabular data makes producing contiguous tensors costly. Moreover, the hidden dimensions used in current models are small compared to recent language models. Yet efficient attention has been studied mostly for one-dimensional sequences, leaving the two-dimensional tabular setting unexplored. To this end, we create a reproducible benchmarking setup and study the unique characteristics of tabular attention across several backends -- Torch SDPA (efficient and cuDNN), FlashAttention-2/3/4, and the inference-only backends vLLM and SageAttention -- measuring forward and backward throughput across realistic tabular shapes on three GPU generations (A100, H100, B200). We find that the optimal backend choice differs between column and row attention and varies across hardware as well as model specifics: While the FlashAttention implementations tailored for each GPU generation perform overall best, they are at times outperformed by CuDNN in the case of column attention at longer sequences with cross-over points depending on the head dimension. Among inference-only backends, SageAttention performs well for row attention and large sequences beyond 16\,k rows. Our reproducible benchmark lays the foundation for future improvements to table-native attention. The self-contained benchmarking and evaluation code is openly available at: this https URL

AI.tldr: 该论文针对表格基础模型（如 TabPFN、Mitra、ConTextTab）所采用的二维交替行/列注意力机制，系统性地在 A100、H100、B200 三代 GPU 上对 7 种主流注意力后端（SDPA efficient/cuDNN、FlashAttention-2/3/4、vLLM、SageAttention）进行了吞吐量基准测试，揭示了行注意力与列注意力在不同硬件与模型配置下的最优后端选择差异，并通过 AI Agent 优化 FA4 内核验证了该基准的实用价值。
AI.motivation: 现有高效注意力实现（FlashAttention、SageAttention、vLLM 等）主要针对一维长序列语言模型设计，而表格基础模型中的二维交替行/列注意力具有序列长度不对称（列短行长）、隐藏维度小、内存布局非连续等特点，亟需专门的性能基准来指导后端选择。
AI.method: 构建可复现的注意力基准测试框架，在 batch=1 下对列注意力（固定 R=1024，扫描 C=16~2048）和行注意力（固定 C=64，扫描 R=32~131072）进行前向/反向吞吐量（TFLOPS）与峰值显存测量；测试后端涵盖 SDPA（efficient/cuDNN）、FA2/3/4、vLLM、SageAttention；硬件涵盖 A100、H100、B200；并通过 roofline 模型量化分析内存拷贝开销；附录 C 进一步使用 8 个 Claude Code Agent 在 B200 上自动优化 FA4 内核。
AI.result: 1) 列注意力（短序列，内存受限）：SDPA（efficient）在 C=16~64 范围内最快；cuDNN 在中等及更长序列下表现最佳，跨硬件均接近最优；FA4 在 B200 上 C≤256 时占优；2) 行注意力（长序列）：FA3（H100）和 FA4（B200）凭借支持跨步张量而避免 .contiguous() 拷贝，相对 cuDNN 获得最高 3.5× 加速，且优势随 head dimension 增大而扩大；3) 推理后端：SageAttention 在 H100 上行注意力 R>16k 时表现出色；4) 不同后端间吞吐量差距最高超过 3×；5) AI Agent 优化的 FA4 在 B200 列注意力 C>256 时取得 11~14% 提升，缩小了与 cuDNN 的差距。
AI.conclusion: 不存在适用于表格注意力的一刀切方案；对于 H100、H=12、D=64 配置，推荐列注意力使用 cuDNN、行注意力使用 FlashAttention-3 的混合策略；行注意力中 .contiguous() 拷贝开销是中等序列长度下的主要瓶颈，支持紧凑跨步的后端（FA3/FA4）具有结构性优势；不同 head 维度与 GPU 架构下最优选择显著不同；作者发布了完整的基准代码以推动表格原生注意力内核的进一步研究与发展。

title: LUCID: Learning Under Confounding for Inference and Discovery in Time Series
summary: Unobserved common causes are pervasive in real-world time series and can induce spurious associations that causal discovery methods mistake for direct edges. We propose LUCID (Learning Under Confounding for Inference and Discovery, a regime-adaptive deconfounding layer that first estimates the confounding regime from data using a Marčenko--Pastur spectral router, then applies a deconfounding strategy matched to that regime. When the spectrum indicates pervasive factor confounding, LUCID attenuates factor-dominated variation and recovers contemporaneous (lag-$0$) structure from the resulting innovations, with edge selection calibrated against a data-driven edge-free null. Rather than being tied to a particular discovery algorithm, it can wrap existing discovery engines; we demonstrate consistent improvements across three such methods. On a diverse synthetic out-of-distribution benchmark spanning changes in confounder strength and sparsity, loading density, lag structure, volatility dynamics, edge heterogeneity, persistence, intermittency, and tail behavior, LUCID achieves the best family-weighted directed, lag-resolved graph $F_1$ ($0.60$), improving over the strongest baseline by $0.19$ absolute ($\approx\!46\%$ relative). Its advantage widens relative to looser lag-collapsed scoring, and remains robust under intermittent and heavy-tailed confounding. Code reproducing the method, the benchmark generators, and every reported experiment is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出LUCID，一种面向时间序列因果发现的"去混杂中间层"。针对未观测共同原因（潜在混杂因子）会诱发虚假关联的核心难题，LUCID通过Marčenko-Pastur谱路由机制先判别数据属于"稀疏局部混杂"还是"普遍因子混杂"两种机制，再分别采用PDS边过滤或S-L（谱低秩加稀疏）即时恢复两种差异化校正策略。该方法可作为"包装层"嵌入CDNOTS、PCMCI+、NTS-NOTEARS等不同因果发现引擎，无需修改其内部搜索逻辑。在十类分布外合成基准（含CDS市场参数校准的实证衍生案例）上，LUCID族加权有向、延迟分辨图F1达0.60，较最强基线绝对提升0.19（约46%相对），在瞬态与重尾混杂下依然稳健。
AI.motivation: 时间序列因果发现普遍面临潜在混杂因子干扰，未观测共同原因（区域降雨、宏观冲击、共享环境等）会在观测变量间引发虚假关联，导致算法系统性过连因果图。潜在混杂并无统一统计特征——在普遍因子混杂下表现为协方差低秩成分与代数秩约束，但在稀疏局部混杂下这些信号可能很弱或缺失——单一校正策略难以兼顾两种机制，使现有方法在异质场景下性能严重退化。
AI.method:
1. Marčenko-Pastur谱路由机制：对VAR(1)残差相关矩阵取特征值，定义R=（λ1+λ2）/d，据此与基于(d, T)推导的MP阈值τ比较，自动判别稀疏或普遍混杂分支，无需数据集调参；
2. 稀疏分支：采用后双重选择（PDS）边过滤（Newey-West标准误 + 极保守α=10⁻¹⁰）对所有候选边（包括lag-0）；
3. 普遍分支：S-L（谱低秩加稀疏）即时恢复——将残差SVD的顶部k̂个奇异值封顶至σ_{k̂+1}（Trim变换），对去因子残差求偏相关，并加持久性门（Spearman边际相关性验证）抑制共父（collider）伪边；
4. 边阈值通过数据驱动的"无边零分布"（对剩余项各列独立循环移位并组合未变因子成分，B=200次抽取，取最大值(1-α)分位数）校准；
5. lag-0有向化采用领先-滞后不对称启发式；
6. 所有超参数固定，仅τ_g在评测套件外经验选择。
AI.result: 十族分布外合成基准（覆盖稀疏ER/无标度/小世界及普遍波动率/结构/GARCH/密集/混合延迟/异质/近单位根家族，50种子）族加权有向延迟分辨F1达0.601±0.025，最强基线（NTS-NOTEARS）为0.411，绝对+0.19（≈46%相对）；包装PCMCI+和NTS-NOTEARS同样有效（0.596、0.538），27/30引擎×家族组合下均提升；提升主要由精度驱动（0.491-0.614 vs 基线0.130-0.287，召回小幅下降）；CDS市场参数校准的半合成案例（T=1000，50种子）下，LUCID(CDNOTS)由0.080升至0.428（p=2×10⁻⁸），SHD由24.0降至4.4；瞬态（占空比低至0.05）和八种重尾/异方差噪声下均领先；额外计算开销中位数0.6-0.7秒，相对基线可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 潜在混杂并非具有单一统计形式，错误形式的校正与忽略混杂同样有害。LUCID以机制自适应的去混杂中间层解决了这一问题：将去混杂逻辑与因果搜索解耦，使同一中间层可适配不同发现引擎；在合成与市场校准基准上均大幅超越现有方法，并在瞬态与重尾混杂下保持稳健，表明自适应去混杂是因果发现的有用附加层而非替代方案。局限在于谱去混杂的固有边界：普遍因子方向与真实lag-0结构强重叠时（pervasive-dense困难）、非线性因子混合、弱因子无法形成可分谱峰、Student-t3重尾带来约0.05下降；评估仍限于合成或半合成场景，真实因果真值验证仍是未来工作。

title: More Sensors Only One Field: Rethinking Continual Spatio-Temporal Forecasting
summary: Continual spatio-temporal forecasting supports traffic management and environmental monitoring under evolving dynamics and expanding sensor networks. However, conventional graph-based continual learning methods tie forecasting representations to the current sensor layout, so sensor expansion can alter the representation of learned spatial relationships. Our key insight is that sensor expansion changes the evidence available about a process without necessarily changing the dynamics to be learned. We propose STFO (Spatio-Temporal Field Operator), which parameterizes forecasting knowledge as a shared field-evolution operator and handles changing sensor layouts through observation and query interfaces. Normalized coordinate-based aggregation lifts irregular sensor histories onto a fixed latent grid, enabling reuse of learned spatial maps across observation sets without sensor-specific parameters. To accommodate process drift, a spectral descriptor summarizes variation across spatial scales and conditions Fourier propagation and attention to adapt operator responses to the current spatial regime. Coordinate-based decoding queries the evolved field at sensor locations and combines spatial corrections with local-history predictions. Experiments on PEMS-Stream, CA-Stream, and AIR-Stream demonstrate state-of-the-art average forecasting performance. STFO-Large reduces average MAE over DOL by 8.4% on PEMS-Stream and 4.7% on CA-Stream. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出STFO（Spatio-Temporal Field Operator），一种基于神经算子视角的持续时空预测方法，通过坐标化聚合将不规则传感器观测映射到固定潜在网格，并以共享场演化算子实现跨传感器布局的知识复用，在PEMS-Stream、CA-Stream和AIR-Stream三个数据集上取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于图结构的持续时空预测方法将空间表示绑定于当前传感器布局，传感器扩张会改变已学习的空间依赖关系表征，导致知识迁移困难；论文通过实证发现传感器扩张仅改变观测采样密度而非底层空间依赖关系本身。
AI.method: STFO包含四个模块：坐标场编码器（CFE）通过归一化高斯核聚合将传感器历史映射到固定潜在网格；谱域编码器（SRE）基于离散傅里叶变换提取谱质心、谱斜率和频带能量比构成空间尺度描述符；双通路场算子（DFO）通过FiLM机制进行通道调制，结合有限模式傅里叶传播（全局空间结构）与归一化线性注意力（局部变化）演化场；坐标查询解码器（CQD）通过高斯核查询并结合局部历史跳跃连接输出预测。
AI.result: 在PEMS-Stream、CA-Stream和AIR-Stream三个持续时空预测基准上，STFO-Large相对最优基线DOL在PEMS-Stream上平均MAE降低8.4%，在CA-Stream上降低4.7%；Wilcoxon符号秩检验（Holm校正）显示对13个基线在三项指标上均具有统计显著性优势（p<0.0001）；同时在零样本和完全适应设置下均优于FNO和EVOLVE，且参数规模小、内存占用低。
AI.conclusion: 通过将传感器布局与底层空间动力学解耦，STFO实现了在固定参数形状下的知识复用和漂移自适应场演化，为传感器网络动态扩展场景下的持续时空预测提供了有效的函数空间表示框架。

title: Bridging Body and Brain: Gene-Driven Morphology--Control Co-Design
summary: Morphology--control co-design jointly optimizes an agent's body structure and control policy as an integrated embodied system. However, existing methods typically model morphology design and control with separate networks coupled only indirectly through a shared task objective, limiting explicit high-level coordination. Inspired by natural genes that coordinate biological development, we introduce \textbf{Morphogene}, a compact latent blueprint that bridges an agent's body and brain. Through AdaConcat, Morphogene jointly conditions morphology and control generation at the limb level, allowing its variations to induce coordinated changes in both components. Building on this representation, we propose \textbf{GeCode}, which formulates co-design as exploration in the compact Morphogene space. Each Morphogene anchors a local design region in which nearby body--brain designs are explored, while performance-guided updates move these anchors toward promising regions for more efficient exploration of the broader design space. This process combines local refinement with global exploration while preserving body--brain compatibility. Extensive experiments across diverse 2D and 3D co-design tasks demonstrate that GeCode consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods, achieving substantially faster convergence and higher final performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Morphogene（形态基因），一种紧凑的潜在蓝图，通过AdaConcat机制在肢体层面联合条件化形态设计与控制策略生成，实现智能体身体与大脑的显式协调。基于此构建了GeCode框架，将形态-控制协同设计重新定义为在紧凑Morphogene空间中的探索过程，以少量Morphogene作为可搜索的锚点，结合局部细化与全局探索，在12个2D/3D协同设计任务上以约2.5倍更快的收敛速度和69.48%的性能提升超越了现有最优方法。
AI.motivation: 现有形态-控制协同设计方法通常使用独立的形态生成网络和控制策略网络，仅通过共享任务目标进行间接耦合，缺乏表征层面的显式协调。这导致形态变化无法直接指导控制器适应，控制器更新也无法显式回馈形态设计，跨组件信用分配模糊，身体-大脑协调建模不足。
AI.method: 提出Morphogene作为受生物基因启发的紧凑潜在蓝图，通过正则化自编码器（RAE）在结构正则化（拓扑感知对比损失和树结构度量损失）下构建形态空间。设计AdaConcat机制将智能体级Morphogene自适应转换为肢体特定条件。GeCode框架维护少量Morphogene作为设计锚点，通过基于形态基因邻近度的奖励进行局部探索，通过性能引导的Morphogene更新（包括局部最优和全局最优的加权组合）实现全局探索，同时引入Morphogene淘汰和自适应采样策略优化探索效率。
AI.result: 在12个MuJoCo协同设计基准测试（Crawler、Stepper、Pusher、TerrainCrosser、Cheetah、Swimmer、Glider三档难度、Walker三档难度）上，GeCode在所有任务上均达到最优性能，平均最终回报比StackelbergPPO高69.48%，收敛速度快约2.5倍。在大型形态空间中（如Crawler、Glider-Hard、Walker-Hard）优势尤为显著。样本效率方面，达到基线阈值所需的环境交互数减少48.06%-57.69%。消融实验验证了AdaConcat（相比直接拼接性能提升显著）、Morphogene更新机制和结构约束的必要性。计算开销方面，离线RAE训练仅占总训练时间不到4%，推理时参数量约0.552M，每肢体FLOPs保持稳定（0.303-0.323M），推理成本随形态规模可预测地扩展。
AI.conclusion: GeCode通过Morphogene实现了身体与大脑在表征层面的显式协调，将协同设计转化为紧凑潜在空间中的高效探索。其局部-全局搜索策略在结构多样的形态空间中表现出色，在收敛速度、最终性能和计算效率上全面超越现有最优方法。未来工作方向包括：通过知识路由或模块化策略选择应对高度多样化形态的扩展性、跨任务共享Morphogene空间、以及将Morphogene驱动的协同设计从仿真推广到物理机器人。

title: Progressive Memory Transformer: Memory-Aware Attention for Time-Series
summary: Time-series carry structure simultaneously at multiple scales (fine-grained variation, mid-range motifs, and global properties) and downstream tasks operate at correspondingly different scales. Most existing self-supervised learning approaches supervise representations globally via instance-level contrastive losses and limited temporal neighborhood supervision, but do not explicitly exploit the structural hierarchy. We propose a learning framework that explicitly enforces a structural hierarchy across three scales independently: a local objective for token continuity, a mid-range objective for window-level motifs, and a global objective for sequence-level agreement. Realizing this framework requires the backbone to expose a representation at each scale; we introduce \textbf{Progressive Memory Transformer} (PMT), which augments a transformer with writable, window-aligned memory that exposes the mid-range scale alongside the token and sequence-level representations conventional transformers already provide. Across seven UCR/UEA/UCI classification benchmarks, a cue-retention probe, and forecasting benchmarks, PMT learns representations that probe well at the global, mid-range, and local scales---strong low-label classification (1--5\% labels), competitive forecasting performance across multiple horizons, and quantitative and qualitative evidence that memory states capture mid-range motifs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于时间序列的多尺度自监督学习框架，并为此设计了渐进记忆Transformer（PMT）架构。PMT通过引入样本特有、与窗口对齐的可写记忆，使中程（mid-range）尺度成为可被直接监督的一类表示，从而在局部（token）、中程（记忆）和全局（序列）三个尺度上分别施加对比学习目标（HGCL、PCL、ICL）。在七个UCR/UEA/UCI分类基准、线索保持探测和预测基准上验证了各尺度表示的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列自监督学习方法（如CPC、SimCLR、TS2Vec、TS-TCC、SoftCLT等）主要依赖全局实例级对比损失与有限的时邻监督，未能显式地利用信号的层次结构（中程motif往往被池化压缩或作为内部优化变量而丢弃）。因此作者希望显式地构建一个覆盖局部、中程、全局三尺度的表示学习框架，并解决中程表示缺乏可被学习信号直接寻址的接口这一核心空白。
AI.method: 1）多尺度对比框架：局部层级HGCL（分层高斯对比损失，在窗口内与跨窗口两个粒度进行软正例聚合，权重由窗口几何决定，无需数据空间距离）；中程层级PCL（InfoNCE，直接作用于最终PMA块的窗口对齐可写记忆槽，使每个槽成为可学习的motif检测器）；全局层级ICL（标准[CLS]实例级对比损失）。2）PMT架构：核心为渐进记忆注意力（PMA），每个窗口配备固定数量的可写记忆槽，沿水平（窗口间）与垂直（块间）两个轴传播上下文；采用非对称因果注意力掩码、自适应门控（混合当前与重置状态）、重叠窗口的注意力聚合器（attentive overlap aggregator），使每个PMA块保持恒定输入输出形状；后续编码器层使用邻域掩码注意力，并附加[CLS]进行全局聚合。3）两视图训练（弱视图保留形态，强视图加入时间/幅度扰动）。总损失为三尺度目标的加权和。
AI.result: 分类（七个UCR/UEA/UCI基准，1%和5%标签线性探测）：PMT在Top-1准确率上以84.4%平均领先所有对比方法（TS-TCC+SoftCLT为83.1%，TS2Vec+SoftCLT为82.5%），在14个准确率设置中11个取得最优；HAR上1%标签即超过先前方法5%标签水平。预测（ETTh1与Electricity，24–720步）：在四个（数据集×模式）平均中，PMT在三个上取得更低的MSE/MAE，且在长horizon（H≥168）优势最明显（与可写记忆支持跨窗口预测的机制相符）。线索保持（FordA上注入Hann突发）：PMT取得EOS AUC 0.994、Top-1 0.921、mF1 0.920，超过Transformer-XL（0.933/0.795/0.790）与xLSTM（0.956/0.820/0.817），并且PCL关闭时（λ_PCL=0）记忆接口本身已得0.983 AUC，PCL主要贡献于特征校准（Top-1与mF1大幅提升）。架构对比：在共享tokenizer/编码器/SSL协议下，PMT以84.4%平均Top-1超过Transformer-XL（82.1%）和xLSTM（80.8%）。损失消融显示三损失互补，λ=1的均匀权重在±2pp范围内接近调优配置。tokenization消融显示小步长（10%–25% patch长度）显著更优，长patch在平台期内稳健。
AI.conclusion: PMT通过将可写、窗口对齐、样本特有的记忆暴露为一类表示，并配以尺度匹配的对比目标（HGCL/PCL/ICL），首次实现了对时间序列token、中程、全局三层结构的协同优化。该方法在低标签分类、跨窗口预测与中程motif保持三类任务上均取得了竞争或领先性能，并经消融验证了可写记忆接口本身（而非仅池化或只读缓存）带来的独特增益。三目标均匀加权可作为稳定、免调参的部署默认。未来工作方向包括：将PMA扩展到原始（非patch化）输入、引入预测型预训练以弥补相位敏感任务（如FordA/B的5%标签场景）、以及用自适应tokenizer替代固定步长卷积以减少数据集级调参。

title: Brenier Meets Adversarial Training: Optimal Transport Geometry for Robust Learning
summary: Distributionally robust optimization (DRO) provides a principled framework for learning under distribution shift, but its practical use is hindered by the difficulty of evaluating worst-case risks for nonconvex loss functions. We study a penalized DRO formulation in which the adversary may choose any distribution but incurs a Wasserstein penalty for deviating from the empirical distribution. We show that the adversary's problem can be reformulated as an optimization problem over transport maps that push empirical samples to adversarial ones, and we prove that optimal maps are cyclically monotone. We also show that standard adversarial training---based on per-sample local optimization---violates cyclical monotonicity and wastes transport costs unless the adversary is severely restricted. We propose two remedies. First, we introduce multi-start particle ascent, which alternates parallel gradient ascent with reassignment to enforce cyclical monotonicity across samples. Second, we parameterize adversarial maps as gradients of input-convex neural networks, which guarantees cyclical monotonicity by construction. Experiments on robust regression, image classification, and robust control show that our methods consistently outperform standard adversarial training and state-of-the-art baselines, achieving improved robustness and better generalization under distribution shift.

AI.tldr: 本文研究惩罚型 Wasserstein DRO 框架下的对抗训练问题，指出标准逐样本粒子上升（PA）方法违反循环单调性（cyclical monotonicity）而浪费传输代价，提出了两种修复方法：多起点粒子上升（MPA，通过重分配隐式保证循环单调性）和 ICNN 参数化 Brenier 映射（ICNN-DRO，通过输入凸神经网络梯度构造保证循环单调性）。在鲁棒回归、CIFAR-10 图像分类和鲁棒控制任务上均优于标准对抗训练和现有最优基线。
AI.motivation: 标准 DRO 中最坏情形风险评估对非凸损失函数非常困难，导致实际中只能采用逐样本局部优化（PA）。但当 λ 较小时（强对抗情形），目标函数非凸，PA 违反最优传输映射的循环单调性结构，产生 Monge gap，造成对抗误差下界，从而削弱外层优化的有效性。需要从最优传输几何角度重建对抗映射的结构性约束。
AI.method: 将对抗者的问题等价改写为在传输映射空间上的优化问题（公式 (2)），并证明最优对抗映射 T* 必为循环单调的（Proposition 3.3），进而 ε(θ,T) ≥ λ·M(T)（Proposition 3.2）。提出两种方法：(1) MPA——交替执行并行粒子上升和重分配步骤，强制实现 assignment-stationarity 从而保证循环单调性；(2) ICNN-DRO——将对抗映射参数化为输入凸神经网络（ICNN）势函数的梯度 T_ω = ∇ψ_ω，由 Rockafellar 定理保证循环单调性。给出 MPA 的有限终止性（Theorem D.1）和全局最优性（Theorem D.2，含样本复杂度界）。
AI.result: 在三个任务上一致优于六种基线（ERM、RO、PA、NN-DRO、SDRO、WFR）：(1) 鲁棒逻辑回归：ICNN-DRO 在各扰动水平上稳健准确率最高；(2) CIFAR-10 鲁棒分类：ICNN-DRO 在 PGD 下达 58.11%、AutoAttack 下 57.71%，Monge gap 仅 1.01e-7（比第二好低约四个数量级），且训练速度优于所有 DRO 基线；(3) CartPole 鲁棒控制：ICNN-DRO 在所有变体上 episode 长度最长，外推场景优势显著。MPA 在所有任务中稳定排名第二。
AI.conclusion: 循环单调性是惩罚型 Wasserstein DRO 对抗映射中缺失的关键结构性先验。通过 MPA 的重分配机制和 ICNN 的凸势函数参数化两种方式，可显式或隐式地恢复该结构，提升对抗样本质量、外推泛化能力和训练效率。ICNN-DRO 凭借 Brenier 几何先验在多数指标上达到最优，且具有最强的循环单调性保证。论文方法可与现有正则化技术无缝结合。

title: Towards Understanding LLM-Based Log Anomaly Detection: An Empirical Study of Performance, Efficiency, and Robustness
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated promising performance in log anomaly detection, yet how their adaptation strategies, architectures, and deployment configurations affect detection effectiveness remains insufficiently understood. To investigate these factors, we conduct a systematic empirical analysis across three public log datasets, examining different adaptation strategies, model architectures, parameter scales, and quantization settings. Our results reveal substantial performance differences across adaptation strategies, while model scaling yields varying detection gains across datasets. We further observe that models with comparable detection accuracy can exhibit markedly different computational costs, and that low-bit quantization largely preserves detection performance in the evaluated configurations. Finally, we examine detection robustness under structural, semantic, and label noise at different perturbation levels. These findings provide empirical insights into the performance, efficiency, and robustness of LLM-based log anomaly detection, highlighting practical considerations beyond conventional accuracy-oriented evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对基于大语言模型(LLM)的日志异常检测,提出一个六维评估框架,在BGL、HDFS、Thunderbird三个公开日志数据集上,系统性地实证分析了适配策略、模型架构、参数规模和量化设置的影响,并考察了模型在结构、语义和标签噪声下的鲁棒性。
