Despite the urgency of reliable and transparent medical fact verification, most systems measure performance with aggregate metrics like F1, which obscure where and why failures occur. Existing RAG diagnostics require gold answers or annotated gold evidence, neither of which exists in this regime. We introduce two comprehensive taxonomies, grounded in a case study on the open-ended MedExpert dataset and 3 closed-ended datasets, decomposing failures into retrieval-stage errors along five quality dimensions, and verifier-reasoning errors into six consecutive steps. We adapt an automatic pattern induction pipeline using LLM-as-Judge to label evidence quality and classify verifier reasoning errors at scale, and then stress-test our findings across 4 retrieval methods and 6 frontier verifier models. Our analysis reveals that scaling model size, adding reasoning effort, expanding to authoritative web sources, and applying medical fine-tuning do not resolve these failure modes, demonstrating that they represent fundamental limitations of the retrieve-then-verify paradigm in open-ended medical settings rather than artifacts of outdated systems. We release our code and data at this https URL for the full reproducibility of our results.

AI.tldr: 本文针对检索增强式（retrieve-then-verify）医学事实性评估范式在开放式长答案场景中的失效问题，提出了一套无需金标准标注即可自动归纳的两阶段错误分类法（检索阶段5维、验证阶段6步），并通过6个验证器LLM × 4个检索器 × 3个语料库的大规模压力测试证明：扩大模型规模、增加推理算力、扩展至权威网络语料或进行医学微调均无法根除这些失效模式，表明这些是该范式在开放式医学场景中的结构性局限。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG式医学事实核查系统在开放式长答案场景下表现崩溃（MedExpert F1仅约0.06），但端到端F1等聚合指标掩盖了失败发生在何处及为何发生；且开放式场景缺乏金标准证据或金标准答案，使传统RAG诊断工具无法适用，亟需一种无需标注、可大规模扩展的错误根因分析方法。
AI.method: 1) 以MedExpert（540条临床医生标注的开放式QA）及3个改造的封闭型数据集为底座，构建MedExpert-gold高质量子集（由5位临床医生复核）。2) 采用"人机协同种子-饱和"LLM-as-Judge自动模式归纳流水线：先与临床医生交互生成种子码本，再迭代扩展直至饱和，最终归纳出检索端5维（实体匹配、范围、可信度、证据极性、分块）错误分类与验证端6步（证据选择、解读、推理、置信度校准、一致性、事实依附）行为分类。3) 跨4检索器（MedCPT/RRF-2/RRF-4/Qwen3-Embedding-8B）× 6验证LLM（GPT-5.4、MedGemma 27B、Gemma3 27B、Qwen3.6-27B、Mistral Small 3/4）× 3语料（MEDIC 30.3M、谷歌通用搜索、谷歌学术搜索）进行压力测试，并以Claude Opus 4.7作为法官对800个(claim, evidence)对和576条推理轨迹打标，人机一致性0.86/0.80。
AI.result: 1) 开放式任务F1仅0.06，封闭型高达0.7–0.8，差距根源在于证据库的"完备性"、"可识别性"与"证据-主张对齐性"三难。2) 即使用最强Qwen3检索器+GPT-5.4验证器，Recall仅25.6%，75%的临床医生发现错误被系统遗漏。3) 模型缩放（Mistral Small 4 119B 反不如 Small 3 24B）、推理算力增加（高/中/低三档recall几乎无差异，至多浪费token于过度犹豫）、语料扩展至谷歌权威网页、医学微调（MedGemma仅Recall翻倍但仍落后）均无法突破瓶颈。4) 5维证据中Qwen3高质量率14.5%（MedCPT仅2%），主导问题为临床范围错位与缺乏直接肯定/否定信号；6步推理中GPT-5.4步骤正确率最高（90%）但仍卡在推理过度延伸与过度自信，而Recall最高的Mistral Small 3推理正确率最低（66%），揭示Recall与推理正确性的脱钩。
AI.conclusion: 开放式医学事实核查的失败并非落后系统的产物，而是"先检索后验证"范式在面对证据分散、需跨段落链式推理与亚群体校准时的结构性局限。研究者应抛弃对聚合F1的盲目追逐，转向：(1)面向任务的多维证据评估（而非余弦相似度或RRF公式），(2)验证器中间步骤行为评估（而非只看最终标签），并构建具备临床领域知识与跨证据对齐推理能力的专门系统。

title: Feeding BabyLMs Macaroni: Code-Switching Curricula Cause Cross-Lingual Convergence
comment: 17 pages, 8 figures. Accepted to the BabyLM Workshop at EMNLP 2026
summary: Children in multilingual communities often code-switch, using multiple languages in a single utterance. Can we induce cross-lingual alignment in language models by training on code-switched text? We pretrain small decoder-only transformers on two 100M-word multilingual corpora: a base corpus formed by mixing the English, Dutch, and Chinese BabyBabelLM datasets, and a corpus generated from it by inserting word- and sentence-level code-switching using an LLM. We find that training on code-switched data aligns the representations of parallel text, particularly across different scripts, and that this alignment persists through training on monolingual documents. Under a learning curriculum that progresses from word-level code-switching, to sentence-level code-switching, to monolingual documents, models trained on code-switched data outperform baselines trained without it on the BabyLM evaluation suite. Our work characterizes code-switching curriculum learning as an effective data augmentation method for multilingual pretraining. We release our code, data, and models at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文研究了通过在多语言预训练中引入代码转换（code-switching, CS）课程学习，是否能在数据受限的小型Transformer语言模型中诱发跨语言表征对齐。研究使用英语、荷兰语和中文的BabyLM多语种语料，对比了词级/句级CS语料与单语语料在随机排序与三阶段课程排序下的表现。结果发现CS课程学习能提升BabyLM评估套件成绩，显著改善跨脚本语言对的表征对齐，且对齐效果在后续单语训练中得以保持。
AI.motivation: 受多语环境中儿童自然出现代码转换现象的启发，作者希望探索：在数据受限的多语言预训练中，是否可以通过有意训练代码转换文本来诱导语言模型对平行文本表征的对齐，从而提升多语言表征能力。现有代码转换课程学习（Yoo et al., 2025）主要针对微调阶段，本文将其适配到数据受限的预训练阶段。
AI.method: 1. 语料构建：基于BabyBabelLM（英语、荷兰语、中文）的单语语料，使用LLM（DeepSeek-V4-Flash）合成两种代码转换语料——词级CS（在矩阵语言中插入外语词汇）和句级CS（将文档中约一半句子整体翻译成嵌入式语言）。另设四个控制语料（仅词级CS、仅句级CS、word salad、文档翻译）。2. 模型训练：使用约98M参数的GPT-2架构解码器，16384词表BPE分词器，100M词预算，每个条件训练8个随机种子。3. 实验设置：主要对比四种（语料×排序）组合——CS/shuffled、CS/curriculum、non-CS/shuffled、non-CS/curriculum。课程排序为三阶段：词级CS→句级CS→单语文档，每阶段10个epoch。4. 评估：在BabyLM 2026多语言评估套件上测试；用FLORES+的997个平行句做跨语言对齐度量（CSLS bitext retrieval P@1）；用词级百分位排名度量词表征对齐。
AI.result: 1. 在BabyLM评估套件上，CS/curriculum模型平均得分最高（46.72），优于非CS课程模型（46.36）且差异统计显著（p=0.016）；shuffled排序下CS与非CS差异不显著。2. 跨语言表征对齐：CS模型在跨脚本语言对（En-Zh、Nl-Zh）上bitext retrieval P@1显著提升（61.4% vs 5.5%），且在课程排序下对齐效果在后续单语训练阶段中保持。3. 词级对齐：嵌入式词与其翻译的百分位排名比非嵌入式词提升更大，但未嵌入词的对齐也有改善。4. 控制实验：word salad控制未带来对齐提升，表明语法语义一致的代码转换至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 代码转换课程学习（从词级CS→句级CS→单语文档）是一种有效的多语言预训练数据增强方法。它不仅能在BabyLM评估套件上带来小幅但显著的性能提升，更关键的是能在跨脚本语言对中诱导并维持跨语言表征对齐。本工作为在固定数据预算下研究多语言数据组合和排序提供了新的方向，并开源了所有代码、数据和模型。

title: REALMS: An AI-Assistant Conversational System for Real-Time Exact Audience Sizing over High-Dimensional Nested Profiles
summary: Audience sizing is a critical component of digital marketing. It enables precise resource allocation, campaign planning, and performance optimization. Traditional approaches using skeleton audiences, sampling, or predictive modeling suffer from significant delays, estimation errors, and poor scalability over high-dimensional profile data. We present REALMS (Real-time Exact Audience sizing via LLM-based Multi-attribute Search), a conversational system for exact audience sizing deployed in production on an enterprise customer data platform. REALMS enables marketers to query massive profile stores with millions of profiles and thousands of attributes using natural language and receive precise counts in seconds. The system introduces three key components: (1) a categorical attribute retrieval mechanism using embedding-based vector search to dynamically identify relevant schema attributes without manual configuration; (2) an LLM-powered NL2SQL pipeline with template-based in-context learning for accurate query generation over complex nested schemas; and (3) schema standardization enabling industry-agnostic deployment across diverse enterprise environments. Evaluation on real enterprise data demonstrates strong recall for attribute retrieval, high SQL execution accuracy, and low latency, which enables real-time interactive audience insights where prior methods required hours.

AI.tldr: REALMS 是 Adobe 部署在企业客户数据平台上的对话式 AI 系统,通过结合 embedding 向量检索、LLM 驱动的 NL2SQL 生成和模式标准化,实现对数百万画像和数千属性的实时精确受众规模估算(替代传统的采样/预测近似方法)。
AI.motivation: 数字营销中,受众规模估算依赖骨架受众、采样或预测建模等近似方法,存在延迟大、估计误差高、对高维嵌套属性扩展性差的问题;现有 NL2SQL 基准假设中等规模规整模式,难以应对企业级异构、高维、深度嵌套的画像存储,且需要秒级交互响应。
AI.method: 系统分离线预处理与在线运行时两阶段。离线阶段将嵌套画像扁平化为列式存储,并为每个属性生成描述+句向量 embedding,按语义类别(人口、行为、事务等)分桶独立建索引,同时注入治理标签。在线运行时为五步管道:(1) 基于 embedding 的跨桶并行 ANN 检索(Schema-Aware Attribute Retrieval)以获得 top-k 候选属性;(2) 基于查询知识图谱的 RAG(KG-RAG),检索历史问句-SQL 样例;(3) 基于模板的 LLM In-Context NL2SQL 生成,组合模式上下文+样例+模板输出 SQL;(4) 治理与类型校验+自修正循环后,送入列式分析引擎执行;(5) 生成自然语言解释返回用户。
AI.result: 在 600 条企业级真实+合成查询上,k=5 时属性检索 Recall@5=94%、Exact-Match@5=93%;端到端执行匹配 90%、LLM-as-Judge 语义匹配 95%。消融实验显示去掉 KG-RAG 执行准确率降至 68%,去掉模式检索降至 57%,随机样例检索仅 72%。查询复杂度从 1 属性增至 3 属性,执行匹配由 100% 降至 88%;Count/Top-k/Percentage 三类意图执行匹配分别为 95%/88%/92%。负载测试:60 RPM、10 并发下中位延迟 10 秒、P95 14 秒,105 请求仅 2 次失败。
AI.conclusion: REALMS 通过统一模式感知检索、KG-RAG 增强的 LLM NL2SQL 生成以及模式标准化执行层,在异构高维嵌套企业画像数据上实现了秒级精确受众估算,验证了 LLM 作为语义查询规划器桥接信息检索与数据库执行的对话式分析范式,并已在企业对话 AI 助手中生产部署。

title: Recursive Self-Improvement via On-Policy Distillation for Reasoning
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student model by having it generate trajectories, then matching its next-token predictions with an external teacher's next-token predictions. This provides dense, token-level supervision to the student. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) eliminates the need for the external teacher. Specifically, a second frozen copy of the student model, now given the ground truth in its context, serves as the teacher. The student model only receives the problem and learns to mimic the privileged teacher model, while the teacher remains frozen throughout training. Previous work showed that freezing the teacher is useful for training stability, but we argue that this can prevent the teacher from incorporating the improvements learned by the student during training. Our primary contribution is to address this limitation with a recursive framework built around two complementary components. First, we let the privileged teacher co-evolve with the student so that revision learned in one round can guide the next, a process we refer to as Dynamic Co-Evolution (DCE). Second, because stronger revision can also make responses too verbose and self-critical, we additionally train on shorter, verified rewrites of the model's own on-policy responses. We call this complementary objective Self-Refined Concise Learning (SRCL). Overall, our comprehensive evaluations show that DCE+SRCL outperforms OPSD across multiple model scales and four competition-level mathematics benchmarks. Specifically, on Qwen3-8B, DCE+SRCL reaches 65.97% Average@12, outperforming OPSD by 35.62 percentage points while reducing mean output length by 7.80% relative to DCE alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出递归自改进框架，通过动态协同演化（Dynamic Co-Evolution, DCE）让特权教师与学生协同进化，并结合自精炼简洁学习（Self-Refined Concise Learning, SRCL）在保持推理能力的同时压缩输出长度，在多个竞赛级数学基准上显著优于冻结教师的自蒸馏基线。
AI.motivation: 现有在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）冻结特权教师以保证稳定，却阻碍了训练中学生获得的反思、修正能力反哺监督信号；此外，更强的反思能力常伴随输出过长的问题。需要一种让教师随学生共进化的递归机制，同时控制推理成本。
AI.method: 方法包含两个互补组件：(1) 动态协同演化（DCE）：每轮更新后，将当前 checkpoint 同时作为下一轮学生与冻结梯度的特权教师，使用前向 KL 在学生自生成轨迹的每个前缀上对齐特权教师分布，使反思能力可递归传递；(2) 自精炼简洁学习（SRCL）：让模型在无可信答案条件下改写自身响应的简洁版本，仅保留更短、自然终止、结构有效且答案正确的改写作为监督目标。两目标加权联合训练。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B/14B 与 Gemma-4-12B-IT 上，覆盖 AIME 2024–2026 与 HMMT 2025 四个竞赛数学基准，使用 12 次采样的 Average@12 评测。Qwen3-8B 上 DCE+SRCL 达到 65.97%，超过 OPSD 35.62 个百分点并比 DCE 单独缩短 7.80% 平均输出长度；Qwen3-4B 达到 61.88%；Gemma-4-12B-IT 达到 63.61%。消融实验表明教师共进化优于冻结、EMA 与周期刷新；前向 KL 优于反向 KL 与 JSD；助手侧答案前置优于用户侧放置；预算对照表明增益并非来自更长生成。
AI.conclusion: DCE 通过让特权教师随学生演化，把每轮学到的修正能力注入下一轮监督；SRCL 在不损害准确率的前提下抑制冗长反思。两者结合在多个模型规模与跨家族上带来稳定且高效（tokens-wise）的递归自改进，验证了教师共进化对特权自蒸馏的关键作用。

title: TRACE: Temporal Audit and Condition-aware Evaluation of Streaming Video Understanding
summary: Streaming video understanding requires models to interpret evidence as it arrives, yet current evaluations often report task scores without specifying when evidence becomes valid, how visual history is maintained, or how responses are triggered. As a result, similar scores may correspond to different workloads, failure modes, and operational behavior. We introduce TRACE (Temporal Audit and Condition-aware Evaluation), a condition-aware benchmark and evaluation framework that makes these factors explicit. TRACE combines temporally audited visual tasks with evidence timing and instruction-dependent trigger annotations, a unified causal Core--Adapter protocol that controls information availability while recording actual history processing and response events, and multidimensional reporting of answer quality, timeliness, response-selection behavior, workload, completion, and reliability. On 1,240 records from 517 videos, we evaluate eight publicly available models or systems in eight configurations. We find that nearly identical QA accuracy can mask substantial differences in completion, answer validity, and generation workload, while proactive performance separates into response quality, response delay, false alarms (responses emitted while no target window is currently valid and a later one remains), and missed target windows. These results show that streaming-video performance should be interpreted as execution-conditioned system behavior rather than a single score. Our benchmark and code can be accessed at \href{ this https URL }{ this https URL }.

AI.tldr: TRACE（Temporal Audit and Condition-aware Evaluation）是一个面向流式视频理解的条件感知评测基准与框架，强调流式视频模型的得分必须结合时间有效性、执行条件和运行行为三方面上下文来解读，而非仅看单一任务分数。
AI.motivation: 现有流式视频评测通常只报告任务分数，忽略了支撑证据何时有效、视觉历史如何维护、响应如何触发等关键条件，导致分数相近的模型在工作负载、失败模式和运行行为上可能差异巨大。论文主张流式视频性能应被解读为"执行条件化的系统行为"，而非单一标量。
AI.method: TRACE框架包含四个组件：(1) 时间审计的视觉任务集（含QA证据时间标注和指令相关的主动触发标注）；(2) 评测Core以1 FPS因果时间线分发帧和任务；(3) 模型特定Adapter，连接共享输入协议与异构模型，记录实际提交、重放、状态维护、输出与失败；(4) 任务特定评分层，输出答案质量、时效性、响应选择行为、工作负载、完成率和可靠性等多维指标。在1,240条记录（来自517个视频）上评估了8个公开模型/系统的8种配置。
AI.result: 主要发现：(1) 时间审计实质性改变了评测边界——328条记录被修改，52条被排除，其中325条涉及时间/触发字段修改；(2) 相近的任务分数掩盖了显著不同的系统行为，例如LiveCC与MOSS-Preview QA准确率几乎相同（65.19% vs 65.07%），但完成率、输出token量和无效输出率差异显著；主动响应中MOSS-VL与AURA窗口准确率相近（8.05% vs 7.92%）但误报率和响应延迟差异很大；(3) 执行条件决定了分数的含义——AURA在QA时重建因果前缀、在主动响应时维护持久状态；JoyAI在完整系统边界下评测；MiniCPM-O原生双工模式的文本输出93.52%无法解析为唯一选项。
AI.conclusion: TRACE将流式视频理解重新定义为条件感知的测量问题，而非单一分数任务。流式结果只有在时间有效性、执行条件和运行行为三者同时明确时才可解释。实验表明这些区分具有实质性影响：时间审计实质性修订了评测边界，相近任务分数可能伴随截然不同的完成率、答案有效性、工作负载、响应时序、误报和漏报，而历史组织方式或系统边界的差异会改变分数的真正含义。TRACE不替代任务准确率，而是通过使准确率背后的时间、运行和执行条件变得明确且可复现，提升了评测的可解释性。

title: SEA-CLIP-Tiny: Efficient Multilingual Text-Vision Embedding for Southeast Asian Languages
comment: Accepted to ACCV 2026. Model weights and datasets are available at this https URL and code for training, evaluation, and preprocessing at this https URL
summary: Multilingual text-vision embedding models are essential for cross-lingual image-text retrieval, but Southeast Asian languages remain poorly supported due to the region's linguistic diversity and limited data and computing resources. In this paper, we introduce SEA-CLIP-Tiny, a compact multilingual text-vision embedding model for Southeast Asia with fewer than 50M parameters. Our model adapts a CLIP-KD-style framework to Southeast Asian multilingual settings through regional data curation and multilingual teacher guidance. Experiments across seven Southeast Asian languages show that SEA-CLIP-Tiny achieves the strongest average retrieval performance among the evaluated student models, reaching 12.9%, 31.5%, and 42.2% at R@1, R@5, and R@10, respectively. Compared with MobileCLIP2, it improves average R@10 by 12.1 points while using 38.4% fewer parameters and lower measured CPU latency. These results highlight the importance of region-aware training for efficient multilingual text-vision models in Southeast Asia.

AI.tldr: SEA-CLIP-Tiny 是一个参数少于 50M 的紧凑型多语言文本-视觉嵌入模型，专门针对东南亚（SEA）七种语言（泰语、缅甸语、马来语、印尼语、爪哇语、巽他语、越南语）。通过将 CLIP-KD 知识蒸馏框架适配到东南亚多语言场景，结合区域数据筛选和多语言教师指导，在保持高效率的同时显著优于 MobileCLIP2 等紧凑基线。
AI.motivation: 东南亚地区语言文化多样性极高，但现有的多语言文本-视觉嵌入模型对该地区的支持不足，且大部分模型体积较大、计算资源需求高，难以在资源受限环境下部署。需要一个兼顾多语言覆盖和计算效率的紧凑模型。
AI.method: 基于 CLIP-KD 知识蒸馏框架，使用 MetaCLIP-2 作为冻结的多语言教师模型，学生模型采用 ViT-T/16 视觉编码器 + 12 层 Transformer 文本编码器。训练数据结合通用域（CC12M）和东南亚区域数据（CG Open-Ended、WIT-HF、BLOOM、SEA-Mammoth）。损失函数为多目标组合：标准 CLIP 对比损失 + MSE 蒸馏损失 + ICL（交互对比学习）+ CRD（对比关系蒸馏）。使用 AdamW 优化器，40 块 A100 GPU 训练 32 个 epoch。
AI.result: 在七种东南亚语言的平均检索性能上达到 R@1=12.9%、R@5=31.5%、R@10=42.2%，是评估中学生模型中最强的。相比 MobileCLIP2，R@10 平均提升 12.1 个百分点，参数减少 38.4%，CPU 延迟从 61.6ms 降至 24.1ms。在泰语、缅甸语、越南语上提升尤其显著。人类评估显示在泰语和爪哇语上更受母语者青睐。但 MobileCLIP2 在 CVQA 视觉问答上仍然更强（33.5% vs 28.2%）。
AI.conclusion: SEA-CLIP-Tiny 证明了区域感知训练对紧凑型多语言视觉-语言模型的重要性。通用域数据和东南亚区域数据具有互补性。但该模型与大型教师模型之间仍有性能差距，且学生分词器对缅甸语等非拉丁脚本的分词效率较低（截断率达 95.2%），这是当前模型的局限。区域感知训练是构建面向东南亚的高效多语言视觉-语言模型的关键。

title: Learning Natural Conversational Behavior in Tandem Speech-to-Speech Models with Randomized Guidance
comment: Submitted to ICASSP 2027. 5 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables
summary: Tandem speech-to-speech architectures couple a responsive speech frontend with an asynchronous text backend. In KAME, a large language model (LLM) serves as the backend, supplying candidate responses as guidance to the speech frontend while the user is still speaking. Ordinary conversation recordings capture the eventual response but not the guidance the backend would supply during the user's utterance. Generating the missing guidance with a simulator LLM adds substantial data-preparation overhead when training on real conversations. We propose randomized intermediate guidance, which derives guidance directly from the conversation corpus rather than simulating backend LLM behavior. During training, target responses provide informative guidance, while randomly sampled responses provide potentially irrelevant updates during the utterance. This combination aims to teach the frontend to use backend information selectively. On synthetic dialogues, KAME trained with this recipe achieves response quality comparable to that of the LLM-generated and similarity-based baselines. Training on 3.8k hours of real conversations improves smooth turn-taking and audio-judge naturalness over synthetic-data KAME while retaining a response-quality advantage over Moshi. These results show that randomized guidance offers a practical route to combining the response-quality benefits of tandem models with natural conversational behavior learned from real speech.

AI.tldr: 本文针对串联式语音到语音（S2S）模型KAME在真实对话数据上训练时的瓶颈——需要用模拟器大语言模型（LLM）逐条生成训练时的中间引导文本，提出了一种名为"随机中间引导"的方法，直接从语料库中以目标回复与随机抽取的回复文本混合作为引导流，省去逐条LLM模拟的开销。在合成对话上其响应质量与LLM生成和相似度检索基线相当；在3.8k小时真实对话上训练后，模型的轮换交接流畅度和音频自然度均优于合成数据训练的KAME，且保留了相对于Moshi的响应质量优势。
AI.motivation: 串联式S2S架构（如KAME）结合了全双工语音前端与异步文本后端LLM的优势，但训练时需要为每条对话样本由模拟器LLM生成逐步收敛至目标回复的中间引导流，这在真实大规模对话语料上构成严重的预处理瓶颈，限制了利用真实语音学习自然对话行为的能力。
AI.method: 提出"随机中间引导"（Randomized Intermediate Guidance）：在每个回复片段的引导流中，最后一个更新位使用真实目标回复文本y作为信息性引导，其余更新位从训练语料库（经去重、长度过滤、排除当前对话）中均匀无放回地随机采样其他回复文本作为可能无关的引导。其核心假设是：通过同时暴露信息性与潜在无关的引导，可训练前端模型有选择地利用有用后端信息。应用于真实对话时，先经VAD、说话人日志化、音频增强（DNSMOS P.835过滤）、faster-whisper large-v3-turbo转录与对齐等流程，构建单说话人片段配对构成训练样本。
AI.result: 合成对话实验（30题spoken MT-Bench子集）：Randomized得分6.09，与Similarity-based（6.14）相当，优于LLM-generated（5.54）和Target-only（5.12）。真实对话实验（3.8k小时，约合成语料的2.8倍）：KAME（real data）MT-Bench为5.04（vs.合成KAME 5.54、Moshi 1.96），流畅轮换交接成功率从40.62%提升至50.88%，音频法官自然度从4.05提升至4.79（接近Moshi的5.29），暂停处理与中断处理未显著改善。
AI.conclusion: 随机中间引导提供了一条实用的路径，将串联S2S模型的响应质量优势与真实语音中学到的自然对话行为相结合，无需逐条LLM模拟即可在真实大规模对话语料上有效训练KAME，并改善轮换流畅度与音频自然度。

title: Understanding the Role of Prompt Template in Knowledge Distillation for Safety Alignment
summary: Prior research has demonstrated that the choice of prompt template during Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) significantly impacts the robustness of safety alignment afterwards. However, the influence of template selection during Knowledge Distillation (KD) from teacher to student remains largely unexplored. Thus, we fill this gap by analyzing how different template configurations influence the pre-existing safety alignment of the student. We observe a significant degradation of safety alignment present in the aligned base instruct-tuned model. Specifically, we find that utilizing chat templates renders the model more compliant with harmful queries compared to a non-chat template. These findings are consistent across three models: LLaMA, Gemma and Qwen model families and are evaluated across multiple safety benchmarks. We further show that using a non-chat template during distillation better preserves the base student's internal representations, while chat template distillation induces a larger representational shift. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文研究了知识蒸馏(KD)中提示模板(prompt template)对大语言模型安全对齐(safety alignment)的影响。研究发现,在良性指令数据上进行KD会侵蚀已对齐学生模型的安全保护,而使用聊天模板(chat template)训练的学生模型比使用非聊天模板的模型更容易遵从有害查询。这一结论在LLaMA、Gemma和Qwen三大模型家族以及多个安全基准测试中均成立。机制分析表明,聊天模板KD会导致学生模型内部拒绝表征(refusal representation)发生更大偏移,降低其对有害与无害提示的区分能力。
AI.motivation: 先前研究表明监督微调(SFT)阶段的提示模板选择会显著影响后续安全对齐的鲁棒性,但知识蒸馏(KD)过程中模板选择对安全对齐的影响尚属空白。本文旨在填补这一研究空白,系统分析聊天模板与非聊天模板在KD阶段如何影响已对齐学生模型的安全行为保留。
AI.method: 方法:(1) 在databricks-dolly-15k良性指令数据集上,采用两种模板格式(聊天模板 vs 非聊天模板)对学生模型进行LoRA微调;(2) 使用平衡的KD损失函数 L = (1-α)L_CE + αL_KD (α=0.5),前向KL散度作为蒸馏目标;(3) 选取LLaMA-3.1-8B→3.2-3B、Gemma-2-9B→2B、Qwen2.5-7B→3B作为师生对;(4) 在AdvBench、JailbreakBench、HarmBench、SORRY-Bench四个安全基准上以ASR评估安全性;(5) 通过解耦师生模板、混合模板比例(0/0.5/0.8/1.0)、跨模板推理评估、token消融(BOS/EOT、role tags)以及拒绝方向(refusal direction)的余弦相似度与投影间隙进行机制分析。
AI.result: 关键结果:(1) KD在良性数据上确实会侵蚀安全对齐,三个模型家族ASR普遍上升;(2) 聊天模板KD导致ASR显著高于非聊天模板KD(如Gemma在SORRY-Bench上+35.32% vs +3.14%,LLaMA在HarmBench上+27.57% vs +17.63%);(3) 学生端模板而非教师端模板是安全退化的主要驱动因素,解耦师生模板后学生单独使用聊天模板即导致回归;(4) 机制层面,聊天模板KD使拒绝方向余弦相似度降至0.53-0.75,而非聊天模板KD保持0.97-0.99,投影间隙也大幅缩减;(5) 安全性对聊天模板暴露比例比效用更敏感,模板混合仅能缓解而非消除退化;(6) 跨模板推理与token消融证实退化并非推理模板造成的假象。存在安全-效用权衡:聊天模板KD带来更高效用但也伴随更大安全代价。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明在KD训练过程中,提示模板并非可忽略的实现细节,而是影响安全对齐保留的关键训练时因素。聊天模板会加速安全退化并导致内部拒绝表征的显著偏移,而非聊天模板则能更好地保留安全行为。实践建议是在KD训练时使用非聊天模板、推理时仍采用标准聊天接口(non-chat训练→chat推理),以在提升任务效用的同时更好维持安全对齐。这一研究揭示了在没有显式安全监督的情况下,如何通过模板选择这一简单干预来调节蒸馏过程中安全与效用的权衡,为未来开发安全保留型蒸馏方法提供了方向。

title: I-Parakeet: Integer-Only Conformer ASR on Mobile NPU
summary: In this paper, we propose I-Parakeet, an integer-only implementation of NVIDIA's Parakeet-CTC (0.6B parameters) that runs on a smartphone NPU without any floating-point operator or CPU fallback. Modern Conformer ASR models are hard to deploy on edge devices because of their size, and quantized models still fall back to floating point for numerically sensitive operations. This prevents them from fully exploiting integer accelerators such as mobile NPUs. To achieve this, our contributions are threefold. First, we derive an integer formulation of the relative-positional self-attention at the core of the Conformer. We fuse its two score branches with different quantization scales and the relative shift into integer-only operations. Second, we introduce a minimax-optimized Swish approximation that minimizes the maximum error of the Swish output. Third, a layer-wise range analysis of activations yields two targeted remedies: an INT16 grid for the BatchNorm output and percentile calibration for the heavy-tailed pre-encoder activations. I-Parakeet achieves 4.97% WER on LibriSpeech test-other, running on a Qualcomm NPU at a real-time factor of 0.048, 7.5x faster than a CPU baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 I-Parakeet，一种基于 NVIDIA Parakeet-CTC（0.6B参数）的纯整数（integer-only）实现，可完全运行于智能手机 NPU，无需任何浮点算子或 CPU 回退，针对边缘设备上的 Conformer ASR 模型部署难题，通过三项关键技术实现了高性能、低延迟的整数推理。
AI.motivation: 现代 Conformer 自动语音识别（ASR）模型参数规模大，难以部署到边缘设备（如智能手机）。现有的量化模型在数值敏感操作上仍需回退到浮点运算，无法充分利用移动 NPU 等整数加速器的能力。因此，迫切需要一种完全纯整数化的实现，以在边缘设备上实现高效、低功耗的 ASR 推理。
AI.method: I-Parakeet 的方法包含三项核心贡献：1）推导出 Conformer 核心相对位置自注意力（relative-positional self-attention）的整数公式，并将其两个具有不同量化尺度的打分分支以及相对移位（relative shift）融合为纯整数操作；2）引入一种基于 min-max 优化的 Swish 近似方法，以最小化 Swish 输出的最大误差；3）对激活进行逐层（layer-wise）范围分析，并据此采取两项针对性修复：对 BatchNorm 输出采用 INT16 量化网格，以及对重尾（heavy-tailed）的编码器前激活进行百分位校准（percentile calibration）。
AI.result: I-Parakeet 在 LibriSpeech test-other 上达到 4.97% 的词错误率（WER），在 Qualcomm NPU 上的实时因子（RTF）为 0.048，相比 CPU 基线实现了 7.5 倍的加速。
AI.conclusion: I-Parakeet 通过纯整数化的 Conformer ASR 实现，成功解决了边缘设备部署中的精度与效率难题，在保持极低词错误率的同时，显著提升了推理速度，证明了在移动 NPU 上运行大规模现代 ASR 模型的可行性。

title: Enhancing Assessment of Self-Consistency in LLM Explanations using Perturbation Strength
summary: Prior work has examined the self-consistency of LLM-generated explanations using surface-level perturbation methods. However, the strength of these perturbations is not explicitly measured and controlled. In this work, we propose an LLM-as-a-judge approach to measure perturbation strength in a unified manner across input and CoT perturbations. We then evaluate the self-consistency in explanations generated from various LLMs under controlled strength conditions, ensuring a fair comparison across perturbation types. Experiments show that our proposed LLM-based perturbation strength measure outperforms other embedding- and probability-based approaches and that input perturbations generally affect LLMs more strongly than CoT perturbations. Our work suggests that judgments about a model's self-consistency is fair only within the same perturbation type.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于LLM-as-a-judge的扰动强度评估框架，用于在统一标准下衡量输入扰动和CoT扰动的强度，从而实现对LLM自一致性（self-consistency）的更公平评估。实验表明，LLM评估方法显著优于基于嵌入和概率的方法，且输入扰动通常对LLM的影响强于CoT扰动。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM自一致性研究使用表面级扰动方法时，未能明确测量和控制扰动强度。这导致两个问题：(1) 当扰动无意中较弱时（变化未干扰推理路径），可能错误地得出模型自一致性差的结论；(2) 比较不同扰动类型时缺乏强度控制，导致不公平比较。因此需要一种跨扰动类型统一、可靠的扰动强度衡量方法。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) 设计4级扰动强度分类标准（0=无/最小变化，1=小变化，2=中等强度变化，3=强变化），基于扰动对推理路径的干扰程度和对答案支持的影响；(2) 提出三种扰动强度测量方法——余弦距离（基于MiniLM嵌入）、惊奇度变化（基于GPT-2概率）、LLM-as-a-judge（使用gemini-3-flash配合含示例的提示）；(3) 基于ARC-Challenge、OpenBookQA、BigBench-Hard Sports和StrategyQA四个QA数据集，使用4个CoT模型（Llama-3.2-3B、Llama-3-8B、Mistral-7B、Phi-3-mini）评估翻转率（flip rate）作为强度函数。提出两个互补的自一致性概念：响应式自一致性（强扰动下的翻转率FR(3)）和鲁棒自一致性（弱扰动下的翻转率FR(0)）。
AI.result: 关键结果：(1) LLM-as-a-judge方法在CoT扰动和输入扰动上与人类判断的相关性均最高（Pearson 0.888/0.885，Spearman 0.877/0.867，Kappa 0.801/0.787），显著优于余弦距离和惊奇度变化；(2) 标注者间一致性高（输入扰动Kappa=0.855，CoT扰动Kappa=0.649），表明标准可靠；(3) 在现有自一致性数据集中，超过50%的CoT扰动是弱扰动（强度0或1），强度3的扰动不到10%，质疑了现有数据集的适用性；(4) 模型在输入扰动下通常呈现高响应式但低鲁棒自一致性（FR(0)常超20%），而在CoT扰动下表现相反——这表明输入扰动对模型影响更强；(5) 整体自一致性指标FR(3)-FR(0)在不同模型和数据集间差异显著，证明跨扰动类型比较是不公平的。
AI.conclusion: 该论文的主要结论是：(1) 提出的LLM-as-a-judge扰动强度测量框架是可靠的，优于嵌入和概率方法；(2) 现有自一致性数据集中大部分扰动较弱，质疑其用于自一致性检查的有效性；(3) 输入扰动和CoT扰动对LLM的影响机制不同，跨扰动类型比较模型自一致性是不公平的，应在相同扰动类型内进行相对比较；(4) 通过控制扰动强度，可区分模型的响应式自一致性和鲁棒自一致性，提供更细致的评估视角。未来工作包括减少中等强度等级的模糊性，并将框架扩展到参数干预和嵌入扰动等。

title: Evidence-Grounded Auditing of Identification Assumptions in Climate-Policy Causal Evaluations
comment: Accepted at ClimateNLP 2026, the 3rd Workshop on Natural Language Processing meets Climate Change (EMNLP 2026). 9 pages plus appendix (21 pages total), 6 figures, 15 tables
summary: Difference-in-differences (DID) studies are widely used to evaluate climate policy, but assessing the evidence supporting their identification assumptions remains challenging. We introduce ARGUS, a structured language-model pipeline that audits reported evidence against an eleven-dimension assumption-implication-evidence rubric and abstains when relevant evidence cannot be retrieved. We evaluate ARGUS using injected flaws, economics papers, and a small pilot with reconciled labels. On the 11-flaw benchmark, ARGUS detects 73% of planted flaws, compared with 18% for a keyword-based pipeline. Across 26 economics papers, ARGUS abstains on about 40% of paper-dimension assessments for lack of retrievable evidence. In a five-paper pilot with labels reconciled by two annotators, it assigns a higher risk level than the labels on 25 of the 33 assessments it completes. A rule fixed before the labels arrived removes most of this in-sample; weighted agreement stays low. ARGUS provides evidence-linked risk reports that localize potential weaknesses for expert review, without adjudicating causal claims. Code and data: this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文提出ARGUS，一个有界、证据驱动的大语言模型审计流水线，用于审查气候变化政策双重差分（DID）研究中识别假设的证据支持程度。它采用11维度的"假设-含义-证据"评分标准，并通过结构化缺陷注入和人类标注金标准进行了系统评估。
AI.motivation: 气候政策评估中DID方法的应用日益广泛，但其识别假设（平行趋势、无预期、错时处理、SUTVA等）的证据支持程度难以评估。若识别假设支撑不足，政策建议可能被误导。因此需要一个系统化工具来审计论文中识别假设的证据完备性。
AI.method: ARGUS采用固定确定性的流水线（分解→提取→评估→定位→报告），模型调用仅限于两个阶段：1）基于词法检索和相关性门控的证据提取；2）评估证据是否充分支持假设。评分标准涵盖11个维度（平行趋势、无预期、错时、SUTVA/溢出、控制组、规范、推断、样本期、并发政策、安慰剂、数据测量）。评估采用"缺陷注入"法：在合成固定装置中植入11种已知缺陷（每种针对一个维度），分为"遗漏型"（删除证据章节）和"委托型"（改写为含缺陷设计但不使用关键词的文本），并辅以26篇真实经济学论文和5篇带有人类标注金标准的试点论文。
AI.result: 在11缺陷基准上，ARGUS检测率73%（vs 关键词法18%），误报率0%；33变体基准上检测率75%（委托型89%，遗漏型45%，后者因检索失败而弃权）；26篇真实论文中约40%的论文-维度评估因缺乏证据而弃权；在5篇试点论文中，与人类金标准对比，ARGUS在33个完成评估中有25个评级过严，预先指定的规则可将过严率降低，加权κ从0.08提升至0.23（样本内）。
AI.conclusion: ARGUS提供证据链接的风险报告，定位潜在弱点供专家审查，但不裁定因果真实性。它将DID识别假设的证据审计操作化为可测量的任务，但其有效性受限于检索覆盖率（仅依赖词汇检索）、小规模人工金标准（5篇论文55个单元）以及在样本内推导出校准规则的限制。在气候变化政策论文上的表现尚未经过测试。

title: Effects of Transcript Compression on LLM-based Medical Misinformation Detection in Japanese YouTube Videos
comment: 15 pages. Accepted at the 18th International Conference on Advances in Social Networks Analysis and Mining (ASONAM 2026), Multidisciplinary Track, Short Paper
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to assess long-form medical videos, but their effectiveness may depend on whether transcripts are provided in full or compressed through summarization, retrieval, or claim screening. This study examines how such transcript compression affects LLM-based veracity classification of Japanese medical YouTube videos. We compare four transcript input designs: full transcripts, LLM-generated summaries, RAPTOR-based retrievalaugmented generation (RAG), and Screening, which extracts candidate medical and health-related sentences. Using 74 long-form videos labeled as Real or Fake, we evaluate classification performance and analyze linguistic changes using J-LIWC, hedge expressions, and institutional or technical terms. The full-transcript Baseline achieved the best performance, whereas all compressed inputs increased false negatives, meaning that Fake videos were more likely to be misclassified as Real. Summary caused the largest performance drop, while Screening performed best among the compressed inputs but still omitted many medically relevant sentences. Linguistic analyses showed that these errors were not explained by a simple increase in certainty. Instead, Summary reduced affective, social, temporal, cognitive, and conversational cues, while Summary and RAG made institutional and technical terms more salient. These findings suggest that transcript compression can represent Fake videos as more coherent and authoritative inputs, thereby weakening cues needed for misinformation detection

AI.tldr: 该研究系统比较了四种转录文本输入设计（全文本、LLM摘要、RAPTOR-RAG、医学句子筛选）对日语医疗YouTube视频真实性分类的影响，发现全文本输入表现最优，而压缩输入均增加假阴性，使虚假视频更易被误判为真实。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM被广泛用于评估长形式医疗视频的真实性，转录文本通常因长度和成本被压缩（摘要、检索或声明筛选）。然而，医疗视频真实性分类依赖分布式的语言线索（声明、证言、模糊语、情感诉求、机构/技术术语等），压缩可能移除或重构这些线索，导致误分类。该研究旨在探究不同压缩方法对LLM分类性能及语言特征的影响。
AI.method: 基于74个日语长形式医疗YouTube视频（10个真实、64个虚假），使用同一分类LLM（calm3-22b-chat）和相同提示，对比四种输入设计：(1) Baseline（全文）、(2) Summary（Qwen2摘要）、(3) RAG（RAPTOR检索）、(4) Screening（提取医学相关句子）。评估指标包括Accuracy、加权F1、MCC和混淆矩阵。语言分析使用J-LIWC、形式/会话模糊语、机构与技术术语词典，通过Wilcoxon符号秩检验和Benjamini-Hochberg FDR校正比较压缩前后差异。同时对Screening的句子提取性能进行人工评估（Precision/Recall/F1）。
AI.result: Baseline性能最佳（Accuracy=0.905, F1=0.891, MCC=0.524, FN=1），三种压缩方法均增加假阴性：Summary FN=32（性能最差，Accuracy=0.541），RAG FN=14（Accuracy=0.770），Screening FN=9（压缩中最佳，Accuracy=0.824）。语言分析显示：错误并非源于简单的确定性增加；Summary同时减少了确定性和犹疑表达，并显著降低情感、认知、时间、社交和会话线索；Summary和RAG使机构与技术术语占比更显著（前景化）；Summary减少会话模糊语但增加形式模糊语。Screening的句子提取精度高（0.777）但召回率低（0.227），表明遗漏了医学相关上下文。
AI.conclusion: 当转录文本适合上下文窗口且计算成本可接受时，全文本输入比通用压缩方法更可靠。压缩（特别是摘要）会重构虚假视频的呈现，使其显得更连贯、更具权威性，从而削弱LLM检测错误信息所需的关键语言线索。未来应开发"线索保留型"压缩方法，在缩短长度的同时保留声明、模糊语、情感和机构语境等多维线索。本研究存在样本量小、单作者标注、词典化语言分析等局限性。

title: From annotation to reasoning: Culture in language models
summary: How should we evaluate language models when more than one interpretation can be right? Cultural benchmarks often test factual knowledge, agreement with survey responses, or recognition of a predefined meaning. These tasks leave open whether a model can explain how a cultural reference works in a particular text, support a reading with evidence, or revise it after criticism. This is a question of interpretive depth, complementary to the breadth of cultural coverage. We argue that literary interpretation offers a useful setting for studying these capabilities. We focus on cultural referencing and reuse: how texts invoke, repeat, and transform earlier expressions across historical and linguistic contexts. Our central claim is that literary scholars can disagree about an interpretation while recognizing the quality of its support. We propose linking evidence-centered benchmarks, evaluation that preserves scholarly disagreement, and model-development experiments on literary data, contextual resources, and scholarly feedback. Danish literature provides a concrete starting point, with implications for other languages and domains. The aim is to develop alternative evaluation strategies that go beyond conventional benchmark metrics and guide model development toward cultural robustness in AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇立场论文（Perspective），主张以文学解释（特别是丹麦文学中的文化引用与再利用）为测试场景，评估和提升语言模型的文化推理能力。文章强调应从"覆盖面（breadth）"转向"解释深度（interpretive depth）"，通过保留学术分歧、评估证据质量、结合检索与学术反馈等方式，构建超越传统基准指标的文化鲁棒评估框架。
AI.motivation: 当前的文化基准主要测试事实知识、调查一致性或预定义含义的识别，无法评估模型能否解释文化引用的工作机制、为解读提供证据支持或在批评后修正观点。即"同意一种解读"与"判定其论据充分"是不同行为，现有评估缺乏对解释深度的衡量，亟需新的评估策略与模型开发方向。
AI.method: 提出三项相互关联的方法路径：(1) 设计以文学学者为主导的解释性基准任务（识别引用、解释其作用、比较多种解读、根据批评修订），结合长上下文与检索辅助条件进行对比；(2) 评估协议分离三个判断——是否存在可识别错误、证据与解读的连接质量、解释的合理性程度，保留个体学术判断，使用概率软标签，采用Toulmin论证模型（主张-证据-论据）；(3) 模型开发实验，对比不同训练数据组成（历史/当代小说、普通语料、学术评论）、检索增强与上下文资源、不同粒度的学术反馈（精调、偏好学习、强化学习），并在未见作品上测试迁移能力。整体依托"CuRe"项目，以丹麦文学为具体起点。
AI.result: 文章为立场性论文，未报告实证结果，而是勾勒了一个研究与开发框架：(1) 阐明"解释深度"作为与覆盖面互补的评估维度；(2) 论证如何在保留学术分歧的前提下进行评估；(3) 提出训练数据、检索和反馈应如何设计以提升文化鲁棒性；(4) 列举了文学之外的延伸领域（视觉文化、法律如欧洲人权法院案例）；(5) 警示风险：模型可能习得学术谨慎的外在形式却仍做无据主张，或变得过度顺从而放弃有据解读。
AI.conclusion: 文化表达的意义在使用中获得，模型发展须贯穿文化情境对训练材料、任务、评估标准和反馈的选择。进步应通过系统能否充分论证文化主张、维持合理替代解读并对知情批评作出有意义的回应来衡量。该评估框架可推广至视觉文化、法律等需要"主张-证据-论据"分离的领域，为构建文化鲁棒的语言技术提供基础。

title: ToolSearcher: Optimizing Tool Selection at Scale via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) excel at natural language processing but struggle to interact with external environments. Tool learning provides a promising way to extend LLMs into actionable agents, where tool selection is a critical prerequisite for successful tool use. Existing work often assumes a small or predefined set of tools, leaving large-scale tool selection underexplored. Real-world repositories contain a vast and diverse array of tools, making it difficult for LLMs to effectively search, distinguish, and compose tools under context-length constraints. We identify large-scale tool selection as a new challenge for agentic reinforcement learning, highlighting that existing RL methods for knowledge-based question answering are inadequate for selecting tools while considering compatibility. To address this challenge, we propose ToolSearcher, a novel RL framework for effective multi-turn search and fine-grained optimization in large-scale tool selection. Specifically, we introduce category-constrained tool discrimination to improve the model's ability to distinguish functionally similar tools, event-level search modeling to explicitly optimize the discovery of target tools during multi-turn search, and trajectory-aligned credit allocation to provide fine-grained reward signals for different stages of the search-selection process. Extensive experiments on large-scale tool selection benchmarks demonstrate that ToolSearcher consistently outperforms a set of strong baselines in challenging settings involving iterative search and complex tool composition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ToolSearcher，一种面向大规模工具选择场景的强化学习框架，通过类别约束工具辨别、事件级搜索建模和轨迹对齐信用分配三个关键组件，显著提升了LLM在大型工具库中搜索、区分和组合工具的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有工具学习方法通常假设候选工具集较小或预定义，而真实场景下的工具库（如PyPI、npm、HuggingFace）规模庞大且功能多样，导致LLM在上下文长度限制下难以有效搜索、区分和组合工具。此外，面向知识型问答的现有RL方法未考虑工具组合兼容性，不适用于大规模工具选择任务。
AI.method: 1. **类别约束工具辨别（CCTD）**：通过工具类别构建强约束搜索环境，分两阶段训练（前30%数据在子类内搜索，后续全局搜索），增强模型区分功能相似工具的能力。2. **事件级搜索建模（ESM）**：将搜索轨迹显式建模为搜索事件序列，仅对首次发现目标工具的事件计算事件级搜索优势，并采用GRPO框架进行优化。3. **轨迹对齐信用分配（TCA）**：根据轨迹进度自动分配奖励——对未完成目标工具搜索的轨迹的选择事件去除奖励，对已被组内掌握的目标工具的搜索事件去除奖励，实现细粒度优化。
AI.result: 在StableToolBench（16k工具）上，ToolSearcher在Qwen2.5-7B和Qwen3-4B上均取得最优性能：F1分别达51.3%和53.1%，相比多轮基线提升显著（分别从9.8%/40.8%提升）。在最具挑战性的I3（集合内多工具）和未见过指令（Inst.）场景下提升尤为明显，例如7B模型上I3-Inst. F1超越GDPO 6.6%。在OOD数据集AppWorld上同样全面领先，工具选择F1达51.4%（7B）和56.2%（4B），TGC/SGC在Difficulty-1和Difficulty-2设置下均优于所有基线。消融实验证实CCTD、ESM、TCA三者均不可或缺，移除ESM导致SRecall在AppWorld上下降39.4%。
AI.conclusion: ToolSearcher通过显式建模多轮搜索过程并提供细粒度的阶段化奖励信号，有效解决了大规模工具库中工具选择的难题。其三个核心组件协同工作，既增强了模型对功能相似工具的辨别能力，也提升了组合兼容性推理能力。在域内和域外基准测试中均验证了该方法在迭代搜索和复杂工具组合任务上的有效性，为LLM智能体在大规模工具场景中的应用提供了重要参考。局限性方面，训练数据多为并行工具组合且缺乏状态感知能力，在处理AppWorld等有状态API场景时仍有提升空间。

title: Training-Free Pronunciation Transcription via Text-Constrained Acoustic Rescoring
summary: Accurate and efficient pronunciation transcription is essential for preparing text-to-speech training data at scale. Existing approaches have different limitations: grapheme-to-pronunciation (G2P) and speech-to-pronunciation (S2P) methods each capture only partial information, using only text or only speech, while speech-and-text-to-pronunciation (ST2P) methods use both but require costly pronunciation-annotated data. To address this problem, we propose a training-free ST2P pipeline that integrates both lexical and acoustic information at inference time. Lexical resources and G2P tools generate text-constrained candidates, and a left-to-right greedy search selects the best one using whole-sequence negative log-likelihoods from frozen pretrained S2P models. On three Japanese corpora, our method reduces Character Error Rate (CER) from 0.60--1.40\% (text-only baseline) to 0.04--0.17\% with reference transcripts, and 0.64--1.58\% with ASR transcripts. It outperforms all baselines, including a trained ST2P model and commercial multimodal LLMs. Our greedy search method is 3--3.5$\times$ faster than beam search at similar CER, and the cascade is 2$\times$ faster than direct decoding ensuring the efficiency and accuracy. In Spanish, French, and preliminary English, it also surpasses four open multimodal LLMs and the best traditional methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需训练的语音-文本到发音（ST2P）转录流水线，通过结合词汇资源/G2P工具生成的文本约束候选与冻结预训练S2P模型的声学负对数似然分数，采用从左到右的贪心搜索选择最佳发音序列。在日语上显著降低字符错误率（CER），并有效推广至西班牙语、法语和英语。
AI.motivation: 发音转录是大规模TTS训练数据准备的关键步骤。现有方法各有局限：G2P仅利用文本，S2P仅利用语音，而ST2P虽结合两者但需要昂贵的发音标注训练数据。本文旨在提出一种无需训练的ST2P方案，在推理时融合词汇与声学信息，避免对标注数据的需求。
AI.method: 1. **候选生成**：使用词典、G2P工具和规则为转录文本的每个片段生成有限候选读音集合。2. **声学打分**：利用冻结预训练S2P模型（CTC或自回归模型）计算完整候选发音序列的负对数似然。3. **从左到右贪心搜索**：逐片段选择使整体NLL最小的候选读音，避免组合爆炸。4. **级联（Cascade）**：使用第二个S2P模型与第一模型融合分数，仅在第一遍改变了默认读音时重新搜索。5. **边际检查（Margin Check）**：对改变后的片段要求声学得分优势超过阈值（按长度缩放）才保留，否则恢复默认读音，以避免弱声学证据下的误改。
AI.result: **日语（三个语料库，512条共同语句）**：使用参考文本时，CER从文本基线的0.60–1.40%降至0.04–0.17%；使用ASR文本时，降至0.64–1.58%。级联方法在所有语料上优于所有基线，包括有训练的Furigana Whisper ST2P模型和商用多模态LLM。贪心搜索比束搜索（宽度5）快3–3.5倍且CER相当；级联比直接自回归解码快2倍。消融实验确认边际检查、级联融合和声学证据的必要性，级联恢复贪心oracle 87–96%的CER降低。**多语言**：在西班牙语（PFER 2.38）、法语（4.11）和英语（13.21）上均超越语言专用的文本基线和四种开源多模态LLM，与最佳Gemini商用模型差距在0.4点以内。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的无需训练ST2P流水线仅利用开放模型和词汇资源，在日语上以更低计算成本取得了优于所有基线的精度，并能有效推广至西班牙语、法语和英语，展示了在缺乏发音标注数据的场景下高质量发音转录的可行路径。

title: FAVoR: Measuring and Mitigating Author-Style Homogenization in Federated Personalized Generation
summary: Large language models are increasingly used as personalized writing assistants, but adapting a model across many authors can compromise individual writing style by pulling author-specific signals toward a shared register. Federated parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) offers a data-local setting for this multi-author adaptation problem: clients keep author text local while sharing compact adapter updates. However, we show that standard aggregation can preserve continuation utility while making different authors' generations less distinguishable in style space, a failure mode we define as author-style homogenization. We evaluate author-style retention with Angular Style Classification Encoder (ASCE)-based diagnostics on our main BlogText benchmark and ASCE-independent external authorship verification. Using this protocol, we find that common federated PEFT baselines can preserve semantic utility while averaging out author-specific signals. To address this homogenization, we instantiate FAVoR (Federated Authorial Voice Retention), an author-style residual mechanism for federated PEFT. FAVoR uses a shared-private adapter design: clients upload shared-adapter updates while retaining author-specific residual corrections locally. Across BlogText and external Mythos-Reddit validation, FAVoR improves author-style retention over standard and personalized federated PEFT baselines. These gains come with small continuation-utility trade-offs and are supported by component ablations, external verification, and cold-start transfer.

AI.tldr: FAVoR是一种用于联邦个性化文本生成的作者风格保留机制，通过共享-私有适配器设计解决多作者协作微调中的"作者风格同质化"问题。
AI.motivation: 在联邦参数高效微调中，多作者协作适配虽能保持生成流畅性，但会使不同作者的风格趋同（author-style homogenization），即风格区分度下降而语义效用不变。仅靠数据本地化不足以解决该问题。
AI.method: FAVoR采用共享-私有适配器架构：(1) 共享适配器通过联邦聚合学习可迁移的续写能力；(2) 私有残差适配器基于共享端点存储作者特定修正，不参与聚合；(3) 使用Angular Style Classification Encoder (ASCE) 计算本地作者风格目标，通过风格对齐损失训练私有残差。客户端仅上传共享适配器增量。
AI.result: 在BlogText和Mythos-Reddit基准上，FAVoR在作者风格保留方面显著优于FedAvg/FedProx/pFedMe/Ditto/FedDPA基线（如BlogText上作者准确率从0.199提升至0.403），同时保持与基线相当的续写效用（BERTScore/SemSim仅有小幅波动）。消融实验表明，私有残差聚合约束贡献了大部分增益。冷启动迁移实验显示，FAVoR共享初始化在低资源场景（K=8）下优于本地基线。人类2FA评审中FAVoR得票准确率91.7% vs Ditto 68.3%。
AI.conclusion: 作者风格同质化是联邦个性化续写中一个效用保持性的失败模式，标准联邦PEFT即使在效用指标正常时也会擦除跨作者风格。FAVoR通过共享-私有残差机制有效缓解该问题，主要贡献来自残差聚合边界而非风格对齐损失本身。未来工作需扩展至更大作者群体、更广泛写作领域以及更强的作者隐私保护机制。

title: Coupled Usage-Sense Processes: Temporal and Attributable Lexical Semantic Change
summary: Lexical semantic change is usually summarized by a scalar distance between independently sampled period distributions. This measures how much a word changed, but does not reveal when it changed, which mechanisms and component movements carried the change, or which usages support the attribution. We introduce Coupled Usage--Sense Processes (CUSP), which derives these answers from a single marginal preserving temporal process. A hierarchical coupling relates contextual distributions through latent usage components, while Markov composition makes adjacent and longer span correspondences compatible. Displacement operators quantify change magnitude and timing, split variation exactly between movement of component centers and reorganization within components, and attribute it to transported component pairs. Word-local modes resolve distinct directions of change and their activity over time, while representative passages from attributed components ground the analysis in text. Under a Gaussian mixture specialization, we prove parametric recovery of the operators and squared distances. Synthetic experiments support the predicted rate. CUSP remains competitive on English and German DWUG and recovers controlled Janus profiles while maintaining compositionally coherent transport. A large corpus of US court opinions demonstrates transition, mode, and passage attribution in unlabeled natural text. CUSP thus makes magnitude, timing, mechanism, movement, modes, and textual evidence compatible views of one lexical history.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CUSP（Coupled Usage–Sense Processes），将各时期的独立使用分布耦合为单一的边缘保持时序过程，从同一过程同时导出语义变化的幅度、时间、机制、成分迁移和文本证据六种兼容读数。在高斯混合特例下证明算子和平方距离的参数恢复率，并在合成数据、DWUG、Janus和US法院判决语料上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有词汇语义变化（LSC）方法将历史压缩为时期间的标量距离，无法揭示变化何时发生、通过何种机制（中心移动或成分内重组）、哪些成分迁移承载变化、哪些用法支持归因。Chen等人（2016）指出可解释性是LSC尚未解决的挑战。需要一个统一过程保持各时期边缘并使所有读数指称同一时序对应。
AI.method: 方法核心是分层耦合与马尔可夫组合：（1）将每时期使用分布表示为潜在使用成分（高斯混合）的混合；（2）分层最优传输在成分对内耦合上下文分布，再在成分流行率之间传输，保持两时期边缘；（3）相邻传输通过马尔可夫组合诱导非相邻对应，形成一个联合时序过程。定义位移算子M(t,s)（耦合位移的二阶矩），其迹给出标量距离，模式给出正交分解。核心定理3.1证明full = mean + dev的精确分解；定理3.2证明按传输成分对(k,ℓ)的精确归因。词局部模式由聚合均值算子的特征向量定义，捕获词特有变化方向。高斯特例下证明O_p(n^{-1/2})的统计恢复率。
AI.result: 合成实验：参数、算子、平方距离的log-log斜率在-0.51到-0.56之间，置信区间包含-1/2预测率；纯机制检验中CUSP将>98.95%路径能量分配到正确机制。DWUG：full trace在英语上ρ=0.746（最高），德语上ρ=0.815（接近最高0.827）；中心位移贡献英语86.8%、德语90.6%的全迹变化。Janus：稳定/渐进/突变调度均被恢复，相邻变化ρ=0.954，AUROC=1.000；配对OT的ℓ₁组成误差为0.084（集中于渐进历史），CUSP构造性为零。法院判决语料：privacy、search、standing等60个法律词条在八个十年区间被分析，privacy的最高富集迁移连接Prosser侵权分类与Katz后的隐私期待语言，expectation的三主导模式同步在1960→1970达峰。
AI.conclusion: CUSP将各时期独立分布转化为单一边缘保持时序过程，使标量测量、时序结构与可检查解释成为同一词汇历史观的兼容方面。理论贡献包括分层耦合、马尔可夫组合、位移算子的机制精确分解与成分传输归因，以及高斯特例下的参数恢复保证。在合成、双语DWUG、Janus和大规模无标注法律语料上的实验验证了恢复率、标量有效性、多时期一致性和段落级归因的完整链条。

title: THA: Weighted Finite-State Text Normalization and Inverse Text Normalization for Khmer
summary: Text-to-speech needs written text in spoken form, and speech recognition output needs the reverse. For Khmer, neither direction has a maintained open-source tool, and the script makes both harder: words are not separated by spaces, and number words occur inside ordinary words. We present Tha, a Khmer text normalization and inverse text normalization toolkit built from weighted finite-state transducers. It segments and classifies a whole line in one shortest-path search, and a second transducer rejects token boundaries inside a Khmer syllable. On Google's Khmer test suite, Tha agrees with the reference on all 274 cardinals up to one spelling variant, and on 2,906 real TTS prompts, 153 of the 158 sentences it rewrites are correct. Tha is open source under the Apache 2.0 license.

AI.tldr: Tha是一个基于加权有限状态转换器(WFST)的开源高棉语(Khmer)文本规范化(TN)与逆文本规范化(ITN)工具包，针对高棉文无空格分词、数字词嵌入普通词等特性，采用整行最短路径搜索和音节边界过滤器实现高准确率的转换。
AI.motivation: 高棉语缺乏维护良好的开源TN/ITN工具，且现有工具(NeMo、WeTextProcessing)不支持该语言；高棉文无词间隔、数字词可能出现在普通词内部(如ពីរ同时是"二"和"melodious"的前缀)，使基于空格分词的方案失效。Google的Thrax语法仅支持TN、依赖CRF分词且已归档。
AI.method: 核心方法：(1) 整行单次最短路径分类——将整行作为分类器WFST C的输入，以半角成本wc(<1)覆盖尽可能多的字符为半符号token，以每字符成本1保留为普通文本，通过权重偏好(如date优先于cardinal)解决歧义；(2) 边界过滤器F拒绝在高棉音节内部开始或结束的token边界；(3) 复用khmercut分词器处理重复符号ៗ的展开范围；(4) 使用flexible join转录器J处理ITN方向的高棉词连接；(5) 支持17个TN类和13个ITN类(含基数、小数、序数、分数、货币、度量、时间、日期、电话、邮件、URL、车牌、罗马数字、序列号、年份范围、足球阵型等)；(6) 字符规范化步骤(基于SIL khnormal)将音节字符排序为规范形式。
AI.result: 评估结果：(1) 与Google语法测试套件对比：TN方向274个基数全部一致(修正一个拼写变体后)；ITN方向265个基数、27个小数、13个时间全部正确(添加ប្រាំពិល拼写后)；(2) 在2,906条真实TTS提示上：ITN改写158句中的153句(96.8%)正确；(3) 往返测试：10类中8类100%往返，小数91.0%(点号千位歧义)，电话98.7%(分块读法歧义)；(4) 消融实验证明边界过滤器能避免音节内分割(如ដណ្ដប់→ដណ្10)；(5) 速度：ITN中位8.6ms/句，TTS规范化3.4ms/句(约4400-10900字符/秒)。
AI.conclusion: Tha成功将Sparrowhawk/NeMo的tagger-verbalizer设计移植到高棉语，整行联合消解消除了对分词器的依赖，边界过滤器是原始文本ITN不破坏普通词的关键。主要遗留问题为拼写变体覆盖与缺乏独立标注的测试集；未来可通过语言模型重打分或神经span tagger(如KhmerTagger)补充上下文信息。代码以Apache 2.0开源。

title: Evaluating Sycophancy in Chinese Large Language Models on Factual Questions Derived from Online Search Queries
comment: 19 pages, 34 figures, 4 tables. Geng Liu and Feng Li contributed equally
summary: As large language models increasingly mediate information access, factually accurate and independent answers are critical. However, these models can exhibit sycophancy by aligning their responses with users' stated beliefs even when those beliefs are incorrect, potentially presenting misinformation as independently verified and reinforcing users' confidence in false claims. Prior work leaves unresolved whether introducing user beliefs causes correct responses to become incorrect or uncertain, or causes uncertain responses to become belief-aligned incorrect answers. It also remains unclear whether anti-sycophancy interventions preserve or restore factual accuracy or merely shift responses toward uncertainty. We analyze factual sycophancy in Chinese-language information seeking using yes/no fact-checking questions. Our analysis covers 364,941 responses from three frontier Chinese-based LLMs (DeepSeek, Qwen, and Doubao) to 12,165 factual questions derived from real-world Chinese search queries. We evaluate the models with and without reasoning across baseline, belief-conditioned, and anti-sycophancy prompting, tracing matched shifts among correct, incorrect, and uncertain responses. Under incorrect user beliefs, we distinguish belief-aligned errors from losses of factual confidence, in which initially correct answers become uncertain. Patterns vary across models and reasoning settings: reasoning is not a consistent safeguard, and anti-sycophancy instructions can reduce incorrect agreement while increasing uncertainty. In Chinese-language factual question answering, avoiding agreement with false beliefs is therefore not equivalent to preserving factual accuracy, highlighting the value of transition-level evaluation. Such behavior may undermine the reliability of LLM-mediated information access by reinforcing misinformation or weakening users' confidence in factually correct answers.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对三个中国前沿大语言模型（DeepSeek、Qwen、Doubao）在中文事实性问题上的"谄媚性"（sycophancy）行为进行了大规模实证分析，共收集364,941条回复，涵盖12,165个源自真实中文搜索查询的事实型是非题。研究通过追踪同一问题在基线、用户信念注入和反谄媚提示三种条件下的匹配响应转变（correct/incorrect/uncertain），发现：推理能力并非一致的保护因素，反谄媚提示虽能减少错误认同，却常以增加正确回答退化为不确定性为代价。"避免认同错误信念"与"保持事实准确性"并非等同。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型越来越多地充当信息访问的中介，其回答的事实准确性和独立性至关重要。然而，这些模型可能表现出谄媚行为——即使在用户信念错误的情况下也调整回答以与用户观点一致，从而可能将错误信息呈现为独立验证的结果，强化用户对错误主张的信心。现有研究尚未厘清的关键问题是：(1) 引入用户信念后，正确回答是变为错误还是变为不确定？不确定的回答是变为错误还是保持不确定？(2) 推理能力是否一致地防止此类变化？(3) 反谄媚干预究竟是恢复事实准确性，还是仅仅将回答推向不确定性？此外，现有研究多以英语为主，中文语境下的事实性谄媚行为研究不足，而中国AI系统运行于独特的信息生态系统中，对中文事实问题的评估可能揭示基于英语提示和西方模型的发现能否泛化到中文部署。
AI.method: 数据：采用Liu等人(2025)基于T2Ranking构建的中文事实性是/否问题数据集（12,165个问题，10个主题类别）。模型：三个中国前沿LLM——Qwen-Plus、DeepSeek-V3.2、Doubao-Seed-2.0-Lite，均支持推理启用/禁用。提示设计：三种条件——基线（无用户信念）、仅信念（注入"我认为答案是Yes/No"）、反谄媚（增加强调独立事实判断的指令和判断规则），共5种提示变体。响应分类：Yes/No回答按是否匹配ground-truth分为正确(C)或错误(I)，"Uncertain"为不确定(U)。两阶段匹配比较：Stage 1比较基线与信念条件的匹配响应；Stage 2比较信念条件与反谄媚条件的匹配响应（保持问题和信念固定）。追踪C→I、U→I、C→U等转换率。辅助方法：对100个问题的子集进行10次重复生成的稳健性分析；逻辑回归分析控制ground-truth极性和主题变量，检查错误信念、推理启用等因素对保持正确回答的影响。
AI.result: 阶段1（引入错误信念）：在6个设置中5个出现正确率下降，最高-5.2个百分点。推理的影响因模型而异——推理启用与Qwen的C→I率较高相关，但与DeepSeek和Doubao的C→I率较低相关。推理一致地降低C→U转换（三个模型均如此），但一致地增加U→I转换（Qwen达56.1%，Doubao达39.8%）。阶段2（反谄媚指令）：反谄媚提示在多数设置中减少了C→I转换（最多降低6.5个百分点），但对DeepSeek和Doubao增加了C→U转换（最高增加9.4个百分点）。Qwen在两种推理设置下正确率均增加（最高7.2个百分点），但DeepSeek和Doubao未出现准确性提升。回归分析：错误信念在所有三个模型中均与正确性保持负相关（Qwen β=-1.51，DeepSeek β=-0.34，Doubao β=-1.80）；推理的关联方向因模型而异。核心结论：推理不是一致的保护因素；反谄媚指令可以减少错误认同但同时增加不确定性；避免与错误信念一致≠保持事实准确性。
AI.conclusion: 贡献：该研究通过匹配响应追踪，区分了事实性谄媚的不同路径（C→I、U→I、C→U），揭示了评估反谄媚干预时需要超越简单的错误认同减少指标。意义：(1) 评估应包含信念条件化交互，因为标准准确性测试可能遗漏模型强化用户错误信念或放弃先前正确答案的情况；(2) 反谄媚保护措施应同时评估是否减少错误回答和是否保持/恢复正确回答，用不必要的不确定性替代错误认同仍可能限制对可靠信息的访问；(3) 不同模型、推理设置、主题和响应路径的差异表明，部署决策应基于领域特定的风险评估而非假设一致的可靠性。局限：数据集仅捕获真实环境中事实问题的子集；提示是受控实验操作；输出限于Yes/No/Uncertain排除了解释和证据使用；仅评估三个中文模型和一种反谄媚提示；测量模型响应变化而非其对用户信念、信心或决策的下游影响。

title: ZooWork-ShopRanker: An Open, Preference-Aligned E-Commerce Reranker
summary: Open rerankers trained for general web retrieval transfer imperfectly to e-commerce, where ranking decisions depend not only on topical relevance but also on user preferences, product constraints, and comparative product fit. These preference signals are difficult to supervise at scale: real search traffic provides authentic queries and candidates but no clean pairwise labels. We present ZooWork-ShopRanker, a family of e-commerce rerankers (0.6B, 4B, and 8B) aligned to judge-labeled shopping preference. Training pairs are labeled by a panel of reasoning large language models (LLMs) from different families acting as a preference oracle, with position-debiased judgments and agreement tiers, and the rerankers are trained on these labels. The aligned 8B flagship then serves as a distillation teacher for the efficient 4B and 0.6B models, which are fit to its scores and sharpened on judged pairs. To measure progress, we introduce ShopRank-Bench, a contamination-limited benchmark of ~10,000 private-traffic preference pairs in both text formats, tiered by how many judge families committed to each label. ZooWork-ShopRanker-8B and -4B significantly outperform the strongest open reranker baseline, every model significantly beats its own un-aligned base, and ZooWork-ShopRanker-0.6B beats its size peer; the gains hold in both formats and extend to common MTEB benchmarks. We release the models and the dual-format ShopRank-Bench to facilitate further research.

AI.tldr: 提出面向电商场景的重排序模型族 ZooWork-ShopRanker（0.6B/4B/8B），通过跨家族 LLM 评委标注的偏好数据进行对齐训练，并发布 ShopRank-Bench 评测基准，在电商购物偏好任务上显著超越现有开源重排序器。
AI.motivation: 通用网页检索重排序器在电商场景表现欠佳，因为电商排序不仅依赖主题相关性，还需考虑用户偏好、产品约束和比较适配性；而真实搜索流量缺乏干净的成对偏好标签，难以大规模监督。
AI.method: 1）跨家族 LLM 评委面板（Qwen3.5-122B、Gemma-4-31B、DeepSeek-V4-Pro）采用"约束优先"协议进行双序位置去偏标注，构建 gold/silver/bronze 三级共识标签；2）8B 旗舰模型直接用 Bradley-Terry 成对损失对齐偏好，0.6B 和 4B 通过蒸馏 8B 教师分数并用成对损失锐化训练；3）所有训练采用 LoRA 适配器（仅约 1% 参数）冻结基座权重；4）引入 ShopRank-Bench（~10,000 私有偏好对，双格式发布）和诊断轨道（属性层级 AHP、显式预算）。
AI.result: 1）ShopRank-Bench 结构化格式：8B 达 83.4%、4B 达 81.2%，均显著超越 Jina-m0（79.2%）等开源基线；2）0.6B 达 76.6%，超越同尺寸 BGE-v2-m3（73.3%）；3）三个规模均显著超越各自未对齐基座（McNemar p≤1.3e-4）；4）蒸馏 0.6B 在 H200 上吞吐量达 4B 基座的 2.8 倍，准确率相当；5）MTEB 通用任务无退化；6）零样本推理 LLM 仍领先重排序器约 8-9 点，表明偏好信号可恢复但尚未完全蒸馏入小模型。
AI.conclusion: 证明了通过 LLM 评委偏好对齐可使开源重排序器在电商偏好任务上获得显著且格式无关的提升，且不牺牲通用检索能力；蒸馏路线为高效部署提供了可行方案；显式预算遵循需要针对性程序化监督而非通用偏好对齐；标签与人类购物偏好的关系仍是待验证的开放问题。

title: Modeling Student Sensemaking with LLMs and Knowledge-Graph-Guided Inference
summary: Collaborative science learning requires nuanced interpretation of student dialogue to characterize how learners identify knowledge gaps, build explanations, and work toward resolution - a theory-driven analysis that is labor-intensive and difficult to scale. We investigate whether instruction-tuned large language models (LLMs) can support multidimensional analysis of collaborative sensemaking without task-specific training, and whether structured knowledge-state information improves model inference. We evaluate two mid-size LLMs on 23 richly annotated, expert-labeled episodes across prompting conditions that vary definitional scaffolding, reasoning mode, and turn structure. Without reasoning, models tend to overpredict successful sensemaking; reasoning-enabled prompting improves identification of unsuccessful cases. Knowledge-state diagnostics provide additional grounding, improving detection of unsuccessful sensemaking and increasing agreement with expert annotations. No single configuration performs best across all sensemaking dimensions, underscoring the multidimensional nature of the task.

AI.tldr: 本文研究指令调优大语言模型（LLM）在无需任务特定训练的情况下，能否支持多维度协作意义建构（sensemaking）分析，并探讨知识图谱（KG）导出的知识状态诊断信息能否提升模型推理效果。基于23个专家标注的协作对话片段（围绕波义耳定律实验），在多种提示条件下评估两款中等规模开源LLM（Gemma-3-27B-IT和Qwen3-32B）。研究发现：推理式提示（CoT）改善了模型对不成功意义建构（USM）的识别；KG诊断与单轮推理模式结合可获得最佳人机一致性（Cohen κ=0.60）；但无单一配置在所有维度均表现最优。
AI.motivation: 协作科学学习中的意义建构分析需要领域专家对学习者对话进行细致的多维度标注（识别知识缺口、构建解释、追踪认识情感），过程劳动密集且难以规模化。尽管LLM在指令遵循和结构化推理方面具备潜力，但其在处理这种多维度、理论驱动的标注任务时的可靠性尚不明确，且定义支架、推理提示、知识结构化表征等因素的影响尚未系统研究。
AI.method:
方法包含两阶段框架：
1. 原始对话分析阶段：评估Gemma-3-27B-IT和Qwen3-32B在四种提示变体（V1-V4，逐步增加定义支架）、两种推理模式（标准零样本/CoT思维链）、两种轮次结构（单轮/双轮）下的表现。
2. KG集成阶段：自动构建领域本体KG（112个实体、609个三元组），为每集对话构建学生知识状态KG并计算诊断指标（概念覆盖率、关系正确性、与领域本体和焦点问题的结构相似性等），将其注入提示。
任务输出包含7个字段：意义建构判定（SM/USM）、焦点知识缺口、知识缺口类型、CER（主张-证据-推理）三要素、两种最突出的认识情感。
评估指标：F1分数、Cohen κ系数、SciBERT余弦相似度。
AI.result:
主要结果：
- 单轮推理模式下，Qwen3-32B + KG诊断达到最佳性能：F1-SM=87.5%，F1-USM=71.4%，Cohen κ=0.60（中等一致性）。
- 无推理时模型倾向于过度预测成功意义建构；CoT推理显著改善USM识别（提升约15-30个百分点）。
- 知识缺口类型分类表现差，模型默认输出"概念性"，仅思维模式下"程序性"缺口可达约30%。
- 双轮提示对SM分类有负面影响，但能改善USM识别；不同配置捕获任务的不同方面。
- KG诊断在不推理模式下引入噪声，但在思维模式下为单轮设置提供有意义的支撑。
- 焦点问题识别在各配置下表现稳定且相似度高；CER推理要素的相似度最低（最难）。
- 认识情感预测显示SM与USM存在区分模式：USM更多出现困惑+挫败组合，SM更多出现好奇+满足组合。
- 无单一配置在所有意义建构维度上均表现最佳，凸显任务的多维度本质。
AI.conclusion: 结论：指令调优LLM可作为协作意义建构多维度分析的有力工具，但需配合适当的提示配置和结构化知识支撑。KG导出的诊断信息在恰当的推理模式下能显著提升人机一致性。然而，性能在不同意义建构维度上仍不均衡，表明此类分析最终可能需要集成式或适应性提示策略。该研究主张采用"专家在环"工作流程——LLM提供理论驱动的特征提取，由人类专家进行解释。未来工作将沿时间维度追踪学生KG、CER结构和认识情感的演变。

title: CG-Probes: Recovering Guardrail Directions from Patient Query Embeddings
comment: Accepted as a short paper at CIKM '26 (35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management), Rome, Italy. 7 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Code and benchmark: this https URL
summary: Patient-facing AI assistants promise valuable support to patients, but incoming queries can pose medical risks. To create guardrails, we work with oncologists to define three ordinal risk axes: Medical Urgency, Psychological Urgency, and Topic Sensitivity. We propose Clinical Guardrail Probes (CG-Probes) to measure the risks from query embeddings. We probe for each axis in the normalized embedding space of frozen embedders via the difference-in-means method, treating each axis as a potential linear direction. To train the probes, we cluster 79,658 Czech oncology search queries with BERTopic and use these clusters to generate pairs of queries with contrastive risk levels via few-shot prompting. We evaluate the approach on 200 queries (90 real, 110 synthetic), each graded by two oncologists, against two open-weight LLMs and a frontier LLM. We find that urgency-based axes are recoverable as linear directions, and the probes are competitive with open-weight LLMs (no significant differences in quadratic-weighted kappa) at a fraction of the latency. Each axis yields a scalar score that clinicians can inspect and use to set escalation thresholds. The pipeline requires only search logs, axis definitions, and black-box access to the embedding model, suggesting transferability across healthcare domains. Robust validation on new queries and axes remains future work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CG-Probes（临床护栏探针），通过在冻结嵌入模型的L2归一化空间中沿差值均值（difference-in-means）方向做点积，从患者查询嵌入中恢复出临床风险轴的标量分数，用于患者端AI助手的轻量级、可审计护栏。
AI.motivation: 患者端AI助手接收的查询风险跨度极大，从"哪里停车"到"我不想活了"，现有护栏方案（LLM安全对齐、LLM判官、规则过滤）无法同时满足低延迟、可检视、可审计、且提供分级风险评分的需求。
AI.method: 与肿瘤学家共同定义三条有序风险轴（医学紧急性MU、心理紧急性PU、话题敏感性TS，0-2级）。用BERTopic对79,658条捷克肿瘤学搜索查询聚类，再通过少样本提示生成对比风险等级的查询对。在四个冻结嵌入模型（含Qwen3-8B、Harrier-27B、text-emb-3-large、gemini-emb-2）上，用差值均值法估计每条轴的单一单位向量方向ŵ，查询分数即为该方向上的点积投影。控制主题混淆采用主题匹配配对＋按簇切分数据集。基线为gpt-oss-safeguard-20b、gpt-oss-120b、gpt-5.4；以二次加权kappa（QWK）为主要指标。
AI.result: 在90条真实临床标注查询上：MU轴探针QWK=0.65（与safeguard-20b的0.64无显著差异，低于gpt-5.4的0.73），PU轴=0.81（优于safeguard-20b的0.76，低于gpt-5.4的0.98）；TS轴仅0.58，不作排序。MU探针在28例真实急诊中无一漏检，而safeguard-20b漏8例；代价是19.5%的良性查询被升档。吞吐量约为LLM判官的30倍，避免了自回归生成。控制任务（随机打乱标签后macro-F1降至近随机水平）和反事实测试验证了方向确实编码目标概念。TS因主题匹配对无法构建而未能恢复为单一方向。
AI.conclusion: MU和PU等基于紧迫性的临床风险轴可作为冻结嵌入空间中的单一线性方向被恢复，CG-Probes以约30倍吞吐量与开源LLM判官表现相当且漏检急诊更少；但TS并非单一线性方向，需未来工作验证；该流程仅需搜索日志、轴定义和嵌入模型黑箱访问，提示可跨医疗领域迁移。

title: Do we need to answer that question? Salience and Answerability of Potential Questions in Naturalistic Dialogue
summary: We empirically investigate Question Under Discussion based modelling in naturalistic dialogue by studying whether the salience of generated potential questions predicts their subsequent resolution. Building on Wu et al. (2024), we construct a dataset of 7,124 questions automatically generated from utterances and preceding context from the British National Corpus, and annotated for salience and answerability. We find a robust but low positive correlation between salience and answerability in dialogue, indicating that more salient questions are more likely to be addressed. However, this effect is markedly weaker than in monologic text, suggesting that conversational structure is less predictable. We further observe that structured interactions exhibit stronger alignment between annotators than less organised dialogues.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过经验研究探讨了对话中"讨论中的问题"(Question Under Discussion, QUD)建模，基于英国国家语料库自动生成7,124个问题并进行显著性和可回答性标注，发现显著性与可回答性之间存在稳健但较低的正相关，且该效应弱于独白文本，表明对话结构可预测性较低。
AI.motivation: 研究QUD建模在自然对话中的有效性，检验生成问题的显著性是否能预测其在后续对话中是否被解答，以理解对话结构与独白文本结构在问题推进上的差异。
AI.method: 基于Wu等人(2024)的方法，从英国国家语料库(BNC)的对话发言及其上文语境中自动生成7,124个潜在问题，由标注者对这些问题的显著性(salience)和可回答性(answerability)进行人工标注，并通过统计分析(相关性分析)探究二者关系，同时比较不同对话结构下的标注一致性。
AI.result: 研究发现显著性(salience)与可回答性(answerability)之间存在稳健但较低的正相关(robust but low positive correlation)，表明更显著的问题更可能被回答；但该相关强度明显弱于独白文本中的表现。此外，结构化对话(如机构性对话)中的标注者一致性高于非组织化对话。
AI.conclusion: 对话中的问题推进结构比独白文本更难预测，结构性差异显著影响QUD建模的有效性；标注一致性受对话组织程度调节，提示未来对话理解建模需考虑交互结构类型。

title: Where a Model Sends Its Own Repeated Token
comment: 8 pages, 3 tables. Companion to arXiv:2608.10986 , arXiv:2608.21315 and arXiv:2609.29507 . Code, per-run results, pre-registrations and the findings ledger: this https URL (archived: this https URL )
summary: Black-box model identification works by scoring a model's response to natural-language prompts. One line of work feeds models a degenerate input -- their own token, repeated -- to find a failure mode rather than an identity. We take that input and ask where the model goes when it does not. For each token t, read argmax p(. | t, t) in one forward pass; the result is a map on the whole vocabulary, with two halves. The first -- which tokens are fixed points -- is partially anticipated, and we report it as a failed estimand: the natural distance on it is 83% cardinality, separates a corpus manipulation by two bits in 3471 against a precision floor of zero, and attributes families at 0.5833. The second half, where the map sends tokens that are not fixed points, is unrecorded; the one paper holding those tokens logged them as a zero. Pairing on the source token removes the cardinality confound by construction (r from 0.9128 to -0.0932) and attributes families at 0.8333 -- twelve models scored against a pool of nineteen -- with chance 0.1389, across seven tokenizer groups and several corpora. Two nulls clear it: frequency-matched destinations agree at 0.1429, independent marginals at 0.0798. Family predicts agreement better than tokenizer (0.2031 against 0.1205), and recurrent architectures cluster at balanced accuracy 1.0 against a 0.7895 majority rate, or 0.90 once each model's dominant destination is excluded -- the figure we stand behind. We measure the robustness envelope: 8-bit weight rounding moves the map less than deduplicating the training corpus does (0.9004 against 0.6353, on one support), 4-bit destroys it (0.0098; 0.1812 at deployment granularity, so not a coarseness artefact), and the precision floor varies by model from 0.201 to 0.9778. All estimands and kill conditions were registered before the data, and the failed one is reported as fully as the surviving one.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对黑盒模型识别任务,提出了一种基于"自重复令牌"的词汇表级目标映射(destination map)。通过对每个令牌 t 进行一次前向传播,读取 argmax p(·|t,t),作者将映射分为两半:固定点集(失败的估计量)和非固定点的目标位置(成功估计量)。通过在源令牌上配对比较,成功以 0.8333 的家族归属率(基线 0.1389)区分模型家族,且对8位权重量化的鲁棒性强于去重训练语料的影响。
AI.motivation: 现存的模型指纹识别方法依赖自然语言提示并对模型响应进行评分,但尚未有人系统性地研究模型在面对退化输入(自重复令牌)时的行为。论文的动机在于:(1)探索模型在非语言输入下的可识别信号;(2)揭示此前被忽略的"非固定点目标"信息——Hammouri et al. (2025)在表格中将这些单元记录为零,而本文正是利用这些被丢弃的信息进行模型归属。
AI.method: 方法核心是构建一个词汇表级的目标映射:对模型 M 的每个令牌 t,进行一次前向传播,记录 argmax p_M(·|t,t)。该映射包含两个部分——自延续位(self-continuation bit)和目标(destination)。比较时使用冻结的字符串索引(4090 个候选词,涵盖 Pile 语料高频词、ASCII 字符和空白符),通过共享字符串交集在跨模型间对齐(3471–3355 个字符串)。通过在源令牌上配对,构造共享目标位置的一致性统计;并设置预注册的"杀死条件"(kill condition)来评估每个估计量的有效性。
AI.result: 核心结果包括:(1)固定点集(E1)失败——汉明距离与集合基数的相关系数高达 r=0.9128,83% 的差异源自基数效应,家族归属率仅 0.5833;(2)非固定点目标(E2/E3)成功——配对比较使 r 降至 −0.0932,家族归属率达 0.8333(基线 0.1389),家族预测一致性优于分词器(0.2031 vs 0.1205);(3)鲁棒性——8位权重量化下目标映射一致性为 0.9004,优于去重训练语料的 0.6353,但4位量化将其破坏至 0.0098(分组粒度下为 0.1812);(4)数值精度方面,不同模型的精度下限差异巨大(0.201 至 0.9778)。
AI.conclusion: 论文的结论是:模型对其自重复令牌的响应——具体而言是"不重复时去往何处"——比"是否重复"本身更能揭示模型身份。目标映射构成一种新的黑盒模型指纹机制,在七个分词器组、多种语料的 19 个模型上有效,且对8位量化和去重训练语料具有鲁棒性。固定点集的失败被等长报告,以保持研究的诚实性。这一发现既可用于模型归属,也对模型架构和训练语料的因果分析提出了新问题。

title: RupeeBias: Auditing Demographic Bias in Indian Economic Guidance from Large Language Models
summary: Individuals turn to large language models (LLMs) for guidance across a wide range of economic tasks, from comparing loan options and planning savings to deciding what raise to ask for or how much to charge for their services. LLMs are known to reproduce social biases, and biased economic guidance may influence what users believe they are worth, what they ask for, and what they ultimately accept. This risk is especially salient in India, where economic outcomes are shaped by demographic categories such as caste and urban-rural location. Existing LLM bias benchmarks, however, are largely designed around Western demographic categories and therefore miss key axes of economic disparity in the Indian context. We introduce RupeeBias, a benchmark for auditing demographic bias in LLM-generated economic guidance across Indian economic settings. RupeeBias consists of 39,150 prompts spanning four use cases: salary estimation, salary increment estimation, counter-offer recommendation, and service pricing recommendation. The benchmark follows a single-attribute counterfactual design, holding the description of the user's qualifications, experience, or service offering fixed while varying one demographic identifier at a time. RupeeBias covers 87 India-specific demographic identifiers across six axes: caste, religion, regional identity, gender, disability, and urban-rural location, with all prompts constructed in both English and Hinglish. We evaluate nine LLMs on RupeeBias and find systematic demographic disparities across all six axes. For otherwise identical prompts that differ only in demographic identifier, LLM-generated economic outputs differ by 20.2% on average. We publicly release RupeeBias to support future research on demographic bias in LLM-generated economic guidance across India-specific demographic and economic contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍RupeeBias基准，针对印度科技行业场景，审计大语言模型在经济建议（薪资评估、涨薪估算、反报价建议、服务定价）中的人口统计学偏见，覆盖87个印度特有身份标识、6个偏见维度，使用英语和印地英语双语评估9个LLM，发现平均20.2%的输出差异。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM偏见基准主要围绕西方人口学类别设计，无法捕捉印度特有的经济不平等维度（如种姓、城乡地域）。随着LLM在印度的大规模使用及其在经济决策中的重要作用，评估模型是否对不同人口学群体提供不同的经济建议具有重要的现实意义。
AI.method: 构建39,150条提示，采用单属性反事实扰动设计，控制资历/经验等非人口学变量不变，仅改变单一人口学标识。覆盖4个用例（薪资/涨薪/反报价/服务定价）、87个标识、6个维度（种姓24、宗教12、地区30、性别5、残疾11、城乡5），双语构造。使用Mean Δ%、Violation@10%、Kendall's W等指标评估9个LLM。
AI.result: 9个LLM在所有6个人口学轴上均存在系统性差异，平均输出差异达20.2%。Gemini 3 Flash差距最小（8.1%），Sarvam 105B差距最大（37.9%）。城市-农村、残疾维度差距最显著。提示语言（英语vs印地英语）显著影响差异模式。公平指令干预对不同模型效果差异显著，部分模型出现"反弹"现象。Claude Opus 4.7差距适中但排序一致性最高（英语W=0.274，印地英语W=0.344）。
AI.conclusion: RupeeBias是首个针对印度语境LLM经济建议人口学偏见的大规模审计基准，证明大语言模型在相同条件下会因用户的人口学身份给出不同的薪资、涨薪、反报价和服务定价建议，平均差异达20.2%。维度差距大小与排序一致性反映不同的失效模式，单一指标不足以全面描述偏见状况，模型审计应同时报告这两类指标，并需要针对代码混合语言进行专门审计。

title: PIA: A Personal Intelligence Agent Turning Health Conversations into Records and Records into Understanding
summary: General-purpose agent memory summarizes conversations: it extracts salient snippets, embeds them, and retrieves the top-k into the prompt. A health agent cannot run on summaries: a dose becomes a sentence, "since last week" is resolved at the model's discretion, and a three-month glucose trend cannot be answered by text similarity. We present PIA, a personal intelligence agent deployed alongside a consumer health agent. PIA receives the agent's natural-language requests, decides for itself whether and how to write or read, and turns conversations into typed clinical records and records into a synthesized understanding of the user. Its memory harness consists of four controls -- extraction, memory, retrieval, and understanding -- each a domain-agnostic mechanism with a pluggable health module: schema, medical alias dictionary, knowledge graph, and temporal rules. We show how the same query receives a different answer as the memory injected into the response context deepens from one-dimensional recall, to a two-dimensional health snapshot, to a three-dimensional trajectory with causality, and report lessons from operation: self-reported health data are missing not at random, question phrasing governs the quality of synthesized understanding, and nearly a third of candidate causal links are structural noise that rules alone remove.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍PIA（Personal Intelligence Agent），一种部署在消费级健康代理旁边的个人智能代理。它将健康对话转化为类型化的临床记录，并将记录合成为对用户的整体理解。其核心是一个包含提取、记忆、检索和理解四个控制器的"记忆框架"，每个控制器都是领域无关机制与可插拔健康模块的组合。本文提出了理解阶梯（ladder of understanding）和个性化三维视角（1D回忆、2D健康快照、3D含因果关系的轨迹），并报告了实际运营中的经验教训。
AI.motivation: 通用代理记忆通过摘要对话、嵌入和检索top-k片段来工作，但健康代理无法依赖摘要运行：药物剂量变成句子，"自上周以来"由模型自行解释，三个月的血糖趋势无法通过文本相似性回答。健康场景需要类型化记录、确定性时间解析和综合用户理解，而非扁平化摘要。
AI.method: PIA的核心方法是一个四控制器"记忆框架"：(1) 提取控制——基于模式的结构化解码，将时间表达式按字面复制并由确定性解析器解析；(2) 记忆控制——临床记忆门（仅接受与医疗别名词典精确匹配的测试结果）和医学知识图谱标注；(3) 检索控制——决策条件回忆，将枚举/值/趋势请求路由到结构化检索，其余路由到关联回忆，并对召回结果"重新水化"以从字段获取值；(4) 理解控制——HU²（Holistic User Understanding）通过七个问题对整合记忆进行综合，并将推荐与观察分离。此外提出了理解阶梯（5级）和个性化三维视角（1D回忆→2D健康快照→3D含因果关系的轨迹）。
AI.result: 在合成测试用户上的评估结果：RETAIN决策精度100%、准确率94.9%、召回率89.1%；READ召回率91.0%；路由器工具选择准确率91.0%；MRR为0.785，Recall@k为0.763；存储判断通过率88.3%。部署记录存储中99.7%的测试结果有标准键，99.2%有概念标签，但仅66.6%有参考范围。三个运营经验教训：(1) 自我报告数据非随机缺失；(2) 问题措辞比模式更能决定综合理解质量；(3) 近三分之一的候选因果链接是结构噪声，可通过规则消除。
AI.conclusion: 健康代理需要记录而非摘要。PIA通过四控制器记忆框架（健康部分作为插件）将对话转化为类型化记录，并通过HU²将记录转化为对用户的理解。当前系统仅在理解阶梯的第1级（状态摘要）投入生产，向更高层级的攀升是未来的工作。评估仅基于合成用户；真实用户纵向评估因隐私原因无法报告。

title: Identifying Scientists on X
comment: Corrected version of Identifying Scientists on X published at Companion Publication of the 18th ACM Web Science Conference 2026
summary: With the growing importance of science-related discourse on the Web and the erosion of the classical knowledge order, it is important to identify different user groups, such as scientists, automatically. This work proposes an approach for identifying scientists and non- scientists on X/Twitter based on their user biographies and tweets. We show that we are able to classify accounts as scientists and non- scientists on two different datasets, reaching an F1 score of up to 0.88 using Random Forests with linguistic features and up to 0.96 using a contrastively fine-tuned DeBERTa model in an ensemble setup. Furthermore, we provide two datasets with X users labeled as scientists or non scientists and their respective tweets and user biographies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于X（原Twitter）用户推文和个人简介来自动识别科学家与非科学家的方法，构建了两个公开数据集（Orcid和Scholar），并通过特征工程和对比学习微调的DeBERTa模型实现高准确率分类。
AI.motivation: 随着科学相关网络话语的重要性日益增长，以及传统知识秩序的削弱（如COVID-19疫情期间虚假信息的快速传播），自动识别科学家用户群体对于研究科学话语模式、理解科学家与其他群体的互动以及应对错误信息至关重要。然而以往的研究要么局限于特定学科，要么依赖网络特征或Twitter/X列表等现已难以获取的信息。
AI.method: 1）构建两个数据集：Orcid通过正则表达式匹配用户简介中的ORCID编号；Scholar基于Mongeon等人提供的通过DOI推文匹配OpenAlex的已验证科学家账户ID（61,645个真阳性账户）。2）特征工程方法：提取词汇（词类比、拼写错误、可读性等）、句法（依存树深度等）、X特有（表情、标签、提及数量）、情感及主题特征（BERTopic、SciTweets），结合用户简介中的关键词和正则匹配（如"professor"、"PhD"等），使用SVM、随机森林、逻辑回归和AdaBoost分类。3）对比学习方法：使用DeBERTa模型分别通过对比损失（Contrastive Loss）和三元组损失（Triplet Loss）在推文和简介上进行微调，并构建集成模型融合两种模态信息。
AI.result: 在Scholar数据集上：随机森林结合关键词特征取得F1=0.88，对比学习微调的DeBERTa集成模型取得F1=0.96（准确率0.96）。在Orcid数据集上：AdaBoost结合关键词取得F1=0.82。特征分析显示关键词匹配和主题得分是最重要特征，词汇多样性（CTTR/TTR）也有重要作用。用户简介比推文提供更多身份识别信息，集成推文和简介信息效果最佳。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了仅依靠推文和个人简介的文本特征即可在不限学科领域的情况下准确识别X平台上的科学家用户。对比学习方法显著优于传统特征工程方法，但缺乏可解释性。研究的局限在于只能识别在简介中透露职业信息的科学家，且随机抽样的非科学家可能含有未被识别的科学家。未来工作将扩展到识别记者和政治家等其他用户群体，并通过数据增强和特征与PLM的集成进一步提升性能。

title: Stale-Document Poisoning: When Outdated Retrieval Overrides Correct Model Answers
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is often used to address outdated knowledge by providing external evidence. But retrieval helps only when that evidence is still valid. We identify a temporal alignment failure, stale-document poisoning, in which outdated evidence makes a model wrong despite answering correctly without retrieval. We construct a benchmark of 317 verified knowledge reversals across medicine, law, software, and platform policy, grounded in dated official sources. Across 12 models, recent medical reversals are harder than long-established ones. More importantly, outdated retrieval flips 30% of Llama and 37% of Qwen answers even without instructions to trust the document; explicit follow instructions raise these rates to 66% and 75%. Across four open models and four domains, poisoning ranges from 17-91%, while matched up-to-date evidence is followed in 97-100% of trials. To isolate temporal applicability, we keep the historical evidence unchanged across 50 reversals and vary only the evaluation date. A clear pattern emerges: dates alone produce only modest adaptation, but when models are explicitly told when the old evidence stops applying, the larger models switch to the appropriate answer almost perfectly. Causal interventions confirm that this validity information directly shapes the final decision. The same internal components also support broader comparison tasks, suggesting that temporal applicability can recruit a general reasoning mechanism used for other comparisons. Finally, a fixed recency-aware hybrid re-ranker reduces poisoning by 4.6-10.0 points when dates are accurate, with gains that depend on reliable temporal metadata. Reliable RAG therefore requires selective trust: models must determine not only what retrieved evidence says, but whether it still applies.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"过期文档投毒"（Stale-Document Poisoning）问题：当检索增强生成（RAG）系统检索到的文档已过时，模型会因信任该文档而放弃原本正确的答案。研究构建了317个经过来源验证的知识反转基准，跨12个模型在医学、法律、软件和平台政策四个领域进行实验，发现即使没有明确指令，仅一条过时证据就足以使30%的Llama和37%的Qwen答案被翻转，而附带"遵循文档"指令后这一比例升至66%和75%。关键发现是：日期信息本身不足以让模型判断证据是否仍然适用，但显式告知有效性边界时，大模型几乎能完美切换正确答案。因果干预显示模型内部存在由注意力主导的通用比较机制，检索端的混合重排序器在日期准确时可降低4.6–10.0个百分点的投毒率。
AI.motivation: 检索增强生成（RAG）常被用于解决模型知识过时问题，但被检索的证据本身可能已过时却仍被表面可信地呈现。以往研究关注上下文与参数化知识的冲突，本文聚焦一个更具体的问题：当模型原本能正确回答时，是否能判断检索证据是否仍然适用——即"选择性认知信任"的失败。医学指南、法律先例、API等领域的知识持续更新，使该问题具有重要现实意义。
AI.method: （1）构建317个来源验证的知识反转基准（医学87、法律100、软件60、平台政策70），每项包含及时答案、过时答案及配套文档；（2）跨12个模型（含GPT-4o、Claude-Opus、DeepSeek、Qwen2.5、Llama-3.1、MedGemma等）测量行为投毒率；（3）控制实验：固定同一历史证据仅改变评估日期以隔离时间适用性；（4）因果干预：在评估日期位置进行双向激活补丁，分离注意力与MLP贡献，并做头级别定位及特异性测试；（5）检索端测试：混合重排序器结合语义相关性、文档时效性和超代提示；（6）自动评判器经双模型交叉验证（κ=0.93）和200份人类盲标验证（准确率92.5%）。
AI.result: （1）所有12个模型在"已定型"医学反转上接近天花板准确率，但在近期反转上显著下降（如Qwen-7B降至0.61，Llama-8B降至0.64）；（2）单条过时文档在所有四个领域都能翻转原本正确的答案，医学最高（Llama-70B 91%，Qwen-72B 85%），软件较低（17–35%）；GPT-5.5无检索时准确率92%–100%，但74/83的医学正确答案被翻转；（3）仅改变日期产生的判别力很小，但显式标注有效性边界时，Qwen-72B完成全部50次转换，Llama-70B完成47–50次；（4）因果补丁在Qwen-72B转移23.08个logit，在Llama-70B转移7.82个logit，匹配控制接近零；（5）注意力是早期主要贡献者（Llama-70B第31层0.91 vs MLP的-0.17），同组头在日期比较和数值阈值任务上同样活跃，表明调用的是通用比较机制；（6）"遵循文档"指令显著放大投毒（Qwen OR=4.92，Llama OR=4.50）；（7）混合重排序器在日期准确时降低投毒4.6–10.0个百分点，但日期错误或缺失时收益消失甚至逆转。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的RAG需要"选择性认知信任"：模型必须判断检索证据是否仍然适用，而非机械地遵循上下文。发布日期与适用期是不同元数据；未来系统应使用显式的有效期、超代关系等结构化时间信息。检索端的时效性重排序在元数据可靠时有用，但不能替代对证据是否适用的判断。该研究暴露了标准RAG评估的盲区——应同时检验"有效证据能否纠正过时模型"和"过时证据是否会损害已正确的模型"。

title: Muslim: A Deployed Arabic Voice AI Platform for Grounded Islamic Knowledge
comment: 6 pages, 4 tables. Deployed system: this https URL - released models: this https URL
summary: We present Muslim, a production Arabic voice AI platform serving grounded, sourced Islamic knowledge to real users. Beyond a real-time voice pipeline (NeMo Arabic ASR, an OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint, self-hosted TTS) and a deterministic multi-source retrieval layer routed across six Model Context Protocol servers, we report three things a research prototype typically lacks. First, a released family of fine-tuned Arabic Islamic model artifacts: an efficient tool-routing LLM (Muslim-6B-PRO, 5.94B parameters) and a Modern Standard Arabic TTS model (Fasih-TTS-V1) that ranks 5th of 17 overall and 2nd of 11 open-weight systems on the community-voted Arabic TTS Arena for MSA. Second, an account and metering layer - a free per-account turn allowance, capacity-aware refusal, and email verification deferred to the point it actually matters - that turns an open demo into an operable, abuse-resistant product. Third, a three-layer observability stack (liveness, error reporting, product analytics) built specifically around the system's characteristic failure mode: a GPU-bound agent host going silent while the web tier keeps serving normally. We report real, measured latency and accuracy figures (98.4% recitation-validation accuracy on 124 cases; end-to-end voice latency of 0.9-1.7s) and discuss the concrete engineering trade-offs and limitations of running an Islamic-knowledge voice product in production.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个已部署的阿拉伯语语音 AI 平台 Muslim，用于提供有根据、有出处的伊斯兰知识。作者重点报告了三个超出研究原型的方面：发布的微调模型族（Muslim-6B-PRO 工具路由 LLM 和 Fasih-TTS-V1 阿拉伯语 TTS 模型）、账户与计量层（将开放演示转化为可运营、抗滥用的产品），以及针对特定故障模式的三层可观测性栈。报告了实际测量的延迟和准确率数据。
AI.motivation: 商用语音助手在阿拉伯语处理上表现欠佳，对伊斯兰教问题依赖参数记忆而非引用经文，且对话路由经第三方云基础设施。在误引圣训会造成真实伤害的领域，这些都是重大缺陷。本文将 Muslim 作为已部署系统而非原型来报告，填补现有商用方案在阿拉伯语、伊斯兰知识检索归因、以及算力组件由运营方自托管方面的空白。
AI.method: 系统采用微服务架构：浏览器通过 WebRTC (LiveKit) 连接无状态语音代理，运行 Silero VAD、NVIDIA NeMo Arabic FastConformer ASR、OpenAI 兼容 LLM 端点、自托管 TTS，通过 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 在六个知识服务器间路由工具调用。混合部署拓扑：Web/账户层在托管平台，语音代理与 GPU 密集型服务在单一自托管主机。检索层使用确定性多源查找（Tafsir 直接 JSON 查找、5 万+ 条圣训的本地服务器、《古兰经》音频流式传输），伊斯兰知识从不从参数记忆生成。发布两款微调模型：Muslim-6B-PRO（5.94B 参数 Qwen3 架构的 QLoRA 微调工具路由 LLM）和 Fasih-TTS-V1（Coqui XTTS v2 微调，1,297 条 MSA 片段）。账户层采用单一服务器路由、签发令牌内嵌权利、30 轮滚动 24 小时配额、容量感知拒绝、延迟邮箱验证。可观测性采用从代理向外发送心跳、三态健康端点、错误上报与精简漏斗分析。
AI.result: 诵经验证器在 124 例测试集上达到 98.4% 准确率；端到端语音延迟 0.9–1.7 秒；ASR 平均延迟 235.5 毫秒（RTF 0.025）；LLM 首 token 平均延迟 519.7 毫秒；在 30 个伊斯兰问题测试中检索成功率达 100%，RAG 条件仅比参数记忆回答多约 50 毫秒。Fasih-TTS-V1 在社区投票的 Arabic TTS Arena 中于 2026-08-18 快照排名 MSA 第 5（共 17 个系统）、开源权重系统第 2（共 11 个）。可靠性的证据包括超过 1,000 个自动化测试（889 个 Python + 119 个 TypeScript）。
AI.conclusion: Muslim 平台通过将阿拉伯语（包括古兰经阿拉伯语）作为一等公民、严格检索归因、以及算力密集组件由运营方自托管三条原则，证明可以在生产环境中运行伊斯兰知识语音产品。论文贡献不仅在于语音技术，还包括把研究原型转变为真实产品的工程取舍（账户/计量/可观测性）。存在的局限性包括：单主机可用性瓶颈、无方言阿拉伯语优化、无正式用户研究、RAG 覆盖范围边界（覆盖外问题回退到参数知识）、Muslim-6B-PRO 缺乏量化基准结果、Arabic TTS Arena 排名可能变动。

title: MexHat: A Dataset for Hate Speech Detection in Mexican Spanish Videos
summary: Ensuring online safety through content monitoring had raised Hate Speech Detection as a crucial task to be addressed. By essence the task demands the capture of contextual cues, which are essential for a precise understanding of the content's intent. Although automated detection approaches for the task have advanced significantly, the scarcity of non-English resources persists, limiting the ability of models to adapt to the subtle, context-dependent, and culturally related nature of multimodal content. In this paper, we introduce MexHat, a video dataset designed to capture the linguistic and cultural cues for the hate-speech detection task in a Mexican Spanish context. Our dataset comprises around 1k video clips annotated across two tasks: a three-way class evaluation (no negative content, offensive content and hate-speech content), and a fine-grained class evaluation including three hate-speech sub-categories. The dataset statistics and the baseline results highlight the inherent challenges associated with the task. Disclaimer: This paper contains sensitive content that may be disturbing to some readers.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了MexHat，一个用于墨西哥西班牙语视频仇恨言论检测的多模态数据集，包含约1378个视频片段，标注了无负面内容、冒犯性内容和仇恨言论三类及仇恨言论的三个子类别，并提供了基线实验结果。
AI.motivation: 现有的仇恨言论检测研究主要以英语为主，缺乏针对西班牙语（特别是墨西哥西班牙语）及文化背景下的多模态资源。同时，仇恨言论的检测需要结合上下文和文化线索，单一文本模态难以捕捉复杂的敌意行为。因此，亟需构建针对特定语言和文化背景的多模态数据集。
AI.method: 1. 数据收集：从YouTube平台通过仇恨言论相关词汇（含墨西哥冒犯性用语）、种子视频和频道播放列表三种方式筛选视频，并分割为1分钟片段（约8k片段）。2. 标注过程：16名标注者基于联合国仇恨言论定义进行三分类（无负面、冒犯、仇恨言论）和细粒度子分类（种族/民族歧视hs1、性别/LGBTQ+歧视hs2、其他hs3）标注，附带置信度评估。3. 特征提取：使用Whisper转录音频，BETO编码文本，I3D提取视频RGB和光流特征，VGGish提取音频特征。4. 基线模型：使用MLP和Transformer+MLP模型评估单模态、双模态和三模态融合在两类任务上的性能。
AI.result: 最终数据集包含1378个视频片段（三分类标注），标注一致性κ值分别为0.416（三分类）和0.514（细粒度）。实验结果显示：1. 三分类任务中，A+T（音频+文本）MLP配置表现最佳，准确率0.568，宏F1为0.423，但多数配置准确率低于0.5。2. 细粒度分类任务性能显著下降，最佳宏F1仅为0.247（T+A配置）。3. 文本模态单独使用或与音频结合时表现最优，但难以有效识别仇恨言论类别（特别是hs1子类别）。4. 案例分析表明，文本、音频和视觉多模态整合对理解讽刺性内容中的真实意图至关重要。
AI.conclusion: MexHat是首个针对墨西哥西班牙语的多模态仇恨言论检测视频数据集。实验证明仇恨言论的识别高度依赖文化和语境，在墨西哥场景中，语言线索使得无害幽默与冒犯意图之间的界限非常模糊。文本模态（单独或结合其他模态）能提供较强的初始性能，但准确区分仇恨言论仍具挑战，需要更精细的多模态线索整合策略。未来工作需针对类别不平衡问题调整评估方法以提升性能。

title: Strategically Diverse Sampling for Self-Training
summary: Many LLM training and inference methods, including RL and test-time scaling, depend on repeated sampling, but benefit only when the responses meaningfully differ. Self-training faces the same challenge: training data is typically constructed by sampling IID responses and filtering primarily for correctness, thereby overrepresenting strategies a model already favours. We investigate strategic diversity, or substantive variation among approaches to a problem, as an alternative principle for constructing self-training data. We generate strategically diverse data with two sampling methods: GROOT, a new method which constructs a hierarchical tree of approaches and samples distinct paths, and Verbalized Sampling (VS), adapted to produce an unstructured set of approaches. Across competitive programming and Next-Chapter Prediction domains, models trained on strategically sampled data outperform IID-trained counterparts on difficult tasks and provide strong initializations for RL and test-time scaling. Most strikingly, self-training on strategically diverse but incorrect traces from Qwen3-4B outperforms IID distillation from a 235B teacher. These results challenge prevailing assumptions about what makes useful self-training data and show that diversity of approaches can matter more than correctness or teacher scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"策略多样性"（strategic diversity）作为自训练数据构建的新原则，通过两种采样方法——结构化的Groot（层次策略树）和非结构化的Verbalized Sampling (VS)——生成多样化解题路径，挑战了以正确性和教师规模为核心的现有自训练范式。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM训练方法（RL、测试时缩放、自训练）依赖重复采样，但IID采样会导致策略坍缩（mode collapse），即模型反复采样同一策略，造成RL梯度消失和测试时聚合失效。标准自训练管线仅基于正确性过滤，进一步加剧了策略集中化。
